(41) iko yaṇaci |6|1|77|
ikoyaṇaci | pratyāhāragrahaṇeṣu tadvācyavācye nirūḍhā lakṣaṇā,
ṭhyūstryākhyau’ ‘vādibhyaḥ’ iti ca nirdeaśāt | tena ikśabdena
ṣaṭṣaṣṭirgṛhyante, yaṇśabdena catvāraḥ, bhāvyamānasyā’ṇaḥ
savarṇāgrāhakatvāt | evaṃ ceha yaṇi tadvācyavācye lakṣaṇā tu na
śaṅkyaiva, bhāvyamānasyā’ṇaḥ savarṇagrāhakatvā’bhāvena
yaṇvācyayakārādivācyānāmabhāvāt | ato nāsti yathāsaṅkhyam | na
ca lakṣyārthabodhātpūrvabhāvinaṃ śakyārthajñānamādāya
yathāsaṅkhyamastviti vācyam; evamapi
tṛtīyacaturthābhyumṛkāralṛkārābhyāṃ pratyekaṃ triṃśadupasthitau
lṛvarṇānāṃ rephādeśasya, Añvarṇānāṃ lādeśasya ca prasaṅgāt |
tasmādiha ‘thāne’ntaratamaḥ’ iti sūtreṇaiveṣṭasiddhirityanupadaṃ
vakṣyati-ṭhsthānata āntaryā’diti | acīti | ‘asmādaci pare’
ityākāṅkṣāyāmarthādika iti saṃbadhyate | saṃhitāyāṃ viṣaya iti |
‘adhyatre’-tyādau kāryinimitayoryadā’tiśayitasaṃnidhirvivakṣyate
tadaiva yaṇbhavatīti bhāvaḥ | 
(42) anaci ca |8|4|47|
anaci ca | yaro dve veti | ṭhyaro’nunāsike’ iti sūtrādyaro veti
cānuvartate | ṭhaco rahābhyām’ iti sūtrādayo dve iti ca, tadāha-acaḥ
parasyetyādi | evaṃ cātra ṭhvā’grahaṇānuvṛtyaiveṣṭasiddheḥ
‘riprabhṛtiṣu śākaṭāyanasya’ ‘arvatra śākalyasya’
dīrghādācāryāṇām’ iti ca sūtratrayaṃ nārambhaṇāyamiti bhāvaḥ | aca iti
kim ?, ‘ādātmya’mityādau masya dvitvaṃ mā bhūt | ṭhanacī’ti yadi
paryudāsaḥ syātato ‘añivayuktamanyasadṛśe tathā hyarthagati’riti
nyāyādajbhinne’csadṛśe varṇe halītyarthaḥ syāt, tato
lāghabāddhalītyeva vadet, tasmātprasajyapratiṣedha ityāha-na tvacīti |
evaṃ cābasāne’pi dvitvaṃ bhavati-vākk vāk |
(43) sthānivadādeśo’nalvidhau |1|1|56|
sthānivadādeśo | ādeśe kṛte
svarūpabhedātsthāniprayuktakāryāṇapravṛtāvatideśa ārabhyate |
ṭhasterbhūḥ’ | ārdhadhātuke vivakṣite dhātvādeśo dhātuvat | tena
ṭhaco ya’-dityādidhātupratyayaḥ-bhavyaṃ babhūva | ‘imaḥ kaḥ’ |
aṅgādeśo’ṅgavat | tena inādeśadīrghaisvabhāvāḥ | kena kābhyāṃ
kaiḥ | ādeśagrahaṇaṃ kimartham ?, ‘thāniva’dityetāvataiva
saṃbandhiśabdamahimnā tallābhāt, yathā ‘itṛvadadhīte’ ityukte ‘utra’
iti gamyate iti cedatrāduḥ,--dvividha ādeśaḥ,-pratyakṣa
ānumānikaśceti | ṭhasterbhūḥ’ ityādiḥ pratyakṣaḥ | ‘estuḥ’
ityādistvānumānikaḥ | ṭheruḥ’ ityatra hi ikāreṇekārāntaḥ sthānī
anumīyate, ukāreṇa cokārānta ādeśaḥ | tathāca ‘estu’riti
phalito’rthaḥ, tatrāsatyādeśagrahaṇe pratyakṣasyaiva grahaṇaṃ
syānnatvānumānikasya | ādeśagrahaṇasāmarthyātūbhayaparigrahaḥ, tena
pacatvityādestiṅntatvātpadasaṃjñā sidhyatīti | nanu ṭheru’-rityādi
yathāśrutamevāstu, ekadeśavikṛtasyā’nanyatvātpadatvaṃ bhaviṣyatīti
cennaḥ, arthavatyeva sthānādeśabhāvaviśrāntervācyatvātasyaivā’tra
prasaṅgā’saṃbhavāt | tathāhi-ṭhṣaṣṭhī sthāneyoge’tyuktam | sthānaṃ ca
prasaṅgaḥ | sa cārthavataḥ , arthapratyayārthaṃ śabdaprayogāt | yadyapi
cleḥ sijādāvasaṃbhavīdaṃ, tathāpi sati saṃbhave arthaprayukta eva
prasaṅgo grāhya ityanenaivādeśagrahaṇena jñāpyate | uktaṃ ca--sarve
sarvapadādeśā dākṣīputrasya pāṇine | ekadeśāvikāre hi nityatvaṃ
nopapadyate’ || iti padamihārthavat, padyate’neneti vyutpateḥ | yadyapi
sarvavikāre sutarāṃ nityatvānupapati stathāpīha vikāra eva
nāstīti tātparyam | etacca śabdakaustubhe spaṣṭam || analvidhāviti
kim ?| yaścālā vidhiḥ, yaścālaḥ parasya vidhiḥ, yaścālo vidhiḥ,
yaścāli vidhistatra mā bhūt | tatrā’lā vidhau yathā--vyūḍhoraskena |
atra sakārasya sthānivatvena visargavadaṭtvamāśritya ṭhaḍvyavāye’ iti
ṇatvaṃ prāptam | alaḥ parasya yathā--dyauḥ, panthāḥ | iha
halṅyādilopo na | alo vidhau yathā--dyaukāmaḥ | lopo
vyorvalī’ti lopo na | na cotvavidhisāmarthyāllopona bhavediti
śaṅkyam ; ‘yauyāna’mityādau tasya sāvakāśatvāt | ali
vidhau--yajeḥ ktaḥ | ka iṣṭaḥ | ṭhhaśi ce’tyutvaṃ na | na ceha
sthānibadbhāvena jātepyutve ādguṇe’vādeśe ca kṛte ṭhhali
sarveṣām’ iti nityaṃ lopena ‘a iṣṭa’ iti rūpaṃ sidhyatyeveti
vācyam ; ‘ayiṣṭa’ iti rūpāntarā’siddhiprasaṅgāt | siddhānte tu
‘hobhagoaghoapūrvasye’ti yasya lopavikalpe ‘a iṣṭaḥ’ ‘ayiṣṭa’
iti rūpadvayamabhyupagamyate | alaṃ ceha sthānyavayava eva gṛhyate, tena
‘āmāye’tyādau ‘upi ce’ti dīrghaḥ sidhdyati, tadvidhau hi
yañāditvamāśritam | yañ cādeśāvayavo na tu sthānyavayavaḥ | tathā
ṭharuditā’mityādau ṭhrudādibhyaḥ-’ iti valādilakṣaṇa iṭ ca sidhyati |
tadetadāhṛna tu sthānyalāśraya #iti | āśrayaṇaṃ ceha yathākathañcinna tu
prādhānyenaivetyāgrahaḥ | tena ‘rapaṭhaḷe’tyatra valādilakṣaṇa iṇna ||
(44) acaḥ parasminpūrvavidhau |1|1|57|
acaḥ parasminpūrvavidhau | acaḥ kim ? | āgatya | ṭhvā
lyapī’tyanunāsikalopastuki kartavye na sthānivat | parasmin
kim ?| ādīdhye | nityatvādiṭ, etvam, tacca na paranimitam,
tena ṭhyīvarṇayo’riti lope kartaṃvye tanna sthānivat |
pūrvavidhau iti kim ?, naidheyaḥ | nipūrvāddhāñaḥ ṭhupasarge ghoḥ kiḥ’
ṭhāto lopaḥ’, ‘vyacaḥ’ ṭhitaścāniñaḥ’ iti ḍhak | ākārasya
sthānivatve tu tryactvavyapadeśena dvyactvaṃ viruddhatvādvādhyeta |
nahi triputro dviputravyapadeśaṃ labhate | nanvevamapi vidhigrahaṇaṃ
vyartham, pūrvasyeti ṣaṣṭaḷa kārye kartavye ityarthasyākṣeptuṃ
śakyatvāditi cennaḥ, pūrvasya vidhiḥ, pūrvasmādvidhiriti
samāsadvayalābhārthaṃ vidhigrahaṇāt | yadyapyatra pañcamīsamāsapakṣo mūle
noktaḥ, tathāpi ‘ūrvasmādapi vidhau sthānivadbhāva’ iti pakṣe tu
ṭhaḍvyavāye’ ityevātra ṇatvamiti ‘adda’nnādipraghaṭṭake svīkṛtaḥ saḥ
| alvidhyarthamidamiti | tena ṭhvavraśce’tyatra vasya samprasāraṇaṃ na,
uradatvasya sthānivatvena samprasāraṇatayā ‘a samprasāraṇe’ iti
niṣedhāt | na coradatvaṃ paranimitaṃ neti vācyam, aṅgākṣipte
pratyaye pare tadvidhānāt | pūrvasmādvidhiḥ pūrvavidhiriti
pañcamīsamāsapakṣasya tu prayojanam-tanvanti, tanvate | iha
yaṇādeśasya sthānivadbhāvānneṭ | atra hi ‘anityaṅga’nemitam,
tacca sthānibhūtādukārātpūrvamiti | nanvidaṃ na prayojanam,
bahiraṅgasya yaṇo’siddhatvādiḍāgamasyātrā’prasakteḥ | na ca
nājānantarye’ iti niṣedhaḥ | ṭhyatrāntaraṅge bahiraṅge
vā’corānantaryam’ iti haradatādimate niṣedhapravatāvapi ṭhutarakārye
yatrāca ānantaryamāśritaṃ tatra bahiṣṭvapraklṛptirne’ti kaiyaṭamate
tadabhāvāt | na caivamapīpacanniti prayojanaṃ bhavatyeva, iha hi
anterakārasya caṅkārasya ca ṭhato guṇe’ iti pararūpe tasya ca
parādivadbhāvājjhigrahaṇena grahaṇe sati ‘ijabhyaste’ti jus
prāpnoti, ṇilopasya ekādeśasya vā sthānivadbhāvānna bhavatīti
vācyam, veterhi laḍayevānantaro jhiḥ sambhavatīti
tatsāhacaryādabhyastādapi laṅ eva jherjusvidhānāt | na ca sicā
sāhacaryālluṅ eva grahaṇamastviti śaṅkyam , ṭhvipratiṣedhe
param’ iti parasāhacaryasya valīyastvāt | na caivamapi
ṭhadabhyastā’dityadādeśasya nivāraṇāya pañcamīsamāsapakṣa āvaśyaka iti
vācyam, caṅkārasya anterakāreṇa ca ṭhato guṇe’ iti pararūpe kṛte
jhasyābhāvadadādeśāprasakteḥ | atra tvekādeśasya
parādivadbhāvājjhagrahaṇena grahaṇaṃ na bhavati; alvidhau
antādivadbhāvā’pravṛteḥ | anyathā ṭhayaje indra’mityādau savarṇadīrgho
durvāra eva syāt | astu vā parādivadbhāvastathāpi jhakārasya
atsyādityadādeśe kartavye’ntādeśo na sthānivat, alvidhitvāt |
tasmātpañcamīsamāsapakṣo nirarthaka eveti
cedatrāhuḥ-pañcamīsamāsaprayojanatayā arītacannityudāharato
bhagavatastu neha sāhacaryaṃ niyāmakatayā saṃmatam | ‘vitriścatur-’
iti sūtre kṛtvorthagrahaṇājjñāpakātsāhacaryaṃ na sarvatrāśrīyate | evaṃ
ca bhavateryaṅluki abyastāśrayasya jusaḥ pravṛtyā ṭhabobhūvu’riti
rūpaṃ sidhyati, ṭhāta’ iti niyamasya sicaḥ paratvamāśritya yo
jusprāptastanmātraparatayā mādhavādibhirvyākhyātatvāt | ata eva
ṭhabhyastāśrayo jus, nityatvādvuk, abobhūvuḥ’, iti mūle
yaṅluṅnteṣūktam | tathā cā’pīpacannityetatsiddhaye pañcamīsamāsa
pakṣa āśrayaṇīya iti | anyetvāhuḥ-pañcamīsamāsapakṣaprayojanatayā
bhāṣye ‘ebhiditā’ ‘āthitikaḥ’ ityasyāpyudāhṛtatvānna tasya
vaiyarthyaśaṅkā kāryā | yadyapi yaṅe’kāralopasya sthānivadbhāvaṃ
vināpi ṭhekāca upadeśe’nudātā’dityatra
vihitaviśeṣaṇāśrayaṇādeva iṇniṣedhāpravṛtau
bhideryaṅntātṛciṭhbebhidite’ti rūpaṃ susādham, tathāpi
‘āthitika’ ityādisidhdyarthaṃ sa pakṣo’bhyupagantavyaḥ | na ca mathitaṃ
paṇyamasya māthitika ityatrāpi ‘adasya paṇyam’ iti ṭhaki ikādeśe ca
kṛte ṭhyasyeti ce’ti lopāt ṭhisusuktāntāt’ iti ikaḥ sthāne
prasajyamāno yaḥ kādeśaḥ so’pyallopasya sthānivadbhāvaṃ vinaiva
supariharaḥ,, ‘hasyekaḥ’ ityatra ‘thānyādeśayorakāra uccāraṇārthaḥ’
ityabhyupagame alvidhitvena sthānivadbhāvā’pravṛtyā ṭhasthānika
ikādeśaṣṭho na bhavatīti kādeśā’prasaktermāthitika iti rūpasiddhau
kimanena pañcamīsamāsapakṣāśrayaṇeneti vācyam, mathitayate kvipi
ṭilopāṇilopayorverapṛktalope ca-mathit, tena carati māthitika
ityatra ‘arati’ iti ṭhaki tasyekādeśasiddhaye tatpakṣasyāvaśyakatvāt |
na hyatra sthānivadbhāvaṃ vināpi ikādeśāpavādaḥ kādeśaḥ
suparihāraḥ, nāpyetādṛśakalpanāyāṃ mānā’bhāvaḥ śaṅkayaḥ,
‘āthitika’ iti bhāṣyodāharaṇasyaiva mānatvāditi |
syādetat,-pūrvatvasya sāvadhitvena saṃnihatasyaivāvadhitvamucitaṃ,
saṃnihitaṃ ceha trayaṃ,--sthānī ādeśo nimitaṃ ca, tatra tāvatsthānī
nā’vadhiḥ | tasyādeśenāpahārāt | nāpyādeśanimite,
ṭhvaiyākaraṇa’ ityatraikārasyāyādeśāpaterityāśaṅkāyāha-acaḥ
pūrvatvena dṛṣṭasyeti | pūrvatvamupalakṣaṇaṃ na tu viśeṣaṇamiti
bhāvaḥ ||
(45) na
padāntadvirvacanavareyalopasvarasavarṇā’nusvāradīrghajaścarvidhiṣu
|1|1|58|
na padānta | padāntādīnāṃ carantānāṃ dvandvaḥ, tato ṭhvidhi’ śabdena
karmaṣaṣṭhaḷntasya samāsaḥ | vidhiśabdaśca bhāvasādhano-vidhānaṃ
vidhiriti | sa ca dvandvānte śrūyamāṇatvāṃtpratyekaṃ saṃbadhyate | padasya
caramāvayava iti | vṛkṣaṃ vetīti vṛkṣavīḥ, vṛkṣaṃ vātīti vṛkṣavāḥ |
tamācaṣṭe vṛkṣavayati | tato vic | vṛkṣav | iha ‘opo
vyorvalī’ti valopo na, ṭilopasya ṇilopasya vā sthānivatvāt |
na ca ‘ubantāṇṇi’jiti haradatādimate antarvartisupā padatvāt ‘a
padānte’ti niṣedhaḥ śaṅkyaḥ, vidheyasya lopasya padānavayavatvāt |
‘adāntasya sthāne vidhau ne’ti vyākhyāne tu ‘a padānte’ti
sthānivatvaniṣedhādvalopaḥ syādevetyādi manoramāyāṃ sthitam |
dvirvacanādau ceti | yalopādaya ādiśabdārthaḥ | ṭhvare’ iti tu vare
yo’jādeśaḥ sa na sthānivaditi vyākhyeyam | sahavivakṣābhāve’pi
nipātanāddvandvaḥ saptamyalukva |
athodāharaṇāni-padānte-kāni santi, kau staḥ | iha yaṇāvādeśayoḥ
kartavyayoḥ śnasorallopo na sthānivat | na cekāraukārayoḥ
sthānibhūtādacaḥ pūrvatvavirahādevā’llopo na sthānivaditi
vācyam, ṭhvākyādapoddhṛtya padāni saṃskillopo na sthānivaditi
udāhāryam | atra hi vopasthānyakārātpūrvatvena dṛṣṭatvādokārasya
| dvirvacane-suddhayupāsyaḥ | ‘ājānantarye’ iti
niṣedhādbahiraṅgaparibhāṣā’tra na pravartate,
sthānivadbhāvaniṣedhasāmarthyācca | evaṃ kvacidanyatrāpyūhyam |
vare-yāyāvaraḥ | yāteryaṅntādyaśca yaṅ iti varac | ṭhato lopaḥ’ |
sa ca ṭhāto lopa iṭi ce’tyālope kartavye na sthānivat |
yalope-yātiḥ | yāteryaṅntāt ktic | ato lopaḥ | yalopaḥ |
allopasya sthānivatvādāto lopaḥ | yalopaḥ | na ca punarālopaḥ
śaṅkayaḥ | ciṇo luṅnyāyena
ālopasyāsiddhatvātsthānivadbhāvācca | nanu yadi yalopavidhiṃ prati
sthānivatvaniṣedhastarhi kathaṃ-vāyvoriti ?| ucyate-ṭhasiddhaṃ
bahiraṅgam’ iti yaṇo’siddhatvānna yalopaḥ | na ca ‘ājānantarye’ iti
niṣedhaḥ, antaraṅgakārye aca ānantaryaṃ yatra tatraiva tadabhyupagamāt |
kiṃ cātra ‘varadirghayalopeṣu lopājādeśa eva na sthāniva’diti
vārtikamasti | tenā’nyaḥ stānivadeva bhavatīti na doṣaḥ |
svare-cikīrṣakaḥ | īkārasya ‘itī’tyudātatve kartavye sano’to
lopo na sthānivat | na ca ‘itī’tyārambhasāmarthya, ‘āraka’
ityādau sāvakāśatvāt | savarṇānusvārayoḥ-śiṇḍḍhi |
śnasorallopo na sthānivat | yadyapyanusvāro na sthānibhūtādacaḥ
pūrva iti tasya parasavarṇe kartavye’llopasya sthānivatvaprasaṅga eva
nāsti, tathāpi sthānivadvārānusvāro’pi dṛṣṭa ityastyeva tatprasaṅga
ityāhuḥ | nanu savarṇagrahaṇamātreṇānusvāro’pyākṣeptuṃ śakyata iti
kimanena pṛthaganusvāragrahaṇena ?| satyam | pṛthaggrahaṇābhāve yatra
parasavarṇastatraiveti saṃbhāvyeta | tathā ca yatra na parasavarṇaprasaṅgaḥ
‘iṣantī’tyādau tatra sthānivadbhāvaṃ niṣeddhumanusvāragrahaṇam |
evaṃ yatra vare ajādeśasya prasaṅgo nāsti yātirityādau tatra
yalope sthānivadbhāvaṃ niṣeddhuaṃ varegrahaṇātpṛthagyalopagrahaṇaṃ
kṛtamiti jñeyam | dīrghe-pratidīvnā, pratidīvne | ṭhhali ce’ti
dīrghe kartavye’llopo na sthānivat | yaṇādeśastu
sthānivadbhavatyeva | ‘opājādeśa eva na sthāniva’dityuktatvāt |
tena ṭhhali ca’ ṭhupadhāyāṃ ce’ti dīrghāpravṛtyā kiryoḥ giryoḥ
vivyaturityādi siddham | jaśi-sagdhiśca me | adanaṃ gdhiḥ | tatra
adeḥ ktini ‘ahulaṃ cchandasi’ iti ghaslādeśaḥ, ‘hasibhasorhali
ce’tyupadhālopaḥ | ‘halo jhali’ iti salopaḥ | ‘haṣastathoḥ’ iti
dhatvam | dhasya ‘halāṃ jaśjhaśī’ti jaśtve kartavye upadhālopo na
sthānivat | ‘amānasya cchandasyamūrdhaprabhṛtyudarkeaṣu’ iti saḥ | samānā
gdhiḥ-sagdhiḥ | na cātra salope dhatve ca kartavye pūrvasmādapīti
sthānivadbhāvātsagdhiriti rūpaṃ na syāditi śaṅkyam;
pañcamīsamāsapakṣasyā’nityatvāt | tatra ‘iṣṭhāyāṃ seṭī’ti
liṅgāt | tathāhi-tatra ‘eṭī’ti padaṃ na
tāvadaniḍvāyavṛtyartham, ṇijantātadasaṃbhavāt | nanu ‘aṃjñāpitaḥ
paśu’rityatra ṭhyasya vibhāṣe’ti iṇniṣedhe saṃbhavatyevāniṭtvaṃ,
‘anīvante’ti vikalpiteṭtvāditi cenna; ṭhyasya vibhāṣe’ tyatra
ṭhekācaḥ’ ityanuvṛteḥ | anyathā ‘aridriti’ iti iṇna syāt , tatra
‘anipatidaridrātibhyaḥ’ iti vārtikena sano vikalpiteṭtvāt |
tasmātkālāvadhāraṇārtaṃ seṅgrahaṇam | iṭi kṛte ṇilopo na tu
tataḥ prāgiti | anyathā ‘ārita’mityādau ṇilope kṛte ṭhekāca
upadeśe’iti iṇniṣedhaḥ syāditi | yadi tu pūrvasmādvidhau
stānivatvaṃ tarhi ṇicā vyavadhānānniṣedhastarhi
‘aṭayatī’tyatrāntarvartinīṃ vibhaktimāśritya padatvājjaśtvaṃ syāt |
maivam | ṭhiṣṭhava’dityatiṣṭayā bhasaṃjñayā padasaṃjñāyā
bādhājjaśtāva’pravṛteḥ | cari-jakṣatuḥ, jakṣuḥ | ghaserliṭi atus us

| kecitu liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣayā’tra vṛddhirityāhustanniṣphalamiti
| bhāvaḥ |

śaṅkyaḥ, tasya sautradvitvamātraviṣayatvāt | ataeva ‘hayaḥ śaraḥ’ iti

suvacamiti | yathāsaṅkhyasaṃbandhena

paṭhati |

(146) arthavadadhāturapratyayaḥ prātipadikam |1|2|45|
athājantapuṃliṅgaprakaraṇam | arthavadadhātu | pratyayaṃ pratyayāntaṃ
ceti | sūtre tantrādinobhayaṃ vivakṣitamiti bhāvaḥ | arthava’diti
napuṃsakanirdeaśasyā’nuguṇaṃ viśeṣyamadhyāharati--śabdasvarūpamiti |

pracalatī’ti nyāyāt | iha tu samudāye pravṛtayā prātipadikasaṃjñayā

saṃyogasaṃjñā pravarteta | atra kecit-ṭhdhanaṃ’ ṭhvana’mityādau prativarṇaṃ
satyāmapi saṃjñāyāṃ satsvapi svādiṣu na kṣatiḥ |
ṭhhalṅyā’bityādinā sulopāt | na ca nalopo dhasya jaśtvaṃ ca
syāditi śaṅkyam, dhātupāṭhe ‘hana’
ṭhvane’tyuccāraṇasāmarthyātadapravṛterityāhuḥ | tadasat |
kārātsorutpatau rutvapravṛteḥ | yadyapi

‘ikīrṣati’ ṭhvidma’ ityādau rephadakārayoḥ padāntatve sati

prasaṅgāditi dik | adhātuḥ kim ?, ahan | dhātoḥ

hantestipi sipa# vā kṛte ṭhitiśce’tīkāralope halṅyādilope

pratyayagrahaṇe yasmātsa vihitastadādergrahaṇāt, kevalasya
cā’tathātvāt | anyathā suptiṅerapi tadantatvātpadatvaṃ syāt |
tathā ca ṭhhariṣu’ ‘aroṣī’-tyādau ṣatvaṃ na syāt,
‘āptapadādyo’riti niṣedhāt | na ca ṣatvavidherniravakāśātā,
‘arpiṣe’ ṭheṣa’ ityādau caritārthatvāt | anye tu
vyācakṣate-ṭhkṛtaddhite’tyatra hi tadantavidhirvakṣyate | tathā ca
‘addhitagrahaṇasya taddhitāntānāmeva natvanyapratyayāntānāṃ saṃjñe’ti
niyamārthatāmāśritya pratyayāntaparyudāso’tra na kartavyaḥ | athavā
‘ātpadādyo’riti sūtre sātigrahaṇātpratyayo na prātipadikamiti
siddhe pratyayagrahaṇaṃ sāmarthyātadantaparam | utarasūtre taddhitagrahaṇaṃ tu
vidhyarthamevā’stu | yadvā sātigrahaṇātpratyayasya prātipadikatvā’bhāve
taddhitagrahaṇasyoktarītyā niyamārthatve ca ṭharthavadadhātuḥ
prātipadika’mityeva suvacamiti, teṣām ṭhiko yaṇacī’ti sūtraṃ
vyarthaṃ syāt | ‘asmādityutarasya’
ṭhvāyvṛtupitruṣasaḥ’-ityādinirdeaśājjñāpakādiṣṭasiddheḥ |
‘ājjhalau’ ityatrākārasahito’c ājityayaṃ mūlagrantho’pi
virudhyeta, ‘ālasamayavelāsu’-ityādijñāpakādeva ḍhatvā’bhāvasiddhe |
yadi jñāpakena pratyākhyānamayuktamiti, yadi cā’’kārapraśleṣe eva
talliṅgamityabhyupagame sūtrākṣaraireveṣṭaṃ sidhyatītyucyeta, tarhi
ṭhapratyaya’ ityetadabhyupagamya pratyayaparyudāse ‘āti’grahaṇaṃ liṅgaṃ,
pratyayāntaparyudāse tu taddhitagrahaṇamityapratyayagrahaṇamevāvartya
vyākhyāyatāṃ, kimanayā kusṛṣṭayeti dik | ṭhadhātupratyayā’viti
siddhe nañdvayopādānamapratyaya ityasyāvṛtisokaryārtham |
mahāsaṃjñākaraṇaṃ śrutyanurodhāt | tathā cātharvaṇe paṭaḷte--ṭhko
dhātuḥ, kiṃ prātipadikaṃ, kaḥ pratyayaḥ’ iti |
ḍitthādīnyavyutpannānīhodāharaṇam | avyutpatipakṣasya cedameva
jñāpakamiti prāñcaḥ | vastutastu vyutpatipakṣe ‘ahupaṭava’ ityādyarthaṃ
sūtramiti navyāḥ | na caivaṃ ‘ahucpūrvaḥ prātipadika’mityeva
sūtryatāmiti vācyam, ‘ūlakenopadaṃśa’mityādau
kṛdantatvenātiprasaṅgāt, gatikārakapūrvasyāpi kṛdantatvāt | na
ca samāsagrahaṇaṃ niyamārthamiti nistāraḥ, arthavatsūtrārambhaṃ vinā
samāsagrahaṇasya niyamārthatvā’yogāt |

(181) svamajñātidhanākhyāyām |1|1|36|
svamajñāti | ātmā’’tmīyajñātidhanavācī svaśabdaḥ, tatra jñātidhanayoḥ
paryudāsādātmātmīyau pariśiṣṭāvityāśayena vyācaṣṭe--ātmīyā
ityarthaḥ | ātmāna iti veti | yatvāhuḥ - ātmani svaśabdo napuṃsakaḥ,
te ‘ve’ ‘vā’ ityudāharaṇaṃ tatrā’yuktamiti | tadrabhasāt | ‘vo
jñātāvātmani, svaṃ triṣvātmīye, svo’striyāṃ dhane’
ityamarasiṃhokterātmanyapi svaśabdasya puṃstvāt | na ca ‘vau
jñātau’ ityamarakośe ṭhātmanī’tyasya
‘va’mityutareṇānvayādātmavācī svaśabdo napuṃsaka eveti vācyam,
‘vaḥ sytāpuṃsyātmani jñātau triṣvātmīye’striyāṃ dhane’ iti
medinīkośavirodhenātmanīti pūrvānvayi, na tūtarānvayīti
vyākhyātumucitatvāt | kiṃca ṭhvibhāṣā jasī’ti prakaraṇe
‘vamātmīye’ ityeva vaktavye gurunirdeaśaṃ
kurvansūtrakāro’pyātmavācisvaśabdasya puṃstve pramāṇam | tasmāt
‘ve’ ‘vā’ ityasya ātmāna iti vivaraṇaṃ samyageveti sthitam |
jñātidhanavācinastviti | tācchīsyena ṇininā
jñātidhanayorapyātmīyatvaṃ puraskṛtya pravṛtau sarvanāmatā’styeveti
dhvanayati | etadarthameva hi sūtre ākhyāgrahaṇaṃ kṛtam |
‘vamātmātmīyākhyāyā’miti vaktavye jñātidhanayoḥ paryudāsāśrayaṇaṃ
mātrālāghavāya | na ca ‘vamātmātmīyayoḥ’ ityucyamāne ākhyāgrahaṇaṃ
nāpekṣitimiti vācyam; vastutastu ātmīyasyāpi jñātitvena
dhanatvena vivakṣāyāṃ sarvanāmatā mā bhū’diti tasyāvaśyakatvāt |

pragītamantrasādhyaguṇiniṣṭhaguṇābhidhāṃ stotram,

vyavahāraḥ|

(823) bandhe ca vibhāṣā |6|3|13|
bandhe ca vibhāṣā | bandha iti ghañantaḥ| hastebandha iti|
bahuvrīhirayam| tatpuruṣe tu nensiddhabandhātiṣu ceti vakṣyamāṇena
niṣedha evetyāhuḥ| apsavya iti| digāditvādyati orguṇe
vāntādeśaḥ| prācā tu yataḥ sthāne jaṃ paṭhitvā apsujaḥ ityudāhṛtaṃ,
tadākaraviruddham| 
apo yoniyanmatuṣu| apsumantāviti| kārīryām apsvagne
sadhiṣṭhava apsu me somo abravīdityājyabhāgamantrau staḥ| tatra
hyapsuśabdo’stīti taddvārā ājyabhāgayorapyapsumatvam| prācā tu
matiṣu iti paṭhitvā apsumatiḥ ityudāhṛtam| atra kecit---
apsvityetadanukaraṇaśabdaḥ saptamyanto na vā ?| ādye
saptamyāntātprathamāyā abhāvena matubeva durlabhaḥ| antye tu lukaḥ
prāptireva nāsti, saptamyabhāvāt| tathā ca matiṣu iti prācoktaḥ
pāṭha eva yuktaḥ| na ca sa pāṭho bhāṣyādau na dṛṣṭa iti vācyaṃ, matiṣu
iti pāṭhasya apsumatiḥ ityudāharaṇasya ca bhāṣyavṛtyādipustakeṣu
dṛśyamānatvena matuṣviti pāṭhasyaiva kkāpyadarśanāt, vyarthatvācca|
asyavāmīyaṃ kathāśubhīyam ityādāviva luki kartavye
prakṛtiprakṛtivadanukaraṇamityatideśā’pravṛtyaiveṣṭasiddherityāhuḥ|
(824) nensiddhabandhātiṣu ca |6|3|19|
nensiddhaba| cakrabandha iti| tatpuruṣe ityanuvṛtestatpuruṣa evāyaṃ
niṣedhaḥ| bahuvrīhau tu bandhe ca vibhāṣā iti vikalpa eva| 
vāgdikpaśyadbhyo yuktidaṇḍahareṣu| paśyatohara iti|
paśyantamanādṛtya haratītyarthaḥ| ṣaṣṭhī cā’nādare iti ṣaṣṭhī| 
devānāṃpriya iti ca mūrkhe| devānāmiti| mūrkhā hi devānāṃ prītiṃ
janayanti devapaśutvāditi manoramā| ayaṃ bhāvaḥ--
brahmājñānarahitatvātsaṃsāriṇo mūrkhāḥ| te tu
yāgādikarmāṇyunutiṣṭhantaḥ puroḍāśādipradānadvārā
devānāmtayantaṃ prītiṃ janayanti| bahmajñāninastu na tathā, teṣāṃ
yāgādyanuṣṭhānā’bāvāt| ato gavādisthānāpannatvānmūrkhā eva
devapaśava iti| 
śepapuccchalāṅgūleṣu śunaḥ| sepapuccheti| śuna iva śepamasya
śunaḥśepaḥ| yadyapi śepasśabdaḥ sakārāntaḥ, gaurliṅgaṃ cihnaśepasoḥ
ityamaraprogāt, tathāpi śīṅgo nipātanādauṇādike papratyaye
akārānto’pyastyeva| tathā ca mantra yasyākamuśantaḥ praharāma
śepamiti| cihnaśephasoḥ iti pāṭe tu śephaśabdasya
sakārāntatvaśaṅkaiva nāstīti bodhyam| śunaḥ pucccha ityādāvapi
bahuvrīhiḥ| trayo’pyamī ṛṣiviśeṣāṇāṃ saṃjñāḥ| mātuḥ
piturbhyāmiti sūtre samāse’ṅguleḥ saṅgaḥ ityataḥ samāsa
ityanuvartitam, tatphalaṃ darśayati-- asamāse tviti| vākye
vaikalpikamapi ṣatvaṃ netyarthaḥ| 
ityaluksamāsaḥ tatvabodhinyām|


 (881) samarthānāṃ prathamādvā |4|1|82|

(882) prāgdīvyato’ṇ |4|1|83|
prāgdiśa itīti| tata utareṣāṃ pratyayānāṃ svārthikatvena ‘amarthānāṃ’,
‘rathamā’diti padayoḥ prayojanaṃ neti bhāvaḥ| nanu ‘amarthaḥ
padavidhi’riti paribhāṣayā gatārthatvāt

‘hakālataneṣu’ityaligvidhānāt ‘ubantātaddhitotpati’riti
siddhāntasya sakalasaṃmatatvādata āha--sāmarthyamiti|
kṛtasandhikāryatvamiti| asya phalaṃ tu ‘asyāpatya’miti sūtre mūla eva
sphuṭībhaviṣyati| iha ‘amarthātprathamādve’ti vaktuaṃ yuktam|
mahotsargānāha---prāgdīvyata ityādīnā| sūtre
‘īvya’dityekadeśo’narthako’pyavadhitvenopātaḥ

(883) aśvapatyādibhyaśca |4|1|84|

(888) strīpuṃsābhyāṃ nañsnañau bhavanāt |4|1|87|
strīpuṃsābhyām| prāgityanuvartate | tadāha---prāgartheṣviti| rpausna
iti| iha ‘vādiṣu’iti padatvātsaṃyogāntalopena puṃsaḥ sasya
nivṛtāvapi pratyayasakāraḥ śrūyata eva| ataevobhābhyāṃ parato nañeva
na vihitaḥ, pāésnamiti rūpā’siddhiprasaṅgāt|
syādetat---ubhābhyāmapi prakṛto’ñevā’stu, tatsaṃniyogena
‘trīpuṃsayor#ukce’ti nugeva vidhīyatām| na caivaṃ ‘traiṇāḥ,
pāésnāḥ’ityatra ṭh yañañośce’ti lukprasaṅgaḥ, sraiṇānāṃ saṅgha
ityādau ‘aṅghāhkalakṣaṇeṣu’ ityaṇaprasaṅgaśca syāditi vācyam,
ubhayatrāpi ‘otre’ityanuvṛteḥ| pravarādhyāyaprasiddhaṃ hi tatra gotram|
anyathā ‘autrāḥ, dauhitrāḥ’ityatrā’pyaño luksyāt| evaṃ ca
‘añsnañīkakkhyu’nniti vārtike nañsnañgrahaṇaṃ vinā’ñantatvādeva
ṅīpsidhyatītyaparamapyanukūlamiti cet| atrāhuḥ---nuki
‘astaddhite’iti ṭilopaḥ syāt| na caivaṃ nugānarthaṃkyaṃ,
ṭilopapravṛtyaiva nukaḥ sārthakatvāt| yadyapi strīśabde tasya sārthakyaṃ
nāsti, ṭhyasyeti ce’tyanenāpīkāralopasaṃbhavāt, tathāpi
‘rīrdeavatā’sya śrāyaṃ haviḥ’ityatraiva lopātparatvādvṛddhiḥ syāt,
nuki tu ṭilopaḥ pravartate iti strīśabde’pi nukaḥ sārthakyamastu|
tasmānnañsnañāviti yatānyāsameva svīkartavyamiti| anye tu
‘trīpuṃsayornukce’tyastu, āgame akāro vivakṣitaḥ| tasya ca
ṭhyasyeti ce’ti lope kṛte’pi sthāmivatvāṭṭilopo na
bhaviṣyati| evaṃ ca ‘iḍḍhāṇa’ñiti sūtreṇaiva ḍīpsiddhau
nañsnayorupasaṅkhyānaṃ mā’sviti mahadeva lāghavamityāhuḥ| vatyartha
iti| ‘trīpuṃsābhyāṃ nañsnañau vatyarthe na pravartete’ iti

ca tvā’diti cakāro nañsnañbhyāṃ tvataloḥ samāveśārtha iti
vakṣyati| tena strītvaṃ strītā, puṃstvaṃ puṃsteti siddham|

prathamaścāpatyapratyayaśūnyaḥ| tathā ca ‘rathamā prakṛtirgotre apatyapratyayaṃ
labhate’iti sūtrārtha vyācakṣate| tatkliṣṭam| ṭhasyāṃ
paṅktāvekamānaye’tyukte ‘rathama’miti prāthamyārthasyā’pratīteḥ|
vastutastu ‘rathamādityadhikārādgotre prathamādeva
prātipadikādapatyapratyayaḥ’iti vyākhyāyaikagrahaṇamiha tyaktuaṃ
śavayamityāhuḥ| āṬpagava ithi| upaguśabda eva pratyayaṃ labhate, na
tvaupagavaśabdaḥ iti ‘otrāpatye’pyanantarāpatya ivā’ṇeva bhavati, na
tviñ| gargya iti| gotrāpatye ‘argādibhyoya’ñiti viśiṣya
vidhānādanantarāpatya ivātra ṭhata iñ’ na bhavati, kiṃ tu yañeva| sa ca
gārgyasyāpatye’pi bhavati, natvatra yañantātphak, ṭheko gotre’iti
niyamāt| nāḍāyaṇa iti| ‘aḍādibhyaḥ pha’giti gotrāpatye
vidhānādatrāpi ṭhata iña’na bhavati, kiṃtu phageva, sa ca
nāḍāyanasyāpatye’pi bhavati, na tu phagantādiñ, uktaniyamāt|
nanvekasmingotre yugapadanekapratyayā’prasaktevyarthamidaṃ
sūtramityāśaṅkya sūtrārambhaphalaṃ matabhedena vyavasthāpayati--gotre
svaikoneti| ‘vaugotraṃ, tadapekṣayā ekonasaṅkhyānāṃ, tṛtīye
dvayoḥ paramparā, caturye trayāṇāṃ, pañcame tu
caturṇā’mityādiparamparā prasajyata ityarthaḥ| tathāhi--upagostṛtīye
aṇiñoḥ paramparā, caturthe tvaṇiñ phagiñām,| yadyapyatra ṭhyasyeti ca’
iti lopenā’ṇāderasatvāt ṭhaṇiñādīnāṃ parampare’tyuktirna
saṅgaccchate, tathāpi ṭhaṇantādiñutpadyate,
iñantatphagi’tyupatimātrābhiprāyeṇa pratyayaparamparābhidhānaṃ bodhyam|
svadvyūnasaṅkhyebhya iti| svaṃugotraṃ, tadapekṣayā
dvyūnasaṅkhyebhyaḥ prātipadikebhyaḥ, tṛtīye ekasmādaniṣṭhotpatiḥ,
caturthe dvābhyāṃ, pañcame tribhyaḥ, ityādītyarthaḥ| apatyaṃ pitureveti|
tatā cāmaraḥ--ṭhātmajastanayaḥsa sūnuḥ sutaḥ putraḥ striyāṃ tvamī|
āhurduhitaraṃ sarve’patyaṃ tokaṃ tayo#ḥ same’iti|
mukhyamatamāha---tataḥ prātāmiti| pitrapekṣayā ye prāñcaḥ
pitāmahaprapitāmadādayasteṣāmapītyarthaḥ| atrāyamāśayaḥ---apatyaśabdaḥ
kiyānimito na tvātmajaparyāyaḥ, ‘a patantyanenetyapatya’miti
vyutpateḥ ‘aṅktirviśatī’ti sūtre bhāṣyakṛtā darsitatvāt,
bāhulakātkaraṇe yatpratyayaḥ| ṭhyannimitaṃ yasyāpatanaṃ
tatasyāpatya’miti phalito’rthaḥ| tathā ca ‘autrādirapi
pitāmahādīnāmapatanahetu’riti teṣāmapatyatvaṃ bhavati| prasiddhaṃ ca
vyavahito’pi pitāmahādīnāmuddharteti jaratkārvādyaupākhyāneṣu|
ṭhapatyaṃ pautraprabhṛtī’ti sūtramapyatrānuguṇam| ādyapakṣe hi
ṭhapatyamivāpatya’miti gauṇī vṛtirāśrayaṇīyā syāt| amarastu
sūtrabhāṣyādivirodhādupekṣya iti| taddhānyai iti| ādyapakṣe pratyayamālā
nivṛtaye, anye tu svadvyūnaṅkhyebhyo’niṣṭotpatinivṛtaye
ityarthaḥ| āṬpagavādiñsyāditi| tṛtīyasya upaguṃ prati
anapatyatvāditi bhāvaḥ| evaṃ ca’sati sūtre asminpakṣe
āṬpagavirityaniṣṭameva syāt ṭhāṬpagava’itīṣṭaṃ tu na siddyatīti
bodhyam| ajobajjyeṣṭhe iti| jīvajjyeṣṭhe jīvadūaṃśye vā
yuvasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ gotrasaṃjñā neti bhāvaḥ| iṣṭe siddhe’pīti|
asmin pakṣe āṬpagavasya yadapatyaṃ tadupayogapyapatyamiti
upagoryadā pratyayaḥ tadā ṭhāṬpagavaḥ’ itīṣṭaṃ yadyapi siddyapi,
tathāpyaupagavirityaniṣṭaṃ prāpnotītyarthaḥ| tata iti|
iñantādityarthaḥ| phagiñoriti| phagantādiñ, iñantātphak,
tadantātpunariñityādiparamparāyāṃ satyāmityarthaḥ| niyamārthamiti|
nanvādyapakṣe tatatpitṛvācakādeva pratyayo, na tu mūlabhūtātsyāt,
anantarāpatye mukhyasaṃbandhe caritārthasyā’ṇādergauṇasaṃbandhe’pi
pravṛteranyāyyatvāt| tathā caupagavāpatyena
upagormukhyasaṃbandhā’bhāvādatrā’prāpte vidhyarthamevedaṃ sūtraṃ, na tu
niyamārthamiti āṬpagavaśabdādapi pratyayo durvāra iti
cedatrāhuḥ--gotre bodhanīye krameṇā’nekapratyayaprasaṅge eka
evāpatyapratyayaḥ syāditi sūtrārthe kṛte
āṬpagavaśabdasyāpatyapratyayāntatvātpunarapatyapratyayastato nopapadyate
ityagatyā paramparāsambandhābhyupagamenopagoreva tadutpatiḥ, na
tvaupagavaśabdāditi siddhimiṣṭamiti| atra kecivdyācakṣate---ṭhādyapakṣe
pratyayaparamparāyāṃ prāptāyām ṭheko gotre’ityanenaikaḥ pratyayo
vidhīyate| tathā caiko nāmaikajātīya
ityarthaparyavasānānmūlaprakṛtertho’patyapratyayo’ṇādistajjātīya eva
gotre bodhanīye tatatpitṛvācakādbhavati ṭhaṇantādaṇ,
iñantādiñ, yañantādyañiti| na caivamaṇiñoḥ paramparāyāṃ
nivartitāyāmapyaupagava ityatrā’ṇpratyayaparamparā syāt, tathā gargya
ityādau yañādiparampareti vācyaṃ, satyāmapi
tasyāmaniṣṭā’bhāvā’diti| taccintyaṃ| phagantātphaki
‘āḍāyana’ityādāvaniṣṭaprasaṅgāditi dik| ūhyamiti| ṭhapatyaṃ
pitureve’ti pakṣe caturthāpatyarūpe yūni vivakṣite ‘otrādyaūnī’ti
niyamasūtre satyasati ca gotrapratyayāntādeva yuvapratyaya iti dvayoḥ
paramparā, sā ceṣṭatvānna niyamena vyāvartyate| pañcame tu yūni
niyamā’bhāve trayāṇāṃ paramparā prasajyeta| ṣaṣṭhe tu
caturṇāmityādi| ‘ataḥ prācāmapī’ti dvitīyapakṣe tu--gargācaturthe
yūni mūlaprakṛtyanantarābhyāmaniṣṭotpatiḥ prasajte| pañcame tu
--mūlaprakṛtyanantarayuvabhyaḥ| tathā naḍāccaturthe yūni
pūrvavaddvābhyāmaniṣṭotpatiḥ| pañcame tribhyaḥ| upagoścaturthe vācye
tu mūlaprakṛterekasmādevāniṣṭotpatiḥ, na tvanantarā
patyavācakāt| tato jāte’pyata iñi rūpāniṣṭābhāvādityādi
yathāsaṃbhavaṃ tatrohyamityarthaḥ|
(901) gotrādyaūnyastriyām |4|1|94|

‘trībhinne yūni gotrādeve’tyarthaḥ kriyate, tarhi strīṣu

gārgī na syāt| kiṃ tu vākyameva syāt| ato
ṭhyuvasaṃjñāniṣedhaparameveda’mityāśayena vyācaṣṭe---na yusaṃjñeti|
atrāyamāśayaḥ---ṭhastriyā’miti yogo vibhajyate| ṭhyūnī’ti
śabdasvarūpamanuvartate| paribhāṣā ceyam| yatra yuvasaṃjñāvidhānaṃ tatra
ṭhastriyā’mityupatiṣṭhata’iti,---siddhasya gatiriyam| ‘īvati tu
vaṃśye yuvā’striyā’mityeva sūtrayituṃ yuktam|

balīyaḥ’ iti pūrvameva guṇe kṛte ityādi yaduktaṃ, tadasat|

ceṇṇyantenocyeteti| sa karte’ti tṛtīyaṃ vākyam| aṇāvityādi
ceccchabdāntamihānurtate| karmaśabdaścātra kārakaviśeṣaparaḥ,
śabdādhikārāśrayaṇāt, tadetadvyācaṣṭe-- aṇau yadityādinā,
syādityantena| ṭhanādhyāne’ iti vākyāntaraṃ vyācaṣṭe -- na tviti|
ādhyānamutkaṇṭhāpūrvakaṃ smaraṇam| vastutastu paryudāsa eva
lāghavādāśrayaṇīyaḥ| asminpakṣe ādhyānabhinne ityarthe sati phalito- ‘a
tvādhyāne’ neyaḥ| tathā ca atra vākyatrayameveti bodhyam| vikalpa
iti| ‘aratvātprāpte’ ityutareṇānvayaḥ| pūrvavipratiṣedheneti|
ṭhvibhāṣopapadene’tyasyāvakāśaḥ--svaṃ yajñaṃ yajati| svaṃ yajñaṃ yajate
ityādi| ṭhṇeraṇā’ vityasya tu-- darśayate rājetyādi| tathā
ṭhaṇāvakarmakā’ dityasya --śete kṛṣṇastaṃ gopī śāyayatītyavakāśaḥ|
ṭhṇeraṇau’ ityasya tu-- lāvayate kedāraḥ svayameveti| tatra hi
lūyate kedāra iti dvitīyakakṣāyāmaṇāvakarmakatvāditi bhāvaḥ| na ca
‘aśyati bhava’ itivaddvitīyakakṣāyāṃ ‘unāti kedāra’ ityeva
prayoga iti bhramitavyam| lavanasya karmasthakriyātvena
‘armavatkarmaṇe’ti yagātmanepadapravṛteḥ| navyāstu ṭhaṇāvakarmakā’
dityasya bādhe ‘arśayate rāje’ti bhāṣyaprayogo mānam| tatra hi
nivṛtapreṣamapakṣe dṛśeraṇāvakarmakatvāccitavatkartṛkatvācca
parasmaipadaprāpteḥ| ṭhvibhāṣopapadene’ti vikalpabādhetu na
kiṃcinmānam| kiṃ ca ṭhaṇāvakarmakā’dityasya bādhe’pi nāstyeva
pramāṇam, pūrvoktabhāṣyasya paragāmini kriyāphale caritārthatvāt|
tathā ca kartṛgāmini kriyāphale paratvāt ṭhaṇāvakarmakā’ dityasya
pravṛtau na kiṃcidbādhakamastīti ‘ūrvavipratiṣedhenedameveṣyate’
ityetaccintyamityāhuḥ| vastutastu ṭhṇeraṇau’ iti
sūtrasyā’citvatkartṛke’pi lāvayate kedāra ityādau caritārthatvāt
ṭhaṇāvakarmakā’ dityanena paragāmini kriyaphale’pi
paratvātparasmaipade prāpte darśayate rājeti
bhāṣyaprayogabalātpūrvavipratiṣedhābhyupagamena ṭhṇeraṇau’
ityātmanepadapravṛtāvapi ṭhātmārthaṃ darśayate’ ‘vārthaṃ darśayate’
ityādau paratvāt ṭhvibhāṣopapadene’tyasya pravṛtau na
kiṃcidbādhakamasti| tato’pi paratvāt ṭhaṇāvakarmakā’ diti
parasmaipadameva syāditi tadbādhena pūrvavipratiṣedhe svīkṛte
ṭhvibhāṣopapadene’tyasyāpyarthātpūrvavipratiṣedhena bādho jāta
eveti cet, evaṃ tarhi ‘arśayate rāje’ti bhāṣyaprayogasya kevale
caritārthatvātsopapadaprayoge ṭhaṇāvakarmakā’ diti
gatārthatvaśaṅkāṃ nirasyati--kartasthabhāvakā iti|
aparispandanasādhanasādhyo dhātvartho bhāvaḥ|ṣa
saparispandanasādhanasādhyā tu kriyā| sādhanaṃ u kārakaṃ,
tatsādhyatvāddhātvarthasya| nanu ‘ṛtyantaṃ bhavaṃ paśyatī’tyatra dṛśeḥ
kartṛsthabhāvakatā na syāt, kiṃ tu kartṛsthakriyākataiva syāt| na ca
sādhanaśabdena lakāravācyaṃ kārakaṃ vivakṣitamiti vācyaṃ, nṛtyanbhavaḥ
paśyatītyatra taddoṣatādavasthyāditi cet| atrāhuḥ-- ārohaṇādau
saparinpanda eva devadatādiryathā sādhanatathā darśanaśravaṇādau na
bhavati kiṃtu spandanarahito’pi noktadoṣa iti|
kartṛsthabhāvakamudāharati--paśyantīti| preraṇāṃśeti|
saukaryavivakṣayeti bhāva-| tata iti| tyaktapreraṇāṃśakāddhātorityarthaḥ|
punarṇyarthasyetyādi| na caivaṃ ṇijapi gaccchatīti ‘arśayate bhava’ iti
na sidhyediti vācyam, upāyanivṛtāvapyupeyā’nivartanāditi
kaiyaṭokteḥ| tatra tṛtīyāyeti| prathamādvitīyayostu
ṇyantatvā’bhāvātaṅḥ prasaktireva nāstīti bāvaḥ| kriyāsāmye’pīti |
prathamakakṣayā sahetyarthaḥ| dvitīyāmādāyeti| ṭhaṇau yā kriyā saiva
ceṇṇyante’ ityasya
nyūnādhikabhāvavyavacchedaparatvamabhyupetyedamuktam| yadā
tvadhikavyavacchedamātraparatvamabhyupagamyate tadā prathamāmādāya
tatsaṃbhavati| idānīṃ kartṛsthakriyākamudāharati-- evamityādinā|
ārohati hastīti| preṣaṇāṃśatyāge udāharaṇamidam| tato ṇijaiti|
nivṛtapreṣaṇāddhātoḥ preṣaṇāṃ’śavivakṣāyāṃ ṇijityarthaḥ|
punarṇyarthasyā’vivakṣāyāmudāharaṇamāha-- ārohayate iti| evaṃ
nivṛtapreṣaṇapakṣamupapādyedānīmadhyāropitapreṣaṇapakṣamāha-- yadveti|
hetutvāropāditi| prayojakakartṛtvāropādityarthaḥ| atrāpi
saukaryavivakṣaiva bījam| paśyata iti| paśyato bhaktān, ārohato
hastipakāniti krameṇā’rthaḥ| ādhikyāditi| ṭhasminpakṣe ṇau cetsā
kriyetyanena ādhikyamātraṃ vyavaccchidyate na tu nyūnatvamapi| anyathā
tṛtīyakṣāyāmapi taṅ na syāt, prakṛtyupātapreṣaṇāśaṃsya tyāgena
nyūnatāyāḥ satvāditi bhāvaḥ| ṇeriti kim ?|
paśyatyārohatītyādinivṛtapreṣamānma#abhūt| na ca ṭhṇau ce’diti
śrutatvāṇṇyantādeva syāditi vācyam, aṇāvityasyāpi śrutatvāt|
tasyā’grimayogārthamavaśyaṃ kartavyasya spaṣṭārthamihaiva
kartṛmaucityācca| aṇau yā kriyā saiva ceṇṇyante kim ?| darśayati
bhavaḥ, ārohayati hastītyadhyāropitapreṣamapakṣe dvitīyakakṣāyāṃ
mābhūt| kathaṃ tarhi ‘areṇurārohayate niṣādina’miti
māghaprayogaḥ, ‘a santataṃ darśayate gatasmayaḥ kṛtādhipatyāmiva sādu
bandhutā’ miti bhāraviprayogaśca saṅgaccchata iti cet| atrāhuḥ--
ṭhṇicaśce’ tyanena kriyāphale kartṛgāmini taṅ, na tu
prakṛtasūtreṇeti| aṇau yatkarma kārakaṃ ṇau cetsa karteti kim?|
darśayanti bhavamiti nivṛtapreṣaṇapakṣe caturthakakṣeyam|
ādhyāropitapakṣe tu tṛtīyakakṣeti jñeyam| kecitu etatsūtrasthe
bhāṣye darśayate bhṛtyāyājetyudāharaṇaṃ, smarayatyenaṃ vanagulmaiti
pratyudāharaṇaṃ ca dṛśyate| tataśca adhyāropitapreṣaṇapakṣe
dvitīyakakṣāyāmevā’nenātmanepadaṃ bhavati, na tu tṛtīyakakṣāyāmiti
pratīyate| tathā ca karmapadamāvartya tasya kriyāvācitvaṃ
svīkṛtyā’ṇau yā kriyāsaiva ceṇṇyantenocyeteti
vākyāntarābhyupagame’pyevakāreṇā’dhikyaṃ na vyavaccchidyate, kiṃ tu
nyūnataivetyasmādeva bhāṣyādavagamyate| evaṃ ca ‘arśayate bhavaḥ’
ṭhārohayate hastī’ti karmaprayogarahitaṃ
mūlagranthasyodāharaṇaṃ,ṭhsmarayati vanagulma’ iti pratyudāharaṇaṃ ca
bhāṣyaviruddhamevetyāhuḥ| anyaistvavivikṣitamiha krametyuktvā’tra
mūlagranthā’virodhenaiva bhāṣyagranthaḥ samarthitaḥ|teṣāmayamāśayaḥ--
‘abhīrāyāṃ nadyāṃ ghoṣa’ ityatra gabhīrā’bhinnanadyāmiti
gabhīranadīpadārthayorabhedabodhānantaraṃ tīralakṣaṇāyāṃ tīrasya
gabhīratvā’bhāvāt, nadyāstu gabhīratve’pyekadeśānvayā’saṃbhavācca
anarthakamapi gabhīrāyāmiti padaṃ prāthamikabodhamādāya yathā sārthakaṃ,
tadvadihāpi adhyāropitapreṣaṇapakṣe dvitīyakakṣāyāṃ karmaṇyanvitaṃ,
tato ṇijarthasyeva karmaṇo’pi tyāge ṇicaḥ karmapadasya ca
prāthamikabodhamādāya sārthakyam| svabodhyasaṃbandho
lakṣaṇetyabhyupagamāt| viśiṣṭavākyārthasya ceha bodhyatvena
tatsaṃbandhasya bodhatṛkatārūpasya vākye satvāt| eṣaivārthavādaiḥ
prāśastyalakṣaṇāyāṃ gatiḥ| anyathā ṭhvāyavyaṃ śvetamālabeta būtikāmaḥ’
ityādividhivākyasya yo’rthavādaḥ ṭhvāyurvaikṣepiṣṭhā devatā,
vāyumeva svena bhāgadheyenopadhāvati’ ‘a evainaṃ bhūti gamayati’
ityādistatra ṭhvāyumeva svena bhāgadheyena’ ‘a evaina’ mitya#adirūpasya
vibhaktibhedena prayogasya vaiyarthyaṃ syāditi|
nanvetatsūtrasyodāharamaṃ pratyudāharaṇaṃ ca yatāśrutabhāṣyānusāreṇa
sakarmakamevāstu kimanena
vidyamānakarmaṇo’vivakṣitatvopapādanakleśeneti cet| maivam|
nivṛtapreṣamapakṣe darśayate bhava ityādyaudāharaṇasya pratyudāharaṇasya ca
karmarahitasya svīkartavyatayā tadaikarūpyasyā’sminnapi pakṣe
akarmakodāharamapratyudāharaṇayoḥ siddhye
karmaṇo’vivakṣitatvāvyākhyāyā ucitatvāt| kiṃca ‘armavatkarmaṇe’
tyanenaiva siddhe kartṛsthabhāvakriyārthaṃ sūtramiti
bhāṣyagranthasvārasyādapyakarmakamevodāharaṇaṃ pratyudāharaṇaṃ cāyāti|
na ca ‘armavatkarmaṇe’ti sūtre tulyaśabdenāpi karmasthakriyāto
nyūnataiva vyavaccchidyate na tvādhikyamiti svīkṛte nāsti
bhāṣyagranthasvārasyabhaṅga iti vācyaṃ, tathā hi sati
‘armavatkarmasthakriya’ ityukte’pi karmasthā kriyā yasya kartuḥ sa kartā
karmavadityarthalābhātatsamīhitasiddhau ‘armaṇā tulyakriya’ ityasya
vaiyarthyāpateḥ| dvitīyakakṣāyāṃ bhave hastini ca
viṣayatvāpādanaviṣayakapreraṇāyāśca nyagbhavanaviṣayapreraṇāyāśca
satve’pi viṣayatvāpatirūpāyā nyagbhavanarūpāyāśca karmasthakriyāyāḥ
satvāt| yadi tu ‘armaṇā tulyakriyaḥ’ ityetatsārthakyāya
tulyaśabdenātra nyūnādhikavyavaccedaḥ kriyata ityucyate, tadā
‘armavatkarmaṇe’ti sūtrasya dvitayīkakṣāyāmapravṛteḥ
‘armavatkarmaṇetyanenaiva siddhe’ ityādibhāṣyagranthasvārasyabhaṅgo
bhavatyeva| tataśca adhyāropitapreṣaṇapakṣe
tṛtīyakakṣāyāmevodāharaṇaṃ, na tu
dvitayīkakṣāyāmityabhyupagantavyam| etenādhyāropitapreṣaṇapakṣe ṇau
cetsā kriyetyanenādhikyamātraṃ vyavaccchidyate nyūnatvaṃ netyatra
vinigamanā’bhāvānnyūnatvavyavaccheda eva svīkṛte, dvitayīkakṣāyāṃ
taṅ durvāra iti nyūnādhikavyavaccheda eva grāhyastena kakṣācatuṣṭayapakṣa
eva sādhīyāniti vadantaḥ parāstāḥ| darśayate bhṛtyān rājeti
bhāṣyodāharabalena adhyāropitapakṣasyaiva prabalatvāditi dik|
gṛdhivañcyoḥ pralabhane| akartrabhiprāyārtha ārambhaḥ| 

(466) mithyopapadātkṛño’bhyāse |1|3|71| 
mithyopapadātkṛño’bhyāse| iha karotiruccāraṇārthatvādakarmakaḥ|
uccāraṇa--- niḥsaraṇam| ṇyantastūccāraṇavṛtiḥ sakarmakaḥ|
uccārayatīti| niḥsārayatītyarthaḥ| asakṛduccāraṇe tu dhātorlakṣaṇā,
ātmanepadaṃ tu dyotakaṃ, tenaiva dyotitatvāt ‘ityavīpsayo’riti
na dvirvacanam| ṛtvijo yajantīti| dakṣiṇādikaṃ tu na yāgaphalam,
‘vargakāmo yajete’tyādinā svargādyauddeśena
yāgādividhānātsvargādireva phalamiti bhāvaḥ| 

(467) samudāṅbhyo yamo’granthe |1|3|75|
samudāṅbhyo| ṭhāṅe yamahanaḥ’ ityeva siddhe āṅpūrvakasya vacanaṃ
sakarmakārthamiti dhvanayannudāharati-- vastramāyaccchata iti| 

(468) anupasargājjñaḥ |1|3|76|
anupasargājjñaḥ| akarmakāccetyeva siddhe sakarmakārtha ārambhaḥ| 

(469) vibhāṣopapadena pratīyamāne |1|3|77|
vibhāṣopapadena| upapadena phalasya kartṛgāmitve dyotite
taṅe’prāptavaprāptavibhāṣeyam| kartṛgāmini kriyāphale nitye
prāpte prāptavibhāṣetyanye| svaṃ yajñamiti| svamityupalakṣaṇam|
‘vārthaṃ yajñaṃ yajati| ātmārthaṃ yajñaṃ yajatī’ tyādyapi bodhyam| 
iti tatvabodhinyām ātmanepadaprakriyā|



 (398) svarādinipātamavyayam |1|1|37|
svarādinipātamavyayam| svarādayaśca nipātāścetisamāhāradvandvaḥ|
nanu cādiṣveva svarādīnpaṭhitvāprakṛtasūtraṃ parityajya
‘addhitaścāsarve’tyādi sūtracatuṣṭayamapi
‘ādayo’satve’ityāsmādūrdhvaṃ kṛtvā’vyayapradeśeṣu nipātaśabdenaiva
vyavahriyatāmiti cenna, ‘vasti vācayati’ṭhsvaḥ paśyati’ṭhsvaḥ
patatī’tyādau karmādikārakayogena satvavācakatvāteṣāṃ
nipātasaṃjñā’nāpateḥ | cādīnāṃ hyasatvavācināmeva nipātasaṃjñā, na
tu satvavācinām| svarādīnāṃ tu satvavācināmasatavavācināṃ
cā’vyayasaṃjñeṣyata iti vyavasthā’nāpateśca| atha
‘rāgrīśvarānnipātāḥ’ṭhsvarādīni’ṭhcādayo’satve’iti sūtryatāṃ, tathā
hi sati svarādīnāṃ satvavacanānāmapi nipātasaṃjñā setsyatīti
cennaḥ, evaṃ hi sati ‘ipāta ekājanā’ṅiti pragṛhyasaṃjñā
svarādīnāmapyekācāṃ prasajyeta| sto hi svarādiṣu
‘imo’t’ṭhdakṣiṇadāc’ityādāvekācau taddhitau| kenprabhṛtaya ekācaḥ
kṛtpratyayāśca santi| ‘asilādistaddhita edhācparyantaḥ’iti sūtrasya,
‘ṛnmakārasandhyakṣarāntaḥ’iti sūtrasya ca svarādigaṇapapaṭhitvāt|
yadyapyatra mūle svarādiṣu gaṇasūtradvayamidaṃ na paṭhitaṃ, tathāpi prācāṃ
pāṭha#e tvastītyanupadameva sphuṭīkariṣyate|
svarādīnudāharati---svarityādinā| svariti svarge paraloke ca|
antariti madhye| prātariti pratyṛṣe| punarityaparthame viśeṣe ca|
sanutarityantardhāne|svarādyāḥ pañcaḥ rephāntāḥ| tena svaryāti
prātaratretyādāvutvaṃ na bhavati| sāntatve hi syādeva hi syāde
doṣaḥ| uccais--mahatiḥ| nīcais---alpe| śanais--kriyāmāndye|
ṛdhak--satye’pi| viyogaśīdhrasāmīpyalāghaveṣvityanye|
ṛte--varjane| yugapadityekakāle| ārāddūrasamīpayoḥ|
pṛthak--bhinne| hyasya--atīte’hni| śvas--anāgate’hni| divā divase|
rātrāviti niśi ḥsāyamiti niśāmikhe| ciramiti bahukāle|
manāk, īṣat--imāvalpe| joṣaṃ--sukhe maune |tūṣṇīmiti maune|
bahis avas imau bāhyae| samayeti samīpe madhye ca| nikaṣetyantike|
svayamiti ātmanetyarthe| vṛtheti vyarthe| naktamiti rātrau| nañiti
niṣedhe| hetāviti nimite| iddheti prakāśye| addheti
sphuṭāvadhāraṇayoḥ| tatvātiśayorityanye|
sāmītyardhajugupsitayoḥ| vat| ‘ena tulya’ mityādibhirvihato
yo vatipratyayaḥ sa iha gṛhyate| tadāha--brāhmāṇavat| kṣatriyavaditi|
pratyayamātrasya saṃjñāprayojanā’bhāvāpratyayāntamudāhṛtam|
yastu’upasargāccchandasi dhātvarthe’ iti vihitaḥ, sa iha na gṛhyate|
yadudvato nivato yāsīṭhtyatra satvadharmasya liṅgasaṅkhyānvayasya
darśanāt| atra vadanti--ṭhtaddhitaścāsarvavibhakti’rityatra ‘asivatī’iti
vatipratyayo’pi parigaṇyate, tacca na kartavyaṃ, svarādipāṭhenaiva
gatārthatvāt| svarādiṣu vā vaditi na paṭhanīyamitiṣa sanā, sanat,
sanāt,--ete nitye| upadheti bhede| tiras--antardhau tiryagarthe
paribhāve ca| antareti madhye vinārthe ca| antareṇeti varjane|
jyogiti kālabhūyastve praśne śīghrārthe saṃpratyarthe ca| kamiti
vārimūrdhanindāsukheṣu| śamiti sukheṣa
sahasetyākasmikā’vimarśayoḥ| vineti varjane|
nānetyanekavinārthayoḥ| svastīti maṅgale| svadhā pitṛdāne|
alaṃ--bhūṣaṇaparyāptiśaktivāraṇaniṣedheṣu| vaṣaṭ, śrauṣaṭ,
vauṣaṭ,--ete havirdāne| anyadityanyārthe| astīti satāyām|
upāṃśu--ityaprakāśoccāraṇarahasyayoḥ| kṣaṇeti kṣāntau|
bihāyasetaci viyadarthe| doṣeti rātrauṣa mṛṣā, mithyetyetau
vitathe| mudheti vyarthe| ita ūrdhvaṃ
‘tvātosunkasunaḥ’ṭhkṛnmakārasandhyakṣarāntaḥ’ ṭhavyayībhāvaśca’iti
gaṇasūtratrayamaṣṭādhyāyīsthatrisūtryā samānārthakamiha na paṭhitaṃ
cedapi prācīnagaṇapāṭhe tadastīti bodhyam| vaiyarthyaṃ tu
parihariṣyate| puretyavirate cirātīte bhaviṣyadāsanne ca| mitho,
mithas--etau rahaḥ sahārthayoḥṣa prāyasiti bāhulye| muhusiti
punararthe| prabāhukamiti samānakāle ūrdhvārthe ca| pravāhiketi
pāṭhāntaram| āryahalamiti balātkāre| śākaṭāyanastu--āryeti
pratibandhe| halamiti pratiṣedhavivādayorityāha| abhīkṣṇamiti paunaḥ
punye| sākaṃ, sārdhametau sāhārthe| namas--natau| hirugvarjane|
dhik--nindābhartsanayoḥ| ita urdhvaṃ ‘asilādayastaddhitā
edhācparyantāḥ’ṭhśastasī’ṭhkṛtvasuc’ṭhsuc’ṭhāsthālau’ṭhcvyarthāśce’ti
prācīnagaṇapāṭhe’stīti bodhyam|
tasilādītyāderayamarthaḥ,--ṭhpañcamyāsta

(567) prākkaḍārātsamāsaḥ |2|1|3|
prākkaḍārātsamāsaḥ| prāggrahaṇamāvartate, tena pūrvaṃ samāsasaṃjñā,
tataḥ saṃjñāntaramapīti labhyate| ato’vyayībhāvādibhiḥ samāveśaḥ
siddhyati| anyathā paryāyaḥ syāt| samasanaṃ samāsaḥ | bhāve ghañ|
anekasya padasya ekapadībhavanamityartha ityeke| vastutastu--ṭhakartari ca
kārake---’ iti karmaṇi ghañ| anyathā subantaṃ samasyata ityutaragrantho
na saṅgaccheta| nanvanvarthatvātsamāsasaṃjñāyāḥ

(568) saha supā |2|1|4|
yogo vibhajyata iti| ‘ubāmantrito---’ ityataḥ subityanuvartate,
tadāha---subantamiti| samasyata iti| sapūrvādasyateḥ karṇi taṅ|
ācāryeṇeti śeṣaḥ| samartheneti tu sahayoge tṛtīyā| samasanakriyāṃ
prati subantaṃ karma, na tu kartṛ| yadyapi subantasya
kartṛtvābhyupagame’pi ṭhupasargādasyatyūhyoḥ’ iti vārtikena
samasyata ityatrātmanepadaṃ labhyate, tathāpi samāsa iti vyākhyeyagranthe
kartari ghañ durlabhaḥ| bāhulakaṃ tu agatikagatiriti
karmatvābhyupagama eva jyāyān| sa ceti| etadapi
yogavibhāgasyeṣṭasiddhyarthatvādeva labhte| cchandasyeveti| yadi
loke’pi syātarhi yatprakurute ityādau svādyautpatiḥ syāt|
liṅgasarvanāmanapuṃsakatāmabhyupetya ‘vamornapuṃsakāt’ iti
luki kṛte’pi ṭhhrasvo napuṃsake---’iti hrasvaḥ syādityādi dūṣaṇaṃ
‘armaṇā yamabhipraitī’ti sūtre’smābhirudbhāvitam| anuvyacaladiti|
subityekatvasya vivakṣitatvātparyāyeṇa samāso bodhyaḥ|
samāsāntodātatve śeṣanighāta iti ‘ugati---’ iti sūtre kaiyaṭaḥ|
(569) supo dhātuprātipadikayoḥ |2|4|71|

prathamānidiṣṭatvā’viśeṣe’pi upasarjanasaṃjñāyā anvarthatvena
pūrvaśabdasyaiva pūrvanipātaḥ syāditi bhāvaḥ|
ivena samāso vibhaktyalopaśca| iveneti| ayamapi samāsaḥ
pūrvavatkvācitka eva| tena jīmūtasyevetyādau taitirīyāṇāṃ
pṛthakpadatvana pāṭhaḥ| ṭhudbāhuriva vāmanaḥ’ ityādau vyastaprayogaśca

(571)prathamānirdiṣṭaṃ samāsa upasarjanam |1|2|43|
prathamānirdiṣṭam| atra samāsapadaṃ tadvidhāyake lākṣaṇikam| anyathā
‘ikīrṣite samāse yatprathamānta’miti vyākhyānaprasaktyā kṛṣṇaśrita
ityādau śritādiṣvatiprasaṅga ityāśayenāha samāsaśāstra ithi| vigraha
iti| anuvartamānena samāsagrahaṇena vigrahe lakṣyata iti bhāvaḥ| natu
tasyeti| ṭhanantarasya--’iti nyāyātpūrvasūtreṇa vihitasya
pūrvanipātatvaṃ na niṣidhyate| tena kumārīśrita ityādau na doṣaḥ| 
(572) gostriyorupasarjanasya |1|2|48|
gostriyoḥ| upasarjanasyeti gostriyorviśeṣaṇam| ekavacanaṃ tu
pratyekābhiprāyeṇa| gostrībhyāṃ tu prātipadikaṃ viśeṣyate|
viśeṣaṇena tadantavidhirityāśayenāha--upasarjanaṃya iti|
upasarjanamiha śāstriyaṃ gṛhyate, na tvapradhānalakṣaṇam| tena
kumārīvā’’caranbrāhmaṇaḥ kumārītyatra na doṣa ityuktam|
strīpratyayāntamiti| ruyadhikāroktaṭābādyantamityarthaḥ|
tenātilakṣmīrityādau nātiprasaṅgaḥ| nanvevamapi
‘ājakumārīputra’ityādāvatiprasaṅga iti cet|
atrāhuḥ--upasarjanasya sasaṃbandhikatayā yasya prātipadikasya hrasvo
vidhīyate tadarthaṃ prati yadyautarapadabhūtayorgostriyorguṇībhāvastadaiva
hrasvatvamiti bhāṣyādāvuktatvānna doṣaḥ| bhāṣyadāvapi
utarapadabhūtayorityarthalābhastu ‘ṛtaddhite’tyataḥ
samāsapadānuvartanāditi bodhyamiti|
(573) nāvyayībhāvādato’mtvapañcamyāḥ |2|4|83|
nāvyayī| atra ṭhapañcamyāḥ’ ithi pratiṣedho’nantaratvādama eva na tu
vyavahitasyā’luko’pi| amumevārthaṃ dyotayituṃ sūtre ‘u’ śabdaḥ|
tasya pañcamīṃ vineti| evaṃ cā’dantādavyayībhāvātparasya pañcamabhinnasya
supo luṅ na, pañcamyāstu lugamādeśāvubhāvapi na bhavata iti
sthitam| ataḥ kim?| adhihari| diśayoriti| diśoriti halantena
vigrahe’pi etadeva rupam| diśśabdasya śaradādiṣu pāṭhāṭṭac|
(574) tṛtīyāsaptamyorbahulam |2|4|84|
apadiśamiti| pañcamīvyatiriktavibhaktīnāmudāharaṇamidam|
pañcamyāstu apadiśādityudāhāryam| vibhaktau tāvaditi| tāvaccchabdaḥ
kramārthaḥ| laukikaṃ vigrahavākyaṃ pradarśayati--harāviti| prācā tu
ṭhharau adhikṛtye’ti vigṛhitaṃ, tadasat| adhiharītyatra
adhikṛtyetyarthasyā’pratīteḥ| hari ṅīti| alaukike ṅśibdasyaiva
praveśa ucitaḥ, ṭhantaraṅgānapi---’iti nyāyāt| anyathā ReĀrautve
kṛte adhiharīti samāse hariśabdekāro durlabhaḥ syāditi bhāvaḥ|
ihaṭhharāvadhī’ti sthite’iti prācoktamupekṣitaṃ, nityasamāseṣu
asvapadavigrahasyaivocitatvāt| abhihite’pīti| dyotite’pītyarthaḥ|
vacanasāmarthyāditi| ‘upe’tyanuvartya subantena
samāsavidhānasāmarthyātsaptamī syādeveti bhāvaḥ|
nanvabhihite’dhikaraṇe ‘ratipadikārthamātre’ti prathamaiva syānna tu
saptamīti cet| atrāhuḥ--acītyasya subantena
samāsasyāvaśyakatve’dhiśabdadyotyādikaraṇārthavācakavibhāktereveha
svīkartumucitatvāditi| yatu prasādakṛtā
vyākhyātaṃ--ṭhtiṅkṛtaddhitasamāsairiti parigaṇanādadhinā’bhihite’pi
saptamī syādeve’tiṣa| tanna| pariganasyākare pratyākhyātatvāt|
‘armaṇi dvitīyā’iti sūtre svayamapi tathaivoktatvāt| ‘ramādamuṃ
nārada ityabodhi saḥ’ iti prayogavirodhācca| atra
vyācakṣate---ṭhvacanagrahaṇaṃ vibhaktyādibhiḥ pratyekaṃ saṃbadhyate’,
‘ākalyānteṣu’ityeva vaktavye vacanagrahaṇāt| evaṃ ca
tatsāmarthyādviṅktyarthamātra vṛteravyayasyeha grahaṇam| tena
vṛkṣasyopari vṛkṣasya pura ityatra samāso na bhavati| uparyādayo hi
digdeśakāleṣvapi vartante, na tu vibhaktyarthamātre| ataeva ‘ramādamuṃ
nārada ityūbodhi saḥ’ ityādau nātiprasaṅgaḥ, itiśabdasya
sarvanāmavatprakṛtaparāmarśakatvena karmatvamātranabhidhāyakatvāt| evaṃ
ca vibhaktiśabdaṃ prāyuṅkta’ti| anye tu---ṭhlāghavāt
‘simīpasamṛddhī’ti vaktavye vibhaktigrahaṇādvibhaktiśabdo na saptamyāṃ
paryavasyati| tataśca karmatvamātradyotakatāyām ṭhitinārada’miti
samāso bhavatyeva’ityāhuḥ|
(575) avyayībhāvaśca |2|4|18|
napuṃsakaṃ syāditi| etaccaṭhsa napuṃsaka’mityato labhyate| samīpa
iti|ṭhavyayībhāva’ ityanvarthasaṃjñāśrayaṇātsaptamīrūpāvyayārthaprādhānya
evāyaṃ samāsaḥ| samīpavartipradhānye tu ‘aṃkhyayāvyayāsanne’ti
bahuvrīhirvakṣyati---ṭhupadaśāḥ’iti yathā| vidhānasāmarthyāditi| nanu
‘amayā grāma’mityādau
dvitīyāvidhānasāmarthyānmāstvavyayībhāvaḥ,ārādvanādityatra tu
bhavedeva| ṭhanyārā’diti pañcamīvidhānasya dūrārthakārāccabdayoge
sāvakāśatvāditi cet| atra kecidutprekṣayanti--ṭhdūrāntikārthaiḥ
ṣaṣṭhaḷnyatarasyā’miti ṣaṣṭhīpañcamyoḥ prāptayostadapavādatayā
pañcamyeva tena vidhīyate| tathā cā’ntikārthakā’’rāccchabdayoge
ṣaṣṭhaḷpavādatayā pañcamīvidhānaṃ niravakāśameveti tatsamārthyā
dvayayībhāvo netyuktiḥ samyageveti| tadapare na kṣamante|
antikārthā’’rāccchabdayoge viśiṣya pañcamīvidhānā’bhāvāt,
ṭhanyārā’diti sūtrasya tvanyatra kṛtārthatvācca, sāmīpye
ārādvanamityavyayībhāvo durvāra eva’iti | evaṃ hi vyākurvatāṃ
padasyetyapakarṣā’bhāve bhṛśārthe sāvakāśo’yaṃ yaṅ paunaḥpunye
pareṇa dvirvacanena bādhyeteti ‘ityavīpsayo’riti
sūtrasthamanoramāgrantho’nukūla iti dik| sumadramiti|
utarapadārthaprādhānye tu ‘ugatī’ti tatpuruṣaḥ---samṛddhā madrāḥ
sumadrāḥ| duryavanamiti| na cārthā’bhāveneha siddhiḥ, yena samasyate
tadīyārthabhāve tatra samāsasvīkārāt| na ceha yavanānāmabhāvo,
yenārthā’bhāve samāsaḥ syāt, kiṃtu tadīyāyā ṛddherabhāva iti|
nirmakṣikamiti| saṃsargā’bhāve’yaṃ samāso, na tvanyonyā’bhāve’pi|
arthagrahaṇasāmarthyena samasyamānapadajanyapratītiviśeṣyavirodhina
evā’bhāvasya grahaṇāt| anyonyā’bhāvasya tu
pratiyogitāvacchedakenaiva virodhāt, tasya ca
prakāratve’pyaviśeṣyatvāt| ye tu vadanti ‘haṭaḥ paṭo netyatrāpi
paṭatvātyantā’bhāva evārthaḥ, ākṛtyadhikaraṇanyāyena jāteḥ
padārthatvā’diti, teṣāmapi mate
arthagrahaṇasāmarthyādevākṣiptadharmyabhāve’yaṃ samāso na tu dharmābhāva
iti na doṣaḥ| atyaya ithi| spaṣṭārthametat| arthābhāvena
gatārthatvāt| arthā’bhāvena saṃsargā’bhāvo vivakṣito na
tvanyonyābhāvaḥ| ghaṭaḥ paṭo netyatrātiprasaṅgāditi niṣkarṣāt|
saṃprati neti| ‘aṃpratītya’vyayamidānīmityarthe| ṭhetarhi
saṃpratīdānī’mityamarokteḥ|
taccādhikaraṇaśaktipradhānatvātkriyāpadenaivānvayārham| niṣeṣo’pi
kriyāyā evocitaḥ| tadetadāha--yujyata iti| asaṃpratīti
sautraprayoge tu yujikriyāntarbhāveṇa nañsamāsa iti bodhyam|
yatu prasādakṛtoktam--ṭhasaṃprati| saṃpratyayabhāva ityarthaḥ| anena
upayogyavastuno yo vartamānaḥ kālaḥ sa niṣidhyata’iti| tanna|
adhikaraṇaśaktipradhānasya kriyāyaivānvayārhasya niṣedhaṃ prati
pratiyogitvenānvayasyā’yuktatvāt| na hi ‘hūtale ghaṭo
nāstī’tyanena bhūtalaṃ niṣidhyata iti kaścidabhyupaiti, yenātra
vartamānakālaniṣedho yuktyarhaḥ syāt| itiharīti| svarūpapareṇa
ṣaṣṭhaḷntena hariśabdena saha prakāśārthasyetiśabdasya samāsaḥ| tataḥ
paścāditi| sati cātrāvyayībhāve paścāccchabdasya pūrvamipātaḥ
syāditi bhāvaḥ| bhāṣyaprayogāditi| ṭhanekamanyapadārthe’iti sūtre
‘arvapaścā’diti bhāṣyaprayogāccetyapi bodhyam| pratyarthamiti|
vṛtau vīpsāntarbhāvānna dvirvacanam| pratiśabdasyeti|
yatvāhuḥ--ṭhgrāmasya vṛkṣaṃ vṛkṣaṃ pratītyatra sāpekṣatvena samāsā’bhāve
dvitīyāvidhānaṃ sāvakāśa’miti| tanna| nityasamāseṣu
‘aviśeṣaṇānāṃ vṛtirne’tyasyā’pravṛteḥ| ānupūrvyeṇeti|
anupūrvasya bhāva ānupūrvyaṃ| brāhmaṇāditvāt ṣyañ|
(576) avyayībhāve cā’kāle |6|3|81|
cakreṇa yugapaditi| atra kecit--yugapaccakramiti samāsenaiva
bhavitavyaṃ, yugapaccchabdasyāpyavyayatvāt, kiṃ tu

(579) suppratinā mātrārthe |2|1|9|
suppratinā| subityanuvartamāne punaḥ
subgrahaṇamavyayanivṛtyarthamiti
dhvanayannudāharati--śākapratīti|nanvārambhasāmarthyādavyayabhinnameva
supsamasyata iti cet| atrāhuḥ--punaḥ subgrahaṇā’bhāve
doṣāmanyamahardivāmanyā rātririti vṛtiviṣaye
satvapradhānatādarśanātādṛśāvyayānyeva mātrārthe pratinā samasyeran,
tathā ca divasasya leśo divāprati doṣāpratītyādīnāharaṇatvaṃ
saṃbhāvyeteti| vṛkṣaṃ pratīti| nanu lakṣaṇādau prateḥ
karmapravacanīyasaṃjñāvidhānasāmarthyāddhvitīyāgarbhaṃ vākyameva syāt,
na tu samāsaḥ, tasya leśārthe sāvakāśatvāditi cet| maivam| ṭhvṛkṣaṃ
prati siñcantī’tyādau ṣatvanivārakatvena
karmapravacanīyasaṃjñāvidhānasya carutārthatvānmātrārthagrahaṇā’bhāve
lakṣaṇādābapyanena samāsaprasaṅgāt| vīpsāyāmavyayībhāve tu
pratyādeḥ pūrvanipātatve ‘ratyarthaṃ siñcantī’tyādau ṣatvā’prasaktyā
karmapravacanīyavidhānasyā’caritārthatayā tatsāmarthyāddvitīyāgarbhaṃ
vākyamapītyuktaṃ mūlakṛtā ṭhavyayaṃ vibhaktī’ti sūtre| atra
navyāḥ--pratyarthamityavyayībhāve vīpsāyāṃ dyotakatvena vidyamānamavyayaṃ
samasyate| vīpsādyotakasya yadi karma pravacanīyasaṃjñāvidhiḥ
svīkriyate, tadāpi pratistavanaṃ pratisthānamityādau ṣatvanivāraṇāya
pratītyasya karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā caritārthaiva| vastutastu vīpsāyāṃ
viṣayabhūtāyāṃ pratyādeḥ karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā, na tu
vīpsādyotakasyaiva| anyathā ṭhvṛkṣaṃ vṛkṣaṃ prati siñcatī’tyatra
dvirvacanenaiva vīpsā dyotyate| pratiśabdastu kriyāyā saṃbadhyate|
karmaṇi dvitīyā| karmapravacanīyasaṃjñayā upasargasaṃjñāyā bādhāt ṣatvaṃ
ne’tyādimanoramāgranthasya ‘akṣaṇetthaṃbhūte’ti sūtrasthasya
datajalāñjaliḥ syāt, tataśca saṃjñāvidhānasāmarthyāsyopakṣīṇatvāt,
arthamarthaṃ pratītyādibhāṣyaprayogādeva dvitīyāgarbhaṃ vākyamapi
bhavatītyevaṃ vyākhyeyamityāhuḥ| parājayaṃ dyotayitumāha---viparītaṃ
vṛtamiti| pūrvaṃ jaye yathā vṛtaṃ tathā na vṛtamityarthaḥ| ekaparīti|
ekaṃna viparītaṃ vṛtamityarthaḥ| evaṃ dviparītyādi|
ṭhvibhāṣā’paparibahi’riti yogaṃ vibhajya vyācaṣṭe|

(580) vibhāṣā |2|1|11|
vibhāṣeti| itaḥ prācīnānāṃ samāsānāṃ hi ṭighubhādisaṃjñānāmiva
vāgrahaṇā’bhāvānnityatvaṃ nyāyata eva siddhaṃ, tacca liṅgenāpi
draḍhayati-etaditi| nanvevaṃ ‘upsupā’ ityapi nityaṃ syāt,
iṣṭāpatau tu ‘ūrvaṃ bhūto bhūtapūrvaḥ| supsupeti samāsaḥ’ iti
vṛtigrantho virudhyeta| tathā śākalasūtre ‘innityasamāsayoḥ
śākalapratiṣedhaḥ’ ityatra ‘itya grahaṇena nārthaḥ, idamapi siddhaṃ
bhavati--vāpyāmaśvo vāpyaśvaḥ’ iti bhāṣyaṃ kaiyaṭo vyākhyāt--ṭhvāpyaśva
iti supsupe’ti samāsasaḥ| ‘aṃjñāyām’ iti saptamīsamāsasya tu
nityatvātsiddhaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ’iti| so’pi grantho
virudhyetetyāśaṅkāyāmāha supsupeti tviti| nanvatra kiṃ
pramāṇamityata āha--avyayamityādīti| supsapetyanenaiva siddhe samāse
ṭhavyaya’mityādisūtraiḥ punaḥ samāsavidhānaṃ pkācīnasya kvācitkātāṃ
jñāpayatītyarthaḥ| evaṃ ca ivena samāsasyāpi kvācitkatvāt
ṭhudvāhuriva vāmanaḥ’ityādi siddham| ṭhivene’tivārtikaṃ tu yadyapi
‘ugatī’tyatra paṭhaḷte tathāpi ‘upsupe’tyatratyameva nityā’dhikāre
smāritamiti kaiyaṭaḥ| evaṃ sthite ṭhudbāhuriva
vāmanaḥ’ityādilokaprayodasiddhaye ivena samāsasya cchandoviṣayakatvaṃ
kalpayantaḥ pratyuktāḥ| cchandasyapi tatsamāsasya nityatvānabhyupagamāt|
‘īmūtasyeve’tyatra hi bahvṛcaiḥ samāsābhyupagame’pi
taitirayairvyastasyaiva pāṭhāt| etacca manoramāyāṃ sthitam|
(581) apaparibahirañcavaḥ pañcamyā |2|1|12|
apaparibahiḥ| apapariyoge ‘añcamyapāṅparibhi’riti
pañcamīvihitā, añcūtarapadayoge’pi ṭhanyārā’ dityādinā
vihitaiva| tenā’tra ‘añcamyā’iti grahaṇaṃ ‘ahiryoge pañcamī bhavati’
iti jñāpanārtham| ‘ñāpakasiddhaṃ na sarvatre’ti ‘arasya karabho
bahi’rityapi siddham|
(582) āṅvaryādābhividhyoḥ |2|1|13|
ābālamiti| ṭhā paramaṇorā ca bhūgolaka’ miti
kiraṇāvalīprayogastu prāmādikaḥ, samāsamadhye ca śabda
prayogā’saṃbhavāt| ṭhā ca bhūgolakāt’iti pāstūcitaḥ|
(583) lakṣaṇenābhipratī ābhimukhye |2|1|14|
lakṣaṇena| ‘ihnaṃ lakṣma ca lakṣaṇa’mityamarastadāha--cihnavācineti|
ihā’bhipratī lakṣyalakṣaṇabhāvam, ābhimukhyaṃ cetyubhayaṃ dyotayata iti
phalitam| agnimabhi| agniṃ pratīti| ṭhabhirabhāge’
‘akṣaṇetthaṃbhūte’tyanena ca abhipratyoḥ karmapravacanīyatvāddritīyā|
lakṣaṇeneti kim?| srugdhnaṃ pratigataḥ| srugdhnādāgatastameva
pratinivṛta ityarthaḥ| atra hi srugdhnaḥ karma, na tu lakṣaṇam|
abhipratīti kim?| yenāgnistena gataḥ| yena pathā agnirgatastena gata
iti pratīterbhavati gamanasyāgnirlakṣaṇam, ābhimukhyamapyastīti
yenatena śabdayoragniśabdena samāsaḥ syāt| ābhimukhye kim?|
abhyaṅkā gāvaḥ| pratyaṅkāḥ| abhinavaḥ pratinavaścāṅka āsāmiti
bahuvrīhiḥ| aṅko hyatra bhavati gavāṃ lakṣaṇam| ābhimukhyaṃ tu nāsti|
nanūtsargato’vyayārthaprādhānye’vyayībhāvasvīkārātkathamiha prasaṅgaḥ?
| atrāhuḥ--iha prakaraṇe bahuvrīhiviṣaye’vyayībhāvo bhavatīti
jñāpanārthamidaṃ| tena ‘aṅkhyā vaṃśyena’ṭhdvimuni vyākaraṇa’mityādi
siddhamiti|
(584) anuryatsamayā |2|1|15|
anuryat,| yadisi samayāyoge dvitīyeti dhvanayati-yaṃ
padārthamiti| yasya padārthasya samīpamityarthaḥ| lakṣaṇenetyanuvartata
ityāha--lakṣaṇabhūteneti| cihnavācinetyarthaḥ| ṭhavyaya vibhaktī’ tyanena
siddhe vibhāṣārthaṃ sūtram| tena pakṣe ṭhvanasyānu’ityudāhāryamiti
manoramāyāṃ sthitam| atra vadanti--vanasyeti ṣaṣṭhīha durlabhā,
karmapravacanīyayukte dvitīyāyā durvāratvāt, tatsāmarthyātsamayā
laṅkāmitivatsamāsabādhe prasakte asya vidhyarthatvāt| na cāyamanuḥ
sāmīpyamātradyotako, na lakṣyalakṣamabhāvasyeti vācyam|
lakṣaṇenetyavṛtivaiyarthyāt| na caivamapi lakṣaṇamātradyotakatvaṃ
nāstīti vācyam| ‘akṣaṇettha’mityatra mātrapadā’bhāvāt| agnimabhi,
agniṃ pratīti pūrvasūtrasthodāharaṇā[pratyudāharaṇaṭvākyavirodhācca|
ato’tra pakṣe ṭhvanamanu’ityudāhāryam| ṭhvanasya samīpaṃ gata’ iti
mūlasthaṃ vivaraṇavākyaṃ tu ‘akṣaṇa bhūtasya vanasya samīpaṃ gata’ iti
vyākhyeyamiti| anviti kim?| grāmaṃ samayā| yatsamayeti kim?|
vṛkṣamanuvidyotate vidyaut| lakṣaṇena kim?| anuva[caṭnam|
upakṛṣṇamitivadatra nityamavyayībhāvaḥ|
(585) yasya cāyāmaḥ |2|1|16|
yasya cā| ihānurityanuvartya āvartyaikaṃ tṛtīyāntatvena
vipariṇamayya vyācaṣṭe--anuneti| lakṣaṇabhūteneti|
lakṣaṇenetyanuvartata iti bhāvaḥ| anugaṅgamiti|
ihā’’yāmopalakṣaṇatvaṃ cānunā dyotyate, lakṣyaṃ tu samāsārthaḥ| ataeva
vārāṇasyāḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyam| evaṃ sthite
phalitamāha--gaṅgādairdhyeti| vārāṇasīti| varaṃ ca tadanaśca
varānaḥuśreṣṭhodakam| ṭhanaḥ klībaṃ jale śoke
mātṛsyandanayordvayoḥ’ iti rudrarabhasau| tasyā’dūre bhavā|
ṭhadūrabhavaśca’ ityaṇ| ādivṛddhiḥ| ‘ūrvapadātsaṃjñāyām’iti ṇatvam|
gaṅgāyā anviti| samāsā’bhāvapakṣe prāguktarītyā
gaṅgāmanvityudāhāryamityāhuḥ| (586) tiṣṭhadguprabhṛtīni ca
|2|1|17|
tiṣṭhadguprabhṛtīni ca| cakāra evakārārtheṣa| tenaiṣāṃ vṛtyantaraṃ na
bhavati| paramatiṣṭhadgu ityādi na bhavatītyarthaḥ| tiṣṭhadgu iti|
‘ostriyo’riti hrasvaḥ| prathamāsamānādhikaraṇe
śatrādeśasyā’saṃbhavādāha--iha śatrādeśa iti| ityādīti|
ādiśabdena--khaleyavam| khalebusam| saptamyā aluk| lūnayavam|
lūyamānayavamityādi grāhyam|
(587) pāre madhye ṣaṣṭhaḷa vā |2|1|18|
pāre madhye| nipātyata iti| yatra saptamyartho na saṃbhavati
tadarthamekārāntatvanipātanam| saptamyarthasaṃbhave tu ‘atpuruṣe
kṛti bahula’miti bahulagrahaṇādalukā’pi siddheḥ, ato’tra
saptamyarthā’bhāvasūcanāya
pañcamyantamudāharati--pāregaṅgādityādi| mahāvibhāṣayeti|
nanvapavāde’vyayībhāve mahāvibhāṣayā vikalpite pakṣe tadutsargaḥ
ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣaḥ pravartate, tasyāpi vibhāṣādhikārasthatvena
vaikalpikatvātpakṣe vākyamapi sidhyatīti sūtre vāgrahaṇaṃ
vyarthameveti cet| atrāhuḥ--mahāvibhāṣayā ekārthībhāvasya pākṣikatve
vivakṣite yadā ekārthībhāvastadā ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaṃ bādhitvā
nityamavyayībhāve prāpte pakṣe ṣaṣṭhīsamāsasamāveśārthamiha
vāgrahaṇam| ṭhvyapekṣāsāmarthyameke’ iti pakṣe tu vṛtāvapi
vyapekṣālakṣaṇameva sāmarthyāmiti vākyasya nityaṃ bādhe prasakte tayā
vṛtirvikalpyate| tathā cā’vyayībhāve vikalpite pūrvoktarītyā pakṣe
tatpuruṣastasyāpi vaikalpikatvādvākyamapi siddhatyeva, tathāpi
ṭhyatrotsargāpavādau mahāvibhāṣayā vikalpyete tatrāpavādena mukte
punarutsargo na pravartate’ iti jñāpanāyedam| tena pūrvaṃ
kāyasyetyekadeśisamāsena mukte ṣaṣṭhīsamāso na bhavati,
dakṣasyāpatyaṃ dākṣirityatra ata iñā mukte aṇ na bhavati, kiṃtūbhayatra
vākyameveti| 
(588) saṃkhyā vaṃśyena |2|1|19|
saṃkhyā vaṃśyena| vaṃśaḥ saṃtānanastatra bhavo vaṃśyaḥ| digāditvādyat|
dvimunīti| pāṇinikātyāyanau| trimunīti| tau dvau,
pātañjaliśceti trayo vaṃśyāḥ| vyākaraṇasyeti saṃbandhe ṣaṣṭhī|
svapadārthaprādhānya evāyaṃ samāsaḥ| yadā
tvanyapadārthaprādhānyavivakṣā-trayo munayo vaṃśyā yasyeti, tadā
bahuvrīhirevetyāhuḥ| trimuni vyākaraṇamiti|
yadyapyetadbahuvrīhiṇā’pyupapannaṃ, tathāpi vibhaktyantareṣu rupe’pi
viśeṣo’styeveti bhāvaḥ| vastutastu ‘akṣaṇenābhipratī--’iti sūtre
ābhimukhyagrahaṇādbahuvrīhiviṣaye’pyaṭhaḷyībhāvo bhavatītidvimuni
vyākaraṇamityādi siddhamityavocāma| janmanodāharati---ekaviṃśati
bhāradvājamiti| ekaviṃśatirbharadvājā vaṃśyā iti vigrahaḥ| nanu
bharadvājādvidādyaño ṭhyañañośce’ti luk prāpnoti| na ca
vartipadānāṃ
svārthepasarjanaikatvaviśiṣṭārthāntaropasaṅkamāllugabhāva iti
kaiyaṭoktamādartavyam| vṛtipraveśātprāgeva prāpnuvato’ntaraṅgasya
luko durvāratvāt| anyathā gargāṇāṃ kulaṃ gargakulamityapi na
syāt| atrāhuḥ--bhāṣyakāraprayogādeva lugabhāvo’tra bodhya iti|
etacca ‘ṛtīyāsaptamyo’riti sūtre śabdakaustubhe spaṣṭam|
(589) nadībhiśca |2|1|20|
nadībhiśca| svarūpasya saṃjñāyāśca neha grahaṇaṃ, bahuvacananirdeaśāt,
kiṃ tvarthasya| naca tasya samāsaḥ saṃbhavati, atastadvācināmayaṃ samāsaḥ,
te ca na kevalaṃ viśeṣaśabdā eva kiṃtu sāmānyaśabdo’pi| tena
pañcanadaṃ saptagodāvaramiti siddham| ‘odāvaryāśca nadyāśce’ti
vakṣyamāṇena samāsānto’c| cakāreṇa saṅkhyetyanukṛṣyata
ityāha---saṃkhyeti| syādetat--purastādapavādanyāyena
‘ūrvakālaike’tyasyaivedaṃ bādhakaṃ syāt,
tataścaivanadītyatrāvyayobhāve tannibandhanasya ‘adīpaurṇamāsye’ti
ṭacaḥ prasaṅgaḥ, samāhāre tu paratvāddvigureva syādityata āha--|
samāhāre cāyamiṣyate| samāhāre cāyamiti| evakārārthaścākāraḥ|
evaṃ ca dvigorapavādo’mavyayībhāva iti phalitam|
(590) anyapadārthe ca saṃjñāyām |1|2|21|
anyapadārthe ca| saṅkhyeti nuvṛtam| nadīgrahaṇamanuvartate|
tadāha--subantaṃ nadībhiḥ saheti| anyapadārtha iti kim?| kṛṣṇaveṇī|
saṃjñānavagamāditi| samyak jñāyate iti saṃjñā| ṭhātaścopasarge’ iti
karmaṇyaṅ| saṃjñino deśaviśeṣasyā’navagamādityarthaḥ|
anyapadārthānavagamāditi tu noktaṃ,
yasyetyādipadāntarasamabhivyāhāreṇā’nyapadārthapratīteḥ| athaeva
bahuvrīhirna nityasamāsa iti bhāvaḥ| saṃjñāyāṃ kim?| śīghragaṅgo
deśaḥ| athā’vyayībhāve’sādhāraṇānsamāsāntanāha--avyayī|
‘aradādibhya’iti vaktavye paryāyeṣu lāghavacintā nādriyata iti
prabhṛtigrahaṇaṃ kṛtam| ṭac syāditi|
‘ājahaḥsakhibhyaḥ--’ityataṣṭajanuvartata iti bhāvaḥ|
(591) samāsāntāḥ |5|4|68|
samāsānta iti| samāsasya samāsārthotarapadasya vā caramāvayava
ityarthaḥ| tenopaśaradamityatra ‘avyayībhāvā’dityam sidhdyati,
avyayībhāvasyā’dantatvāt, dvipurītyādautu
ṭhṛkpūrabdhū’rityapratyaya utarapadasyāvayava iti ṭhakārāntotara
pado dviguḥ striyo’miti strītve ‘vigo’riti ṅīpsidhyatīti
bodhyam|
(592) avyayībhāve śaratprabhṛtibhyaḥ |5|4|107|
prativipāśamiti| ‘akṣanenābhipratī---’iti samāsaḥ| ṭhvipāśā tu
vipāṭ striyā’mityamaraḥ| gaṇaṃ paṭhati--śaradityādinā| atra ye
jhayantāsteṣāṃ ‘hayaḥ’ iti vikalpe prāpte nityārthaḥ pāṭhaḥ| iha
‘arāyā jaras’, ‘ratipare’ti ca dvayaṃ gaṇasūtram| upajarasamiti|
jarāyāḥ samīpamityarthaḥ| yasyeticeti| ṭacastaddhitakatvātasminpare
ikāralopa iti bhāvaḥ| pratyakṣamiti| vīpsāyāṃ yathārthatvena samāsaḥ|
akṣṇo rābhimukhyamityarthe ‘akṣaṇenābhipratī---’ iti vā samāsaḥ|
akṣṇaḥ paramiti| aviṣaya ityarthaḥ| vṛtiviṣaye ṭhakṣi’ śabda
indriyamātraparaḥ| avyayā’ghaṭitasamudāyasya kathamihāvyayībhāvo,
vidhāyakasūtrā’bhāvādityāśaṅkyāha--vidhānasāmarthyāditi|
samakṣamiti| akṣṇo yogyam| anvakṣamiti| akṣṇaḥ
paścādityarthe’vyayībhāvaḥ|
(593) nāstaddhite |6|4|144|
nāstaddhite| ‘a’ityanena bhasyetyadhikṛtaṃ viśeṣyate, viśeṣaṇena
tadantavidhirata āha--nāntasya bhasyeti| nanūparājimityatra
‘astaddhite’iti vyartham, ṭhavyayānāṃ bhamātre---’ iti ṭilopenaiva
siddheḥ| na cāvyayatvaṃ ṭajviśiṣṭe paryāptamiti vācyam,
avyayībhāvasaṃjñāyā upajīvyatvena ṭacaḥ
pūrvabhāgasyāpyavyayatvānapāyāt| atrāhuḥ--bhāṣye
luṅmukhasvaropacāreṣu triṣveva kāryeṣu
avyayībhāvasyāvyayasaṃjñāvidhānānna doṣa iti| yukta caitat| anyathā
upaśaradamityādau ṭilopaḥ prasajyeta| yadyapyaḍutamasya piccetyatra
dīrghoccāraṇena svāvayavena paurvaparyaṃ nāstītijñāpitam, ṭha’
ḍityukte’pi tadādigrahaṇena tadviśiṣṭasyā’ṅgatvādato dīrgho
yañīti dīrghasiddheḥ, tathāpyahnaṣṭakhoreveti liṅgatsamāsānteṣu
tannāśrīyata iti bodhyam| ādhyāyatmamiti ātmani adhyātmam|
vibhaktyarthe’vyayībhāvaḥ|
(594) napuṃsakādanyatarasyām |5|4|109|
napuṃsakādanya| napuṃsakagrahaṇamannantasya viśeṣaṇaṃ nāvyayībhāvasya,

cāvyayībhāvaviśeṣaṇātadantavidhirityāha--tadantāditi|
upacarmamiti| ṭaci ṭilopapo’dantatvādambhāvaśca| tatvaṭ|
(595) nadīpaurṇamāsyāgrahāyaṇībhyaḥ |5|4|110|
nadīpaurṇa| iha svarūpasyaiva grahaṇaṃ na saṃjñāyāḥ,
paurṇamāsyāgrahāyaṇyoḥ pṛthaggrahaṇāt| upanadīti| ṭacabhāve
napuṃsakahrasvaḥ| atra vyācakṣate--ṭhvṛtigranthamanurudhyedaṃ vikalpakathanam|
paramārthatastu nehānyatarasyāmityanuvartate| ‘ahugaṇe’ti
sūtrasthabhāṣyavirodhāt| tatra hi--nadīśabdena nadīviśeṣāṇāṃ
gaṅgāyamunādīnāṃ grahaṇamāśaṅkya śaratprabhṛtiṣu
vipāṭśabdapāṭhānneti samāhitam| na cedaṃ bhāṣyaṃ
‘adīpaurṇamāsī’tyatra ṭacaḥ pākṣikatve saṅgaccchate,nityārthatayā
tatpāṭhasyopapateḥ| ataeva senakagrahaṇamutaratrā’rthavat| kaiyaṭastu
vyavasthitavibhāṣāmāśritya vṛtigranthaṃ kathaṃcitsamarthitavāniti|

 (718) śeṣo bahuvrīhiḥ |2|2|23|
śeṣo bahuvrīhiḥ| ‘iṣ asarvopayoge’ karmaṇi ghañ| atra
vṛtikṛt---, ṭhyatrānyaḥ samāso noktaḥ sa śeṣa’ ityāha| ṭhyeṣāṃ
padānāṃ yasminnarthe’vyayībhāvādisaṃjñakaḥ samāso na vihitaḥ sa śeṣa
ityartha’iti haradato vyākhyāt| etacca ‘rākkaḍārātparaṃ kārya’miti
pāṭhābhiprāyeṇa bodhyam| asmistu pakṣe śeṣagrahaṇā’bhāve
unmatagaṅgamityatra paratvādbahuvrāhiḥ syāt,
niravakāśatvāccā’vyayībhāva ityunmatagaṅga ityādyaniṣṭaṃ pakṣe
prasajyate| ṭhā kaḍārādeke’ti pāṭhābhyupagamapakṣe
tvekasaṃjñā’dhikāreṇāvenmatagaṅgamityādisiddheḥ śeṣagrahaṇaṃ
vyartham| niravakāśatayā’vyayībhāvasaṃjñayā bahuvrīhisaṃjñāyā
bādhāt| atastatrāpi prayojanamāha--dvitīyā śritetyādineti|
seṣadhikārasthabahuvrīhereva ‘eṣādvibhāṣe’ti kappratyayo
nānyasmādbahuvrīhorityetallābhārthamapi śeṣagrahaṇamāvaśyakamiti
bodhyam| yasya trikasyeti| yadyapi ‘rādayo gatādyarthe
prathamaye’tyuktam, tathāpi ‘vitīyā śritādibhiḥ’itivat ‘rathamā
kenacitsaha samasyate’iti noktamityarthaḥ| vārtikakṛtā
prathamayetyuktāvapi sūtrakṛtā noktamiti vā| prathamāntamiti|
‘aṇṭhekāla’ityādibahuvrīhistu jñāpakasādhya iti bhāvaḥ| anyasya

prayogasambhavāt| na ca madaddhalaṃ haliḥ, tadrahito’halistatraivārthe’hala
iti prayogārthaṃ tadgrahaṇamiti vācyam, ahala ityatra
pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ syāditi saṅkyaṃ,
‘añsubhyā’mityanenāntodātatvavidhānāt| atrāhuḥ---śaiṣikasya
kapo nivṛtyarthaṃ, ‘urhalaḥ’ ityatrāntodātatvārthaṃ ca taditi|
śaktyoriti| ācāryeṇa kecicchātrā ṭhhaliśaktyo’riti pāṭhitā iti
bhāvaḥ|
(744) nityamasic prajāmedhayoḥ |5|4|122|
nityamasic| akāroccāraṇaṃ bhatvasampādanārtham, te

nityagrahaṇamanyato vidhānārtham| tena ṭhalpamedhasa’iti sidhyatīti
vṛtikārādayaḥ|
(745) dharmādanickevalāt |5|4|124|
dharmādanic| anico’kāraścintyaprayojana ityeke| anye tu dharmaṃ
karotyācaṣṭe vā, ‘atkarotī’ti ṇyantātkvipi dharm, paramo
dharm yasya saḥ paramadharm|
ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvāddharmaśabdo’yamityakāroccāraṇamiha
saprayojanamevetyāhuḥ| bahuvrāhiṇātra pūrvapadamākṣipyata
ityanupadameva vakṣyati| tacca ‘evalā’dityanena viśeṣyata
ityāha---kevalātpūrvapadāditi| prācā tūtarapadamapi viśeṣitam|
prasādakṛtāpi kevalāditi dharmaśabdasya pūrvapadasya ca viśeṣaṇamiti
vyākhyātam, tadubhayamapi cintyam| āvṛtau mānā’bhāvāt,
dharmapadaviśeṣaṇe prayojanā’bhāvācca| na ca dharmaśabdāntaṃ
yatrotarapadaṃ tavdyavṛtiḥ phalamiti vācyaṃ , tatra
bahuvrīhyavayavībhūtapūrvapadātparasya
dharmapade’sambhavādevā’doṣatvāt| madhyamatvāditi| na ca
‘arvanāmasaṅkhyayo’riti svaśabdasya pūrvanipātaḥ śaṅkyaḥ,
āhitāgnyāderākṛtigaṇatvāditi haradatadibhiḥ samāhitatvāt|
āpekṣikamiti| nanvata eva kevalagrahaṇaṃ vyarthaṃ, pūrvaśabdasya
samāsaprathamāvayave rūḍhatvenaiva madhyamapadavyāvṛtisambhavāditi cet|
atrāhuḥ--pūrvapadākṣepe tātparyagrāhakatvena kevalapadasya
sārthakatvāditi| karmadhārayapūrvapada iti| nanvatrā’nic da#urlabhaḥ,
‘evalā’dityasya samāsānātacmakatvādityarthāditi cet, maivam|
kevalagrahaṇasya samāsānātmakapūrvapadaparatve mānā’bhāvāt|
‘ivṛtidharmā hi sthānī bhavatī’tyādiprayogavirodhācca|
asmaduktārthastu ‘hṛñ dhāraṇe’iti dhātau mādhavagranthe spaṣṭaḥ| etena
sādhyoḥ dharmo’syeti sādhyadharmā, saṃdigdhaścāsau sādhyadharmā ceti
vigrahaḥ| sa ca sandehaḥ sādhyadharmadvāraka eva paryavasyatīti
keṣāñcivdyākhyānaṃ parāstam| uktirītyaiva sādhyasya
sākṣātsandigdhatvalābhe tatsamarthanaprayāsasya vyarthatvāt| sādhveveti|
paramaścāsau svaśca paramasvaḥ, sa dharmo yasyeti yadā vigṛhyate
tadetyarthaḥ|

(476) sārvadhātuke yak |3|1|67|
sārvadhātuke yak| ‘hātorekācaḥ’ ityato dhātoriti, ‘iṇ
bhāvakarmaṇo’rityato bāvakarmaṇoriti cānuvartate| bhāvo
bhāvaneti| utpatyarthadbhavaterṇijantāderajiti bhāvaḥ|

bhavaterutpatyarthatvaṃ, ṇyantasya bhavateḥ śuddhena karotinā tulyārthatvaṃ
ca darśayati-- utpādanā kriyeti| yathā karoti
ghaṭamityādāvutpatyanukūlo vyāpāraḥ kulālaniṣṭhaḥ, tathā bhāvayati
ghaṭamityādāvapi| bhavati ghaṭa ityatrāpi ghaṭaniṣṭha utpatyanukūlo
vyāpāro’styeva, paraṃtu phalasamānādhikaraṇaḥ saḥ, kulālaniṣṭhastu
phalavyadhikaraṇa itīyānbhedaḥ| ata eva phalavyāparayoḥ
sāmānādhikaraṇyādbhavatyādirakarmakaḥ, tayostu
vaiyadhikaraṇyātkarotyādiḥ sakarmaka ityāhuḥ| etena ‘hāvo bhāvane’
tyādigranthena ‘hūvādayo dhātavaḥ’ ityatra kriyāvācinaḥ kim ?|
vikalpārthakavāśabdādbhāve liṇ mābhūt| anyathā bhvādigaṇe
vāśabdamātrapaṭhanādakriyāvācino’pi vāśabdasya dhātutve ‘hātvarthaḥ
kevalaḥ śuddho bhāva ityabhidhīyate’ iti vikalpasyāpi bāvatvāpatyā
tadvācakavāśabdālliṭ syādeveti keṣāṃcidvyākhyānaṃ parāstam,
bhāvanāvācakādeva bhāve liṭaḥ svīkārāt| vikalpasya tu
bhāvanābhinnatvāt| anyathā ‘riyāvācina’ iti viśeṣaṇe date’pi
taddoṣatādavasthyāt| vikalpavācakālliḍabhāve’pi laḍādayaḥ syuriti
tu na śaṅkanīyameva, vartamānakriyādivṛtereva laḍādīnāṃ
vidhānāt| kimrathaṃ tarhi kriyāvācino bhvādaya iti sarvaireva tatra
vyākhyātam?| ṭhyāḥ paśyasī’tyatrāpi lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣayā
yāśabdasya dhātutvā’saṃbhavāt ṭhāto dhātoḥ’ iti
tatrā’’llopāprasaktiriti cet| atrāhuḥ-- ‘āryakālaṃ
saṃjñāparibhāṣa’miti pakṣe ṭhāto dhātutvā’saṃbhavāt ṭhāto dhātoḥ’
iti tatrā’llopāprasaktiriti cet| atrāhuḥ-- ‘āryakālaṃ
saṃjñāparibhāṣa’miti pakṣe ṭhāto dhāto’riti kāryapradeśe
bhvādayo dhātava ityupatiṣṭhate bhvādiṣu
yāśabdamātarpaṭhanāddravyavācako’pi yāśabdastatropatiṣṭhate|
varṇagrahaṇe lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣāyā apravṛteḥ, ṭhāto
dhāto’rityatra tvāt iti varṇagrahaṇāt| tasmāddvyavacākasya
yāśabdasya dhātusaṃjñā mābhūditi kriyāvācina iti viśeṣaṇamavaśyaṃ
vaktavyameveti| ṭhutpādanā kriye’ tyanena tu kriyāvācī
dhāturdhātvarthaḥ kriyetyanyonyāśrayo’tra duṣparihara iti
keṣāṃcidākṣepo nirastaḥ| utpatyanukūlavyāpārasya kriyātvāt|
tada#uktam-- ṭhvyāpāro bhāvanā saivotpādanā saiva ca kriye’ti |
dhātutveneti| sakaladhātuṣu dhātutvaṃ
jātirakhaṇḍopādhirvetyanyadetat| tacca vācakatāvacchedakam|
kriyātvaṃ tu vācyatāvacchedakamiti bhāvaḥ| dhātuvācyeti| nanvevaṃ
pacatītyādāvekakartṛkā vartamānā pacikriyeti kriyāviśeṣyako
bodho na syāt, pratyayārthaṃ prati prakṛtyarthasyaviśeṣaṇatāyā
āṬpagavādau klṛptatvāt| tathā ca ‘hāvanā tiṅ pratyayavācye’ti
mīmāṃsakamatameva ramaṇīyamiti cet| atrāhuḥ-- ‘ratyayārthaḥ
pradhāna’miti utsargaḥ, sa ceha tyajyate,ṭhkriyāpradhānamākhyāta’smarāt|
ṭābādyarthatvena mīmāṃsakairabhyupagatasya strītvasya pācikādau
viśeṣaṇatvābyupagamātpratyayārthaḥ pradhānamiti niyamasya tyaktatvācca|
kiṃ ca bhoktavyamityādau tiRṃĀ vināpi bhāvanā pratīyate,
kārakāpekṣā ca dṛśyate| asti ca karotisāmānādhikaraṇyam| kiṃ ca
bhoktavyamityādau tiRṃĀ vināpi bhāvanā pratīyate, kārakāpekṣā ca
dṛśyate| asti ca karotisāmānādhikaraṇyam| kiṃ kartavyaṃ ?,
bhoktavyam, kiṃ kṛtavān ?, bhuktavāniti| naca kṛtāmapi
tavyadādīnāṃ bhāvanāvācakatvamastviti śaṅkyam,
nāmārthayorabhedānvayānurodhena ‘artari kṛ’diti tavyadādayaḥ
karma#adāviti parairapyabhyupagamāt| anyathā pācako devadataḥ,
paktavya odana ityatrā’bhedabodho na syāt| tathā ca dhātuvācyatvaṃ
bhāvanāyā ityeva mataṃ ramaṇīyataramiti| lakārasya sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ
kartṛkarmābhidhāyina eva saṃbhavati na bhāvābhidhāyina ityāśayena
vyācaṣṭe-- sāmānādhikaraṇayābhāvāditi| na caivaṃ
yuṣmadasmadbhinnopapade samānādhikaraṇe devadataḥ patītyādāviva
prathamapuruṣeṇa bhāvyamiti prathamapuruṣo’pyatra na syāditi vācyaṃ,
‘eṣe prathamaḥ’ ityatra ‘adhyamotamayoraviṣaye prathamaḥ syā’diti
vyākhyānāt| tiṅvācyeti| ghañāditavācyāyāstu
satvarūpatvamiṣṭameveti pākaṃ pākenetyādau yathāyathaṃ dvitīyādayaḥ
pravartante| ata eva bhāṣyakṛtoktaṃ ‘ṛdabhihito bhāvo
dravyavatprakāśate’ iti| dravyadharmāṃlliṅgasaṅkhyākārakādīn
gṛhṇātītyarthaḥ| ekavacanameveti| prāyovādo’yam| anyathā
ṭhuṣṭrāsikā āsyante’ ṭhhataśāyikāḥ śayyante’ iti bhāṣye
dhātvarthanirdeaśe ṇvuli kṛdabhihito bhāvo dravyavatprakāśata
ityāsikāḥ śāyikā ityatra bahuvacanasiddhāvapi āsyante śayyante ityatra
tanna sidhyet| na ca karmaṇyevā’tra lakāro’stviti śaṅkyam,
dhātudvayasyāpyakarmakatvena tadasaṃbhavāt, arthā’saṅgateśca| tatra
hyuṣṭrāṇāṃ yādṛśānyāsanāni hatānāṃ yādṛśāni śayanāni tādṛśāni
devadatādi kartṛkānyāsanādīnītyarthaḥ. sādṛśyāvagamādiha
ākhyātavācyasyāpi bhāvasya bhedā’vabhāsādbahuvacanam| na caivaṃ
saṅkyānvayitve asatvarūpatā na syāditi vācyam,
liṅgakriyā’nādhārakārakayogā’bhāvamātreṇā’satvarūpatvamupapadyata
iti kārakeṣūktatvāt| kecidiha uṣṭrāsikā--
hataśāyikāśabdayostatsadṛśe lakṣaṇāṃ svīkṛtya āsyanta ityādinā
abhedānvayamāhuḥ| manoramāyāṃ tu āsikāḥ śāyikā iti ca
dvitīyābahuvacanaṃ, kriyāviśeṣaṇatvena karmatvāt| na caivaṃ

dvikarmakāsteṣu lakṛtadyaktakhalarthāḥ kiṃ mukhye karmaṇi, uta gauṇe, kiṃ
vobhayoriti saṃdehe vyavasthāmāha----dvikarmakāṇāṃ
tviti|duhyāderiti| duhyācpaciti śloke pūrvārdhopātā dvādaśa
duhyādayastebhyo gauṇe karmaṇi lādayo matā ityanvayaḥ| ṭhakathitaṃ
ce’ti sūtreṇa yasya karmasaṃjñā tadgauṇam| ‘atibuddhī’ti sūtreṇa
ye dvikarmakāstatra vyavasthāmāha-- tadgauṇam| prayojyeti| aṇau
kartuṇau karmasaṃjñā yasya tatprayojyakarma| anyeṣāmiti|
gatyarthā’karmakahṛkarotīnām| lādaya iti| kṛtyaktakhalarthā
ādiśabdena grāhyāḥ| gaurduhyate iti| ‘evadatene’ti
śeṣaḥ|kṛtyādiṣu gaurdogdhavyā| dohanīyā payaḥ| gauḥ sudohā
durdohā payaḥ| ajā grāmaṃ netavyā | nayanīyā| haratvayā| haraṇīyā |
ajā grāmaṃ neyā ityādyauhartavyam| grāmaṃ gamyata iti|
ṭhyajñadatene’tyadhyāhāraḥ| māṇavaka iti| ayaṃ prayojyaḥ kartā|
devadateneti prayojakastvadhyāhartavyaḥ| 
iti tatvabodhinyām bhāvakarmaprakriyā|

 tatvabodhinī- bālamanoramā-śekhara-saṃvalitā
siddhāntakaumudī
tasyā utarārddham
atha tiṅnte bhvādayaḥ
tatvabodhinī--
śrautrārhantīcaṇairguṇyairmaharṣibhirahadiṃvam| 
stoṣṭūayyamāno’pyaguṇo vibhurvijayatetarām||1||
ajñānanāśane dakṣaṃ dīkṣitaṃ bhaktarakṣaṇe| 
vaṭamūlāśrayaṃ tryakṣaṃ dakṣiṇāmūrtimāśraye||1||
granthamadhye vighnavighātāya kṛtaṃ maṅgalaṃ śiṣyaśikṣārthaṃ nibandhāti--
śrautretyādinā| śrautriyasya bhāvaḥ śrautram|
hāyanāntayuvādibhyo’ṇiti sūtre śrotriyasay yalopaśceti
vārtikādyalope’ṇpratyaye ca yasyeti cetītakāralopaḥ| arhato bhāva
ārhantī| guṇavacanabrāhmaṇādibhyaḥ iti sūtre arhato num
cetyukternum, ṣyañ ca| ṣitvānṅīṣi halastaddhitasyetiyalopaḥ|
tābhyāṃ vitaiḥ-- śrautrārhantīcaṇaiḥ| tena vitaḥ iti caṇap|
śrotriyatvayogyatābhyāṃ prasiddhairityarthaḥ|kiṃ ca guṇyaiḥ guṇavadbhiḥ|
praśastaguṇayuktairiti yāvat| rūpādāhatapraśaṃsayoriti sūtre
[matvartheṭ ṭhanyebhyo’pi dṛśyate’ ityukā ‘uṇyā brāhmaṇāḥ’ ityasya
bhāṣyādāvudāhṛtatvāt| ahardivamiti| ahanyahani| pratyahamityarthaḥ|
ṭhacature’ tyādinā nipātanātsādhuḥ| toṣṭūayyamāna iti|
stauteryaṅntātkarmaṇi śānac| ‘ārvadhātuke ya’ giti dhātoryak|
ṭhāne mu’giti muk| apiśabdena āpātato virodhaṃ dyotayati|
vastutastu na virodhaḥ|
stutiprayojakībhūtānāmanantakalyāṇaguṇānāṃ śrutismṛtisiddhatve’pi
biyadādivadvyāvahārikatvātadabhāvasya pāramārthikatvāt|
etaccotaramīmāṃsāyāṃ spaṣṭameva| vibhuvyāpakaḥ parameśvaraḥ|
atiśayena vijayate vijayatetarām| sarvotkarṣeṇa vartata iti
phalito’rthaḥ| ṭhviparābhyāṃ je’riti ityasya
aprātipadikatvādatiṅntatvācca| na ca ‘aha supe’tyatra saheti
yogavibhāgātiṅntena viśabdasya samāse prātipadikatvaṃ syādeveti
vācyaṃ, ‘a ca cchandasyeve’ti tatratyagranthena saha virodhāpateḥ| kiṃ ca
prātipadikatvābhyupagame sorūtpatiḥ syāt,
liṅgasarvanāmatābhyupagamena napuṃsakatvātsorlukyapi ṭhhrasvo
napuṃsake’ iti hrasvo durvāraḥ syāt| samudāyāntargatasya ‘ayate’
ityasya tiṅntatve’pi sākāṅkṣatvenā’sāmarthyātato’pi bhavituṃ
nārhati, ‘amarthaḥ padavidhi’riti cet| atrāhuḥ--
samudāyāntargatājjayata ityasmādeva tarap| tasya viśabdena saha
sākāṅkṣatvenā’sāmarthyaṃ śaṅkyam| tiṅntasya pradhānatvena

spaṣṭapratipatyartha evetyāhuḥ| taccintyam| vahi-- mahītyasyāpi
sthānivatvena liṅtvāt| mahiṅe ṅkārastiṅ taṅiti
pratyāniṣedho na, tathā ca vṛścateḥ pṛccchateśca karmaṇi raliṭi
vavraścimahe papraccchimahe ityatra ‘rahijye’ti saṃprasāraṇaṃ na|

(6) anudātaṅti ātmanepadam |1|3|12|
anudātaśca ṅśca anudātaṅai, tau itau yasya so’nudātaiṅt|
dvandvānte śrūyamāṇa iccchabdaḥ pratyekaṃ saṃbadhyate| tatrānudātāṃśe
tadantavidheḥ phalā’bhāvādaṃśāntara eva
tadantagrahamamityāśayenāha--anudāteta ityādi|
ṭhupadeśe’janunāsika’ ityato’nuvṛtamupadeśagrahamamapi ṅdiṃśa eva
saṃbadhyate, nānyatra, avyabhicārātadāha-- upadeśe yo ṅiditi|
viśeṣyamantareṇa tadantavidhiriha durlabha ityata āha--- dhātoriti|
lasyeti| nanvihā’nuvṛterabhāvādubhayamapi durlabhaṃ, ‘hūvādayaḥ’
iti sūtrānmaṇḍūakaplutyānuvṛtasya ‘hātava’ ityasya
vibhaktivipariṇāmātkathaṃciddhātoritipade labdhe’pi lasyetyetanna
labhyata iti cet| atrāhuḥ-- ṭhiko jha’lityatra sanā
dhātorivehātmanepadena lakāradhātvorāpekṣo bodhyaḥ, tiṅaṃ
lādeśatvāllasya ca dhātorvidhānāditi| upadeśa iti kim ?|
cukuṭiṣati| ‘āṅkuṭādibhyaḥ’ iti sana ātideśikaṃ ṅtvim|
dhātoḥ kim ?| caṅṅbhyāṃ mābhūt| adudruvat| avocat| nanu
lāvasthāyāmeva vṛtādibhyaḥ ‘yatāsī’ ityādinā syapratyaye kṛte
vyavadhānādātmanepadaparasmaipadarūpaniyamā’pravṛtāvapi
lakārasāmānyāśrayatvenāntaraṅgatvātsyapratyayātpūrvameva lasya
tibādiṣu satsu pakṣe parasmaipadaṃ pakṣe cātmanepadaṃ sidhyatyeveti
ṭhvṛdbhyaḥ syasano’riti sūtre syagrahaṇaṃ vyarthaṃ [saṭ tenaiva
syagrahaṇena ṭhvikaraṇebhyo niyamo balīyā’niti jñāpitam|
tenānudātetvādvartiṣyata ityevaṃ nityamātmanepade prāpte ṭhvṛdbhyaḥ
syasano’riti parasmaipadamapi pakṣe bhavati| tathā ca vikaraṇebhyo
niyamasya balīyastvāccaṅṅerdoṣaḥ syādeva| ayaṃ ca pakṣaḥ ‘adeḥ
śitaḥ’ iti sūtre bhāṣyakaiyaṭayoḥ spaṣṭaḥ| kiṃ ca
tadantavidhilābhārthamapi dhātugrahaṇamāvasyakaṃ| ‘hātorekāca’
ityādinā yaṅ| bobhūyate| ṭhṛterīyaṅ’| ṛtīyate| śete hnute
ityatra tu vyapadeśivadbhāvena ṅdintatvam| ‘amovarivaścitraṅ’
iti kyaci citrīyate ityetatkathamiti cet| atrāhuḥ---
avayave’caritārtho ṅkāra kyajantasya viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati| tathā ca
samudāyānubandho ṅkāra iti vyapadeśivadbhāvenaiva ṅdintatvaṃ
bodhyamiti|

(8) tiṅstrīṇi trīṇi prathamamadhyamotamāḥ |1|4|101|
tiṅ ṣaṭ trikāḥ, saṃjñāstu tisra iti yathāsaṅkhyā’sambhavādekaikasya
trikasya tisṛṣu saṃjñāsu ubhayoriti| parasmaipadamātmanepadamiti
cānuvartate| tena padadvaye pratyekaṃ trayastrikā itiyathāsaṃṅkhyaṃ
saṃjñāḥ pravartanta iti bhāvaḥ| nanu prathamaśc prathamaśca prathamau,
madhyamaśca madhyamaśca madhyamāvityevaṃ kṛtaikaśeṣāṇāṃ prathamādīnāṃ,
prathamau ca madhyamau ca utamau ca prathamamadhyamotamā iti
dvandve’bhyupagate trikadvayasya trakadvayasya yathāsaṅkhyaṃ
prathamamadyamotamasaṃjñāḥ syurna tvekaikasyeti ṭhṇalutamo ve’ti sūtraṃ
viradhyeta, ṇala utamasaṃjñakatvā’lābhāt, tataśca ‘rathamamadyamotamā’
ityatra kṛtadvandvānāṃ prathamamadhyomotamāśca
prathamamadyamotamāścetyekaśeṣa āśrīyatām, tathāhi sati sañjñā api
ṣaḍiti parasmaipadātmanepadagrahaṇānuvṛtikleśaṃ
vinaiveṣṭasiddhiriti cet| maivam| ekadeśāśrayaṇe
gauravādvaiyarthyācca tvayāpi
parasmaipadātmanepadagrahaṇamanuvartyameva| anyathā śatṛkvasvoḥ
sāvakāśā parasmaipadasaṃjñā prathamādisaṃjñayā bādhyeta| tataśca krāmyati
padānāmiti vihitasya ṇalo ṭhṇalutamo ve’ti
ṇitvavikalpavidhānājjñāpakātparasmaipadasaṃjñā prathamādisaṃjñayā na
bādhyata iti brūṣe, tarhi sutarāṃ pratipatigauravam||

(9) tānyekavacanadvivacanabahuvacanānyekaśaḥ |1|4|102|
‘ānī’tyasya vyākhyānaṃ-- labdhetyādi|
anyathaikasaṃjñādhikārātprathamādisaṃjñānāmekavacanādisaṃjñānāṃ ca
paryāyaḥ syāt| iṣṭāpatau tu aterloṭo ‘erni’ riti kṛte
ekatvavivakṣāyāmutamasaṃjñā’bhāvāt ṭhāḍutamasye’tyasyā’pravṛtyā
annītyādiprayogo’pi sādhuḥ syāditi bhāvaḥ| pratyekamiti | yatu
prācā ṭh ekaikaśa’ ityuktaṃ,tadayuktam| śasaiva vīpsāyā uktatvena
dvirvacanā’yogāt, ṭhyena nāprāptinyāyena dvirvacanāpavādaḥ śa’
siti siddhāntāt| tathā ‘upaḥra’ iti sūtre’pyekakaikaśa iti
prācoktamayuktameva| etacca manoramāgranthānurodhenoktam|| anye tu
ekaikamevaikaikaśaḥ, svārthe śas, na tvatra vīpsāyām| na ca svārthe yaḥ
śas sa ākaragranthānnāvagamyata iti vācyam, ṭhekāṃ kapilāmekaikaśaḥ

tataścaikaikaśa iti prācoktamayuktamiti yaduktaṃ tadevā’yuktamityāhuḥ|

(11) prahāse ca manyopapade manyaterutama ekavacca |1|4|106|

pūrvasūtrātadanuvṛteḥ| sa ceti| saḥ u manyaterutamapuruṣaḥ,

(14) jho’ntaḥ |7|1|3|

nanvahgātparasya pratyayasyeṭ, yāsuḍantaṃ tu nāṅgamiti cet|
ṭhāgamavinirmuktasyāpi pratyayatva’miti vadatāṃ mate bhavāmi
bhaviṣyāmītyādau vikaraṇāntasyeva tadādigrahaṇabalena
yāsuḍantasyāpyaṅgatāyā durvāratvāt| kiṃ ca laviṣīyetyatra

tasyāgamenā’’ditvavighātātpratyayādyaudātatvaṃ na

na caitatkaivalasyāpi pratyayatve yujyate| na ca tanmate

‘ratyayasvare kartavye’ ityādigranthaḥ svīkartavya eveti

(19) bhuvo vugluṅliṭoḥ |6|4|88|

cet| atrāhuḥ-- ‘huvo vugi tyasyāṅgatvāhvapekṣatvena

ayaṃ ca śaṅkāgranthaḥ, samādhānagranthaśca manoramāyāṃ sthitaḥ| atra

yaṅlugnāstī’ti ‘havoḥ śū’ḍiti sūtre bhāṣye dhvanitam,

‘varatvare’ tyūṭhabhāvinoḥ srivimavyostu yaṅlugastyeveti

pūrvā’paragranthavirodho nāstīti dik|
