ṭhatra lopo’bhyasasye’ti sūtrādabhyāsapadamanuvartate| atra prācoktaṃ--
bhavateriti kartṛnirdeaśādbhāvakarmaṇornā’tvamiti| vyākhyātaṃ ca
tatpautreṇa-- ‘artrarthayoḥ śtipśapornirdeaśādityartha’ iti| tanna|
dhātunirdeaśamātre śtipo vidhānāt, śapaśca
vikaraṇatvanānarthakatvāt, kartrarthake pare vihitasyāpi tasya śtipaḥ
śitvasāmarthyādeveha pravṛteḥ, anyathā tvaduktarītyā
ṭhupasargātsunotisuvatī’tyādīnāmapi bhāvakarmaṇorapravṛtau
sarvopaplava eva syāt, apasiddhāntaścā’yamiti spaṣṭamevākaradṛśām|
prayuñjate cakarmaṇyapyakāraṃ kavayaḥ-- ‘asyātapatraṃ bibharāṃbabhūve’,
ṭhvibhāvarībhirvibharāṃbabhūvire’ ityādi| etacca
prakriyāprasādagranthadūṣaṇaṃ manoramāyāṃ sthitam|
atra navyāḥ-- ‘tipaḥ śitvasāmarthyādeveha śapaḥ pravṛti’riti yaduktaṃ,
tannāpibatirglāyatirityādau pibadyādeśapravṛtyā ātvanivṛtyā ca
śitvasya caritārthatvāt| evaṃ ca ṭhupasargātsunotisuvati’,
‘havateraḥ’ ‘hyāyateḥ saṃprasāraṇaṃ ce’tyādinirdeaśādakartṛvācinyapi
pare śavādaya ityeva vyākhyeyam| anyathā ṭhikśtipau’ iti sūtre
vakṣyamāṇasvagranthena saha virodhāpateḥ| kecitu-- śitvātipaḥ
sārvadhātukatvena bhavatirityādau
ṭhārddhadātukasyeḍvalāde’ritīḍāgamanivṛtyā, ‘ravīti’rityatra
‘ruva īḍi’ tīḍāgamapravṛtyā ca śitvaṃ caritārthamiti vyācakhyuḥ,
tañcintyam| ‘itutre’ tyanenaāṇniṣedhādārddhadhātukatve’pi
kṣatyabhāvāt| ‘ruva ī’ḍityatra ‘ruvaḥ parasya halādeḥ pita īḍāgama’
ityetanmātrasya mūle vyākhyātatvātsārvadhātukasyeti
viśeṣaṇā’bhāve’pi kṣatyabhāvāt| na ca halādeḥpitpratyayasya
‘ārvdhātukasye’ti viśeṣaṇā’bhāve bruvo liṭi vacyādeśe
sipasthali uvakthetyatrā’tiprasaṅgaḥ syāditi vācyaṃ, thalo’tra
pitavā’bhāvāt| na ca sthānivadbhāvena pitvaṃ, śnaḥ śānacaḥ śitvena
liṅgena kvacidanubandhakārye’pyanalvidha#aviti tanniṣedhāt|
tasmātpūrvoktarītyaiva śtipaḥ śitvasāmrathyādakartaryapi śapaḥ
pravṛtiriti grantho nirākartavya ityāhuḥ| tadapare na kṣamante| thalaḥ
pitvā’bhāve hi ṭhasaṃyogālliṭki’diti kitvāt ṭhvacisvapī’ti
saṃprasāraṇe satyuvacitha uvaktheti na sidhyet, kiṃtu ūcitha
ūktheti syāt| tasmātsthānivatvena thalaḥ pitve’bhyupagate
uvakthetyādāvatiprasaṅgavāraṇāya ‘itaḥ sārvadhātukas īḍāgama’
iti vyākhyātameva, tathā ca bravītirityatra īḍāgamapravṛtyā śitvaṃ
caritārthamiti kaiścidyaduktaṃ tadapi samyageveti|| 

(25) asiddhavadavā bhāt |6|4|22|

(26) ārddhadhātukasyeḍvalādeḥ |7|2|35|

odanīyāstaṇḍulāḥ| evaṃ cānenaiva gaṇasūtreṇa siddhe apūpādīnāṃ
keṣācidgaṇe pāṭhaḥ prapañcārthaḥ|

(1276) cchadirupadhibalerḍhañ |5|1|13|

sta[saṭnaṅguścarmavikārastadarthaṃ carma| ṭhugavādibhyaḥ’iti yat|

ṭhaptṛn’ iti dīrghasya ṭhāpastiṣṭhantī’

(1034) varaṇādibhyaśca |4|2|82|
varaṇādi| cakāro’nuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tenāsyākṛtigaṇatvaṃ siddham|
varaṇā iti| evaṃ kaṭuabadarī, śirīṣāḥ, godau,
khalatikamityādīnyudāhartavyāni| vatvasyā’siddhatvātasminkartavye
ṭilopo na sthānivadityāśayenāha--jhaya iti| naḍvānityatpāpi
paratvāt ‘hayaḥ’ityanenaiva vakāro na tu ‘ādupadhāyāḥ’ityaneneti
bhāvaḥ| na cā’siddhatvāt ‘ādupadhāyāḥ’ityeva tatra nyāyyamiti
vācyaṃ, ‘rakaraṇe prakaraṇamasiddhaṃ, na tu yoge yogaḥ’iti
ṭhupasargādasamāse’pī’tyatra bhāṣye nirṇītatvāt| nanu vetasvānityatra
vetasaśabdasya subantatvena padatvātṅbhatupo
ḍitvasāmarthyāṭṭilope ekadeśavikṛtanyāyena padatvātsasya rutvaṃ
syāt| na ca sthānivatvena nirvāhaḥ| pūrvatrāsiddhe tanniṣa #edhāditi
cet, maivam| antaraṅgaṃ rutvaṃ prati bahuraṅgasya
ṭilopasyā’siddhatvāt| na ca ṣāṣṭhī bahiraṅgaparibhāṣā traipādikaṃ
na jānātīti vācyaṃ, kāryakālapakṣābhyupagamāt| nanvevamapi
‘vādiṣu’iti sāntasya padatve

ṇatvam| śamādipāṭha iti| ‘hśamityaṣṭābhyo ghinuṇ’| śamādaya iti|
śamutamudamuśramubhramukṣamuklamumada ityarthaḥ| 

(306) yaso’nupasargāt |3|1|71|
yaso’nupa| atra vadanti-- ṭhyasa’ ityevāstu| tataḥ ‘amaḥ’|
niyamārthamidam, -- sopasargādyasaścetsaṃpūrvakādeveti| evaṃ ca
pūrvasūtre’nupasargāditi grahaṇamutaratra ca yasaśceti grahaṇaṃ tyaktuaṃ
śakyamiti| dāhe paṭhita iti| vyuṣa dāha iti-- asminneva gaṇe paṭhita
ityarthaḥ| arṅthamiti| dāhe paṭhitasya tu sijeva| avyoṣīt| 
iti tatvabodhinyām divādayaḥ|



 (767) cārthe dvandvaḥ |2|2|29|
cārthe dvandvaḥ| ṭhanekamanyapadārthe’ityato’nekamityanuvartate,
‘ubāmantrite---’ityasmātsubapi|ṭhsamāsaḥ’iti , ṭhvibhāṣā’iti
cā’dhikiyata eva| tadāha---anekaṃ subantamityādi| cārthā iti|
caśabdadyotyā ityarthaḥ| ekasminniti| bhajanādāvityarthaḥ| īśvaraṃ guruṃta
bhajasveti| kriyāyāṃ dravyayoḥ samuccayo’yam| tathā rājño
gajaścāśvaśceti dravye dravyayoḥ samuccayaḥ| paṭaḥ śuklo raktaśceti
dravye guṇayoḥ| raktaḥ paṭaḥ kuṇḍalaṃ ceti guṇe dravyayorityūhyam|
bhikṣāmaṭa gāṃ cānayeti| atra hyadarśanādgāmanānayannapi
bhikṣāmaṭatyeva| anaṭṃastu bhikṣāṃ na gāmānayati| tathā aṭannapi
nā’nviṣya gāmānayati| ato bhikṣā’ṭanasyaiba prādhānyaṃ, gvānayanasya
tvānuṣaṅgikatā| asāmarthyāditi| ekārthībhāvā’bhāvādityarthaḥ|
tathāhi bahuvrīhighaṭakapadānāṃ karmādyantarbhāveṇeva
dvandvaghaṭakapādānāṃ cārthāntarbhāveṇa ekārthībhāva āvaśyakaḥ, ‘amarthaḥ
padavidhiḥ’iti paribhāṣitatvāt, ‘ārthe dvandvaḥ’ ityukteśca| na
cetaretarānvaye parasparanirapekṣāṇāmekārthībhāvaḥ saṃbhavati yena
samuccayānvācayāvekārthībhāvāntarbhūtau syātām| tataścetarayoge
samāhāre ca parasparasāhityasatvātsamāso bhavati, na tu
samuccayānvācayayoḥ| paraṃ tvitaretarayoge sāhityaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ,
dravyaṃ tu viśeṣyaṃ, samāhāre tu sāhityaṃ pradhānaṃ, dravyaṃ
viśeṣaṇamiti vivektavyam| nanu ‘īlotpala’mityādau
caśabdāntarbhāveṇa vigrahadarśanādekārthībhāvasatvācca dvandvo durvāraḥ
syāt| maivam| ṭhviśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇe’ti sāmānādhikaraṇye
vihiratayā tatpuruṣasaṃjñayā dvandvasaṃjñāyā bādhāt|
tasyāstvasāmānādhikaraṇye sāvakāśatvāt|
sāmānādhikaraṇyā’bhāvavivakṣāyāṃ tu ‘ramāṇaprameye’tyadāviva
nīlotpalādāvapi dvandve iṣṭāpatireva| hotṛpotriti|
utarapadaparatvā’bhāvādanayorānaṅ na|

(769) dvandve ghi |2|2|32|
dvandve ghi| ṭhaneka’miti sarveṣāmeva
prathamānirdiṣṭatvenopasarjanatvā’viśeṣādaniyamaprāpatāvayamārambhaḥ|
yatra tvanekaṃ dhyantaṃ tatra dvayorapi pūrvanipātaniyamaḥ syādata
āha----|
anekaprāptāvekatra niyamo’niyamaḥ śeṣe| anekaprāptāvekatreti| atra
vyācakhyuḥ--ākṛtau padārthe samudāye sakṛllakṣaṇaṃ pravartate, na
prativyaktyāvṛtyā| tatraikasya pūrvanipāte sati jātau lakṣaṇaṃ
pravṛtameveti na punaḥ pravartate| vyaktipakṣastviha nāśrīyate,
lakṣyānurodhāditi| harihara gurava iti| haraguruśabdayornaṃ niyamaḥ
pravartata iti bhāvaḥ|
(770) ajādyadantam |2|2|33|

(771) alpāctaram |2|2|34|
alpāctaram| ataeva nipātanātsvārthe tarap, kutvacutvayorabhāvaśca|
yadi tu prakarṣe tarap syātadādvayereva niyamaḥ syāt,
dvivacanāntopapadatvaviṣaya eva tarapo vidhānāt|tataśca
‘haravadirapalāśā’ityādau bahuṣu niyamo na syāt|
ṛtukṣatrāṇāmiti| ṛtūnāmānupūrvyaṃ prādurbhāvakṛtaṃ, nakṣatrāṇāṃ
tūdayakṛtam|
abhyarhitaṃ ca| abhyarhitaṃ ca| ṭhvāsudevārjunābhyāṃ vuni’ti
nirdeaśenedaṃ jñāpyata iti caturthe bhāṣyam| ṭhalpāctaram’
ṭhajādyadanta’miti sūtrābhyāmarjunasya pūrvanipāte prāpte tamakurvan
jñāpayati ‘arvato’bhyahitaṃ pūrva’miti tatraiva sūtre vakṣyate|
bhrāturjyāyasaḥ| yudhiṣṭhirārjunāviti|
indraputratvādviṣṇoraṃśatvācchūaratvādvā’bhyarhitatvamarjune’pyastīti na
tena niyamaḥ sidhyatīti bhāvaḥ|
(772) dvandvaśca prāṇisūryasenā’ṅgānām |2|4|2|
dvandvaścaprāṇi| prāṇitūryasenānāmaṅgānīti
bahuvacanāntenā’ṅgaśabdena ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| aṅgaśabdaśca
pratyekamanveti| tena prāṇyaṅgānāṃ prāṇyahgaireva,
tūryāṅgeraiva, senāṅgaireva yo dvandvaḥ sa ekavadbhavati na tu
vyatirekeṇa| teneha na--mārdaṅgikāśvārohau| atra
prāṇisenayoraṅgaṃ nāmā’vayavaḥ| tūryasya tvaṅgaṃ nāmopakārakaṃ
bodhyam| eṣāṃ dvandva iti| prāṇyaṅgānāṃ dvandvaḥ, tūryāṅgānāṃ
dvandvaḥ, senāṅgānāṃ dvandva ityarthadhaḥ| ‘vigurekavacana’mityata
ekavacanaṃ vartate| tatraikaṃ vaktīti vyutpatyā ekatvaviśiṣṭaḥ
samāhārarūpo yo’rthastatpratipādakaḥ syādityarthaṃ manvānaḥ
phalitamāha--ekavatsyāditi| pāṇipādamiti| yadyapyatra
‘ātiraprāṇinā’mityeva siddhaṃ, tathāpi dravyaprādhānye’pi bhavatviti
prāṇigrahaṇamityeke| prāṇipaṇavāviti vyatikare mā bhūditi
niyamārthaṃ vacanamityanye| mārdaṅgiketi| mṛdaṅgavādanaṃ
śilpamasyetyarthe ‘adasya śilpa’miti ṭhak| evaṃ ‘āṇavika’ityapi|
rathikāśvārohamiti| rathena carantīti rathikāḥ| ‘arpādibhyaḥ
ṣṭha’nniti ṣṭhan| te cāśvarohāścā teṣāṃ samāhāraḥ| nanu ‘ārthe
dvandvaḥ’ityanena samāhāradvandvaḥ siddhaḥ tasya caikatvādekavacanamapi
siddhamiti kimanenetyāśaṅkyāha--niyamārtamiti| samāhāra eveti|
‘amāhāre prāṇyaṅgādīnāmeve’ti viparītaniyamo’tra na bhavati,
‘iṣyapunarvasvo’riti sūtre bahuvacanagrahaṇāt| taddhi samāhāre
ekavacanasya dvivacanaṃ mā bhūditi kṛtam| anyathā ‘iṣyapunarvasvi’ti
na syāditi| evaṃ ca ‘vandvaśca prāṇisūtreya’ti
prakaraṇabahurbhūtānāmapi lasamāhāradvandvo bhavatyeva, tena ‘arvo
dvandvo vibhāṣaikavadbhavatī’ti paṭhaḷmānaṃ nā’pūrvaṃ vacanamiti
jñeyam|
(773) anuvāde caraṇānām |2|4|3|

(775) jātiraprāṇinām |2|4|6|
jātira| jātivācyavayavakadvandvo’pi jātirityupacaryata
ityāśayenāha--jātivācināmiti| viṭśūdrā iti|

vidhānāt| tenātra vdyaṅgavikalaṃ neti bhāvaḥ|
dravyajātīyānāmeveti| ṭhaprāṇinā’miti paryudāsāt ‘añivayukta
nyāyena dravyajātīyānāmekavadbhāvo, na tu
guṇakriyājātīyānāmiti bhāvaḥ | jātiḥ kim?| nandakapāñcajanyau|
saṃjñāśabdāvetau| jātiprādhānya eveti| etacca jātigrahaṇāllabdham|
anyathā paryudāsenaiva jātyupasarjanadravyavācino’pi
grahaṇopapattauḥ kiṃ teneti bhāvaḥ| dravyaviśeṣeti| nanvevaṃ
‘añjitā nu vividhāstaruśailāḥ’iti bhāraviprayogaḥ saṅgaccchata
eveti kimiti tarusahitāḥ śailā iti manoramāyāṃ samarthitamiti
cet| atrāhuḥ--sakalataruśailarañjanaṃ tatra vivakṣitaṃ, na tu
keṣāṃcitaruśailaviśeṣaṇāmiti

badarāmalakāniti| ‘hale lu’giti luk| ‘uktaddhitalukī’ti
strīpratyasyāpi luki phalatvajātyupasarjanadravyavacanāvetau| ṭhvibhāṣā
vṛkṣamṛge’ti sūtre badarāṇi cāmalakāni ca badarāmalakam|
‘ātiraprāṇinā’mityekavadbhāva’iti vakṣyati, tatu nā’nena granthena
va#rudhyite| ‘halatvajātivācināṃ bahuvacanāntānāmeva dvandva
ekavadbhavati, na tvekavacanāntāṃ dvandva’ iti ‘halasenāvanaspatī’ti

(776) viśiṣṭaliṅgo nadīdeśo’grāmāḥ |2|4|7|
viśiṣṭaliṅgo| sūtre catvāro’pi śabdā avayavadharmeṇā’vayavidvandve
vartanta ityāśayenāha---grāmetyādi| iha ‘adīvācināṃ dvandvaḥ,
‘eśavācināṃ dvandva’ iti vākyabhedena vyākhyeyam| tena
‘aṅgākurukṣetre’ityatra na bhavati| deśaśabdenātra prasiddha eva janapado
gṛhyate, nadyāḥ pṛthaggrahaṇāt| tena parvatānāṃ na, kailāsaśca
gandhamādanaṃ ca kailāsagandhamādane| nadīdeśa iti kim?| kukkuṭa
mayūryau| viśiṣṭapadasya’rthamāha---bhinnaliṅgānāmiti| vipūrvo hi
śiṣirbhedārthaḥ | ataeva ṭhviśeṣaṇaṃ viśṣyeṇe’ti sūtre bhedakaṃ
bhedyeneti vyākhyātam| samāhāre dvandvaḥ syāditi|
niṣkarṣābhiprāyeṇeyamuktaḥ| yathāśrutābhiprāyeṇa tu ‘vandva
ekavatsyā’diti keṣu citsūtreṣu vyākhyāyata iti jñeyam|
uddhyerāvatīti| uvdyo nadaḥ, so’pi nadīviśeṣatvānnadīśabdena
gṛhītaḥ| evaṃ śoṇo’pi| ṭhagrāmā ityatra nagarapratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ’|
tena ‘athurāpāṭaliputra’mityatra niṣedho na bhavati, ubhayorapi
nagaratvāt|
(777) kṣudrajantavaḥ |2|4|8|

(778) yeṣāṃ ca virodhaḥ śāśvatikaḥ |2|4|9|

śāśvatikaḥ| ‘ālāṭhaṭhañ’| ataeva nipātanāt ṭhisusuktāntā’diti
kādeśaḥ, ṭhavyayānāṃ bhamātre’iti iti ṭilopaśca na | śāśvatikaḥ
kim?| devāsurairamṛtamambunidhirmamanthe’| teṣāṃ hyamṛtādiprayuktaḥ
kādācitko virodho na tu nityaḥ, manthanapravṛtikāle tadvirahāt|
paratvāditi| paśuśakunidvandvasyāvakāśo--gomahiṣaṃ gomahiṣāḥ|
haṃsacakravākaṃ haṃsacakravākāḥ| ṭhyeṣāṃ
ce’tyasyāvakāśaḥ--mārjāramūṣakaṃ śramaṇabrāhmaṇamityādau jñeyaḥ|

(781) vibhāṣā
vṛkṣamṛgatṛṇadhānyavyañjanapaśuśakunyaśvavaḍavapūrvāparādharotarāṇām|2|4|12|
bibhāṣā| viśeṣaṇāmeveti| ayaṃ bhāvaḥ--vṛkṣādiśabdaiḥ pratyekaṃ
dvandvo viśeṣyate, na caiko vṛkṣaśabdo dvandvaḥ , na ca dvayoḥ saha
prayogaḥ, ‘arūpāṇā’mityekaśeṣāt| nāpi paryāyāṇāṃ,
ṭhvirūpāṇāmapi samānārthānā’mityekaśeṣāt| nāpi vṛkṣaśca
dhavaścetyādisāmānyaviśeṣayoḥ, anabhidhānātatra
dvandvasyaivā’bhāvāditi sarvaprakaraṇaśeṣatayā niyamamāha|
phalesenāvanaspatimṛgaśakunikṣudrajantudhānyatṛṇānāṃ
bahuprakṛtireva dvandva ekavaditi vācyam| phalasenetyādi|
phalasenādīnāṃ dvandvo ṭhvibhāṣā vṛkṣamṛge’tyanena, lakṣaṇāntareṇa vā
ekavadbhavanbahuprakṛtireva ekavadbhavatītyarthaḥ| bahavo
vartipadārthāḥ, bahuvacanāntā vā--prakṛtiḥukāraṇaṃ yasya sa
bahuprakṛtiḥ| badarāṇi cāmalakāni ceti|
‘ātyākhyāyāmekasmi’nniti vaikalpikaṃ bahuvacanam| badarāmalake
iti| jātiprādhānye’pyekavacanāntaryodvandva iti nāstyekavadbhāva iti
bhāvaḥ| paśugrahaṇamiti| ṭhvikalpārtha’mityanuṣajyate| ‘ārthe
dvandvaḥ’ityanenaiva siddhe mṛgaśakunigrahaṇaṃ
vyarthamityāśaṅkhyāha--mṛgāṇāṃ mṛgairevetyādi|
napuṃsakatvārthamiti| ayaṃ bhāvaḥ--paśutvādvikalpe siddhe
aśvavaḍavagrahaṇaṃ pratipadavidhānārtham|
tenāśvavaḍavamityekavadbhāvapakṣe ‘ūrvavadaśvavaḍavau’ ityatabdādhitvā
‘a napuṃsaka’mityetadeva bhavati| ‘a’ iti taccchabdena
hyaekavadbhāvabhājaṃ parāmṛśya vidhīyamānaṃ
napuṃsakatvamekavadbhāvavadeva pratipadavihitaṃ bhavati| tathā ca
pratipadektasya balīyastvānnapuṃsakatvaṃ sidhyatīti|

(783) na dadhipayaādīni |2|4|14|
na dadhipaya| dadhipayasī iti| vyāñjanatvādvikalpaḥ prāptaḥ| evaṃ
‘adhusarpiṣī, ‘arpirmadhunī’ityatrāpi bodhyam| iha ‘rāhma prajāpatī’
‘ivavaiśrabaṇau’ityādau
samāhāradvandvaniṣedhamukhenetaretarayogadvandvo’nena vyāvasthāpyate|
tatsāhacaryāddadhipayasī ityādavapi tataiva| tena tatra
vyañjanatvaprayuktavikalpe niṣiddhe’pi jātilakṣaṇo
nityamekavadbhāvo’stviti na śaṅkanīyam| kiṃ ca neha
lakṣaṇaviśeṣe āgrahaḥ, ṭhetāni naikatsyuḥ’ityekavadbhāvamātrasya
niṣedhāt, yathā ‘a ṣaṭsvasrādibhyaḥ’ityatra ṅīpṭāporubhayorapi
niṣedhasiddhaye ‘triyāṃ yaduktaṃ tanne’ti sāmānyato niṣidhyate iti

(319) atpūrvasya |8|4|22|
atpūrvasyeti| ekājutareti| na cā’llope kṛte ekāctvaṃ nāstīti
vācyaṃ, pūrvasmādapi vidhau sthānivadbhāvāt| na ca ‘ūrvatrā’siddhe
na sthāniva’diti vācyam, ‘asya doṣaḥ
saṃyogādilopalatvaṇatveṣvi’tyukteḥ| nivartyate iti| ‘umati
ce’ti ṇatvamapi nivartyata eveti bodhyam| bhāṣye tu--ṭhkuvyavāye
hādeśeṣu pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ’| kiṃ prayojanam?|vṛtraghnaḥ srugghnaḥ
prāghāni| ṭhhanteratpūrvasye’tyatpūrvagrahaṇaṃ na kartavyaṃ bhavati,
ityuktam| etacca vārtikāśayavarṇanamātram, natu vastusthitiḥ
vārtikena sūtrāvayavapratyākhyānāpekṣayā yogavibhāgamāśritya
vārtikārthopasaṅgrahasyaiva nyāyyatvāditi tu manoramāyā sthitam|
nanvatpūrvasyetyatra taparo vivakṣito na vā, yadi vivakṣitastarhi
‘ahuvṛtrahāṇī’ti na sidhyet| yadyavivakṣitastadā ‘rāghānī’ti
ciṇante’pi ṇatvaṃ syāt, tataśca ‘uvyavāye hādeśeṣu
pratiṣedhaḥ’iti vacanaṃ svīkartavyameveti kimanena yogāvibhāgena?
atrāhuḥ--tuparo’tra vivakṣita eva| na ca ‘ahuvṛtrahāṇī’tyatra
ṇatvā’siddhiḥ, ṇatvasyā’ntaraṅgatvena tatkāryaṃ prati
dīrghasyā’siddhatvāt| na ca traipādike’ntaraṅge ṣa#aṣṭhī paribhāṣā na
pravartata ithi vācyaṃ, kāryakālapakṣā’bhyupagamāt| na caivamantaraṅgaṃ
ṇatvaṃ ‘rāghānī’tyatrāpi syāditi vācyaṃ, ‘ūrvadhātuḥ sādhanena
yujyate’iti pakṣe ṇatvasya bahiraṅgatvāt| iṣṭānurodhena ‘ūrvaṃ
dhāturūpasargeṇe’ti pakṣasyānabhyupagamāditi| anye
tu--ṭhhanteratpūrvasye’tyatra
ṭhupasargā’dityasyānuvṛtisvīkārādyodavibhāgasārthyena ‘hrūṇapraghna
’ityatra ṭhekājutare’tyādinā ṇatvā’bhāve’pi ṭhvṛtraghnaḥ’ṭhsrugghna’ityatra
ṇatvaṃ darvāramiti ‘uvyavāye’iti vārtikaṃ svīkartavyameva|
yogavibhāgasyā’nantarasyeti nyāyabādhenāpi
caritārthakatvādupasargasaṃbandhasyāpi bādhe sāmarthyā’bhāvāt| na ca
brahmādiṣu karmasūpapadeṣu vidhīyamānaḥ kvippratyayaḥ kevaladhātoreva
syānna tu sopasargāditi ‘arahmaprahā’ṭhbhrūṇaprahe’--tyādi rūpameva
durlabhamiti vācyam, ṭhāto’nupasarge kaḥ’ityatrā’nupasarge iti
sāmānyāpekṣajñāpakātsopasargāddhanterapi ‘rahmabhrūṇe’ti
kvipsaṃbhavāt| anupasargagrahaṇasya sāmānyāpekṣajñāpakatve
tūktavārtikameva pramāṇam| tasmānṭhhante’riti yogavibhāgo’tra
nirarthaka evetyāhuḥ|

(321) ugidacāṃ sarvanāmasthāne’dhātoḥ |7|1|70|

(323) na saṃprasāreṇa saṃprasāraṇam |6|1|37|

(324) arvaṇastrasāvanañaḥ |6|4|127|
arvaṇastṛ|ṭhaṅgasye’ti vartate, taccā’rvaṇā viśeṣyate,
ṭhanaña’ityanenāpi, tadāha--nañā rahitasyetyādi| ṭhasā’viti
parayudāse vibhaktau parata eva syāt, tataścā’rvatītyādau na
syādityāśayenāha--na tu sāviti| nacaivamarvapriya
ityādāvatiprasaṅgaḥ, aṅgena svanimitasya pratyayasyā’’kṣepāllukā
luptatvenā’tra pratyayalakṣaṇā’bhāvāt| etena ṭhvāhairalupyata

‘thānivadādeśaḥ’iti sūtre

vikalpya,ṭhnāntyaḥ, abyayasyāṅgapadābhyāṃ pṛthaggrahaṇavaiyarthyā’diti
manoramāyāṃ yaduktaṃ tatkathaṃ saṅgaccheta?,
avyayasyoktirītyā’naṅgatvāt| na ca ‘a
lumate’tyanenā’ṅgakāryaniṣedhe’pyaṅgasaṃjñāyā
aniṣedhānnoktadoṣa iti vācyam, pratyaye parataḥ pūrvasya
yatkāryamāṅgamanāṅgaṃ vā tatsarvaṃ ‘a lumate’tyanena niṣidhyate
ithi ṭhyaṅe’cu ce’ti sūtrasthamanoramāgranthaparyālocanayā
lumatāśabdena lupte’ṅgasaṃjñāyā apyasvīkāryatvāt| tasyā api
pratyaye parataḥ pūrvasya kāryatvāt| yadi tu lukā lupte’pyaṅgatvaṃ
svīkriyate, tadā’yaṃ grantho ṭhyaci bhaṃ’ṭhvṛṣaṇvasvaśvayo’rityatra ṭhvṛṣa
varṣukaṃ’vasu dhanaṃ yasya vṛṣaṇvasu, vṛṣā aśvo yasya
vṛṣaṇaśva’ityudāhṛtma bhatvādiha nalopo na bhavati, allopastu
anaṅgatvānneṭa’ti mūle vaidikaprakriyāyāṃ vakṣyamāṇa granthena saha
virudhyate| naca
ṭhallopo’naḥ’ityatrāṭh’ṅgāvayavo’sarvamānasthānayajādisvādiparo
yo’’niti vyākhyānādallopasya tatra prāptyabhāvādanāṅgatvāditi
samādhānaṃ vyarthamiti bhramitavyam, bhasaṃjñayaiva
ṭhyajādisvādiparoyo’’niti vyākhyānāvadvasvaśvayoḥ parato
yo’niti vyākhyānasyāpi labhāt| tasmātpadātpṛthagityeva vaktavye
aṅgapadābhyāmityaṅgagrahaṇaṃ rabhasakṛtameveti cedatrāhuḥ--ṭhna
lumate’ti sūtre lumatālupte tannimitāṅgasaṃjñakasya kāryaṃ
nasyāditi yadā vyākhyāyate, tadā
ṭharvaṇastṛ’ityadyaṅgakāryā’vṛtāvapyaṅgasaṃjñāyā
nirbādhatvādaṅgagrahaṇaṃ tatratyaṃ samyageva| yadātvāṅgamanāṅgaṃ
vetyādimanoramāgranthasyānaṅgatvāditi mūlagranthasya ca
svārasyaparyālocanayā lāghavādavyayasyāṅgatve phalābhāvācca pratyaye
parataḥ pūrvasya kāryaṃ niṣidhyate, tadā tvaviśeṣeṇā’ṅgasaṃjñāyā
api niṣedhādaṅgagrahaṃ tatra rabhasakṛtameva| na ca ‘a
lumate’tyanenāṅgasaṃjñāniṣedhe ṭhyuvoranākā’viti
sūtrasthabhāṣyakaiyaṭābhyāṃ virodhaḥ syāditi vācyaṃ, tayostatra
prauḍhavādena pravṛtatvāt| tathāca ‘a lumata tasmi’nniti siddhāntaḥ,
pratyaye parataḥ pūrvasya kāryaṃ niṣidhyateṭhiti manoramāgranthaśca
svarasataḥ saṅgaccchata iti| nanu ṛdhātorvici guṇe ca ṭha’riti rūpaṃ,
tasmānmatupi arvantāvityādi setsyati, ‘chandasīvanipā’viti vanapi
vede ṭharve’ti setsyati| ṛdhororeva ‘trāmadipadyartī’tyādinā
vanipi tu loke’pyarveti setsyati| rūḍhiśabdaścāyaṃ,
ṭhvājivāhārvagandharvahayasaindhavasaptayaḥ’ityamarakośāt|

(353) padasya |8|1|16|
padasya| ṭhapadāntasya mūrdhanyaḥ’iti
virodhinirdeaśātprākpadasyetyayamadhikāraḥ| tena ṭhrājā’

‘o no dhātoḥ’iti natvaṃ ‘raśānbhyā’mityādau bhavati na tu
‘raśamau’praśām’ityatra| tathā ṭhhariṃ vande’ityādau

pade’ityataḥ ‘ade’ityadhikārātpade parato masyā’nusavraḥ syāt, na
tu gamyata ityatreti kimiha padasyetyadhikāreṇeti vācyaṃ,
‘uṃsvi’ti rūpā’siddhiprasaṅgāt| tasmāt ‘o’nusvāraḥ’ityatra
‘adasye’tyanuvartanīyameva| ‘ade’ityasyotarasūtre’pyupayogo
nāstīti ṭhuñica pade’ityatrā’vocāma| iha ‘adasyo#e’ti

sambandhaviśeṣe’vatiṣṭhate| kvacitsthāne ṣaṣṭhī, kvacidavayavaṣaṣṭhīti|
tatra ‘aṃyogāntasya lopaḥ’ṭhmo no dhātoḥ’ ‘o’nusvāraḥ’ityādau

etaccānupapādayiṣyate| yadyapi ‘aṣṭhī sthāneyoge’ti paribhāṣayā

tu ‘adasye ’ti sthānaṣaṣṭhaḷeva syātarhi nāntasya padasya lopo

avayavaṣaṣṭhaḷṅgīkāre cu ṭhantasye’ti grahaṇaṃ sārthakam|

(92) śāt |8|4|44|
śāt | ‘e’ti ‘o’riti cānuvartate tadāha-tavargasyetyādi |
‘aśtva’-mityādivyākhyātṛnirdeaśe niḥsandigdhatvena bodhanāya
ṭhvaśce’ti ṣatvaṃ jaśtvaṃ ca na kṛtaṃ,tathā ścutvamapi na kṛtamiti
parihārasambhavādvargāntyamevodāharati-viśnaḥ praśna iti | ṭhvicccha
gatau’, ‘racccha jñāpsāyām’ | ṭhyajayāce’tyādinānaṅ | ‘havoḥ
śū’ḍiti cchasya śatvam | naṅe ṅtvādguṇābhāviḥ | pracchestu ‘raśne
cāsanne’ti nirdeaśātsaṃprasāraṇā’bhāvaḥ | nanu ñamaṅṇanānā
nāsikāsthānādhikyādvargeṣvādyaiścaturbhiḥ saha tulyasthānatvābhāvena
sāvarṇyā’bhāvāt ‘toḥ ścune’ti ‘u’ śabdena nakāro na gṛhyate
kiṃ tu svavargādyaścatvāra eveti viśna praśna ityatra ścutvā’prasakteḥ
kimanena niṣedheneti cedatrāhuḥ,-ṭhśā’diti niṣedhālliṅgādeva
‘ulyāsyaprayatna’mityatrāsyagrahaṇena nāsikāsthānabhinnaṃ
tālvādisthānaṃ gṛhyate, tatsthānaṃ tu tulyameveti ‘u’ śabdena
pañcamasyāpi grahaṇātscutvaprasaktau niṣedho’yamāvaśyakaḥ | evaṃca
‘orlī’ti ‘u’ śabdena nakārasyāpi grahaṇādvidvāÄllikhatītyādi
sidhyati | naca
nimitakāryiṇoryathāsaṅkhyanirāsajñāpakamityuktatvātenaiva
cārthavatve kathamuktārthe jñāpakaṃ bhavediti vācyaṃ; ‘u’ śabdena
nakāragrahaṇe siddhe hi yathāsaṅkhyanivṛtiratena
jñāpanīyetyubhayajñāpenabādhakā’bhāvāt | nāpi ‘ulyāsye’tyatra
yatkiñcitsthānatulyatvavivakṣāyāṃ vargeṣu pañcāpi varṇāḥ parasparaṃ
savarṇā bhaveyurityuktodāharaṇe ścutvaprasaktau ‘ā’dityārambha
āvaśyaka ityetajjñāpakāśrayaṇaṃ kimarthamiti vācyaṃ, tathāhi sati
ñamaṅṇanānāṃ parasparasāvarṇyapatyā ‘va nayasī’tyādau ṭhanusvārasya
yayi parasavarṇaḥ’ṭhvā padāntasye’tyanusvārasya ñādayo’pi syuḥ |
tālvādisthānāsāmyā’bhāve’pi nāsikārūpasya yatkicitsthānasya
tulyatvāt | nāpi tusyāsyatvamanyūnāsyatvamiti vyākhyāyāṃ
ñādīnāṃ paratparasāvarṇyaṃ na bhavet, teṣāṃ nāsikāsthānasāmye’pi
tālvādisthānasāmyā’bhāvena nyūnasthānakatvāt | tataśca ‘vaṃ
nayasī’tyādiṣu nātiprasaṅgaḥ | svavargādyaiḥ saha tu ñādīnāṃ
sāvarṇyaṃ syādeva |
nāsikāsthānādhikye’pitadanyūnasthānakatvāteṣāmiti
ṭhvidvāÄllikhatīṭa’tyādīṣṭaṃ sidhyati | vargādyānāṃ tu
nāsikāsthānā’bhāvena nyūnasthānakatvātpañcamena ca sāvarṇyābhāve’pi
na kṣatiriti jñāpakāśrayaṇaṃ vinaiveṣṭasiddhiriti vācyaṃ, ṭhhe gauri
ehī’tyādau savarṇadīrghāpateḥ | ṭhiko’savarṇa’ iti
śākalaprakṛtibhāvānāpateśca | ikārānyūnasthānakatvena
tatsavarṇatvādekārasya | ‘varāṇāmūṣmāṇāṃ caiva vivṛtaṃ karaṇaṃ
smṛtam | tebhyo’pi vivṛtāveṅai tābhyāmaicau tathaiva ce’ti
vacanātprayatnabhedena sāvarṇyā’bhāvamabhyupagamyoktāniṣṭavāraṇe’pi
‘advastu’ ‘adastra’mityatra ‘orlī’ti parasavarṇavidhinā dakārasya
vakārāpaṃteḥ,vakārasya oṣṭhasthānādikye’pi dantasthānasāmyena
lakārā’nyūnasthānakatvāt| yadi tu ṭhvakārasya dantoṣṭha’miti
samāhāranirdeaśādoṣṭhasthāna (dantasthāna)bhinnameva dantoṣṭhasthānamiti
vakārasya lakārasāvarṇyābhāvātadvastvityādau nātiprasaṅga iti brūṣe
tarhi ‘ugvā duhe’tyādinā dantye taṅ ividhīyamāno raksastasya
luk-ṭhaduhvahī’tyatra na syāt, kiṃtu ṭhadugdhe’tyādāveva syāt |
tathā ‘ipūrtaḥ’ ‘ipuratī’tyādau vidhīyamānam
ṭhudoṣṭhayapūrvasye’tyutvaṃ ‘usvūrṣatī’tyādau na syāduktarītyā
vakārasyauṣṭhaḷtvā’bhāvāt | na ca vasyoṣṭhaḷtvedantyatveca sati
‘eksṛp’ iti ṣopadeśalakṣaṇe svidādīnāṃ pṛthaggrahaṇaṃ vyarthaṃ
syāteṣāmapi dantyāntasāditvāditi bhramitavyam; ‘antyaḥ
kevaladantyo na tu dantoṣṭhajo’pī’tyādermūla eva vakṣyamāṇatvāt |
ye tu pāṇiniśikṣāyāṃ yamānusvārayoreva
nāsikāsthānatvakathanādanyeṣāṃ sthānaṃ nāsikā na bhavati, kiṃ
tvanunāsikatvaṃ guṇa eva | nāsikāvyāpāreṇoccāryamāṇatvamātreṇa
nāsikāsthānatvakathane tvakārādīnāmapyuktarītyā nāsikāsthānamiti
sthānanirūpaṇe teṣāṃ tadakathānnyūnatetyādi vadanti |
teṣāmatroktajñāpakāśrayaṇaṃ vinaiveṣṭasiddhiḥ | anye tvakārādīnā
nāsikayā sarvadā’nuccāraṇādanunāsikatvaṃ guṇaḥ, ‘atve
niviśate’paitī’tyādilakṣaṇalakṣitatvāt | ñamaṅṇanānāṃ
tvanunāsikatvaṃ nāpaiti, sarvadaiva tayoccāraṇāditi na guṇaḥ,
kintu yamānusvārayoriva sthānameva nāsiketi sthānānirūpaṇe
ṭhñamaṅṇanānā nāsikā ce’tyuktaṃ natvakārādīnāṃ | nāsikā ceti |
yatūktaṃ tulyāsyatvamanyūnāsyatvamiti vyākhyāyāṃ tadvastvityādau
‘orlī’ti dakārasya vakāraprasaṅga iti tadāpātataḥ | ‘orlī’tyatra
lakāradvayanirdeaśa iti svīkṛtya lakārarūpe lakāre pare parasavarṇa
iti vyākhyāyāmuktadoṣā’prasakterityāhuḥ ||
(93) ṣṭuanā ṣṭuaḥ |8|4|41|

| padāntasyeti kim ?| vedmi | stabhrāti | sparśe caritārtha iti |
prasiddhaprayogābhiprāyeṇedamuktam | ‘amalmurāriḥ’
ṭhvṛkṣavnete’tyādau lakāravakārayoranunāsikapravṛtau
bādhakā’bhāvāt | ‘parśasyaiveṣyate’iti prāco granthānurodhena

| rephe na pravartata iti | yadyapi ṭhvyaktiḥ padārtha’ iti pakṣe lakṣyabhede

pravṛtirdurvāraiva, tathāpi lakṣyānurodhena

yavādigaṇe ‘aku’diti pāṭho nirarthakaḥ syāditi vācyam;

dhugvidhīyatāṃ ḍakārasya sakāre pare dhu’giti

pūrvāntatve tu na padāntāṭṭoranāmiti niṣedhāpravṛtyā dhakārasya

(473) karturīpsitatamaṃ karma |1|4|49|

(475) karmaṇi dvitīyā |2|3|2|

‘āyāpratigrāhitagandhamālyā’mityatra ktapratyayenā’bhidhānaṃ

kartṛtvādupapadyate| evañceha jāyāniṣṭhapreraṇaviṣayībhūtaṃ

na ca bindunā yoge taddayotakā’piśabdenā’pi yogo jāta eva,
arthadvārā śabdānāṃ yogasyābyupagamāditi śaṅkyam| apiśabdasya
bindudyotakatvā’bhāvāt| kathaṃ tarhi bindupratītiriti cet|
śrṛṇu---apinā dyotyaṃ bhavanadaurlabhyameva kartṛdaurlabhyamākṣipati|
kartā tviha vindureveti sa pratīyate| ata eva ṭhapiśabdabalena
gamyamānasye’tyaktuaṃ, na tvapinā gamyamānasyeti| uktatvāditi|
uktaprayātvādityarthaḥ| ṭhapiśabdaḥ syādityanena
saṃbadhyata’ityuktesyādityasyā’pinā yogo na tu sarpiṣā
ityarthaparyavasānāt| apa# stuyāiditi| avāṅbhanasagocaraṃ
viṣṇumapi stuyādityadhikoktiḥ| etādṛśasyā’nyadīyastavane
sāmarthyamastītyatra kiṃ vaktavyamiti bhāvaḥ| iha
saṃbhāvanādyotako’piśabdaḥ, pūrvatra tu
saṃbhāvanāviṣayedaurlabhyadyotaka iti mahānbhedaḥ|
ṭhupasargātsumanoti’ ityādinā ṣatvaṃ na bhavati,
karmapravacanīyasaṃjñayā upasargasaṃjñāyā bādhāt| evamutaratrāpi
bodhyam| api siñca| api stuhīti| siñca ca stuhi cetyarthaḥ|
(492) kālādhvanoratyantasaṃyoge |2|3|5|
tālādhvanoḥ| antaṃ virāmamatikrānto’tyantaḥ, sa cāsau
saṃyogaścā’tyantasaṃyogaḥ| nirantarasaṃnnikarṣa ityarthaḥ|
kenetyākāṅkṣāyāṃ guṇakriyādravyairityaucityādbodhyam|
dvitīyā syāditi| śrutatvātkālādhvavṛtibhyāmeva| svarūpagrahaṇaṃ tviha
na bhavati, ‘ālāḥ,’ ṭhatyantasaṃyoge ca ’iti samāsavidhāyake
‘ālāḥ’iti bahuvacananirdeaśena dvitāyāvidhau svarūpavidhirneti
jñāpanāt| ataeva ‘āsapramitaḥ,’ ‘uhūrtasukha’miti
dvitīyāsamāsavidhāvudāhariṣyati| māsaṃ kalyāṇītyādī|
akarmakadhātubhiryoga eva desakālādīnāṃ karmasañjñāvidhānānneha
‘armaṇi dvitīya’iti dvitīyā prāpnotīti bhāvaḥ| māsasya dviriti|
‘ṛtvorthaprayoge kāle’dhikaraṇe’ityanena ṣaṣṭhīti prāñcaḥ| tanna| tatra
śeṣagrahaṇā’nuvṛtyā ‘virahno bhojana’miti kṛdantena saha
samāsanivṛtereva phalatvāt| tasmādiha ‘aṣṭhī śeṣe’iti sūtreṇaiva
ṣaṣṭhī bhavatyantaraṅgatvādityāhuḥ| anyarthamārabdhasyā’pi
‘ṛtvorthaprayoge’iti sūtrasya dvirahno bhuṅkta ityatra
viśeṣavihitatvātpravṛtau bādhakaṃ nāstīti kecit| iti dvitīyā|
(493) svatantraḥ kartā |1|4|54|

(494) sādhakatamaṃ karaṇam |1|4|42|
sādhakatamaṃ karaṇam| prakṛṣṭeti| yaddyāpārānantaraṃ
phalaniṣpatistatparrakṛṣṭam| uktañca----ṭhkriyāyāḥ
phalaniṣpatiryaddyāpārādanantaram| vivakṣyate yadā yatra karaṇaṃ tatadā
smṛtam’iti| ṭhvivakṣyate’ityanena sthālyādīnāmapi karaṇatvamastīti
sūcitam| āha ca--ṭhvastutastadanirdeaśyaṃ na hi vastu vyavasthitam|
sthālyā pacyata ityeṣā vivakṣā dṛśyate yataḥ’iti| ayaṃ
bhāvaḥ--kārakatvaṃ taddyapyakartṛtvādiṣaṭkaṃ ca vastuviśeṣe
viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvavanna niyataṃ, kintu vaivakṣikam| na hi ‘auḥ
sarvaṃ prati gaurave, na tu kañcitpratyagauḥ’ iti vadviśeṣaṇaṃ sarvaṃ prati
viśeṣaṇameveti vaktuaṃ śakyam| tathāca kayā dhātuvyaktyā
upasthāpite’rthe kiṃ kartrādikamiti praśne
‘rakṛtadhātuvyaktyupātavyāpārāśrayatayā vivakṣitaḥ kartā,
vyāpāravyadhikaraṇaphalāśrayaḥ karma, kartṛkarmadvārakasambandhena
vyāpārasya phalasya vā āśrayo’dhikaraṇa’miti sthitam| pacyartho
vyāpāra ścā’nekadhā| evañca
paceradhiśrayaṇataṇḍulāvapanaidhopakarṣaṇāditātparyakatve tadāśrayo
devadataḥ kartā, jvalanātātparyakatve edhāḥ kartāraḥ,
taṇḍuladhāraṇādiparatve sthālī katrīṃ, avayavavibhāgādiparatve
taṇḍulāḥ kartāraḥ| ‘thālyā pacatī’tyatra
tṛtīyopātavyāpārāśrayā’pi sthālī karaṇameva, natu kartrī,
devadatādivyāpārāsyaiva taddhātīpātatvāt, tathā
ādikhādibhyāmupāte’rthe prayojyaḥ kartā, tasminnevārthe
bhakṣayatinopāte prayojyaḥ karma| adhipūrvaiḥ śīhādibhirupāte’rthe
ādhāraḥ karma, kevalairupāte adhikaraṇāmityādi jñeyam| etena
jñānasya svaprakāśatve kartṛkarmavirodha iti keṣāñciduktiḥ parāstā|
yaddhātūpātakriyāyāṃ yadā yasta svātantryaṃ vivakṣyate tadā tatkriyāyāṃ
sa kartā, yadupātayā kartuṛ kriyāyā yadā āptumiṣṭatamatvena
yadvivakṣyate tadā tatkārakaṃ tatkriyāyāṃ karmetyeva
śabdaviśeṣapādhikasya kartṛtvādeḥ pratyakṣe uktisambhavā’bhāvāt|
yatuta kecitparasamavetakriyājanyaphalaśālitvaṃ karmatvaṃ cet
ṭhvṛkṣātparṇaṃ patatī’tyādau svasamavetakriyājanyavibhāgādiphalaśālini
kartaryativyāptyabhāve’pyāpādāne’tivyāptiḥ syādeva| ataśca
dhātvarthatāvcchedakaphalaśālitvaṃ karmatvamityevābhyupagantavyam|
evañca sati ‘rāmaṃ gaccchatī’tyādisakarmakeṣu
gamanajanyasaṃyogādāviṣṭā’nurodhene
dhātvarthatāvaccchadakatve’bhyupagate’pi, ṭhvṛkṣātpatatī’tyādyakarmakeṣu
patanāda#jinyavibhāgādau
tadavacchedakatvā’kalpanānnāpādāne’tivyāptiḥ, navāṭh grāmaṃ
gaccchatī’tyādau
kartaryativyāptiḥ,saṃyogādiphalajanakībhūtadhātvarthasya
parasamavetatvaviśeṣaṇātkarmatvenābhimataṃ yatadbhinnasya
paraśabdenā’tra vivakṣitatvādityāhuḥ| tadapyetena pratyuktam| ‘rāmaṃ
gamayati devadata’mityādau gantaryavyāpteḥ|
ṇijarthapreraṇājanyaprayojyavyāpāre gamanādau
dhātvarthatāvacchedakatvā’bhāvāt| tatvābhyupagame tu ‘evadatena
pācayatī’tyādau prayojyakartaryativyāpteḥ|
‘atibuddhī’tyādiśāstrābhyupagamaṃ vinā kvacitprayojyakartari
kramatvaṃ, kvacitu kartṛtvamiti nirdhārayitumaśakyatvāt|
ṭhhṛkroranyatarasyā’miti śāstramantareṇa ṭhhārayati kārayati vā kaṭṃa
bhṛtyena bhṛtya’mityatra vaikalpikakarmatvasya durupapādatvācca|
etādṛśeṣi vaiyākaraṇoktyaiva nirvāha iti cet, tarhi
ṭhākaḍārādekā sañjñā, yā parā’navakāśā ce’tyaktvānniravakāśayā
apādānasaṃjñayā sāvakāśāyāḥ karmasañjñāyā bādhānnoktātivyāptiriti
kimanena ‘hātvarthatāvacchedake’tyādi pariśrameṇa?|
syādetat--ṭhātmānamātmanā vetsi
sṛjasyātmānamātmane’tyādiprayogaḥ kathaṃ saṅgaccchate, ekasyaiva
vastuno yugapadekakriyānirūpitakartṛtvakarmatvāderasambhavāt,
parayā kartṛsañjñayā karmakaraṇādisañjñāyā bādhāt| naiṣa doṣaḥ|
ahaṅkārādyaupadhibhedenātmano’pi bedamāśritya ṭhātmānamātmanā
hanti’ityādiprayogasyākare samarthitatvāt| nanu ‘ādhakaṃ
karaṇa’mityevāstu, kārakādhikārādiha kārakamiti vartate, sādhakaṃ
kārakaṃ hi paryāyaḥ, tathā cobhayopādānena prakarṣo labhyata
ityāśayena pṛccchati---tamabgrahaṇaṃ kimiti| itarastu kārakaprakaraṇe
gauṇamukyanyāya etatsūtrādanyatra na pravartata iti jñāpanāya
tamabgrahaṇamityāśayena jñāpanaphalamudāharati---gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣa
iti| uktajñāpanā’naṅgīkāre tvihādhikaraṇasañjñā na syāt| tileṣu
tailaṃ, dadhani sarpirityādau mukhyādhāre tasyāścaritārthatvāditi
bhāvaḥ| atra vyācakhyuḥ--yadā ca tīradharma ādhāratvaṃ sāmīpyātpravāhe
upacaryate tadedaṃ prayojanam, yadā tu gaṅgāśabda eva tīre vartate
tadā tu na prayojanam, tīrasya mukhyādhāratvāt| tatrā dyapakṣe
vibhaktirlākṣaṇikī,dvitīye tu prakṛtirlākṣaṇikītyādi|
(495) kartṛkaraṇayostṛtīyā |2|3|18|
rameṇeti| yadyapi vibhaktyupasthitānāṃ kārakāṇāṃ kriyāṃ prati
viśeṣaṇataiva, tathāpi kṛdupasthitānāṃ viśeṣyataiva, ‘atvapradhānāni
nāmānī’tyukteḥ| dhātūpasthāpyayoḥ phalavyāpārayorhanyata
ityādikarmākhyātasamabhivyāhāre
viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvavyatyāsā’bhāve’pi ṭhhata’
ityādikarmakṛtsamabhivyāhāre vyatyāso’styeva| tathā ca rāmaniṣṭho
yo vyāpāro dhanurākarṣaṇādistadviṣayībhūto yo bāṇavyāpāraḥ
śarīrabhedanādistatsādhyaprāṇaviyogāśrāyo vālīti vākyārthaḥ|
ṭhvālinaṃ hanti’ ṭhvālī hanyate’ityādau tu
vāliniṣṭhaprāṇaviyogānukūlo yaḥ
śarīrabhedanādirbāṇavyāpārastadviṣayako
rāmaniṣṭhadhanurākarṣaṇādivyāpāra ityartho bodhyaḥ|
atredamavadheyaṃ---ṭhphalavyāpārayordhāturāśraye tu tiṅḥ smṛtaḥ| phale
pradhānaṃ vyāpārastirṅthastu viśeṣaṇam’| iha ‘hātuḥ smṛta’ityanvayaḥ|
ṭhvācaketvene’ti śeṣaḥ| ṭhāśraye tu tiṅḥ’ityatra
vibhaktivipariṇāmena ‘mṛtā’iti sambandhate| vācakatveneti
pūrvavat| tiṅ ityupalakṣaṇaṃ, dvitīyātṛtīyādīnāmapi
keṣāñcidāśrayamātrārthakatvāt| nanvevamādhārārthakatve
dvitīyātṛtīyāsaptamīnāṃ sāṅkaryaṃ syāt| maivam|
nirūpapakabhedenādārabhedāt| phalanirūpita ādhāro dvitīya#arthaḥ|
vyāpāranirūpitastu tṛtīyārthaḥ| svāśrayadvārā vyāpāranirūpitaḥ
phalanirūpitaḥ phalanirūpitaśca saptamyartha iti hyabhyuhagamyate| ‘hale
pradhāna’miti| etacca prāyikam| karmakṛtsamabhivyāhāre tu
vyatyāso’styevetyuktatvāt| ṭhhariṃ bhajati devadataḥ’ityādau tu
vyāpārasya prādhānyamastyeva|
prakṛtipratyayārthayorharyādhārayordeavadatatiṅvācyādhārayoścā’bheda ihaṃ saṃsargaḥ| tathā ca haryādhārikā yā prītistadanukūla ekadevadatādhārako vartamāno yo vyāpāra iti vākyārthaḥ| na cā’’dhārataiva vācyeti mantavyaṃ, tanniṣṭhadharmasyādhāratvasya vācyatāvacchedakatvāpatyā’tigauravāt| ‘armaṇi dvitīye’tyādisūtrasvarasabhaṅgāpateśca| ataeva bhāṣyakāro’pyāha--ṭhsupāṃ karmādayo’pyarthāḥ saṅkhyā caiva tathāsa tiṅa’miti| anabhihite kim? hariḥ karoti| pācakaḥ| kartari ṇvul| śābdikaḥ| ‘abdadarduraṃ karoti’iti ṭhak| kṛtaṃ viśvaṃ yena kṛtaviśvaḥ, viśvakarmakakṛtyāśraya ityarthaḥ| jīvantyena jīvanaḥ| karaṇe lyuṭ|
prakṛtyādibhya upasaṅkhyānam| prakṛtyādibhya iti| ākṛtigaṇo’yam|
tena ‘āmnā sutīkṣṇaścaritena dāntaḥ’ityādi siddham| cāririti|
abhirūpa ityarthaḥ| kriyāyā aśravaṇāt kartṛkaraṇayorabhāvāt ṣaṣṭhīha
prāptā| etacca gamyamānakarotikriyākaraṇatvāsiddhaṃ,
karaṇāntaravyudāsāya hi prakṛtereva karaṇatvaṃ vivakṣitam|
svabhāvenāyamabhirūpaḥ kṛto, na tvalaṅkārādinetyarthāt| prāyeṇa
yājñika iti| etadapi gamyamānajñānakriyāṃ prati karaṇatvātsiddhim,
ācārādibāhulyena yājñiko’yamiti janairjñāyata ityarthāt|
gautreṇa gārgya iti| gārgyau’sya gotramityarthaḥ| prathamā’tra prāptā|
gotreṇāhaṃ gargyaṃ itila jñāye ityarthādihāpi tṛtīyā siddhā|
samenaitītyādi| samametītyādyarthe samaviṣamābhyāṃ karmaṇi dvitīyā
prāptā| ihāpi tṛtīyā siddhā, patho’pi gamane karaṇatvābyupagamāt|
(496) divaḥ karma ca |1|4|43|

ṣaṣṭhī--mātuḥ saṃjānātīti, tanna| tatra śeṣādhikārāditi
manoramāyāṃ sthitam|
(504) hetau |2|3|23|

hetau| heturiha laukikaḥ phalasādhanībhūto gṛhyate, na tu
‘atpratyayojako hetuśce’ti kṛtrimaḥ| tasya cakāreṇa
kartṛsaṃjñāvidhānātkartṛtvādeva tṛtīyāsiddherata āha--hetvarthe
ityādi| nanu laukikahetorapi karaṇatvādeva tṛtīyasiddhau
kimanenetyāśaṅkya hetutvakaraṇatvayorbhedamāha--dravyādīti|
ṭhādi’śabdena guṇakriye grāhyae| dravyaguṇakriyānirūpitaṃ
nirvyāpārasavyāpāravṛti ca yataddhetutvamityarthaḥ| karaṇatvaṃ tviti|
kriyāmātranirūpitaṃ vyāpāravadvṛti ca yatatkaraṇatbhityarthaḥ| evaṃ ca
hetutvakaraṇatvayorbhedādanyatareṇānyasyānyathāsiddhirna śaṅkyeti
bhāvaḥ| uktaṃ ca--dravyādiviṣayo hetuḥ kārakaṃ niyatakriyam|
anāśrite tu vyāpāre nimitaṃ heturiṣyate’iti| dravyaviṣaye
hetutvamudāharati--daṇḍena ghaṭa iti| daṇḍahetuko ghaṭa ityarthaḥ| atra
hi vyāpāro’stu vā, mā vā, sākṣātkriyānvayitvā’bhāvātkaraṇatvaṃ
nāstīti bhāvaḥ| kriyāviṣaye udāharaṇamāha--- puṇyena dṛṣṭa iti|
puṇyaśabdeneha paramā’pūrvamucyateta, tasya ca
haridarśanarūpakriyānvayitvasaṃbhave|ñapi vyāpāravatvā’bhāvanna
karaṇatvamiti bhāvaḥ| yadā tu yāgādikameva puṇyaśabdena vivakṣyate,
tadā tasya vyāpāravattvamastyeveti ‘artṛkaraṇayo’rityanenaiva
tṛtīyā siddhā| guṇaviṣaye tu ‘uṇyena gauravarṇa’ityādyaudāhāryam|
‘aṭābhistāpasa’ityādau tu lakṣyalakṣaṇabhāvavivakṣāyāṃ
hetutvā’vivakṣaṇādanenā’prāptā tṛtīyeti
ṭhitthambhūtalakṣaṇe’ityārabdhamityāhuḥ| atra kecidutprekṣante
dravyādisādhāraṇatvāddhetutvasya ṭhhetau’ityanenaiva ‘āṇena hata’
ityādiprayogasiddheḥ ‘artṛkaraṇayo’riti sūtre karaṇagrahaṇaṃ tyaktuaṃ
śakyam, karaṇasaṃjñā tu āvaśyakī ‘araṇādhikaraṇayośce’tyādyarthamiti|
anye tu kriyāsādhakatamaṃ yataddyāpāravatvena vivakṣitaṃ cet karamaṃ,
no ceddhetuḥ| dravyasādhakatamasya daṇḍādestu vyāpāravatve’pi
hetutvameva| evaṃ ca ṭhrāmeṇa bāṇena hata’ityādau hanane
bāṇādirnimitamityetāvadeva yadā vivakṣyate, tadā ṭhhetau’
ityanenaiva tṛtīyā| ‘āṇavyāpārasādhyaprāṇaviyogāśrayaḥ’ityevaṃ
vyāpārāviṣṭatvena vivakṣāyāṃ tu hetutvā’vivakṣaṇāt
‘artṛkaraṇayoḥ---’iti karaṇe tṛtīyā ārabdhetyāhuḥ| phalamapīti|
etacca ‘ratyayaḥ’it sūtre kaiyaṭe spaṣṭam| adhyayaneneti|
tādarthyavivakṣāyāṃ caturthyapi bhavatīti caturthyā saheyaṃ tṛtīyā
vikalpyate| adhyayanāya vasati| atra kecitpariṣkurvanti---ṭhadhyayanena
vasatī’tyatra ‘aṇḍahetu ko ghaṭa’itivadadhyayanahetu ko nivāsa
ityarthasvīkāre’pyayaṃ viśeṣaḥ,---adhyayanasyā phasena sahā’bhedaḥ
saṃsargaḥ, upakārakatvena saha tu nirūpakatā| tataśca
phalābhinnā’dhyayananirūpitopakārakatvāśrayanivasanānukūlo
vyāpāraḥ’ityarthaḥ| ‘aṇḍena ghaṭaḥ’ityatra tu
daṇḍaniṣṭhopakārakatvanirūpitopakāryatvāśrayo ghaṭa ityarthaḥ|
upakāryaṃ hi sādhyam| phalamapi tadeveti| gamyamānāpīti|
ṭhapi’śabdena śrūyamāṇakriyā samuccayate| nakevalaṃ śrūyamāṇaiva kriyā
vibhaktau prayojikā, kiṃtu gamyamānā’pīti bhāvaḥ| sādhaneti|
‘ādhya.’mityatra prakṛtibhūto yo dhātustadarthaṃta pratīti bhāvaḥ|
aśiṣṭeti| etacca ‘āṇaśca sā ceccaturthyartha’ityanena jñāpyate iti
manoramāyāṃ sthitam| kecidiha
pariṣkurvanti--ṭhaśiṣṭavyavahāra’ityaṃśo vācanika eva, anyāṃśastu
jñāpakasiddhaḥ’iti| dāsyā saṃyaccchate iti| ‘āṇaśca sā ce’diti taṅ|
‘āghradhme’ti yacchādeśaḥ| kāmuka iti| ‘aṣapatapade’tyādinā
kamerukañ| iti tṛtīyā|
(505) karmaṇā yamabhipraiti sa saṃpradānam |1|4|32|
karmaṇā| mahāsaṃjñākaraṇamanvarthasaṃjñāvidhānārtham| samyak
pradīyate’smai tatsaṃpradānamiti| ata evāha---dānasyeti|
dānakriyākarmaṇā kartā yamabhipraiti sambandhnāti, sambanddhumīpsati
vā taskārakaṃ sampradānasaṃjñakamityarthaḥ| tena ṭhajāṃ nayati grāmaṃ’
ṭhhastaṃ nidadhāti vṛkṣe’ ityādau nā’tiprasaṅgaḥ | dānaṃ
cā’nupunargrahaṇāya svasvatvinivṛtipūrvakaṃ parasvatvotpādanam |
ataeva ṭhrajakasya vastraṃ dadātī’tyādau na bhavati| tatra hi dadātirbhāktaḥ
| etacca vṛtimatam | bhāṣyamate tu nā’nvarthatāyāmāgrahaḥ
‘haṇḍikopādhyāyaḥ śiṣyāya capeṭāṃ dadāti’ ityādiprayogāt|
‘ājakasya dadātī’ti prayogastu śeṣatvavivakṣāyāṃ bhaviṣyati| na
caivamajāṃ nayati grāmamityādāvatiprasaṅgaḥ śaṅkyaḥ, ajāṃ prati
grāmasya śeṣitvā’bhāvāt| ṭhyamabhipraitī’tyuktyā hi yamiti
nirdiṣṭasya śeṣitvaṃ, karmaṇaśca śeṣatvaṃ labhyate, gāṃ prati tu viprasya
śeṣitvamastīti bhavati tasya saṃpradāmasaṃjñā| atra abhi pra
etītyetatpadatrayaṃ, na tu samāsaḥ|’ udātavatā gātimatā ca tiṅa
gateḥ samāso vaktavyaḥ’ iti vārtikasya cchandoviṣayatvāditi haradataḥ|
bhāṣāviṣayatve tu ṭhyatprakurute’ ityādau samāsatvātsora#utpatiḥ
syāt| liṅgasarvanāma napuṃsakatāmabhyupetya ‘vamornapuṃsakāt’
iti luki kṛte’pi ṭhhrasvo napuṃsake---’ iti hrasvaḥ
syāt,ṭhyatprakurvīra’nnityatra tu nalopaḥ syāt, tasmāduktavārtikasya
cchandoviṣayatvaṃyuktameva| dānīya iti| bāhulakātsaṃpradāne anīyari|
kriyayeti | kriyāyāḥ kṛtrimākarmatvā’bhāvātayā abhipreyamāṇasya
sūtreṇa saṃjñā na prāpnotīti vacanam| etacca ‘riyārthopapadasya ca
karmaṇi sthāninaḥ’ ityanena siddham| ‘atye śete’ ityādau
patimanukūlayituṃ śete ityādyarthābhyupagame vādhakā’bhāvāt |
bhāṣyakāramate tu ‘armaṇā yamabhipraiti’ iti sūtreṇaiva siddham,
‘aṃdarśanaprārthanā’dhyavasāyairāpyamāṇatvātkriyāpi kṛtriṃmaṃ karma’ iti
tairuktatvāt| nacaivamapi dadātikarmatvā’bhāvāt ‘riyayā
yamabhipraiti’ ityetadvacanaṃ kartavyameveti vācyam,
bhāṣye’nvarthasaṃjñātbasvokārāt | nanvenaṃ kaṭṃa karoti, odanaṃ
pacatītyādāvapi saṃpradānatvaprasaṅgastathā ca
vacanadvayabalātkarmasaṃpradānayoḥ paryāyatve ‘aṭāya
karotī’tyādyaniṣṭaprayogo’pi syāditi cet? | atrāhuḥ--ṭhpatye
śete’ ityakarmakasthale sāvakāśāyāḥ saṃpradānasaṃjñāyāḥ niravakāśayā
karmasaṃjñayā bādhitatvānnaivā’niṣṭaprasaktiḥ | na caivaṃ
‘atyarthakarmaṇi dvitīyācaturthyau---’ iti sūtramāvaśyakameveti
tatpratyākhyānaṃ bhāṣyasthaṃ na saṅgaccchata iti vācyam | bhāṣye
tatpratyākhyānasya prauḍhivādamātratvāditi dik | syādetat---dānasya
tadarthatvātādarthye caturthī siddhaiva kimanayā saṃpradānasaṃjñayā ?|
maivam | dānakriyārthaṃ hi saṃpradānaṃ na tu dānakriyā tadarthā |
kārakāṇāṃ kriyārthatvāt|
karmaṇaḥ karaṇasaṃjñā saṃpradānasya ca karmasaṃjñā | karmaṇaḥ
karaṇasaṃjñetyādi | cchandasametat| ata evedaṃ subvyatyatyena
siddhatvāditi pratyākhyāyate |
(506) rucyarthānāṃ prīyamāṇaḥ |1|4|33|
rucyarthānām | rucirartho yeṣāṃ te rucyarthāsteṣām | prīyamāṇā
iti| ‘rīñ tarpaṇe’ asmātkarmaṃṇi liṭ | haraye rocata iti| hariṃ
prīṇayatītyarthaḥ| karmasaṃjñāyāṃ prāptāyāṃ vacanam | yadyapi
rucirdīptāvapi paṭaḷte, tathāpīha dīptirna
vivakṣitetyāha---anyakartṛko’bhilāṣa iti | ata eva ṭhādityo
rocate dikṣu’ ityatra dīptyarthe saṃjñā na bhavati | hariniṣṭha
prīteriti | etena anyakartṛkatvamiha
prītyāśrayā’nyakartṛkatvamityuktaṃ bhavati | modakaḥ pathīti|
devadatasyaiva prīyamāṇatvaṃ na tu patha iti na katasya saṃpradānatvaṃ |
prīyamāṇapadā’bhāve cu patho’pi syāditi bhāvaḥ|
(507) ślāghahnuṅsthāśapāṃ jñīpsyamānaḥ |1|4|34|

(508) dhārerutamarṇaḥ |1|4|35|
dhārerutamarṇaḥ| ‘hṛṅ avasthāne’| hetumaṇṇyantaḥ|
utamarṇoudhanasvāmī| arteḥ ktaḥ| ṛṇam| ṛṇamādhamarṇye ithyatra
vyavahāraviśeṣopalakṣaṇārthamādhamarṇyagrahaṇamiti

bahuvrīhau niṣṭhāntasya paranipāto bodhyaḥ| bhaktāyetyādi | iha bhakta

apyayamapavādaḥ syātadvāraṇayotamarṇagrahaṇamiti bhāvaḥ| evaṃ ca

sthitam|
(509) spṛherīpsitaḥ |1|4|36|
spṛherīpsitaḥ| ‘pṛha īpsāyāṃ’ curādāvadantaḥ, tena

cetat---ṭhkriyayā yamabhipraiti---’ ityanenaiveṣṭasiddhe

(510) krudhadruherṣyā’sūyārthānāṃ yaṃ prati kopaḥ |1|4|37|
krudhadruha| ‘rudhe krodhe’, druha jighāṃsāyām’, ṭhīrṣya īrṣyāyām’,
asūyatiḥ kaṇḍvādiyagantaḥ, eṣāmartha ivārthe yeṣāṃ
dhātūnāmityarthaḥ| droho’pakāra iti| druha drohe’iti
pāṭhābhiprāyeṇoktaṃ, jighāṃsādroha evetyarthato’nubhāṣaṇaṃ vā|
akṣameti| parasaṃpatyasahanamityarthaḥ| krudhadruhorakarmakatvātadyoge
ṣaṣṭhī prāptā, anyayostu sakarmakatvāddvitīyā prāptā| nanu
citadoṣārthānāmityevāstu, kiṃ krodhādīnāṃ
viśiṣyopādāneneti cet?atrāhuḥ--dviṣādāvatiprasaṅgavāraṇāya
viśiṣyopādānam| tena ṭhyo’smāndveṣṭi yaṃ ca vayaṃ dvi ṣmaḥ’ ityatra
caturthī na bhavati| tatra hyanabhanandanaṃ dviṣerarthaḥ| ata evā’cetaneṣu na
prayujyate ṭh--āṬṣadhaṃ dveṣṭi devadata’miti | kopaprabhavā eveti| kathaṃ

vyācakhyuḥ--kupiratra drohārtha iti| patye śete itivat
‘riyayāyam---’ ityeva siddhe krudhadruhorgrahaṇaṃ

(513) paskriyaṇe saṃpradānamanyatasyām |1|4|44|

tādarthye caturthī vācyā || tādarthya ithi tasmai kāryāyedaṃ
tadarthaṃukāraṇaṃ, tasya bhāvastādarthyam| brāhmaṇāditvātṣyañ|
‘ṛtaddhitasamāsebhyaḥ saṃbandhābhidhānaṃ bhāvapratyayena’ iti
siddhāntātṣyañā saṃbandho’bhidhīyate| sa ca saṃbandho’nekavidho, na
tu kāryakāraṇabhāva eva; tena ‘rāhmaṇāya dadhī’ tyādyapi siddham|
brāhmaṇasya dadhyajanyatve’pi tatsaṃskāryatvāt | na caivaṃ dadhiśabdādapi
caturthī syāditi śaṅkyaṃ, saṃbandhasya dviṣṭhetve’pi
ṣaṣṭhīvadviseṣaṇādeva bhavatītyākare ’bhyupagamāt| evaṃ ṭhyūpāya
dāru’ ityatra dāruśabdādapi na bhavati| ṭhhetau’ iti tṛtīyāpi
ṣaṣṭhīviṣaya eva bhavatīti sāpīha na bhavati, kiṃtu prātipadikārthe
prathamaiva| na caivadvārtikasyāvaśyakatve ‘aturthī saṃpradāne’ iti sūtre
vyarthamiti bhramitavyam, ṭhharaye rocate’ ityādyartha
tasyāpyāvaśyakatvāt| ṭhviprāya gā’ mityatrāpi tādarthya caturthyāḥ
prāptirnāstīti prāgevoktatvācceti dik|
klṛpi saṃpadyamāne ca || klṛpīti| saṃpadāditvādbhāve kvipi
tadantātsaptamī| saṃpatirihā’bhūtaprādurbhāvaḥ,
klṛpkatyarthakadhātuprayoge yaḥ saṃpadyate tatra caturthī,
vikāravācakāccaturthītyarthaḥ| sa hi saṃpadyateuprādurbhavati |
tadudāharati---bhaktirjñānāyeti | jñānātmanā pariṇamata ityarthaḥ|
prakṛtivikṛtyorbhedabivakṣāyāṃ vikṛtivācakāccaturthī|
abhedavivakṣāyāṃ tu paratvātprathamaiva, ‘haktirjñānaṃ kalpate’| yadā tu
‘anikartuḥ---’ iti bhakterapādanatvaṃ vivakṣyate, tadāpi
jñānasyābhihitakartṛkvanātprathamaiva, ‘haktarjñānaṃ kalpate’|
klṛpītyarthagrahaṇamityāśayenāha---saṃpadyate ityādi| yadyapi
tādarthye caturthyaiva bhaktirjñānāyetyādiprayogāḥ sidhyanti,
tathāpi pariṇamātvaprakārakabodhārthamidaṃ vacanamityāhuḥ|
utpātena jñāpite ca | utpāteneti| prāṇināṃ śubhā’śubhasūcako
bhūtavikāra utpātaḥ, tena jñāpite’the vartamānaccaturthī vācyetyarthaḥ|
vātāyeti| vātasya jñāpiketyarthaḥ|
hiteyoge ca | hiteti|
caturthīsamāsavidhānājjñāpakādetallabdhamiti bhāvaḥ| evaṃ
sukhayoge’pila caturthī bodhyā| kriyārthopapada| kriyā arthaḥ
prayojanaṃ yasyāḥ sā kriyārthā, sā kriyārthā kriyā upapadaṃ yasya|
yadyapi kriyāyā upapadatvaṃ na saṃbhavati, tathāpīha svavācakaśabdadvārā
tadbodhyam| kriyāphalakakriyāvācakamityarthaḥ| kriyāvācakasyāpi
dhātorupoccāritapadarūpopapadatvaṃ yadyapi na saṃbhavati,
suptiṅntasyaiva padatvāt, tathāpīha kriyāvācakaprakṛtikamityartho
vivakṣitaḥ, tādṛśamupapadaṃ yasya tumunnantasya tasya karmaṇi caturthī
bhavatīti niṣkṛṣṭo’rthaḥ| ‘umunṇvulau kriyāyām---’ iti
sūtramahinmā kriyārthakamupapadaṃ kriyāvācyeva phalatītyāśayenāha--|
(514) kriyārthopapadasya ca karmaṇi sthāninaḥ |2|3|14|
kriyārthā kriyate| sthānina ityasyaivārthakathanam--aprayujyamānasyeti|
tumuna iti| ṇvulo’pyupalakṣaṇam, phalabhyo yātītyasya
phalānyāhāraka iti vivaraṇe bādhakā’bhāvāt| karmaṇīti| tathā ca
dvitīyāpavāde’yamiti bhāvaḥ| yatu prasādakṛtā
vyākhyātamṭhaprayujyamānasyaiva karmaṇi yathā syāt, prayujyamānasya
karmaṇi mā bhūditi niyamārthaṃ sūtra’miti, tadasat, aprāptasya
niyamā’yogāt| na ceha ‘ādarthya’ iti prāptiḥ śaṅkyā,
yānakriyāyāḥ phalārthatvā’bhāvāt| āharaṇārthā hi yānakriyā|
āharaṇaṃ tu phalakarmakamintyanyadetat| kriyārthopapadasya kim?|
praviśa piṇḍim| gṛhapraveśanaṃ yadyapi bhakṣaṇārthaṃ tathāpi bhakṣiṃ prati
kṛtrimopapadatvaṃ nāsti| na ca tumunaḥ
karmaṇīt.yuktatvādbhakṣikarmaṇi caturthyāḥ prasaktireva nāstīti
pratyudāharaṇamidaṃ na saṅgaccchata iti vācyam, sati tu
‘riyārthopapadasya’ iti pade ‘umunṇvulau kriyāyām’
ityetadviṣayakamevedaṃ sūtramiti ‘umunaḥ’ iti labhyate nānyatheti
pratyudāharaṇasyā’saṅgatatvā’bhāvāt|
(515) tumarthāñca bhāvavacanāt |2|3|15|
tumarthāt| ṭhavyayakṛto bhāve’ iti tumuno bhāve eva
vidhānātadarthasya bhāvavacanatve siddhe punarbhāvavacanagrahaṇaṃ
sūtraviśeṣaparigrahārthamityāha---bhāvavacanāścetīti | na ca
‘ādarthye’ ityeva gatārthatā śaṅkyā| kriyārthakriyopapadakena
‘hāvavacanādeva yathā syāt, pācako vrajatīti ṇvulantānmā bhūditi
niyamārthamidaṃ sūtramiti| tanna, ṇvulaḥ kartṛvācakatayā
tumarthakatvā’bhāvena niyamārthatvā’yogāt| ṇvulanto kartuḥ
prādhānyāt, kartāraṃ prati ca tādarthyā’bhāvāt,
guṇībhūta[tayāṭpātaṃ prati tādarthyasaṃbhave’pi
pātavācakadhātoścuturthyayogācca| tumarthātkim?| pacanaṃ vartate|
bhāvavacanātkim?| pākaḥ | tyāgaḥ | atra vadanti--ṭhkriyārthopapadasya---’
ityanuvartya pañcamyā vipariṇamayya vyākhyāne
bādhakā’bhāvādbhāvavacanāditi tyuktaṃ śakyam| na caivaṃ
‘umarthāt---’ ityeva vaktavyamiti vācyam| varṇalāghavasambhave
gauravāśrayaṇā’yogāditi| 
upapadavibhakteḥ kārakavibhaktirbaliyasī || valīyasīti | haraye nama
ityatra tūddeśanakriyādvārā harimanaskārayoḥ sambandhaḥ--haryuddeśyako
namaskāra iti | evaṃ coddeśanakriyāvagatau vilamba iti
kārakavibhakterbalīyastvamityeke | anye tūpapadaviṅktyā
saṃbandhasāmānyamavagamyate,
tadviśeṣāvagamastvarthaprakaraṇādiparyālocanā’dhīnaḥ | kārakavibhaktyā
tu karmatvādisaṃbandhaviśeṣe jhaṭityevā’vagamyata iti tasyā
balīyastvamityāhuḥ| ṣaṣṭhaḷpīti| nanu prabhvādiyoge ṣaṣṭhaḷevāstu,
alaṃśabdastu paryāptītarārthaka eva gṛhyatāmityāśaṅkyāha---tasmai
prabhavatīti| na tvāṃ tṛṇamityādi | nanu tṛṇādivadyauṣmaccchabdādapi
pakṣe caturthyā bhāvyam| maivam, ṭhanādare’ ityasya karmaviśeṣaṇatvena
anādaradyotakaṃ yatkarma tatra caturthīti vyākhyānāt| tṛṇaṃ
hyatrā’nādaradyokataṃ na tu yuṣmadarthaḥ| syādetat---tvāṃ tṛṇaṃ manye
tṛṇāya vetyudāhriyatāṃ, kimanena nañaḥ prayogeṇa?| atrāhuḥ--ṭhprakṛṣya
kutsita grahaṇaṃ kartavyam’ iti vārtikamasti, tena yadvācinaścuturthī
vidhīyate tato nikṛṣṭatvena yadi kutsā pratipādyate, tadā caturthī
bhavati na tu sāmyavivakṣāyām| tādṛśī ca kutsāpratītirnañaḥ
prayoga#e jhaṭityeva bhavatīti ‘a tvā’ mityuktamiti|
(516) manyakarmaṇyanādare vibhāṣā’prāṇiṣu |2|3|17|
śyanā nirdeaśāditi | na ca manya iti yakā nirdeaśaḥ kiṃ na syāditi
vācyam, anabhihita ityadhikārāt| na hi yakā yoge anabhihitaṃ
karma saṃbhavati| śyannapi daivādikāradhātūpalakṣaṇamātraṃ, na tu svayaṃ
vivakṣitaḥ| tena ‘ṛṇāya matvā raghunandano’pi bāṇena rakṣaḥ
pradhanānnirāsthat’ iti bhaṭṭiprayogaḥ saṅgaccchate|
naukākānnaśukaśrṛgālavarjyeṣviti vācyam| naukākānneti|
vyavasthitavibhāṣā vijñātavyeti bhāvaḥ|
(517) gatyarthakarmaṇi dvitīyācaturthyau ceṣṭāyāmanadhvani |2|3|12|
gatyarthakarmaṇi| gatyartheti kim?| odanaṃ pacati| karmaṇīti kim?|
aśvena vrajati | ṭhanadhvani’ ityatrādhvanīti na svarūpagrahaṇam| tathā hi
sati ṭhanadhvanaḥ’ ityevā’vakṣyat| kiṃ tvarthagrahaṇaṃ, saptamīnirdeaśāt,
karmaṇītyanena sāmānādhikaraṇyāt | arthesyaiva hi karmatvaṃ saṃbhavati
na śabdasvarūpasya, tenā’dhvavacināṃ sarveṣāmeva niṣedhaḥ| tathā ca
vārtikam---adhvanyarthagrahaṇamiti| gantrādhiṣṭhita eveti|
ṭhāsthitapratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ’ iti vārtikāditi bhāvaḥ|
āsthitaḥ--saṃprāptaḥ| panthānāṃ gaccchatītyatra hi panthāḥ prāpta eveti na
pakṣe caturthī| yadā tvaprāptatvena vivakṣā tadā pakṣe bhavatyeva sā| iha
anadhvanītyapanīya ṭhasaṃprāpte’ iti pūryate| tena ‘triyaṃ gaccchatī’tyatra
strī prāptaiveti na caturthī| atra vyācakṣate--ṭhajāṃ nayati grāma’mityatra
tu na bhavatyeva caturthī, agatyarthatvāt| ākṣepādinā hyatra pratīyate
gatirna tvasau nayaterarthaḥ, prāpaṇavācitvāditi| ‘atyarthakarmaṇi
[caturthīṭ vā’ iti vaktavye dvitīyāgrahaṇamapavādaviṣaye’pi dvitīyā
yathā syādityetadarthaṃ, tena ‘rāmaṃ gante’ tyatra kṛdyogalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī na
bhavatīti vṛtikṛtoktam| iti caturthī|
(518) dhruvamapāye’pādānam |1|4|24|
dhruvamapāye| ‘hru gatisthairyayoḥ’ asmātpacādyaci kuṭāditvāniṅtve
uvaṅ | ‘hruva stherye’ iti kecit| tatra ṭhigupadha--’iti kaḥ| dhruvaṃ
sthiram | apāyaśabdena vivakṣitamāha--viśleṣa iti| evaṃ ca
prakṛtadhātvarthā’nāśrayatve sati tajjanyavibhāgāśrayo dhruvamiti
phalitam| taccā’rthādavadhirevetyāha--avadhibhūtamiti| dhāvata iti|
iha dhāvanakriyāviśiṣṭasyā’pyaśvasya prakṛtapatanadhātūpātakriyāṃ
pratyavadhitvaṃ na virudhyate, ‘arasparasmānmeṣāvapasarataḥ’ ityatra tu
sṛdhātunā gatidvayasyāpyupādānādekaniṣṭhāṃ gatiṃ prati
itarasyāpyapādānatvaṃ na virudhyate | uktaṃ ca hariṇā--ṭhapāye
yadudāsīnāṃ calaṃ vā yadi vā’calam|
dhruvamevā’tadāveśātadapādānamucyate | patato dhruva evāsvo
yasmādaśvātpatatyasau| tasyāpyaśvasya patena kuḍaḷadi dhruvamiṣyate |
meṣāntarakriyāpekṣamavadhitvaṃ pṛthakaṃ pṛthak | meṣayoḥ
svakriyāpekṣaṃ kartṛtvaṃ ca pṛthak pṛthak’|| iti|
‘arvatātpatato’śvātpatatī’tyatra tu parvatāvadhikapatanāśrayo
yo’śvastadavadhikaṃ devadatādiniṣṭhṃa patanamarthaḥ, pañcamyarthā’vadhau
abhedena saṃsarge prakṛtyarthaḥ paravatādirviśeṣaṇam, pratyayārthastu
patanakriyāyām, sa cā’vadhirūpo dharmī, na tu dharmamātram,
ṭhuddhṛtaudana sthālī’ tyātraudanakarmakoddharaṇāvadhibhūtā sthālīti
sāmānādhikaraṇyadarśamāt| etacca manoramāyāṃ sthitam| nanviha
dhruvagrahaṇaṃ kimartham?| na ca ‘rāmādāgaccchati śakaṭene’tyatra
śakaṭe’tivyāptivāraṇāya taditi vācyam, paratvātatra
karaṇasaṃjñāpravṛteḥ | na ca saṃjñinirdeaśārthaṃ dhruvagrahaṇam,
kārakā’dhikārāt kārakamiti labhyata iti dhruvagrahaṇaṃ
cintyaprayojanamiti cet| atra
vadanti--kārakatvarūpavyāpakadharmamātravivakṣāyāṃ sādhakatamatvena
vivakṣā’bhāvadaśāyāṃ karaṇasaṃjñāprasaṅgena śakaṭasyā’pādānatvaṃ
syātanmā bhūdityetadarthaṃ dhruvagrahaṇamiti|
jugupsāvirāmapramādārthānāsupasaṃkhyānam | jugupseti|
jugupsā-nindā, viramo viratiḥ, pramādo’navadhānatā,
etadarthakānāṃ dhātūnāṃ kārakamapādānasaṃjñaṃ syādityarthaḥ|
saṃyogapūrvako viśleṣo vibhāgaḥ, sa ceha nāsti, buddhikṛtastu
gauṇatvānneha gṛhyata iti sūtreṇā’prāptau vārtikārambhaḥ|
bhāṣyākārastu--kārakaprakaraṇe gauṇamukyanyāyo nāśrīyata iti
tamabgrahaṇena jñāpitatvājjugupsādīnāṃ
tatpūrvakanivṛtivācitvāmāśrityedaṃ vārtikaṃ,
‘hītrārthānām---’ityādi sūtrāṇi ca pratyācakhyau| pūrvaṃ hi
buddyā’pāyaṃ saṃprāpya tato doṣadarśanānnivartata ityastyevā’tra
buddhikṛto’pāyaḥ|
(519) bhītrārthānāṃ bhayahetuḥ |1|4|25|
bhītrā | ‘asya bibhyati devāśca jātaroṣasya saṃyuge’ iti rāmāyaṇe
tu ‘asye’ tyasya saṃyugenānvayānnāsti bhayahetutvamiti
ṣaṣṭhīprayogaḥ saṅgaccchata eva| na caivaṃ
saṃyugasyā’pādānatvāpatiriti vācyam| parayā adhikaraṇasaṃjñayā
apādānasaṃjñā[yāṭbādhāt| adhikaraṇatvā’vivakṣāyāṃ tu iṣṭāpateḥ|
bhītrārtheti kim?| vyāghraṃ paśyati | na ca karmatvena bādhaḥ śaṅkyaḥ,
karmatvā’vivakṣāyāṃ śeṣaṣaṣṭhaĀ bādhitvā pañcamī prasaṅgādityāhuḥ |
bhayatahetugrahaṇaṃ cintyaprayojanam, araṇye bibhetītyatra
paratvādadhikaraṇasaṃjñāpravṛteriti cet, atra
vadanti--bhayahetugrahaṇā’bhāve kārakaśeṣatvavivakṣāyāmatiprasaṅgaḥ
syāt| tathā ca ṭharaṇyasya corādbibhetī’ti prayogo na syāditi|
(520) parājerasoḍhaḥ |1|4|26|
parājeḥ | adhyayanāditi| adhyayanasaṃbandhinī glānirityarthaḥ|
kārakaśeṣatvena ṣaṣṭhaḷaṃ prāptāyāmi dam| parājayata iti|
ṭhviparābhyāṃ jeḥ’ iti taṅ| ṭhasoḍha’iti ktārtho bhūtakālo na
vivakṣitaḥ| tenā’dhyayanāt parājeṣyata ityādi siddham|

(521) vāraṇārthānāmīpsitaḥ |1|4|27|
vāraṇārthā| yavebhya iti| yavasaṃyogātprāgeva gāṃ nivārayatīti

buddhiparikalpitā’pāyamaṅgīkurvāto bhāṣyakārasya mate tu

‘ā’mityatra īpsitatvaprayuktā’pādānasaṃjñā na
bhavati|īpsitatamatvavivakṣāyāṃ paratvātkarmasaṃjñāpravṛteḥ|
nanvevamīpsitagrahaṇameva vyarthaṃ, kṣetre vārayatītyatra

padaprayojanasyehāpi kalpayituṃ śakyatvāt|
(522) antarddhau yenā’darśanamiccchati |1|4|28|
antardhau| yeneti kartari tṛtīyā| na ca kṛdyogaṣaṣṭhīprasaṅgaḥ,
ṭhubhayaprāptau karmaṇyeve ti niyamāt| atra hyātmana iti
gamyamānatvādastyubhayoḥ prāptiḥ| nilīyata iti| ‘iṅ śleṣaṇe’
daivādikaḥ| nanvantarddhāviti vyarthaṃ, ‘a didṛkṣate coro nityatra
paratvātkarmasaṃjñāsiddheḥ | atrāhuḥ--corāḥ ātmānaṃ mā drākṣuriti

(523) ākhyātopayoge |1|4|29|
ākhyātopa | nayamapūrvaketi| tatraivopayogaśabdo rūḍha iti bhāvaḥ|

(524) janikartuḥ prakṛtiḥ |1|4|30|
janikartuḥ| jananaṃ janiḥ--utpatiḥ| ṭhiñajādibhyaḥ’iti janerbhāve iñ|
‘anivadhyośca’iti vṛddhipratiṣedhaḥ| tasyāḥ karteti śeṣaṣaṣṭhaḷa
samāso, na tu kārakaṣaṣṭhaḷa,ṭhtṛtābhyām---’iti yathā|
tadetadāha--jāyamānasyeti| etena ṭhikśtipau dhātunirdeaśe’iti
ikā nirdeaśo’yaṃ janirityāśritya ‘amahana---’
ityupadhālopamarthā’saṅgatiṃ samāsānupapatiṃ codbhāvya
vyākaraṇādhikaraṇe jaranto mīmāṃsakāḥ samāhitā iti bhāvaḥ| iha
prakṛtigrahaṇaṃ hetumātraparamiti vṛtikṛnmatam, ‘utrāt pramodo
jāyate’ ityudāharaṇāt| upādānamātraparamiti tu bhāṣyakaiyaṭamataṃ,
tadubhayasādhāraṇamudāharaṇamāha--brahmaṇa iti| brahmāuhiraṇyagarbha-| sa ca
hetureva na tūpādānam| kiṃca māyopahitaṃ caitanyaṃ brahma, taddhi
sarvakāryopādānamiti vedāntasiddhāntaḥ|
(525) bhuvaḥ prabhavaḥ |1|4|31|
bhuvaḥ| bhuvanaṃ bhūriti| saṃpadāditvādbhāve kvip| pūrvasūtre
samāsanirddiṣṭamapi kartṛgrahaṇamanuvartate,
svaritatvādityāha---bhūkarturiti| prabhavatyasmāditi prabhavaḥ,
ṭhakartāri ca kārake’ ityadhikārādapādānārthe ṭhAñdorap’|
janikarturityeva siddhe nirarthakamidamityāśaṅkāṃ
pariharannāha--tatra prakāśata iti | prathamaṃ dṛśyata ityarthaḥ| eṣa cā’rtho
dhātūnāmanekārthatvāllabhyate| tathā cā’bhūtaprādurbhāvo janiḥ|
anyataḥ siddhasya prathamamupalambhaḥ prabhava ityarthabhedo’stīti bhāvaḥ|
‘hītrārthānām---’ ityārabhyeyaṃ saptasūtrī bhāṣye pratyākhyātā|
tatretthamupapatisaṃbhavaḥ---caurebhyo bibheti, bhayānnivartata ityarthaḥ|
trāyateurakṣaṇena caurebhyo nivartayatītyarthaḥ| parājayateuglānyā
nivartata ityarthaḥ| vārayati| pravṛtiṃ pratibandhannivartayatītyarthaḥ|
nilīyateunilayanena nivartata ityarthaḥ| adhīteuupadhyāyānniḥ sarantaṃ
śabdaṃ gṛṅṇātītyarthaḥ| brahmaṇaḥ prapañco jāyata ityatrāpi
tato’pakāmati| nirgaccchatītyarthaḥ| prabhavatītyatrāpi bhavanapūrvakaṃ
niḥsaraṇamarthaḥ| tathā ca ‘hruvamapāye---’
ityenenaiveṣṭerūpasiddhiriti| vastutastu
nivṛtinissaraṇādidhātvantarārthaviśiṣṭe sva#arthe vṛtimāśritya
yathākathaṃcudiktaprayāgāṇāṃ samarthane’pi mukhyārthapuraskāreṇa
ṣaṣṭhīprayogo durvāraḥ,--naṭasya śrṛṇotītivat| na
hyupadhyāyanaṭayoḥ kriyānukūlavyāpārāśe viśeṣo vaktuaṃ śakyaḥ|
anabhidhānabrahmāstramāśritya pratyākhyānaṃ tu nā’tīva manoramam| evaṃ
‘ugupsāvirāme’tyādivārtikamapyārambhaṇīyam| tathā ca
sūtravārtikamatameveha prabalam| tathā ‘hruvaṃ’ ‘hayahetuḥ’ ṭhasoḍhaḥ’
ityādisaṃjñinirdeaśo’pi sārthakaḥ| paratvātatatsaṃjñāprāptāvapi
śeṣatvavivakṣāyāṃ ‘a bhāṣāṇāmaśrīyāt’ ityādāviva ṣaṣṭhaḷa iṣṭatayā
tatrāpādānasaṃjñāyā vāraṇīyatvāt| etacca śabdakaustubhe spaṣṭam|
lyablope karmaṇyadhikaraṇe ca| lyablopa iti| lyabantasya
gamyamānārthatvalādaprayoga ityarthaḥ| lyabgrahaṇamiha lyabarthaparam|
tena ktvo’pi lope sidhyati| āsane sthitvā
prekṣate,----āsanātprekṣate,---āsanātprekṣate iti|
yataścā’dhvakālanirmāṇaṃ tatra pañcamī || yataśceti|
yadavadhitvenāśrityādvanaḥ kālasya vā nirmāṇaṃuparicchedaḥ pratipādyate
tataḥ pañcamītyarthaḥ | tena pañcamyantārthenārthadvārā
yuktānnirmīyamāṇādhvavācinaḥ prathamāsaptamyau staḥ|
kālātsaptamī ca vaktavyā| kālāditi| ihāpi tadyauktādityapekṣyate|

(535) ṣaṣṭhī śeṣe |2|3|50|

uktāḥ, tatra dvitīyādīnāṃ vidhānāt, ato prati

edhodakam|ṭhjātiraprāṇinām’ ityekavadbhāvaḥ| yadvā ca dakaṃ ceti
vigrahe pūrvavadekavadbhāvaḥ| yadvā edhāṃsi ca dakaṃ ceti vugrahe
pūrvavadekavadbhāvaḥ| udakaparyāyo dakaśabdo’pyasti| tathā ca
halāyudhaḥ---ṭhbhuvanamamṛtaṃ jīvanīyaṃ dakaṃ ce’ti| upaskurute iti|
gandhanādisūtreṇātmanepadam| ṭhupātpratiyatne’ti suṭ| nacaivaṃ
‘ño’vidarthasya karaṇe’, ṭhadhīgarthadayeśāṃ karmaṇi’, ‘ṛñaḥ
pratiyatne’, ṭhrujārthānāṃ bhāvavacanānāmajvareḥ’, ṭhāśiṣi nāthaḥ’,
‘āsimiprahaṇanāṭakrāthapiṣāṃ hiṃsāyām’,ṭhvyavahṛpaṇoḥ samarthayoḥ’,
‘ṛtvorthaprayoge kāle’dhikaraṇe’ iti
śeṣaṣaṣṭhīvidhānārtheyamaṣṭasūtrī niṣphalā syāditi vācyam, ‘arpiṣo
jñāna’mityādau tasyāḥ samāsanivṛtiphalakatvāt| tathā hi
‘ño’vidarthasya--’ ityādau ‘eṣe’ ityanuvartate, śeṣatvena vivakṣate

(543) āśiṣi nāthaḥ |2|3|55|
caurajvara iti| iha cauraśabdāt ṭhrujārthānām--’ iti ṣaṣṭhaḷa
apravṛtau ‘aṣṭhī śeṣe’ ityanena ṣaṣṭhaḷaṃ’ ṣaṣṭhīti samāso
bhavatyeveti bhāvaḥ| sarpiṣo nāthanamiti| sarpirme
bhūyādityāśāsanamityarthaḥ| māṇavakanāthanamiti| yadyapi
karmatvavivakṣāyāṃ ‘artṛkarmaṇoḥ’ iti yadā ṣaṣṭhī, tadā āśiṣyapi
samāso’styeva, tathāpi tatra ‘atikārakepapadātkṛt’ iti
kṛdutarapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ| samāsāntodātatvaṃ tu yācñādāveva na
tvāśiṣīti niṣkarṣa iti kaustubhe sthitam|
(544) jāsiniprahaṇanāṭakrāthapiṣāṃ hiṃsāyām |2|3|56|
jāsi| ‘asu tāḍane,’ ‘asu hiṃsāyām’ iti ca curādistasyedaṃ
grahaṇaṃ na tu daivādikasya ‘asu mokṣaṇe’ ityasya, jāsīti
nirdeaśāt, ṭhhiṃsāyām’ iti vacanācca| niprahaṇanamiti|
ṭhhanteratpūrvasya’iti ṇatvam| praṇīti| ‘ergada--’iti ṇatvam|
curādiriti| ‘aṭa nṛtau’ iti tu gṛhyate, dīrghanirdeaśāditi bhāvaḥ|
krāthanamiti| ‘ratha hiṃsāyām’iti ghaṭādau paṭhaḷte, tasya mitve’pi
iha nipātanādvṛddhiḥ| mitvaphalaṃ tu nipātanātparatvāt
‘iṇṇamuloḥ’ iti dīrghe caritārthamiti ghaṭādau vakṣyati| yatu
haradatenoktam---ṭhṭhghaṭādipāṭho ‘haṭādayaḥ
ṣitaḥ’ityātideśikaṣitve aṅyathā syādityetadartha’’iti| tanmandam|
‘haṭādayaḥ ṣitaḥ’ iti hi madhye sūtritam| tena pūrveṣāṃ
tvaratyantānāmeva ṣitvaṃ, na tu jvarā dīnāṃ pareṣāmiti| ataeva
‘varatyantāstrayodaśānudātetaḥ ṣitaśca’ iti ghaṭādau vakṣyati|
(545) vyavahṛpaṇoḥ samarthayoḥ |2|3|57|
paṇanamiti| ‘tutāveva’ iti vakṣyamāṇatvādāyasyā’bhāvaḥ|
brāhmaṇapaṇanamiti| ṭhāyādaya ārddhadhātuke vā’ ityāyasya vikalpaḥ|
(546) divastadarthasya |2|3|58|
divastada| taccchabdena vyavahṛpaṇau parāmṛśyete, tau ca dyaūte
krayavikrayavyavahāre ca tulyārthau pūrva’sūtre
gṛhītāvityāśayenāha---dyaūte iti| pūrvasūtre eva diveḥ pāṭhe
tadarthasyeti na kartavyamiti yadyapi lāghavaṃ, tatāvi yogāvibhāga
utarārthaḥ| karmaṇīti| iha śeṣa iti na sambadhyate, utarasūtre
vikalpārambhāsāmarthyāt| anyathā ṣaṣṭhaḷa vikalpitāyāṃ tayā mukte
śeṣe vibhaktyantarasyā’prāptyā vṛthaiva vikalpārambhaḥ syāditi bhāvaḥ|
anye tvāhuḥ--lāghavātpūrvasūtre eva divo grahaṇe kartavye
pṛthagyogakaraṇasāmarthyādatra śeṣa iti na sambadhyate| na
cotarārthatvāpṛthagyogasya noktārthajñāpakatvamiti vācyam|
saṅkoce mānā’bhāvena phaladvayasyāpi suvacatvāditi| śeṣa
ityasyā’sambandhādiha trisūtryaṃ tiṅntamudāharati--śatasya dīvyatīti|
(547) preṣyabruvorhaviṣo devatāsaṃpradāne |2|3|61|
preṣyabruvoḥ| iṣyatekdaivādikasya loṭo
madhyamapuruṣaikavacanaṃ---preṣyati| tatsāhacaryāddra virapi tathābhūta
eva gṛhyate| ata eveha śeṣagrahaṇaṃ na sambadhyate| tiṅntena saha
samāsasyā’prasaktatvāt| preṣyābruvoḥ kim?| agneya chāgasya
hahavirvapāṃ medo juhudhi| haviṣaḥ kim?| agnaye gomayāni
preṣya| devatā sampradāne kim?| māṇavakāya puroḍāśānpreṣya|
ṭhhaviṣaḥ prasthitatvena viśeṣaṇe pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ’| indrāgnibhyāṃ
chāgasya havirvapāṃ medaḥ preṣya|
(548) kṛtvo’rthaprayoge kāle’dhikaraṇe |2|3|64|

(549) kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti |2|3|65|
kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti| śeṣa iti nivṛtaṃ, ‘artari ca kṛti’ iti sūtre
kṛte cakāreṇa ṭhadhīgartha---’iti sūtrāt ‘aturthyarthe bahulaṃ cchandasi’
iti paryantamanuvartamānasya karmaṇītyasyānukarṣaṇasambhave’pi punaratra
karmagrahaṇāt| tasmāvdyākhyānamevātra śaraṇamityapare| kartṛkarmaṇoḥ
kim?| śastreṇa bhetā| kṛtiriti| karaṇaṃ kṛtiḥ| ‘triyāṃ ktin’|
kṛṣṇo’tra kartā| karmaṇyudāharati---jagata iti| kṛṣṇasya
tṛcā’bhihitatvātataḥ ṣaṣṭhī na bhavati| kṛti kimiti| nanviha
kartṛkarmabhyāṃ kriyā ākṣipyate, tadvācī tu dhātureva| dhātośca dvaye
pratyayāḥ, kṛtastiṅśca | tatra tiṅprayoge kaṭṃa karotītyādau ‘a
lokā---’iti pratiṣedhena bhāvyam| tataśca pariśeṣātkṛdyoge eva
ṣaṣṭhī bhaviṣyati, ta[smāṭtkiṃ kṛdgrahaṇeneti praśnaḥ| 
guṇakarmaṇi veṣyate| kṛtapūrvī kaṭamiti| atra
karotikriyāpekṣamanabhihitaṃ karmatvaṃ kaṭasyā’styeveti ṣaṣṭhī
syāt| taddhitādhikye tu sā mā bhūdityetadarthaṃ kṛdgrahaṇamiti
bhāvaḥ| nanu kṛtaḥ kaṭaḥ pūrvamanenetyasmin vigrahe ktasya karmaṇi
vidhānātenaivā’bhihitaṃ karmeti naiva dvitīyā prāpnoti, nāpi
tadapavādabhūtā ṣaṣṭhī, ihāpyanabhihitādhikārāt| kiñca kṛtaśabdasya
kaṭasāpekṣatayā samāso durlabha eva, evaṃ taddhito’pīti cet|
atrāhuḥ--pūrvaṃ kṛtamaneneti vigrahe avivakṣitakarmatayā bhāve
ktapratyaye kṛte kṛtaśabdasya kaṭasāpekṣatvā’bhāvātsamāsataddhitau bhavata
eva| tathāca ‘ṛpūrvī’tyayaṃ pūrvaṃ kṛtavān ityanena samānārthaḥ
sampadyate, guṇabhūtayāpi kriyayā kārakāṇāṃ sambandhasya kaṭṃa
kṛtavānityādau darśanādatrāpi karoti kriyāpekṣaṃ karmatvaṃ
kaṭasyābhyupagamyate| tacca karmatvaā na kenāpyabhihitam|bhāve ktasya,
kartari inipratyayasya ca vidhānāt| ato’sati kṛdgrahaṇe ṣaṣṭhī
syādeveti| evaṃ ca ṭhodanasya pācakatama’ityatra ṣaṣṭhaḷa asādhutve
iṣṭāpatireva śaraṇam| ‘ṛtapūrvī’tyatra samāsataddhitau bhavata
evetyuktam|tatra samāsaḥ ‘upsupā’ iti bodhyaḥ| taddhitastu
‘ūrvādiniḥ’ ‘apūrvācca’ iti kartari iniḥ, tadvidhau
‘rāddhamanena’iti sūtrādanenetyanuvṛteḥ| syādetat-bhiderṇyantāt
‘aryāyārhaṇotpatiṣu’iti ṇvuci ‘hedikā devadatasya yajñadatasya
kāṣṭhānā’mityubhāmyāmapyanena kṛdyogaṣaṣṭhī jāyate, tatra
mukhyā’mukhyasannidhau mukhyayasyaiva kārye
sampratyayātprayojakakartṛvācakādeva syāt| anyathā ‘ācayatyodanaṃ
devadatena yajñadata’ ityatra prayojyaprayojakayorubhayorapi
lakatāravācyatve ubhābhyāmapi kartṛvācakāṅyāṃ prathamā syāt|
maivaṃ| prayojyaprayojakavācakābhyāṃ bhedena ṣaṣṭhī jāyate na
tvekaiveti neha mukhyā’mukhyānyāyapravṛtiḥ| tatra tu
lakārasyaikatvātkartustadvācyatvakalpanāyāmuktanyāyaḥ pravartata iti
vaiṣamyāt| evaṃ casa ṭhodanaḥ pācyate devadatena
yajñadatene’tyādāvubhābhyamapi tṛtīyā syādeveti bodhyam| atra
vyācakṣate--ṭhtadarhami’ti nirdeaśātṭhkartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti’
ityetadanityam| tathācaṭhdhāyairāmodamutamam’ iti bhaṭṭiprayogaḥ
saṅgaccchati iti|
(550) ubhayaprāptau karmaṇi |2|3|66|
ubhayaprāptau| kṛtītyanuvartate|
tenānyapadārthatvādbahuvrīhirityāha--ubhayoḥ prāptiryasminniti|

kartṛkarmaṇoḥ prāptilābhādāścaryamidamodanasya pāko brāhmaṇānāṃ ca
prādurbhāva ityatra nāyaṃ niyamaḥ pravartate| tatpuruṣe tu
syādevā’trātiprasaṅga iti bhāvaḥ| pūrvasūtreṇaiva siddhe
niyamārthamidamiti dhvanayati---karmaṇyeveti| evaṃ ca kartari ṣaṣṭhī
pratiṣedo’sya sūtrasya phalaṃ, na tu karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhīvidhānamiti
sthitam|
strīpratyayayorakā’kārayornāyaṃ niyamaḥ| strīpratyayayoriti|
‘triyāṃ ktin’ ityadhikāre vihitayorityarthaḥ| nāyaṃ niyama iti|
ṭhakā’kārayoḥ prayoge karmaṇyeva ṣaṣṭhī na tu kartarī’ti yo niyama
uktaḥ sa na pravartate, kintu kartaryapi ṣaṣṭhī pravartata iti|
phalito’rthaḥ| kathaṃ tarhi ‘uṭtithoḥ’ iti sūtre ‘uṭāsīyuṭo
bādhona’ iti vṛtiḥ?| atrāhuḥ--kartuḥ karaṇatvavivakṣayā tṛtīyā
bodhyeti| bhediketi| bhedanaṃ bhedikā| ‘aryāyārhaṇotpatiṣu’iti
ṇvuc| ‘hātvarthanirdeaśe ṇvul vaktavyaḥ’ ityanena ṇvulityeke|
ṭhyuvoranākau’| striyāṃ ṭāpi ‘ratyayasthāt---’iti itvam|
bibhitseti| bhetumicchā| bhideḥ sani ṭhhalantācca iti
kitvādguṇā’bhāvaḥ| ṭha pratyayāt’ ityakārapratyaye ṭāp|
śeṣe vibhāṣā| śeṣe iti| akā’kārābhyāmanyasmin ktinādāvityarthaḥ|
kartari ṣaṣṭhīniṣedhaphalakasya ṭhubhayaprāptau’ iti sūtrasya, tatraiva
kartari ṣaṣṭhīsampādanaphalakasya ‘trīpratyayayorakā’kārayoḥ’ iti
vacanasya ca prāk sthitatvātkartaryeva vibhāṣā anena śeṣavacanena
kriyate, na tu karmaṇītyāśayenodāharati--jagataḥ kṛtirharerhariṇā
veti| aviśeṣeṇeti| akā’kārabhinne kṛnmātre ityarthaḥ|
anuśāsanamiti| anuśāsanamiti| anuśiṣyante asādhuśabdebhyaḥ
pravibhajya bodhyante yeneti karaṇe lyuṭ|
(551) ktasya ca vartamāne |2|3|67|

(552) na lokāvyayaniṣṭhākhalarthatṛnām |2|3|69|

(551) akenorbhaviṣyadādhamarṇyayoḥ |2|3|70|
akenoḥ | ādhamarṇye akasyā’sambhavāha---bhaviṣyatyakasyeti| inastu
ubhayoḥ sambhavādāha--bhaviṣyadādhamarṇyārthenaśca yoga iti| yathāsaṃkhyaṃ

vibhajya vyākhyānāt|iha bhaviṣyaditi svaryate, tena ‘haviṣyati
gamyādayaḥ’ityadhikāre vihitaḥ ‘umunṇvulau--’ iti ṇvuleva

yastu kālasāmānye ṭhṇvultṛcau--’iti ṇvuluktastara na niṣedhaḥ,
ṭhodanasya pācakaḥ’ ‘utrapautrāṇāṃ darśaka’itīti bhāvaḥ| vrajaṃ

kecidaṣṭādhyāyīgatā iti haradataḥ| nanu ‘atyarthakarmaṇi caturthī ca’
ityeva siddhe dvitīya grahaṇamapavādaviṣaye’pi dvitīyāpravṛtyarthamiti
vrajaṅghgamiti sidhyatyeveti cet, atrāhuḥ--ihaiva sūtre
grāmaṅgamīti bhāṣyodāharaṇātatsūtraṃ nāṅgīkriyate| tena grāmasya
ganteti ṣaṣṭhaḷeva sādhvī, na tu grāmaṃ gantiti dvitīyate |
śataṃdāyīti| ṭhāvaśyake’tyādharmaṇye ṇiniḥ|

(552) kṛtyānāṃ kartarivā |2|3|71|

(555) ādhāro’dhikaraṇam |1|4|45| 
ādhāraḥ| ādhriyate’sminnityādhāraḥ| ṭhadhyāyanyāya---’iti sūtre
ṭhavahārādhāre’ tyupasaṅkhyānādadhikaraṇe ghañ| sa cādhāraḥ
kasyetyākaṅkṣāyāṃ kārakādhikārātkriyāyā iti labhyate| iyaṃ ca
saṃjñā sākṣātkriyādhārayorna sambhavati, parābhyāṃ kartṛkarmasaṃjñābhyāṃ
bādhitatvāt| ato vyācaṣṭe--katṛkamadvāreti| evaṃ ca ‘hūtale
ghaṭa’ityādau astīti kriyādhyāhāro bodhyaḥ| tridheti| etacca
‘aṃhitāyām’ iti sūtre bhāṣye spaṣṭam| nadyamāsta ityādyarthaṃ
sāmīpikamadhikaraṇaṃ caturthamapi kecidiccchanti| kaṭe āste iti|
kartṛdvārā kriyādhārasyodāharaṇamidam| karmadvārā kriyādhārasya
tu---sthālyāṃ pacatīti| vaiṣayikādhāramudāharati---mokṣe
icchā’stīti| abhivyāpakasya tu---sarvasminniti| tileṣu
tailamityādyapyabhivyāpakasyodāharaṇamāhuḥ| catasra iti|
prātipadikārthamātra ityarthaḥ| dūrāntikārthebhya
ityasyehā’nuvartanādadhikaraṇe’pyete bodhyāḥ| ktasyenviṣasya
karmaṇyupasaṅkhyānam| ktasyenviṣayasyeti| inuinnantaḥ śabdo,
viṣayouvartabhūtamiryasya ktāntasya tasyetyarthaḥ| anye tvāhuḥ--ino
viṣaya iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| viṣayaśabdeneha prakṛtirucyate| ktāntasyenaḥ
prakṛtitvāditi| adhīti vyākaraṇe iti| bhāve ktapratakyaye tata
ṭhiṣṭādibhyaśca’ iti kartarīnau kṛte paścādguṇabhūtakriyayā
sambadhyamānaṃ vyākaraṇamanabhihitaṃ karmeti kṛtapūrvī
kaṭamitivavdditīyā’tra prāptā| ‘āsamadhīti vyākaraṇe’ ityādau
tvakarmakairdhātubhiriyoganimitasya kālakarmaṇo
bahiraṅgatvādihā’grahaṇamiti sapyamyabhāvaḥ| na caivaṃ tatra dvitīyāpi
na syāditi vācyam| lakṣyānurodhena dvitīyāvidhāne
vyaktipakṣāśrayaṇāt| etacca kostubhe sthitam|
sādhvasādhuprayoge ca| sādhvasādhuprayoge ca| yatrā’rcā na vivakṣitā,
kiṃ tu tatvakathanamātraṃ, tatrāpi saptamyartaṃ vārtike’smin
sādhugrahaṇaṃ, sādhurbhṛtyo rājñītyādi yathā|
‘ādhunipuṇābhyām’iti sūtre sādhugrahaṇaṃ tvarcāyāṃ vavakṣitāyāṃ
pratiyoge saptamīnivṛtyarthamiti vivekaḥ| 
nimitātkarmayoge| nimitamiha phalamiti| yadi tukāraṇamityucyeta
tarhi ‘āṅyena baddha’ ityādāvatiprasaṅgaḥ syāditi bhāvaḥ|
carmaṇīti| carmaṇīti| carmadvīpyādīnāṃ samavāyaḥ sambandhaḥ|
hetutṛtīyeti| tādarbhye caturthītyapi bodhyam| sīmā’nṇḍakośa
iti| tathā ca medinīkāraḥ--ṭhsīmā ghāṭasthitikṣetreṣvaṇḍakośu ca
striyām’ iti| ṭhatha puṣkalako gandhamṛge kṣapaṇakīlayoḥ’ iti ca|
haradatastu---ṭhpuṣkalakaḥ śaṅkuḥ, sīmniusīmajñānārthaṃ hatounihataḥ
nikhāta’ ityāha| asmiṃstu pakṣe sīmapuṣkalayoḥ saṃyogasambandhaḥ|
(556) yasya ca bhāvena bhāvalakṣaṇam |2|3|37|
yasya ca| nirjñātakālā hi kriyā anirjñātakālāyāḥ kriyāyāḥ
kālaparicchedakatvāllakṣaṇaṃ, tatra prasiddhakriyāśrayayoḥ
kartṛkarmaṇorvācakādbrāhmaṇādiśabdāllakṣyalakṣaṇabhāvasambandhe ṣaṣṭhaḷaṃ
prāptāṃyāmiyaṃ saptamī| lakṣaṇakatvamiha kriyāyāḥ sākṣāt, āśrayasya
tu brāhmaṇādeḥ kriyādvāreṇeti bodhyam| ‘rāhmaṇeṣvadhīyāneṣu gata’
iti kartṛryudāharaṇam| karmaṇyāha--goṣviti|
arhāṇāṃ kartṛtve’narhāṇāmakartṛtve tadvaivarītye ca|
arhāṇāmityādi| yasyāṃ kriyāyāṃ ye ucitāste arhāḥ| teṣāṃ
kartṛtve vivakṣite sati tatra saptamī vācyā| tathā yasyāṃ kriyāyāṃ
yeṣāṃ kartṛtvamanucitaṃ teṣāmakartṛtve vivakṣite ca saptamī
vācyā| tathā tadvaiparītyeuyeṣāṃ kartṛtvamucitaṃ teṣāmakartṛtve,
yeṣāṃ tu nocitaṃ teṣāṃ kartṛtve ca saptamī vācyetyarthaḥ|
ādyamudāharati---satsu taratsviti| santo hi taraṇakriyā’rhāḥ
kartarāścaṣa dvitīyamudāharati---asutsu tiṣṭhatsviti| atra
taraṇakriyāyāmasatāmanarhatvamakartṛtvaṃ ca tiṣṭhatsvityanena dyotyate|
tadvaiparītye prathamamudāharati-satsu tiṣṭhatsviti| satāṃ hi
taraṇamucitaṃ, teṣāṃ cā’rtṛtvaṃ tiṣṭhatsvityanena gamyate|
dvitīyamudāharati--asatsu taratsviṃti| asatāṃ hi taraṇamanucitaṃ,
teṣāṃ ca kartṛtvaṃ taratsu ityanena gamyate| yadyapīdaṃṭhyasya ca
bhāvena---’ityeva siddhaṃ, tathāpi lakṣya lakṣaṇabhāvā’vivakṣāyāṃ
saptamyarthamidamiti kaiyaṭādayaḥ| tatvatastu vyarthamevedamityanye| 
(557) ṣaṣṭhī cā’nādare |2|3|38|
ṣaṣṭhī cānādare| anādara iti| ṭhyasya ca bhāvena’ ityanena saptamī|
anādare sati yo bhāvaṃ lakṣayatīti| tadetphalitamāha anādarādhikya
iti| kevalabhāvalakṣaṇe saptamyeva, anādarādhikye tu
ṣaṣṭhīsaptamyāviti niṣkarṣaḥ|
(558) svāmīśvarādhipatidāyādasākṣipratibhūprasūtaiśca |2|3|39|
svāmīśvara| ‘vāmyarthe’ti vaktavye svāmyāditrayagrahaṇaṃ
paryāyāntaranivṛtyartham| ṭhvirūpāṇāmapi samānārthānām’
ityekaśeṣo’tra na bhavati, svarūpaparatvena samānārthakatvā’bhāvāt|
dāyāda iti| dāyamādate iti dāyādaḥ| sopasargādapyādantādata eva
nipātanātkaḥ| ‘avāṃ goṣu vā dāyāda’ ityatra yadyapi
gavābhityetatsamudāyasya viśeṣaṇaṃ, tathāpi dīyate’sau dāya iti
vyutpatyā avayavārthabhūtamaṃśaṃ spṛśatyeva, tathā cātra
gavātmakasyāṃ’śasya ādāteti phalitam|
(559)pañcamī vibhakte |2|3|42|

(560) sādhunipuṇabhyāmarcāyāṃ saptamyaprateḥ |2|3|43|

(561) prasitotsukābhyāṃ tṛtīyā ca |2|3|44|

(562) nakṣatre ca lupi |2|3|45|
nakṣatre ca lupi| lupśabdo’trārthaviśeṣe lākṣaṇika ityāśayenāha--yo
lupsaṃjñayetyādi| adhikaraṇa iti| etacca ‘aptamyadhikaraṇe ca’ ityato
maṇḍūakaplutyānuvartata iti bhāvaḥ| adhikaraṇe kim, mūlaṃ pratīkṣate,
mūlāya spṛhayati| mūleneti| ‘akṣatreṇa yuktaḥ kālaḥ’ ityaṇo
‘ubaviśeṣe’ iti lup| nakṣatra iti kim?| pañcāleṣu tiṣṭhati| iha
‘anapade lup’ ithi lup|
(563) saptamīpañcamyau kārakamadhye |2|3|7|

kāvādhvanorityanuvartate, tacca pañcamyā vipariṇamyate,

vibhaktyoryathāsaṃkhyaṃ na bhavatyasvaritatvāt| adya bhuktvā’yamiti|

śaktyāśrayaṃ dravyaṃ kārakamiti vyavahriyate, kiṃtu śaktireva| sā ca

cakātsaptamītyeko’rthaḥ| ṭhīśvara’ śabdo bhāvapradhānaḥ|

(565) vibhāṣā kṛñi |1|4|98|

madviniyokturīśraratvaṃ gamyate ithyarthaḥ| tiṅ codāteiti|
udātaviti tiṅ pire gatirmihanyata iti sūtrārthaḥ| atra kariṣyatīti
tiṅnta udātavān, ‘iṅṅtiṅḥ’ ithi nighātasya ‘ipātairyadyadi’
ityādinā niṣedhāt| nighāto neti| māmiti dvitīyā tu ‘armaṇi

vibhaktyarthāḥ|

 atha tiṅnte karmakartṛprakriyā|

karmaṇastviti| saukaryātiśayaṃ dyotayitumityanuṣahgaḥ| prāyeṇeti|
ye bhidiccchidiprabhṛtaya ekakarmakānte akarmakā ye tu dvikarmakāste
sakarmakā iti bhāvaḥ| akarmakatvasya phalamāha-- bhāve kartari ceti|
‘hāve cā’karmakebhya’ ityuktatvāditi bhāvaḥ| dvikarmakeṣu karmaṇaḥ
kartṛtvavivakṣāyāmudāharaṇam-- ‘athnāti sāgaro’mṛtaṃ’ ‘vayaṃ
pradugdhe’sya guṇairupasrutā vasūpamānasya vasūni medinī’ti|
‘radugdhe’ ityatra ‘armavatkarmaṇe’ ti prāptasya ‘akarmakāṇā’miti
niṣedhe duhipacyoriti pratiprasūtasya yako ‘a duhasnunamā’miti
niṣedhaḥ| uktaprayogānurodhāddvakarmakeṣu gauṇasyaiva karmaṇaḥ
kartṛtvavivakṣā na mukhyasyetyāhuḥ| taccintyam| ṭhajāṃ grāmaṃ
nayatī’tyatra mukhyakarma ṇaḥ kartṛtvavivakṣādarśanāt|
atredamavadhyam--adikaraṇatvā’vivakṣāyāṃ vrajo gauṇakarmeti ṭhruṇiddhi
vrajo gāṃ svayameve’ti bhavati| yadā tu vrajasya na karmatvaṃ tadā
mukhyakarmaṇo’pi kartṛtvavivakṣā bhavati| rudhyate vraje gauḥ
svayameveti| tathā gorapādānatvavivakṣāyāṃ gaurduhyate payaḥ
svayamevetyādi|

(485) karmavatkarmaṇā tulyakriyaḥ |3|1|87|
karmavatkarmaṇā| vatkaraṇaṃ kimartham ?| yathā abrahmadate prayujyamāno
brahmadataśabdaḥ brahmadatavadityarthaṃ vadati tathā karmetyucyamāne’pi
karmavadityarthalābhāt| satyam| karmaṇā tulyakriyaḥ kartā
karmetyucyamane karmasaṃjñaka ityarthaḥ syāt| tathā hi sati
akarmakavyapadeśā’bhāvādbhāve lakāro na syāt-- kiṃ tu karmaṇi
syāt-- ‘acyate odanaḥ bhidyate kāṣṭha’miti| yadyapyayaṃ prayogaḥ
siddhānte iṣṭa eva tathāpi ‘acyate odanena, bhidyate kāṣṭhene’ti
bhāve na syāditi bodhyam| karmaśabdenā’tra karmasthakriyā lakṣyata
ityāha-- karmasthayeti| karmakārakasthayetyarthaḥ| ‘artari śa’bityataḥ
kartarītyanuvartya prathamayā vipariṇamyate| saca viśeṣyastadāha--
tulyakriyaḥ| karteti| kāryātiśedho’yamiti| yadyapi śāstrātideśe’pi
lakṣyaṃ sidhyati tathāpi śāstrasyāpi kāryārthatayā
mukhyatvātkāryātideśa evāśritaḥ| bhāve lakāre iti| tatra
karturanabhihitatvāditi bhāvaḥ| dvilakārakāditi| ṭhvyatyayo
bahulalaÄ-lliḍaḷaśiṣya’ kṅiti saṃhitayā pāṭhe’nusvārasya
parasavarṇena jāte lakāre tasyopari ladvayamityarthaḥ| tena
‘akāravācyaḥ kartā tatraiva karmavatvamiti vyutpādanasya phalamāha-- ata
eveti| na bhavantīti| lakāreṇaiva karmakarturupasthānātkṛtyādīnāṃ
prasaktirnāsti, uktārthānāmaprayogāt| lavidheḥ pūrvaṃ tu sutarāṃ
nāsti, lakāropasthāpyakarturabhāvena karmatvā’bhāvāditi bhāvaḥ|
atredaṃ bodhyaṃ--- ‘ṛtyaktakhalarthā’ ityatra ktagrahaṇaṃ tyuktamucitaṃ , tasya

svayameve’ti| nanu ‘atyarthā’karmake’tyatrā’vivakṣitakarmāṇo’karmakā
iti na gṛhyante, datavān pakvavānityarthe dataḥ pakva ityāpateriti
cet| atrāhuḥ-- ‘inotergrāsakarkartṛkasye’ti niṣṭhātakārasya
nakāravidhānasāmarthyādavivakṣitakarmāṇo’pi kvacidgṛhyante| anyathā
niṣṭhātakārastatra na labhyeta, tena ‘ino grāsaḥ svayameva, ‘hinnaḥ
kusūlaḥ svayameve’tyādi saṅgaccchate iti| atra
kecidvadantilakāravācyasyaiva kartuḥ karmavatve ‘armavatkarmaṇe’tyatra
vadgrahaṇaṃ vyartham| na ca kartuḥ karmasaṃjñāyāṃ bhave lakāro na
syādityuktamiti vācyaṃ, karmaṇaḥ kartṛtvavivakṣāyāṃ dhāturakarmaka
ityakarmakātkartarīva bhāve lakārasya nirbādhatvāt| lakāravāttyasya
karmasaṃjñāyāmapi kevalakartustadanabhyupagamāt| na hi bhāve lakāraḥ
kartāraṃ vakti| na ca vatkaraṇā’bhāve kartuḥ karmasaṃjñāyāṃ
kartṛvyapadeśā’bhāvānnamate daṇḍa ityatra ‘a duhasrunamā’miti yako
niṣedhe’pi śabna syāt, vatkaraṇe kṛte tu kartṛkāryamapi syāditi
vācyam, ekasaṃjñādhikārādanyatra saṃjñādvayasamāveśādiṣṭasiddheriti|
na tu tatulyeti| tulyatvaṃ hi sādṛśyam| tacca bhedanibandhanam, naca

syāt, tanmābhūdityathaḥ| naca karmatvā’vasthāyāṃ viklityādiriva karaṇatvādyavasthāyāmapi sthālyā vyāpāro vastutaḥ sannapi dhātunā nopāta iti kathamatiprasaṅga iti vācyaṃ, sādṛśyapratiyogikriyāyā kathaṃ jñātavyā ityata āha-- yatra rmaṇīti| grāmeṣviti| ārūḍhā’nārūḍhahastiṣu adhigatānadhigataśāstrārtheṣvityādāvapi valakṣaṇyaṃ nolabhyata iti bodhyam| kāriṣyate iti| ‘yasicsīyu’ḍiti vaikalpakaściṇvadiṭ| pakṣe ṭhṛddhanoḥ sye’ itīṭ| kariṣyate| evaṃ lṛṅ ikāriṣyata| sicaściṇvadiṭi-- akāriṣṭa| pakṣe akṛta| sīyuṭaściṇvadiṭi--kāriṣīṣṭa| pakṣe--kṛṣīṣṭa| tāsi tu kāritā kartā| yakciṇostu kriyate ghaṭaḥ svayameva, akārītyādi| naitatsidhyediti| ‘armavatkarmaṇe’ti karmavatvaṃ na sidhyedityarthaḥ| etena pacati pākaṃ karotīti vivakaraṇādākhyātasya yatne śaktirita naiyāyikoktiḥ pārastā| karoteryatnārthatve tu yatate iti vatsarmakatāpi na syāditi| eteneti| jñānasay kartṛsthatvābhyupagamenetyarthaḥ| yagabhāvāditi| sati tu yakyanuvyavasīyamāna iti syāditi bhāvaḥ| ollopa iti| ṭhotaḥ śyanī’tyanena| nanu karmavatvā’bhāve kathamiha śānajityata āha--tācchīlyādāviti| na tviti| śānajña bhavatītyarthaḥ| ‘evadatayajñadatāvanyonyaṃ spṛśata’ ityatra tayoreva karmatvaṃ kartṛtvaṃ cāstīti karmasthakriyāyāḥ kartṛsthatvātkarmavadbhāvaprāptimāśaṅkyāha-- sakarmakāṇāmiti| na cā’tra ‘evadato yajñadataṃ spṛśati, yajñadatastudevadata’miti kriyābhedo’vaśyamāśrayitavyaḥ| tathā ca svaniṣṭhāṃ kriyāṃ prati kartṛtvam, itarakriyā prati tu karmatvaṃ bhavati| anyathā dvayorapi kartṛtvameva syātṭhimau gaṅgāṃ spṛśata’ ityatra yathā| evaṃ ca karmasthakriyāyāḥ kartṛsthatvā’bhāvātkarmavadbhāvo na prāpnoti| na ca saṃyogasya dviṣṭhatvātkarmasthaphalasya kartṛsthatvā’ccāstyeveti śaṅkyaṃ, tatannirūpitasaṃyogasya bhinnatvāt| anyathā phalavyāpārayorekāśrayatve sakarmakatvameva na labhyet| kiṃca ruhigamyoḥ kartṛsthakriyatvādārohate hastī, gaccchati grāma ityatra karmavadbhāvo neti bhāṣyakaiyaṭādisaṃmatam| tathāca saṃyogarūpaphalasya sarvatra tulayatayā ruhigamibhyāṃ spṛśervaiṣamyaṃ durupapādamiti nā’trakarmavatvaprasaktirityudāhaṇāntaramāha-- ajā grāmaṃ nayatīti| iha pratiṣedhā’bhāve yak syāt, kriyāphalasyā’kartagāmitve’pyātmanepadaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ| nanvihāpi karmaṇi kriyākṛto viśeṣo nopalabhyata iti karmasthakriyatvaṃ durupapādamiti cet| atrāhuḥ-- kriyākṛtaviśeṣopalambhā’nupalambhavaduddeśyatā’pi niyāmikā| yatra kramasthāṃ’śasyoddeśayatā sā karmasthakriyā, yatra tu vyāpārāṃ’śasyasā kartṛstheti| tathā hi--darśanārohaṇābhyāṃ viṣaye nyagbhūteca viśeṣānupalambhātkartṛsthatā| uddeśānurodhācca ahaṃ paśyeyamityuddeśo, na tvayaṃ viṣayo bhavatviti| evamahamuparigaccheyamityuddeśo na tu hastano nyagbhāvo bhavatviti| ūrdhvadeśasaṃyogānukūlavyāpāraviśeṣa uparigamanaṃ, tadeva ruherartho na tu nyagbhāvamātram| vṛkṣasyaśākhāṃ hastābhyāmavanamayatyapi bhūmiṣṭhe pura#uṣa ārohatītyaprayogāt| ataeva hi ṭhyaddhituparaṃ cchandasī’tyatra bhāṣyaṃ ṭhruhirgatyartha’ iti| ata eva cārohanti hastinaṃ hastipakāstānārohayati mahāmāt ityādiprogeṣvaṇau karturṇau kmatvaṃ saṅgaccchate| pacibhidyostu viklitirdvidhābhavanarūpo viśeṣaḥ karmaṇi dṛṣṭastaduddeśenaiva kārakavyāpāra iti karmasthakriyatvātpacyate odanaḥ, bhidyate kāṣṭhamityatra karmavadbhāvo bhavatyeva| ajā grāmaṃ nayatītyatrāpi karmasthāṃ’śasya saṃyogasyoddeśyatā, na tu vyāpārāṃśasyeti karmavadbhāve prāpte pratiṣedho’yamāvaśyaka iti dik|

(487) acaḥ karmakartari |3|1|62|

dvikarmakeṣu paceraprāmāṇikaḥ pāṭha iti ye vadantiteṣāmayaṃ granthaḥ
kathaṃ saṅgaccchata iti cet| atrāhuḥ-- ṭhudumbaraḥ phalaṃ pacatī’tyatra
‘armavatkarmaṇe’tyasyā’prāptau ‘uhipacyo’rityanena karmavadbhāvo
bahulaṃ vidhīyate sṛjiyujyoriveti na kāpyanupapatariti| 
|sṛjiyujyoḥ śyaṃstu| śyano nitvamādyaudātārtham| yaki tu
‘āsyanudāte’dityādinā lasārvadhātukānudātatve kṛte yaka

| bhūṣāmakarmeti| karmaśabdaḥ kriyāvācītyāha-- bhūṣāvācināmiti|
anyatreti| ātmanepadādanyasya niṣedha ātmanepadameva

(489) tapastapaḥ karmakasyaiva |3|1|88|
atapteti| tapastāpasa ityanuṣajyate| na duhasnu| nanu
dogdhiparthāyatvena srauterapi dvikarmakatvādgorūpakarmaṇaḥ
kartṛtvavivakṣāyāmapi payorūpakarmaṇo vidyamānatvātsakarmakāṇāṃ
pratiṣedhena yakciṇoḥ prāptireva nāstīti cet| atrāhuḥ--
vatsādiyogena kṣīraprasravaṇānukūlā utkaṇṭhā snudhātorarthaḥ| sā ca

ciṇi pratiṣiddhe ṭhṇiśrī’ti caṅ| 
| ṇiśranthigranthibrūñātmanepadā’karmakāṇāmupasaṅkhyānam|

yo’karmakastamudāharati-- vikurvate saindhavā iti| kuṣirañjoḥ|

girāpadasthāna eva yathā bhavatyevamihāpi yakaḥ pratiṣedaṃ kṛtvā
vidhīyamānaḥ śyan tadīyasthāna eva bhavatyato vyācaṣṭe--- yagaviṣaye
tu nāsyeti| śyanā sanniyogaśiṣṭaṃ parasmaipadaṃśyanabhāve na

kaiyaṭādau|
