(540) dhātoḥ |3|1|91|
dhātoḥ| nanu tiṅnirūpaṇātprāgeva ‘pṛśo’nudake kvin’
ṭhṛtvidgadhṛ’gityādinā kvinnādinirūpaṇaṃ kṛtamiti kathamiyaṃ
bhavaduktasaṅgatiḥ saṅgaccchata iticet| atrāhuḥ-- kvinnādinirūpaṇasya
tatra prāsaṅgikatvāt, prādhānyena ca kṛtāmatraiva
nirūpaṇānnoktaśaṅkāvakāśaiti| yadyapi ‘hātorekāco halāde’riti
sūtrāddhātorityanuvartata eva tathāpi ārddhātukasaṃjñāyā
āśritaśabdavyāpāratvalābhāya punardhātoriti grahaṇaṃ kṛtam| anyathā
ṭhārddhadhātukaṃ śeṣaḥ’ ityanena tiṅśidbhinnasya
dhātorvihitapratyayamātrasyārddhadhātukasaṃjñāyāṃ lūbhyāṃ
pūbhyāmityādāviḍguṇo syātāṃ, dhātorvihitatvena
byāmāderārddhadhātukatvāt, punardhātugrahaṇe kṛte tu tavyatavyādaya
iva dhātorityavamavidhānādbhyāmāderārddhadhātukatvaṃ neti dik|
‘rāglādeśāddhātvadhikāraḥ’ iti pakṣo’yukta ityāśayenāha--
ātṛtīyasamāpteriti| tṛtīyādhyāyasamāptiparyantamityarthaḥ|
‘rāglādeśā’diti pakṣe tu ‘ihśitsārvadhātuka’mityatra
dhātorityadhikārā’bhāvāt śitpratyayamātrasya sārvadhātukatvena
śaso’pi sārvadhātukatve ‘ārvadhātukamapi’diti ṅtve ci
harīnityādau ‘herṅtī’ iti guṇaḥ syāditi jñeyam| syādetat---
dhātorlakāre sati tasmin parato nityatvātkariṣyatītyādau
prathamaṃ syapratyayapravṛtau tibādyaprasaṅgaḥ, yatra tu tibādyāśrayo
vikaraṇastatraiva vyavadhānā’bhāvādbhavatityādau tibādayaḥ syuriti
cet| maivam| ṭhvikaraṇebhyo niyamo balīyā’ niti svīkārāt|
athavā vihitaviśeṣaṇāśrayaṇena dhātorvihitasya lasyeti
vyākhyānādiṣṭasiddheḥ| nanvevaṃ vihitaviśeṣaṇāśrayaṇe ṭhvidlṛ
lābhe’ ityasmāddhātorvihitasya laṭaḥ śabvikaraṇavyavāye’pi ṭhvido
laṭo vā’ iti ṇalādayaḥ syuriti cet| atrāha haradataḥ-- dhātunā’tra
vihitaṃ viśeṣyate, vidanā tvānantaryamiti| tathā cāyamarthaḥ
saṃpadyate --dhātorvihitasya vido’nantarasya laṭo ṇalādaya
ityabyupagamādvetereva vihitasya laṭo ṇalādayo bhavanti na tu
vidanterlaḍiti dik|
vidheyā’nirdeaśātsvaritatvāccādhikārasūtramidamityāha---adhikāro’yamiti| tatropapadamityādi| etena kṛtsaṃjñopapadasaṃjñayoriha vidhānasauṣṭhavāya dvitīyo dhātvadhikāra āvaśyaka iti dhvanitam| ayaṃ bhāvaḥ-- yadi dvitīyadhātvadhikāro na syātadā pūrvadhātvadhikāre’pi kṛdupapadasaṃjñe syātām| iṣṭāpatau tu saptamīnirdiṣṭamātrasyopapadatvena ‘li luṅī’ tyādau luṅnta#e upapade clirityavamaniṣṭo’rthaḥ prasajyeta| tiṅbinnadhātvadhikārapratyayasya kṛtsaṃjñāyāṃ kariṣyatītyādau syapratyayasya kṛtvena ‘ṛtaddhite’ tiprāpatipadikatvādautsargikamekavacanamiti sarvasaṃmatatvena supratyayaprasaṅgācca, tasmādadhikāraviśeṣe anayoḥ saṃjñayorvidhānārthamayamadhikāra iti| 

(541) vā’sarūpo’striyām |3|1|94|
vāsarūpo [’striyāmṭ| apavādena nityaṃ bādhe prāpte
kvacidupasargasyāpi pravṛtyarthamidaṃ sūtram| ataeva ṭhaco yat’ ,
ṭhṛhalorṇyat’ ityādyapavādaviṣayetavyadādayo’pi
prayujyante--bhavyam, bhavitavyam| kāryaṃ, kartavyaṃ,karaṇīyam|
vācyam, vaktavyamityādi| paribhāṣeti| adhikārasūtramiti| svīkṛte
tu stryadhikāreṇa vicchedādvāsarūpasūtrā’pravṛtyā ṭhāsitvā bhuṅkte’
ṭhāsyate bhoktu’mityādirūpāṇi na sidhyanti| iha hi
bhojanārthatvādāsanasya pūrvakālatā gamyate, ktvāpratyayaśca
tumarthādhikārādbhāve bhavati, lakāro’pi tatraiveti
samānaviṣayatvādubhayorbādhyabādhakabhāvaḥ syāt| kiṃca varṇātkāra
ityutsargaḥ, saca ṭhrādiphaḥ’ ityanena bādhyeta| na ceṣṭāpatiḥ|
‘akārādīni nāmāni śṛṇvato mama pārvati’
ityādiprayogavirodhāt| amumevārthaṃ manasi nidhāya haradatādibhiḥ
paribhāṣeyamityuktam| etena ‘aki lih ce’ti
jñāpakādvāsarūpavidheranityatvena stryadhikārādutareṣu
ktalyuṭtumunkhalartheṣu vāsarūpavidhirnāstīti siddhāntaḥ saṅgaccchata
iti dik| ṭhvāsarūpe’ tyatrā’sarūpa iti cchedaḥ| anyathā
lāghaveviśeṣā’bhāvenā’saṃdehāya ‘arūpo ve’ti
brūyādityāśayenāha--asarūpaiti| asarūpa iti kim ?| ‘armaṇyaṇ’
ityusargaḥ| ṭhāto’nupasarge kaḥ’ ityapavādaḥ| sa tūtsargasya nityaṃ
bādhako yathā syāt| godaḥ| kambaladaḥ| na ca kṛte’pyasarūpagrahaṇe
aṇkayorapyasarūpatvānneṣṭasiddhiriti vācyaṃ,
‘ā’nubandhakṛtamasārūpya’miti siddhāntāt| ṭhastriyā’mityatra
strīśabdaḥ svaryate| svaritena cādhikārāvagatirityāśayenāha--
stryadikāroktaṃ vineti| tena ‘triyāṃ ktin’ ityutsargam apratyayā’
dityapavādo nityaṃ bādhate| cikīrṣā| jihīrṣā| nanvastriyāmityatra
strīśabdasya svaritatvaṃ pratijñāya
svaritenā’dhikārāvagatirityādivyākhyāṃ vihāya
striyāmabhidheyāyāṃ vāsarūpavidhirneti, striyāmityevaṃ śabdamuccārya
vihite vāsarūpavidhirneti vā vyākhyāyatāmiticet| atrāhuḥ--
‘triyāṃ vācyāyā’miti pakṣe lavyā lavitavyeti yato viṣaye tavyo
na syāt, dvayorapi iha strīvācakatvāt| ‘triyā’miti
śabdoccāraṇapakṣe tu vyāvakrośī vyāvakruṣṭiriti karmavyatihāre
ṇaco viṣaye ktin syāt| dvayorapi striyāmityuccārya vidhānāt|
tataśca ‘tryadhikāroktaṃ vine’ti vyākhyaiva jyāsīti dik|

(542) kṛtyāḥ |3|1|95|

(546) ṇervibhāṣā |8|4|30| 
prayāpaṇīyamiti| yā prāpaṇe| ṇici ṭhartihrī’ ti puk|
ṭhṇeraniṭī’tiṇilopaḥ| prayāpyamāṇamiti| yāterṇaici puki ṇyantasya
dhātutvena vartamāne karmaṇi laṭi laṭaḥ śānac| tasya śitvena
‘iṅśi’diti sārvadhātukatve ‘ārvadhātuke yak’ ityanena yaki
kṛte ṭhṇeraniṭi’ iti ṇilope ṭhāne mu’giti mugāgame ṇatve ca
sidhyati rūpam| vihitaviśeṣa’ṇā’karaṇe tu yakā vyavadhānena
ṇyantātparatvā’bhāvānna sidhyati| na cā’ḍvyavāye’pīti bhaviṣyatīti
vācyaṃ, raṣābhyāṃ parasay nasyetyaṃśe tasmāditi nirdiṣṭaparibhāṣayā
prāpitasyā’vyavadhānasya rāmāṇāmityādisiddhaye ṭhvyavāye’pī’ti
yogavibhāgena bādhesati ādarśenetyādāvatiprasaṅge
prāpte--aṭkupvāṅtyiṃśo niyamārthaḥ| āḍgrahaṇaṃ tu
padavyavāye’pīti niṣedhaṃ bādhitumiti sthitam| ṭhṇervibhāṣā’ ityatra
tu ṇyantakṛtoravyavadhānasyā’pekṣā kathamaḍgrahaṇena nivāryeteti
bhāvaḥ|

(548) ijādeḥ sanumaḥ |8|4|32|
ijādeḥ sanumaḥ| ‘ṛtyacaḥ’ ityeva siddhe niyamārthamidamityāha--
sanumaścedityādi| iha ṭhhala’ ityanuvṛtaṃ tadantaparaṃ na tu
tadādiparam| ijāderhalāditvā’saṃbhavāt| tadāha--- halantāditi|
vihita iti| yadi tu vihitaviśeṣaṇaṃ na vyākhyāyeta tarhi
niyamārthatā na labhyet, ṇijantādvihitasyāpi kṛtasthanakārasya
ṇilope kṛte halantātparatvena ṭhṇervibhāṣe’ti vikalpaṃ bādhituṃ
vidheḥ saṃbhavāt| iṣṭāpatau tu aṇijantaprakṛtikā’nīyarpratyayāntaṃ
preṅkhaṇīyamityādyaudāharaṇaṃ na syāt, kiṃ tu
ṇijantaprakṛtikamevodāharaṇaṃ syāt| kiṃ asya sūtrasya
niyamārthatvā’bhāvātpramaṅganīyamityatra ‘ṛtyacaḥ’ ityanena ṇatvaṃ
syāt, ato vihitaviśeṣaṇamavaśyaṃ svīkāryamiti dik|
nanvevamapi niyamārthatā na yujyate| prenvanamityatra
vidhyarthatvasaṃbhavāt, numnakāreṇa vyavadhānāt ‘ṛtyacaḥ’
ityasyā’prāpterityata āha---numgrahaṇamiti| ṭhaṭuakupvāṅ’iti sūtra
ivā’trāpi numā’nusvāro lakṣyata eti vidhyarthatvamiha na
śaṅkanīyamiti bhāvaḥ| prombhaṇamiti| umbha pūraṇa ityasmādbhāve
lyuṭ| ‘ṛtyacaḥra’ ityato’nuvartanādāha--

(551) aco yat |3|1|97|
aco yat| dhātoriti vartate| ajgrahaṇaṃ ca dhātorviśeṣaṇaṃ,
viśeṣaṇena tadantavidhistadāha--ajantāditi| śakyamakartumiti| atra
kecidajgrahaṇamajantabhūtapūrvādapi yathā syādityevamarthapekṣitam|
tena ditsyaṃ dhitsyamitra yati kṛte ṭhyato’nāvaḥ’ ityādyaudātatvaṃ
sidhyati, ṇyati kṛtetu ‘itsvaritam’ iti prasajyeta| na ca ditsyaṃ
dhitsyamityatra ṭhṛhaloḥ’ iti ṇyataḥ prasaktireva nāstīti vācyam,
ārddhadātukavivakṣāyāmeva ato lope kṛte halantatvena
tatsaṃbhavādityāhustadāpātataḥ| ārddhadhātuke vivakṣite yadyato lopaḥ
syātadā hīdaṃ saṃbhavet| lopastu ārddhadhātuke para evocitaḥ|
anyathā paranimitatvā’bhāvena sthānavatvā’bhāve
gaṇayatītyādāvupadhāvṛddhiprasaṅgāditi bhāvaḥ| supaṭhatvāditi| dvaye
dhātavo’jantā halantāśca| tatra halantāṇṇyantaṃ vakṣyatīti
pariśeṣādajtādeva yadbhaviṣyatīti bhāvaḥ| takiśasīti| taka
hasane| śasu hiṃsāyām| cate yācane| yatu kecicchṃasīti
sānusvāraṃ paṭhanti tadupekṣyam, ṭhīḍavandavṛśaṃsaduhāṃ ṇyata’ iti
sūtrā’virodhena śaṃserṇyata eva svīkartavyatvāt| 

(552) īdyati |6|4|65|
| hano vā yadvadhaśca vaktavyaḥ| hano vā yaditi| hantervā yatsyāt|
yatsaṃniyogena vadhādeśastu nitya eva| yadyapi vadhamarhatīti vadhya iti
‘īrṣacchedādyacce’tyato yadityanuvartamāne ‘aṇḍādibhyaḥ’ iti
taddhitena yatā’pi sidhyati tathāpyasivadhyo musalavadhya iti samāso
na sidhyet| kṛti punaḥ ‘artṛkaraṇe kṛtā’ iti sidhyati| na
cāsivadhamarhatīti vigrahe kṛtasamāsādeva taddhito’stviti vācyam|
daṇḍādiṣu kevalasya vadhaśabdasya pāṭhātpratyayavidhau tadantavideśca
pratiṣedhāt, svare bhedācca| asivadhaśabdādyati hi sati
‘itsvarita’miti svaritaḥ prasajyeta| kṛdantena samāse tu
kṛdutarapadaprakṛtisvareṇa vadhyaśabda ādyaudātaḥ| ataeva vadhyaśabdena
taddhitāntena saha supsupeti samāsa ityapi na vācyam,
antodātatvaprasaṅgāditi dik| ghātya iti| ṭhhanasto’ciṇṇaloḥ’
iti tatvam| ṭhho hanteḥ’ iti kutvam|

(573) padā’svairibāhyāpakṣyeṣu ca |3|1|119|
padāsvairi| eṣvartheṣu graheḥ kyap syāt| avagṛhyamiti| yas
padasyā’vagrahaḥ kriyate tatpadam| avagraho u vicchedaḥ|
avāntarapadasaṃjñāṃ sūcayituṃ pāṭhakāle kiṃcitkālamavasanām|
pragṛhyamiti| yasya pragrahastatpadam| pragrahastu prakṛtibhāvāt
yaṇādyabhāve parasparamacorasannakarṣaḥ| ṭhyasya pragṛhyasaṃjñā vihitā
tatpragṛhya’miti vṛtiḥ| yadpi padāvayavasya dvivacanādeḥ pragṛhyasaṃjñā
na tu padasya, tathāpyavayavadharmasya samudāye upacāro bodhyaḥ|
avagṛhyapragṛhyaśabdau prātiśākhyādiṣu padaviśeṣaparatayā nirūḍhāṬ|
asvairīti| svena īrituṃ śīlamasya svairī u svatantraḥ|
‘vādīreriṇoḥ’ iti vṛddhiḥ| nañpūrvastu asvairī| gṛhyakā iti|
ṭhanukampāyā’miti kan| gṛhāsaktāḥ pakṣamṛgāśchekāste gṛhyakāśca te’
ityabharaḥ| vibhāṣā kṛ| karoteḥ kyapyaprāpte, vṛṣestu
ṛdupadhatvānnityaṃ prāpte’yamārambhaḥ| 

(574) yugyaṃ ca patre |3|1|121|
patraṃ vāhanamiti| patantyanenetyarthe ‘āmnīśase’tyādanā karaṇe
ṣṭran| yugyo gauriti| yadyapi ‘advahati rathayugaprāsaṅga’miti
taddhitayatā’pi idaṃ sidhyati tathāpi ṇyataṃ vyāvartayitumidaṃ sūtram|
anyathā hi yogyo gauriti syāt| anye tvāhuḥ-- yugyo hastīti
hi vṛtāvudāhṛtaṃ,tatu taddhitena na sidhyati| na hi hastīyugaṃ
vahati| kṛtā tu sidhyati| yujyate saṃbadhte hyasau kuthādineti|
tataścātra vaiyarthyaśaṅkaiva nāstīti dik| 

(574) amāvasyadanyatarasyām |3|1|122|
vṛddhau satyāmiti| tena ṭhamāvāsyāyā ve’ti vihitastaddhito
hrasvapakṣe’pi sidhyati, ekadeśavikṛtarayā’nanyatvāt| yadi tu
yatpratyayāntasyedaṃ pākṣikaṃ nipātanamityāśrīyeta tadā yatā
mukte’dhikaraṇe ṇyadeva tāvaddurlabhaḥ| athāpi bāhulakāllabhyeta,
evamapi ṇyadantamanūdya vihitastaddhito yadantānna syāditi dik|
ṛhaloḥ| pañcamyarthe ṣaṣṭhī| ṭhṛ’ iti ṛdhātorna grahamaṃ kiṃtu
ṛvarṇasya, halā sāhacaryāt, paraṃ kāryamiti nirdeaśāt, ṭhīḍavande’
ityādiliṅgācca| ṭhṛhalo’rityetadanuvartamānasya dhātorviśeṣaṇaṃ
| viśeṣaṇena tadantavidhistadetadāha--- ṛvarṇāntāditi|
atredamavadheyaṃ-- mūlapustakeṣu sarvatra ṭhvibhāṣā kṛvṛṣo’rityatra
pakṣe ṇyadbhavatīti vaktuaṃ ṭhṛhalorṇya’diti sūtraṃ paṭhitvā paścāt
ṭhyugyaṃ ca patre’, ṭhamāvasyadanyatasyā’miti paṭhitam| manoramāyāṃ
tu sūtrapāṭhakrameṇa ṭhyugyaṃ ca patre’, ṭhamāvasyadanyatarasyā’miti
vyākhyāya ṭhṛhalorṇya’ditisūtraṃ vyākhyātaṃ tathaivātrāpi
vyākhyātamiti|

(526) hetuhetumatorliṅ |3|3|156|
hetuhetu| vibhāṣetsyā’nuvartanādāha-- vā syāditi|
nameccediti| kṛṣṇanatiḥ sukhaprāptau hetuḥ| 
|bhaviṣyatyeveṣyate| bhaviṣyatyeveti| liṅtyinuvartamāne
punarliṅgrahaṇaṃ kālaviśeṣapratipatyarthamiti bhāvaḥ| hantītyādi|
nanu ‘akṣaṇahetvoḥ kriyāyāḥ’ iti hanteḥ śatṛpratyayaḥ syāt,
hananasya palāyane hetutvāt| maivam| ‘evatrāto galo grāha iti
yoge ca sadvidhiḥ| mithaste na vibhāṣyante gavākṣaḥ saṃśitavrataḥ’ iti
‘ācchāeranyatarasyāmiti sūtre bhāṣye vyavasthāpitatvāt| vyākhyātaṃ
ca kaiyaṭena tatraiva sūtre-- ‘evatrāt’ iti saṃjñā| tatra
‘udavidondatrāghrāhrībhyo’nyatarasyā’miti na ṇatvaṃ bhavati--devatrāṇa
iti| kiṃ tu devatrāta ityeva| ‘ro yaṅ’, ṭhici vibhāṣā’ iti
prāṇyahge nityaṃ latvam| galaḥ| viṣavācake ‘ara’ ityatra na bhavati|
ṭhvibhāṣā grahaḥ’ iti ṇapratyayo jalacare bhavati-- grāhaḥ| jyotiṣi na,
--grahaḥ| ‘akṣaṇahetvo’riti sūtre ‘anvorvibhāṣe’tyato
vibāṣetyanuvartya vyavasthitavibhāṣāśrayaṇāditiśabdayoge sadvidhiḥ
u śatṛśānacau na bhavataḥ| hantīti palāyate| vātāyane-- ‘avākṣaḥ’|
anyatra tvavaṅna bhavati-- go’kṣaḥ| saṃśitavrata iti bahuvrīhiḥ| atra
‘ācchāeranyatarasyā’miti saṃśāta itītvavikalpo na bhavati| anyatra tu
śātaḥ| śitaḥ| te u pūrvoktanatvādividhayo, mithaḥ uparasparam
ekaviṣaye, na vikalpyante-- tatadvidhāyakasūtre
vyavasthitavibhāṣāśrayaṇāditi bhāvaḥ| kriyātipatau tu bhūte
bhaviṣyati ca nityaṃ lṛṅ| yadyavarṣiṣyat sasyamupatsyam|

(527) icchārtheṣu liṅloṭau |3|3|157|

(536) dhātusaṃbandhe pratyayāḥ |3|4|1|
dhātusaṃbandhe| iha dhātvorviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvādisaṃbandho’nupapannaḥ
, svārthasmāraṇenopakṣīṇatvāt, padārthasaṃsargo vākyārthaḥ,
kārakaviśiṣṭā kriyā ceti svīkārāt| ‘abdānugamādṛte na
śābdo’sti pratyaya’ ityavaṣṭabhya śābdabodhe śabdo’pi bhāsata
ityabhyupagame’pi śabdasya svarthaṃ pratyeva prakāratvaṃ na tu śabdāntaraṃ
prati| tathā ca dhātusaṃbandho vākyena na budhyate iti tasya
vākyārthatvā’saṃbhavāddhātuśabdena dhātvartho lakṣyate| nanu ‘hātoḥ
karmaṇaḥ samānakartṛkā’diti sanvidhau karmatvaṃ samānakartṛkatvaṃ ca
dhātorarthadvārakaṃ viśeṣaṇamāśritaṃ tathehāpi dhātvorarthadvārakaḥ
saṃbandho’stviti rakacet| maivam| tathā hi sati
parasparasaṃbandhā’rthabodhakā’nekadhātuprayoga eva pratyayāḥ syustataśca
gomānāsīt gomān bhavitetyādi na sidhyet| na hyatra ṭhvasan
dadarśe’ tyatra vartamānakālo vasiriva vartamānakālo’stiḥ
prayujyate| na cā’prayujyamānasya dātvantareṇa saṃbandho’sti| arthayoḥ
saṃbandhābhyupagame dhātudvayā’bhāve’pi dhātvarthadvayasya
satvādgomānāsīdityādau nā’nupapatiḥ| tadetadabhipretyāha---
dhātvarthānāmiti| viṣayabahutvāpekṣaṃ bahuvacanam|
ekaikaviṣayāpekṣāyāṃ ta#u dhātvarthayoriti bodhyam| etacca
manoramānusāreṇa vyākhyātam| kecitu--
dhātvorarthdavārakasaṃbandhe’bhyupagate
‘omānāsīdbhavite’tyādi na sidhyediti manoramoktaṃ
cintyameva| ‘atkaroti tadācaṣṭe’ ityakatreva ‘adasyāstyasmi’
nnitakyatrāpyekatvavartamānatvayoravivakṣitatvātprakṛtasūtrānapekṣayaiva
tatsiddheḥ| na hyatra matubbidhau ṭhvartamāne la’ḍityādāviva
kālaviśeṣaparigraho’stītyāhuḥ| tadbhāṣyakaiyaṭādyananuguṇam| tadhā
hi bhāṣye-- pratyaya ityanuvartamāne punaratra pratyayagrahaṇaṃ
kimarthamityākṣipya adhātupratyayānāmapi saṃbandhe sādhutvaṃ yathā
syāt, gomānāsīt bhavitā veti samāhitam| kaiyaṭena tu--
‘adasyāstyasminniti matup
pratyayovartamānasatāviśiṣṭaprakṛtyarthayukto vihita’ ityuktam| tathā
ca matubvidhāvastītyatra ekatvasyā’vivakṣatatve’pi vartamānatvaṃ
vivakṣitamiti tadgranthabalādavagamyate| kiṃ ca ‘aṇḍinamānaye’ tyukte
vartamānasatāviśiṣṭadaṇḍayukta evānīyate nā’nyaḥ| tathā ca ṭhāsīt’
‘havite’ ti tiṅntapadānurodena ‘omā’nityatra gāvo’syāsan
gāvo’sya bhavitāra ityatītānāgatasatāviśiṣṭaprakṛtyarthayukto
matuppratyayaḥ prakṛtasūtreṇaiva va#dhīyite na tu taduktarītyā labhyata
iti dik| nanu tatadvidhivākyaireva svaviṣaye pratyayāḥ siddhāḥ
kimanena sūtreṇetyata āha-- atra kāla iti| ṭhvartamānasāmīpye’
ityārabhya kālā’nyatvaṃ prāyeṇa pratipādyate tadeva ceha gṛhyata iti
bhāvaḥ| ṭhvanāni paśyan yayā’ vityādau
vartamānabhūtakālādipratyayeṣu ko vā svakālātpracyuto
bhavatītyākaṅkṣāyāmāha--tiṅntavācyeti| pradhānānurodhena guṇasya
nayanamucitaṃ na tu viparītamiti bhāvaḥ| pratyayā iti|
kālāntarabhājo bhavanantītyarthaḥ| bhūte laḍiti| evaṃ coṣitvā
dadarśertthaḥ| atīteti| atītavāsakartā kartā yasya darśanasyeti
bahuvrīhiḥ| somayājīti| ‘araṇe yajaḥ’ iti bhaviṣyati ṇiniḥ| ata
evāha-- somena yakṣyamāṇa iti| evaṃ ca ‘aśyan yayā’ vityatra
dṛśerbhūte laṭ| dṛṣṭvā yayāvityarthaḥ| ‘ivedayiṣyato mano na
vivyathe’ ityatra tu vedaterbhūte lṛṭ| tasya ‘ṛṭaḥ sadvāṭa iti
śatṛpratyayaḥ| nivedanaṃ kṛtavata ityartha ityādyaūhyam|syādetat ‘hāvi
kṛtyamāsī’dityatra sūtrarītyā ‘hāvi’śabdasya bhūtakālatve svīkṛte
satyatītaṃ bhavanamityarthādāsīccchabdasyāpyekartṛkamatītaṃ
bhavanamitayarthādbhāvyāsīccchabdayoryugapatprayogo na syāt,
bhāviśabdārthasya āsīccchabdenaiva lābhāt| tataścaitāvantaṃ kālaṃ
bhāvitayā vyavahṛtaṃ tadidānīmāsīdityartho’trāvaśyaṃ svīkartavyaḥ|
svīkṛte tu ‘omānāsī’dityatrāpi gomāniti vyavahāraviṣaya
āsīdityartho’stu| ṭhvasan dadarśe’ ityādau bhūte lakṣaṇayā yathāyathaṃ
laḍādiḥ svīkartavyaḥ| ‘omayājī’ tyatra tu bhūta eva ṇinipratyaye
jāte’pi bhaviteti luḍantasamabhivyāhāre sati somayājīti
vyavahariṣyamāṇa ityadhyāhāreṇa,ṇinerbhaviṣyadarthe lakṣamayā vā
prayogo bhavediti kimanena sūtreṇeti cet| atrāhuḥ--
adhyāhāralakṣaṇāprayuktakleśaṃ vinaiva prāyaśo nirvāhārthaḥ sūtrārambhaḥ|
na hi ‘hāvi kṛtyamāsī’dityādau kvacidadhyāhārādikamagatyā
bhavatīti sarvatra tatsvīkartumucitamiti|

(537) kriyāsamabhihāre loṭ, loṭo hisvau, vā ca tadhvamoḥ
|3|4|2|
kriyāsamabhihāre| dyotya iti| kriyāsamabhihāro dhātorevārthaḥ|
loṭ tu dyotaka iti bhāvaḥ| tasyaca hisvau sta iti| nanu
‘o’ḍityanena tiṅe lakṣayitvā tiṅameva hisvau
vidhīyetām|thā sati tiṅntatvātpadatvaṃ labhyata iti guṇo’pyasti,
ṭhvā ca tadhvamo’riti vākyaśeṣo’pi svarasataḥ saṅgaccchate| anaythā
yena nāprāptinyāyena hisvayostiṅtiṅlakṣaṇā na nyāyyā,
asaṃjātavirodhitvenopakramasya prābalyāt, vi,yasaptamyāśraṇena
vākyaseṣasyopapannatvācca| kiṃca tiṅamādeśatve tipsipmipāṃ sthāne
vihitasyaheḥ sthānivadbhāvena pitvānṅtvā’bhāveni
‘unīhī’tyatra ṭhī halyagho’ritītvaṃ na s#at| ‘rūhī’tyatra ‘rūva
ī’ḍitīḍāgame ‘ravīhī’ti syāt| ‘ṛṇḍhaī’tyatra tu ‘ṛṇaha
i’mitīmāgame tṛṇeḍhaīti syāt| kiṃca lādeśānāmeva
parasmaipadātmanepadasaṃjñe na tu lādeśatiṅadeśānāmiti sarveṣāṃ
tiṅaṃ dvāvapi hisvau paryāyeṇa syātāṃ na tu tibādīnāṃ hiḥ,
tiṅaṃ sva iti padavyavasthayā| tataśca lakārasyaivādeśau hisvau
syātāmata āha---tau ceti| ayaṃ bhāvaḥ- ‘oṭo hisvau’ iti vākye
‘riyāsamabhihāre lo’ḍiti vākyālloḍityanuvartate, tacca
hisvāvityasya viśeṣaṇam| na ca hisvau loṭau bhavata
itisāmarthyālloṭadharmakāvirtthaḥ saṃpadyate| tatrāpi
mukhyaloṭsaṃbandhino dharmasya pratyayatvasyātideśovyarthaḥ,
sthānivatvenaiva tatsiddheḥ| kiṃtu
sthānavadbhāvalabdhaloḍvyapadeśakau tiṅbhūtau yau hisvau
tayoreva dharma ihātidiśyate| kecitu-- ‘riyāsamabhihāre lo’
ḍityanantaraṃ lāghavātasya hisvāviti vaktavye
loḍgrahaṇasāmarthyālloḍdharmakāveva hisvau loṭaḥ sthāne bhavata
ityarthaḥ saṃpadyate| tathā ca pūrvoktarītyā tiṅbhūtau yau hisvau
tayoreva dharma ihātidiśyata iti siddhamiṣṭam| evaṃ ca ‘oṭo
hisvā’viti vākye pūrvavākyālloḍgrahaṇaṃ
nānuvartanīyamityāhuḥ| tiṅsaṃjñau ceti| tena padatvaṃ,
‘iṅṅtiṅḥ’ iti ca bhavati| hisvavidhāna iti| yadi hi
puruṣavacanasaṃjñe api syātāṃ tarhi yuṣmatsāmānādhikaraṇaye ekatve ca
satyeva hisvābhyāṃ bhāvyaṃ, tatraca vyartho hisvavidhiriti bhāvaḥ| hiḥ
kartari| svo bhāvakarmakartṛṣviti| uktaṃ ca kaiyaṭenāpi-- ṭhhiśabdasya
kartā vācayaḥ, svaśabdasya tu bhāvakarmakartāra iti| atra navyāḥ-- ṭhalpe’
ṭhhrasve’ ityādau kapratyayavatkriyāsamabhihāre loḍayaṃ svarthika eva| na
tvasmiṃlloṭi ‘aḥ karmaṇi ce’ tyādyartho’bhyupeyaḥ, prayojanā’bhāvāt|
yadi tu hiśabdasya kartā arthaḥ syāt, punaḥ punaratiśayena vā yānaṃ
hyantasyārtha iti vakṣamāṇagranthaḥ svarasato na saṅgaccheta|
yāhiyāhītyādau tu kartrādirptītiryātītyādisamabhivyāhāreṇa
sulabhaiva| yathā edhāṃcakre ityatra taṅadeśātprāgeva āmaḥ parasya
lerlukyāmante sahkhyāptītbhāve’pi cakre ityanuprayogavaśena
ekartṛkā vṛddhirūpā kriyetyavidyamānā’pi saṅkhyā pratīyate, tathaiva
hisvānteṣpi kālakārakasaṅkhyāpratītiryātītyādyanuprayogabalena
bhavatītyāhuḥ| syādetat--ṭhkriyāsamabhihāre hisvau loḍvā ca
tadhvamo’riti sūtramastu| tathā ca hisvau loṭau na bhavata ita
loḍdharmakāvityarthaḥ pūrvoktarītyā syāditi sarveṣṭasiddhau
kimanena loṭa iti ṣaṣṭhaḷntakaraṇeneticet| atrāhuḥ---
hisvayoryadi loṭsthānikatvaṃ na svīkriyate tarhi
tayorloḍādeśavadbhāvena ṭhīhalyagho’rityādipravṛtyā
lunīhītyādisiddhāvapi hisvāntasya loḍantatvaṃ na sidhyet| tathā ca
ṭhhanta ce’tyanudātavikalpo na syāt, ṭhhanta!
pralunīhipralunīhītyayaṃ lunāti’| evaṃca loḍantatvalābhārthaṃ ‘oṭo
hisvā’viti vidhīyate| yadi tu ṭhhisvau lo’ḍityukte’pi
loḍvadbhāvāśrayeṇa loḍantakāryaṃ ṭhhanta ce’ti svaravikalpaḥ
sidhyatīti brūṣe tarhi sthānivadbhāvalabdhaloḍdharmakau
hisvāvityarthasyā’nāśrayaṇālloḍādeśakāryāṇi
parasmaipadātmanepadatiṅsaṃjñāstu na sidhyanti| tathā ca
pūrvoktadoṣastadavasthaḥ syāt| ‘oṭ loṭo hisvau’ityukte tu
sthānivadbhāvena hisvayorloṭtvālloḍantakāryaṃ svaravikalpa
sidhyati, ‘riyāsamabhihāre loḍi’ti vākyālloḍityaranuvartya
hisvau loḍiti prāgeva vyākhyātatvāllopaḍādeśavadbhāvena
parasmaipadātmanepadasaṃjñādīnyapi sidhyantīti|

(539) pūrvasmin |3|4|4| 
pūrvasman u kriyāsamabhihāraviṣaye| atra saṅkhyākārakādīnāṃ

| kriyāsamabhihāre dve vācye| dve vācye iti| vārtikamidaṃ

tadhvamo’rityuktatvāddhisvā’bhāvapakṣa ityarthaḥ| tadhvamorityatra taśabdena madhyamapuruṣabahuvacanaṃ gṛhyate, ‘hvam’ sāhacaryāt| yadyapi ‘hva’mityasyātmanepadatvamastīti tatsāhacaryeṇa ‘asthasthamipā’miti yātetyatra thasya tādeśaḥ| vidhyādiloḍviṣaye tvanuprayoge’pi tu thasya tādeśapravṛteryūyaṃ yātetyanuprayoktam| adhīdhvamadhīdvamiti| ‘avābhyā’mityam| adhīdhve iti| vidhyādiloḍviṣaye tu savābhyāṃ vāmāviti pravṛteradhīdhvamityevānuprayoktavyam| bhāvakarmaṇostu ‘hūyasva--bhūyasveti bhūyate’ ‘acyasvapacyasveti pacyate’ ityādyaunneyam| ‘amuccaye’nyatarasyā’miti sūtre puruṣavacanasaṃjñe tu vidhānasāmarthyāddhisvayorna sta ityuktamiti sarveṣṭasiddhiḥ|

(420) anunāsikas kvijhaloḥ kṅiti |6|4|15|

iha iṇo ṇici kṛte ṭhiṇo ya’ṇiti yaṇaṃ bādhitvā paratvāddhṛddhiḥ| na
ca ṭhoḥ puyaṇjī’ti jñāpakātpūrvaṃ dvitvaṃ, paścādvṛddhiriti
śaṅkyam, ṭhajāderdvitīyasye’ti ṇico
dvitve’byāsotarakhaṇḍasyā’varṇaparatvā’bhāvāt| iti vā’rtha iti|
vyākhyānadvayamapyākarārūḍhamiti bhāvaḥ| 
| īrṣyatestṛtīyasyeti vaktavyam| ṣakārasyeti| rephasya tu ‘a ndrāḥ’
ityanena niṣedhāditi bhāvaḥ| dvitīye tviti| ‘ṛtīyasyaikāca’ iti
pakṣe| sannante pravartata iti| vacanasāmarthyāditi bhāvaḥ|
airṣyiyaditi| ‘ṛtīyavyañjanasye’ti pakṣe idamudāharaṇam|
ṭhairṣiṣya’diti rūpasyā’sādhutvamāśaṅkyopapādayati--
dvitīyavyākhyāyāmityādinā| dvitīyasyaiveti| ṭhekāca’ iti śeṣaḥ|
apravṛteriti| kiṃtu sannanta eva pravartate| tatra
hyanupadamīrṣyiyiṣatītyudāhariṣyati| ṭhartha upayācñāyā’mityasya
āgarvīyatvādātmanepadena bhāvyamiti ‘rārthayantī’ti
māghakāvyādiprayogo’sādhurityāśaṅkya tatsamarthanāyāha--
nivṛtapreṣaṇāditi| uktaṃ ca-- ‘ivṛtapreṣaṇāddhātoḥ prākṛte’rthe
ṇijucyate’ iti| tenetyādi| ‘rārthanā kurvantī’ ti vivakṣitārthe
prayogaḥ siddha iti bhāvaḥ| kecitu parasmaipadasiddhyarthaṃ-- prārthanaṃ
prārthaḥ, taṃ kurvanti prārthayantīti vayācakṣate, tadasat|
dhātusaṃjñāprayojakapratyaye cikīrṣite upasargāṇāṃ pṛthakkaramasya
vakṣyamāṇatayā ṭharthavede’ tyāpugāgamasya durvāratvāt| iti
ṇyantaprakriyā||



 (1370) dhānyānāṃ bhavane kṣetre khañ |5|2|1|
dhānyānām| ‘hivi prīṇane’ityasmāt ‘ṛtyalyuṭo bahula’miti
kartari ṇyat| asmādeva nipātanādantyasya lopa ikārasya cātvam|
dhinotīti dhānyam| mantraśca ‘hanyamasi dhimuhi devān’iti
dṛśyate| ‘hānyānā’miti bhavanāpekṣayā kartari ṣaṣṭhī| sā ca
nirdeaśādeva samarthavibhaktiḥ| bahuvacanaṃ tu svarūpavidhinirāsārtham|
alaukike prakiyāvākye tu ṣaṣṭhaḷntatvānuvādena
tadvidhisāmarthyādeveti bodhyam| bhavatirihotpativacanaḥ,
kṣetragrahaṇasāmarthyāt| sūtre hi satāvacanasyāpi bhavatergrahaṇaṃ
mābhūditi kṣetragrahaṇaṃ kṛtam| anyathā ‘hānyānāṃ bhavanaṃ
kusūlaḥ’ityatrāpi syāditi| dhānyānāṃ kim?| tṛṇānāṃ bhavanaṃ
kṣetram|
(1371) vrīhiśālyorḍhak |5|2|2|
vrīhiśālyoḥ| atrāpi nirdeaśādeva ṣaṣṭhī samarthavibhaktiḥ | sā ca
bhavanāpekṣayā kartarītyādi pūrvavat|
(1372) yavayavakaṣaṣṭikādyat |5|2|3|
yavayavaka | atra pratyayārthasāmarthyāllabhyā ṣaṣṭhī samarthavibhaktiḥ|
vibhāṣā khañi nitye prāpte vacanam| āṬmīnaṃ bhāhgīnamiti|
nanūmābhaṅgayordhānyatvā’bāvātkathamiha khañ| ṭhvrāhiyaśca me
yavāśca me’iti canakānuvāke hi dvādaśaiva dhānyāni paṭhitāni, na
tūmābhaṅgau paṭhitau iti cet| maivam| ‘aṇasaptadaśāni
dhānyānī’ti smaraṇāt| tatra comabhaṅgayorapi
pāṭhāddhānyatvamastīti bhāṣyādau sthitatvāt| na ca camakānuvāke
dhānyaparigaṇanenā’rthaḥ, tatrā’dhānyānāmapyaśmādīnāṃ pāṭhāt,
dhānyānāmapi kaiṣāṃcitkodravādīnāmapāṭhāt| tasmādanyata eva
dhānyanirṇaya iti pūrvoktasmṛtyā tayordhānyatlamastīti jñeyam|
(1373) sarvacarmaṇaḥ kṛtaḥ khakhañau |5|2|5|
sarvacarmaṇaḥ| ‘haśce’tyeva tu noktaṃ, yato’pyanukarṣaḥ
saṃbhāvyeteti| atra tṛtīyā samarthavibhaktiḥ, kṛta iti pratyayārthe
carmaṇaḥ karaṇatvasyocitatvāt| sarvaścarmaṇeti| sarveṇa carmaṇā kṛta
ityarthe taddhito neṣyata iti bhāvaḥ|
(1374) yatāmukasaṃmukhasya darśanaḥ khaḥ |5|2|6|
yathāmukha| dṛśyate’smin darśanaḥuādarśādiḥ| adhika,raṇe lyuṭ|
ṭhasādṛśye’iti pratiṣedhātsādṛśye kathaṃ yathāśabdasya samāsaḥ?|
tatrāha----nipātanāditi| etacca vṛtigranthamanusṛtyoktam|
bhaṭṭikāvye tu padārthānativṛtau yathāśabda āśritaḥ| tathā ca
māyāmṛgaṃ prakamyoktaṃ---ṭhyathāmukhīnaḥ sītāyāḥ pupluve bahu
lobhayan’iti| yathāmukhaṃ darśana iti| avyayībhāvasyāpi
yathāmukhaśabdasyenmatagaṅgādivatsatvavacanatvātkarmaśaktiyoge sati
kṛdyogalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī| tasyā ‘āvyayībhāvā’dityamādeśaḥ| sarvasya
mukhasyeti| ‘aṃmukhasye’ti noktaṃ, pratyayasaṃniyogenaiva
samaśabdasyā’ntyalopanipātanāt| saṃśabdastacusamaśabdārthe na
dṛśyate, ‘aṃmukho bhava’ityatra ṭhabhimukha’ityarthapratīteḥ| tatra ca
khapratyayasyā’niṣyamāṇatvāt| kathaṃ tarhi----ṭhsaṃyuge saṃmukhīnaṃ
tamudgadaṃ prasaheta kaḥ’iti bhaṭṭiḥ|
abhimukhāvasthānātsāmarthyādbhaviṣyatīti haradataḥ| 
(1375) tatsarvādeḥ pathyaṅgakarmapatrapātraṃ vyāpnoti |5|2|7|
tatsarvādeḥ| ‘a’diti dvitīyā samarthavibhaktiḥ| vyāpnotīti
pratyayārthaḥ| pariśiṣṭaṃ prakṛtiviśeṣaṇam| tatra kevalānāṃ
pathyādīnāṃ sarvāditvā’saṃbhavātprātipadikairapi taistadantavidhiḥ|
tadāha----pathyādyantāditi|
pathyaṅgakarmapatrapātrāntātprātipadikādityarthaḥ| sarvapathīni iti|
‘ūrvakālaike’ti samāsaḥ| ṭhṛkpī’riti samāsāntaḥ| tasya
pathyantasamāsagrahaṇena grahaṇādbhavati khapratyaya|
(1376) anupadasarvānnāyānayaṃ baddhābhakṣayatineyeṣu |5|2|9|
anupadasarvānnāyānayaṃ| ‘addhābhakṣayatī’tyatra nipātanātiṅntena saha
dvandvaḥ| dvitīyāntebhyo’nupādadibhyo yathāsaṅkhyaṃ baddhādiṣvartheṣu
khaḥ syāt| anurāyāma ityādi| ṭhyasya cāyāmaḥ’iti ,
yathārthe--ṭh’vyaya’miti vā avyayībhāva ityarthaḥ| sarvānnīna iti|
prakārakārtsnye sarvaśabdaḥ| yānyannāni labhyante uṣṇāni śītalāmi
sarasāni vā sarvāṇi bhakṣayatītyarthaḥ| ṭhayaḥ---pradakṣiṇagamanam|
anayaḥ---prasavyagamanam| pradakṣiṇaprasavyagāmināṃ śārāṇāṃ
yasminparairasamāveśaḥ so’yamayānaḥ’iti kāśikā| taṃ neya iti|
nayaterdvikarmakatvādapradhāne karmaṇi dvitīyā | āyānayīnaḥ śāraiti|
‘halakaśirasi sthita ityarthaḥ’iti kāśikā|

(1379) samāṃsamāṃ vijāyate |5|2|12|
samāṃsamām| yalopa iti| ‘amāyā’mityatra yakāralopa ityarthaḥ|
pūrvapade nipātyata iti| anyathā taddhite utpanne yathotarapade supo
lugbhavati ‘upo dhātuprātipadikayo’riti, tathā pūrvapade’pi
syāditi bhāvaḥ| samāṃsamīneci| vīpsāyāṃ dvirvacanam|
subantasamudāyaḥ prakṛtiḥ| vijāyata ityetadvyācaṣṭe---prasūyata
iti| vipūrvako janirgarbhavimocane vartata iti bhāvaḥ|
garbhavimocane kṛtsnāyāḥ samāyā vyāptyabhāvāt ṭhatyantasaṃyoge
ce’ti dvitīyā nabhavatītyāśayenāha---samāyāmityādi|
khapratyayānutpatau yalopo vā vaktavyaḥ| ‘hapratyayānutpatā’viti|
vārtikena samāṃsamāmiti sautraprayogastūpapanna iti bhāvaḥ| adyaśvīnā|
avibhaktiko nirdeaśo na tu strīlihganirdeaśo’yam, ṭhadyaśvīno
gosamūhaḥ’ ṭhadyaśvīnaṃ gomaṇḍala’mityādāvapīṣṭatvāt|

(1382) anugvalaṃgāmī |5|2|15|
anugvalaṃ| ‘ha’ityanuvartate| anuguśabdāt ṭhalaṃgāmī’tyasminnarthe khaḥ
syāt| goḥ paścāditi| paścādarthe’vyayībhāvaḥ| paryāptimiti|
kriyāviśeṣaṇam| atra haradataḥ---anugvityasya
kriyāviseṣaṇatvāddvitīyāntādiha pratyayaḥ| na cālaṅgāmītyasya
‘upyajātau’iti ṇinipratyayāntatayā kṛdyogalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī syāditi
vācyaṃ, kriyāviśeṣaṇātadapravṛteḥ, ‘obhanaṃ pācaka’ityādau
tathādarśanādityāha| atra kecit---dhātūpātavyāpārajanyaphalāśrayatvaṃ
yatra tanmukhyaṃ karma, yatra tu vyāpārajanyatvamātraṃ tadaupacārikam|
tataśca ‘aṇḍulānā pācaka’ityatra mukhye karmaṇi kṛdyogalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī
bhavati| ‘ṛdu pācakaḥ’ ‘obhanaṃ pācaka’ityatra tu sā na bhavati,
phalavyāpārayoḥ kriyākarmabhāvavyavahāre satyapi
phalasyopacārikakarmatvāt, tadviśeṣaṇatvācca mṛdvāderiti
tasyāśayaityāhuḥ| anye tvevaṃ tarhi tulyanyāyena
kriyāviśeṣaṇāddvitīyayāyā apyapravṛtiḥ syāt| tasmāt ‘adarha
miti nirdeaśādanityā kṛdyogaṣaṣṭhīti kriyāviśeṣaṇātsāna svīkriyata
iti haradatāśayaḥ kathaṃ cidvarṇanīya ityāhuḥ| vastutastu
paścādarthe’vyayībhāvo’yamiti nirbivādam| paścāditi cā’statyarthe
nipa#atitam| tacca yadyapi vibhaktitrayasādhāraṇaṃ tathāpīha
yogyatābalātsaptamyarthavṛtiḥ| atastasya
karmatvā’yogātprathamāntādeveha pratyaya iti vaktumucitam|
kṛdyogalakṣaṇaṣaṣṭhīśaṅkā’pyata eva neti bodhyam|

(1393) vinañbhyāṃ nānāñau nasaha |5|2|27|

(1399) pramāṇe dvayasajdaghnañmātracaḥ |5|2|37|

prameye’rthe trayaḥ pratyayāḥ syuḥ| pramāṇamiha paricchedakamātram| tatra

tadūrdhvamānam---ūrvādi| tena tiryaṅbhānādau ‘aṇḍajvayasaṃ
kṣetra’mityādi na prayujyate, yathotaraṃ munīnāṃ prāmāṇyāt| ataeva

nādartavyamityavocāma|
pramāṇe laḥ| pramāṇo la iti| luka eṣā pūrvācāryasaṃjñā| pramāṇatvena
ye prasiddhāstataḥ parasyaivāyaṃ lugityudāharati--śamaḥ diṣṭiḥ

itarayorasaṃbhavāt| śamādīnāmanūrdhvamānatvāt|
dvigornityam| dvigornityamiti|
dvigorapramāṇatvātadantavidhyabhāvācca pūrveṇā’prāpto lugvidhīyate|
nanu vikalpasyā’prakṛtatvānnityagrahaṇamiha nirarthakamiti cet|
atrāhuḥ----anupadaṃ saṃśaye vakṣyamāṇo mātrac śamamātramityādau yathā
na lupyate ‘ramāṇe laḥ’ityasya ‘ramāṇe dvayasa’jiti yaḥ
pūrvavidhistadviṣayatvāt,---evaṃ dvigorapi na lupyeta| iṣyate ca
luk| dvau śamau syātāṃ na vā dviśama iti| tathā cā’dhikasaṅgrahārthaṃ
nityagrahaṇabhiti| atra kecit---dvigorlaḥ’ityukte’pi punarlagrahaṇaṃ
nityārthamadhisaṅgrahārthamiti vyākhyātuṃ śakyata iti vaicitryārthaṃ
nityagrahaṇamityāhuḥ|
pramāṇaparimāṇābhyāṃ saṅkhyāyāstapi saṃśaye mātrajvaktavyaḥ|
śamamātramityādi| śamaḥ syānna vetyādivigrahaḥ|

(1401) yatadetebhyaḥ parimāṇe vatup |5|2|39|
yatadetebhyaḥ| yāvānityādi| ṭhā sarvanāmnaḥ’ityātve ṭhugidacā’miti
num| ṭhatvasantasya ce’ti dīrghaḥ| halḍaḷadilopasaṃyogāntalopau|
‘ramāṇe’ityanuvartamāne parimāṇagrahaṇaṃ
pramāṇaparimāṇayorbhedātkṛtam| tathā ca
vārtikam---ṭhḍāvatāvarthavaiśeṣyānnirdeaśaḥ pṛthagucyate|

iti viśeṣaḥ, tasya bhāvo vaiśeṣyaṃ, tasmāt, arthabhedādityarthaḥ|
arthabhedastu---ṭhparimāṇaṃ tu sarvataḥ| āyāmastu pramāṇaṃ syā’diti

rajjurityādi na sidhyet, atra hyāyāmamātraṃ gamyate|
yadyaupamānādbhaviṣyatīti brūṣe, tarhi pramāṇagrahaṇamevānuvartyatāṃ,
yāvānadhvetyādiprayogāśca mukhyāḥ santu| ye tu parimāṇe prayogāḥ
ṭhyāvān dhānyarāśi’rityādayaḥ, ta evopamānādbhavantu |
tatrāha---ṭhmātrāditi’| ṭhyatadetebhyaḥ’iti viśeṣavihito hi vatup
sāmānyavihitān mātrajādīn bādheta| tena tanmātramityādi na
syāt| parimāṇagrahaṇe sati tu bhinnopādhikatvādvatupaḥ pramāṇe
vihitamātrajādibhiḥ saha bādhyabādhakabhāvo neti bhāvaḥ| nanvevamapi
bādhaḥ syādeva, ‘ramāṇe dvayasa’jityatra prasthamātramityādisiddhaye
pramāṇagrahaṇasya paricchedakamātraparatayā vyākhyātatvena vatupo
yatadetebhyo vihitatvena viśeṣavihitatvātanapāyāt| tasmāt
ṭhyatadetebhyo vatup ce’tyeva sūtryatāṃ, māstu parimāṇagrahaṇam,
astu ca pramāṇe ityarthādhikāraḥ, tena ṭhyāvatī rajjuḥ’ ṭhyāvān
dhānyarāśi’rityādiprayogāḥ sarve’pyupacāraṃ vinaiva
nirvahantītyaparamanukūlamata āha---ṭhbhāvaḥ siddhaśceti’| ḍāvatoriti
pañcamyantam| arthabhede sati vatvantānmātrajādīnāmutpatiḥ sidhyati|
tatparimāṇamasya tāvaddhānyaṃ rāśīkṛtam| tāvatpramāṇamasya kuḍaḷadeḥ
‘āvanmātram’| yādṛgrāśīkṛtasya dhānyādedêardhyaṃ tādṛśaṃ
kuḍaḷaderapītyarthaḥ| ekaviṣayatve tu vatupaiva viśiṣṭasya
prameyasyoktatvādvatubantānmātrajādayo na syuḥ| yasya hi tāvatpramāṇaṃ
tasyatadapi pramāṇam| jānupramāṇakaṃ jalādi yasya pramāṇaṃ tadapi
jānupramāṇakamiti vaktuaṃ śakyatvāt| evaṃ ca tāvaccchabda eva prayujyeta
na tu ‘āvanmātra’mityādi| anyathā tatpramāṇamasya tanmātram| tanmātraṃ
pramāṇamasya tanmātramātramityevaṃ mātrajādibhyaḥ
pratyayamālāprasaṅgāt|

tena ṭhekādaśānāṃ ghaṭānāṃ pūraṇo jalādi’rityatra

pūraṇe pratyayaḥ, tarhyatra ekādaśatvasya pūraṇa iti vigraho vaktuaṃ yukta

ṭhvṛddhirādai’jityadhyāyo yadā caramaṃ gaṇyate tadā so’pyaṣṭamo

āgamatvamevābhyupagantavyam, anudātatā yathā syāt| pratyayatvai
hyādyaudātaḥ syāt| tayā caikarūpyeṇaiva saṃdarbhavyākhyānamucitam|
anyetvāhuḥ--maṭaḥ prayayatve akārasahito makāro vidheyaḥ, āgamatve
tu makāramātramiti lāghavamastīti| viṃśa iti| viśateḥ pūraṇaḥ| ‘i
viṃśaterḍiti’iti lopaḥ|
(1410) ṣaṭkatikatipayacaturāṃ thuk |5|2|51|

jaśtvuprasaṅgāt| caturthe rephasya visargaprasaṅgācca| na caivaṃ
‘āntā ’diti sūtre’pi ḍati pare mugeva vidhīyatāmiti vācyaṃ,
pañcamaḥ saptama ityādau nalopā’bhāvāpateḥ|
caturaścchayatā vādyakṣaralopaśca| caturaścchayatāviti|
viśeṣavihitābhyāmapi cchayabhdyāṃ ḍaṭpratyayo na bādhyate,

acsahitasyādervyañjanasyetyarthaḥ| ṭhvyañjanasahitasyāderaca’iti

----ṭhdvitīyatṛtīye’

(1413) viṃśatyādibhyastamaḍanyatarasyām |5|2|56|

bhāṣyamatam| vṛtikṛtā tu viṃśatyādayo laukikā eva saṅkhyāśabda
gṛhyantaṃ, na paṅktyadisūtranirdiṣṭāḥ, tadgrahaṇaṃ
hyaekaviṃśatiprabhṛtibhyo na syāt, grahaṇavatā prātipadikena
tadantavidhipratiṣedhāt| evaṃ ca sati ‘aṣṭhaḷadeścā’saṅkhyāde’riti

grahaṇa’miti | evaṃ ca sati ekannaviṃśateḥ pūraṇa ekānnaviṃśatitama ityapi
sidhyati |ṭhlaukikānāṃ grahaṇa’miti vṛtimate ti naitatsidhyet|

pratipadikavijñānādyathā sahasrādiṣu’ iti vadatā kātyāyanena
paṅktyādisūtrasya pratyākhyātatvā ‘atsūtre’nipātitā viṃśatyādayo
gṛhyante’iti bhāṣyamatamayuktamiti cedatrāhuḥ---yadyapi pratyākhyātaṃ
tathāpīhārthamāvaśyakaṃ tat| ataeva tatra bhāṣyakṛtā ‘ā’sūyā kartavyā
yatrānugamaḥ kriyate’ityuktam| ataḥ kātyāyanoktapratyākhyānaṃ
nādartavyamiti| śatatama iti| yadyapīdaṃ ‘aṣṭaḷadeśce’tyutarasūtreṇaiva
sidhyati, tathāpi saṃkhyādyartha ‘ityaṃ śatadī’tyāvaśyakamiti
dhvanayannudāharati---ekaśatatama iti| māsāderiti|
saṃkhyāvācitvā’bhāve’pīti bhāvaḥ|

(40) svaritenādhikāraḥ |1|3|11|
svaritenādhikāraḥ | atretthaṃbhūtalakṣaṇe tṛtīyā | adhikāro
viniyogaḥ | kiyaddūramadhikāra ityatratu vyākhyānameva śaraṇam |
yathā--ā saptamādhyāyaparisamāpteraṅgādhikāraḥ, na tu
prāgabhyāsavikārebhya evetyādi | yadvā svaritā iti saptamyantam,
svarite dṛṣṭe adhikāro nivartata ityarthaḥ | kaḥ
svarito’dhikārārthaḥ, kaśca tannivṛtyartha ityatra tu vyākhyānameva
śaraṇam | nanvevaṃ vyākhyānādevānuvṛtyananuvṛtī staḥ kimanena
sūtreṇeti cet, atrāhuḥ-arthāntarasaṅgrahāyedaṃ sūtraṃ kṛtam |
tathāhi-adhi-adhikaḥ kāro’dhikāraḥ | adhikaṃ kāryaṃ gauṇepi
śāstrapravṛtirityarthaḥ | tathā ca gauṇamukhyanyāyo yatra neṣyate
apādānādhikaraṇādau, tatra svaritaḥ pāṭhayaḥ | kiṃca adhikaḥ kāraḥ
kṛtiriyaṃ-yatpūrvaḥ san paraṃ bādhate | tathā ca
‘umaciratṛjvadbhāvebhyo nu’ḍityādivakṣyamāṇapūrvavipratiṣedhāḥ
sarve saṅgṛhītā bhavanti, tatra svaritapāṭhenaiva gatārthatvāditi ||
paranityeti | parānnityaṃ yathā-ṭhtudādibhyaḥ śaḥ’ | tudati |
‘udhādibhyaḥ śnam’ | ruṇaddhi | paramapi laghūpadhaguṇaṃ bādhitvā
nityatvāt śaśnamau | tathā dhinavāva, dhinavāma | paramapi
‘opascāsyānyatarasyāṃ mvo’rityukāralopaṃ bādhitvā
nityatvādāḍutamasyetyāṭ | parādantaraṅgaṃ yathāparamapi
ṭhanekā’liti sarvādeśaṃ bādhitvā ‘icce’tyantādeśaḥ | dadhnā,
dadhne | ṭhasthidadhī’tyanaṅ | nityādantaraṅgaṃ yathā-ṭhgrāmaṇinī
kule’ | nityamapīko’cīti numaṃ bādhitvā ṭhhrasvo napuṃsake’ iti
hrasvaḥ | kṛte tu numi anajantatvāddhrasvo na syāt |
antaraṅgādapavādo yathā-ṭhdaityāri’, ‘rīśaḥ’ | paramapi savarṇadīrghaṃ
bādhitvā’ntaraṅgatvādādguṇe yaṇi ca
prāpte’pavādatvātsavarṇadīrghaḥ | tathā ṭhunnyaḥ’ sulvau ‘ulvaḥ’
ityatrāntaraṅgatvādiyaṅ uviṅ ci prāpte’pavādatvāderanekāca iti,
ṭhoḥ supī’ti ca yaṇ | yadyapavādo’nyatra caritārthastarhi
parāntaraṅgābhyāṃ uvaṅ ci prāpte’pavādatvāderanekāca iti, ṭhoḥ
supī’ti ca yaṇ | yadyapavāde’nyatra caritārthatvātātāṅ ni pravartate,
kiṃtu pareṇa ṭhanekālśi’dityanena bādhyate,-jīvatāt | bhavatāt |
ayaje indram, grāme iha, sarve ittham |-atra ayaja i indram, grāma iha,
sarva ī itthamiti sthite’ntaraṅgeṇa guṇena savarṇadīrgho bādhyate |
tasya asamānāśraye ‘aityāriḥ’ ‘rīśa’ ityādau caritārthatvāt ||
asiddhamiti | tena ‘acāveda’mityādau ṭheta ai’ ityaitvaṃ na |
akṛtavyūhā iti | akṛtakāryā ityarthaḥ | evaṃ tarhi sarvasya śāstrasya
vaiyarthyaṃ syādata āha--nimitaṃ vināśonmukhaṃ dṛṣṭveti |
lokasiddhārthakathanametat | yadvā | akṣarārthenāpyetatkathanam | ūhyate
tarkyata ityūhaḥ-kāryam , viśiṣṭo ya ūho
vyūhouvināśonmukhanimitakaṃ kāryam | akṛto vyūho yaiste
akṛtavyūhā iti | yadyapi ‘ṛtamapi śāstraṃ nivartayantī’ti
paribhāṣāntaraṃ paṭhaḷte, phalaṃ ca tulyaṃ, tathāpi ṭhakṛtavyūhā’ ityeva
laghu, ‘rakṣālanāddhi paṅkasya dūrādasparśanaṃ vara’miti nyāyāditi
bhāvaḥ | na kurvantīti | yathā niṣeduṣī’mityādau
kvasoriṭamantaraṅgatvātprāptamapi ‘hāvinā saṃprasāraṇena
valāditvaṃ naṅkṣayatī’tyālocya na kurvantītyarthaḥ ||
iti tatvabodhinyāṃ paribhāṣāprakaraṇam |

(611) supi sthaḥ |3|2|4|

bhaṭṭavārtike brahmavādiśabdasya tacchīlataddharmatatsādhukāriparatayā
vyākhyānaṃ kṛtam| ṭhā kve’rityadhikāre tu brahmaṇi
vaderṇinividhāyakaṃ vacanaṃ nāstyeveti kathamidaṃ saṅgaccheteti
cet, atrāhuḥ-- bhaṭṭāpādānāmayamāśayaḥ-- ‘upyajātau’ iti
sūtreṇa tācchīlye ṇiniḥ| upasaṅkhyānena jñāpakena vā sādhukāriṇi
ṇiniḥ| ṭhāvaśyakādhamarṇyayorṇini’rityāvaśyake ṇinistu taddharme
paryavasyati na tviha ṭhā kveṭa riti sūtrasya vyāpāro’stīti| nanu
brahmavādino vadanti ityatra brahma veda iti brahmaśabdasyāpi
jātivācakatvātkathamiha tācchīlye ṇiniriti samarthanamiticet| atra
navyāḥ-- ‘upyajātau’ ityatra prāṇijātireva paryudasyate,
tācchīlyasamabhivyāhārāt,
‘rāhmaṇānāmantrayite’pratyudāharaṇānuguṇyācceti na
kāpyanupapatiriti| 

(661) manaḥ |3|2|82|

na tūpratyayaḥ| tadāha-- manyateriti| 

(662) ātmamāne khaśca |3|2|83|
ātmamāne| mananaṃ mānaḥ, bhāve ghañ, ātmano māna iti karmaṇi
ṣaṣṭhaḷa samāsaḥ| svaparyāya ātmaśabdaḥ pratyayārthatvena sannihitaḥ kartā
svapadārthastadāha-- svakarmaka ityādi| cāditi| nanu vāsarūpavidhinā
labhyata eva ṇiniriti kimarthaścakāra iti cet| atrāhuḥ--
cakāreṇā’vacchedāya ṇiniḥ samuccīyate| tena ‘araṇe yajaḥ’ ityādau
ṇinirevā’nuvartate na tu khaśṣa evaṃ coktaprayojanānurodhena
‘ānukṛṣṭaṃ notaratre’ tīha na pravartate iti| paṇḍitamātmānamiti|
ekasyāpyātmanaḥ svarūpeṇa kartṛtvaṃ, paṇḍitatvaviśiṣṭarūpeṇa ca
karmatvaṃ bodhyam| ātmamāne kim ?| darśanīyamānī devadato
yajñadatasya| kāliṃmanyeti| ‘triyāḥ puṃva’diti prāptaṃ puṃvadbhāvaṃ
bādhitvā partavāddhrasvaḥ| yatvatra ‘yaṅmānino’riti prāptaḥ
puṃvadbhāva iti prasādakṛtoktaṃ, tadrabhasoktameva, māniyūpā’bhāvasya
spaṣṭatvāt| divāmanyeti| adhikaraṇaśaktipradhānasyāpyasya
vṛtisvabhāvātkarmatvam|

(663) ica ekāco’mpratyayavacca |6|3|68|
ica ekācaḥ| amgrahaṇamihā’’vartate, tata ekena am vidhīyate, pareṇa
pratyayo viśeṣyate| tadāha-- svādyamvaditi| evaṃ ca ‘a vibhaktau
tusmāḥ’ iti niṣedhānmakārasya natsaṃjñā, ataeva paraśca bhavati|
ṭhāṬto’mśaso’rityatra śaśā sāhacaryātsubevā’m gṛhyata
ityuktatvādota ākāraśca bhavatītyāśayenodāharati-- gāṃmanya iti|
naraṃmanya iti| ṭhṛto’ṅītyādinā guṇaḥ|bhāṣyakaroti| ayaṃ bhāvaḥ--
yathā praṣṭhādayaḥ śabdāḥ puṃyogātstrīyāṃ vartante-- praṣṭhī gaṇiketi,
tatheha śrīśabda parityaktasvaliṅgaḥ klībaḥ san kule vartate, tatra
ṭhhrasvo napuṃsake’ iti hrasvaḥ, mum tu na, apavādena amā bādhāt|
‘vamornapuṃsakā’dityamo luk| nacaé gāmaṃnya ityādāvapi ‘upo
dhātuprātipadikayo’riti luk syāditi vācyam,
ṭhamvidhisāmarthyādeva tadbādhādityāhuḥ| ampratyayastu
‘adhye’pavādā’ iti nyāyena ‘upo dhātuprātipadikayo’riti
lukameva bādhate na tu ‘vamornapuṃsakā’diti lukamiti bhāṣyādau
sthitam| syādetat--napuṃsakahrasve kṛte mumaḥ prāptireva nāsti,
kathamatrāpavādena amā bādhādityuktiḥ saṅgaccheta, ṭharurdviṣa’diti
sūtre hi antagrahaṇasya samīpavācitvena ‘hityanavyayasye’ti
punarhrasvo mumarthaḥ svīkriyate tathātrāpi bhavedityastyeva mumaḥ
prāptiriti|

(667) brahmabhraṇavṛtreṣu kvip |3|2|87|
caturvidha iti| ayamāśayaḥ-- iha sūtre śrutatvātpūrvaṃ brahmādaya
uddeśyāstato’nantaraṃ prakṛtitvāddhantistataḥ pariśeṣādbhūta iti|
kvip tu sarvānte nirdeaṣṭavyaḥ, vidheyatvāt| tadevaṃ
vacanavyaktiḥ--ṭhbrahmādiṣūpapadeṣu hanterbhūte kvi’ biti| evaṃ sthite
ṭhyatraivakarāstato’nyatra niyama’ itinyāyena niyamo’tra bhavannanantare
bhavati| tataśca brahmādiṣvevetyavadhāraṇe
hantestadanantaranirddiṣṭatvādupapadāntaranivṛtiphalaḥ [prakṛtiṭ
niyamo bhavati| ‘rahmādiṣu hantereva bhūte’ ityavadhāraṇe
tvanantaratvā’viśeṣe’pi prāthamyādupapadaniyamo
dhātvantaranivṛtiphalakaḥ| ‘rahmādiṣu hanterbhūte eva kvi’
bityavadhāraṇe tu kvibhantyorānantarye’viśiṣṭe’pi
prādhānyātkālāntara saṃbandhānavṛtiphalakaḥ pratyayaniyamaḥ| ‘rahmādiṣu
hanterbhūte kvibeve’ti vacanavyaktau
pratyayāntarasaṃbandhanivṛtiphalakaḥ kālaniyamaḥ| so’yaṃ
prakṛtyupapadapratyayakālaniyamānāṃ vivekaḥ|
agṛhyamāṇaviśeṣatvātucaturvidhasyāpīha grahaṇam| tatra ‘rahmādiṣveva
hante’riti prakṛtiniyame bhūtaityāśrayaṇādvartamānakāle
bhaviṣyatkāle copapadāntare’pi bhavatyeva| puruṣaṃ hanti haniṣyati
vā puruṣahā| ṭharihayo’rahayogavicakṣaṇaḥ’| arīn hantīti arihā,
sa cāsau yogaśca arihayogastatra vicakṣaṇa ityarthaḥ| prakṛtiniyamaphalaṃ
tu puruṣaṃ hatavān puruṣahā iti bhūtārthe prayogā’bhāvaḥ| ‘rahmādiṣu
hantereva’tyupapadaniyame’pi bhūta
ityāśrayaṇādvartamānabhavikhyatkālayordhātvantarādapi bhavatyeva,-- vṛtraṃ
jayati jeṣyati vā vṛtrajiditi| upapadaniyamaphalaṃ tu vṛtraṃ
jitavān vṛtrajaditi prayogābhāvaḥ| ‘hūta eva kvi’ biti
pratyayaniyame’pi brahmādiṣvityukterupapadāntare
vartamānabhaviṣyatkālayorhanteḥ kvibbhavatyeva| puruṣaṃ hanati
haniṣyati vā puruṣahā| ariheti prāgvata| pratyayaniyamaphalaṃ tu
brahmāṇaṃ hanti brahmahetyādiprayogā’bhāvaḥ| ‘hūte kvibeve’ti
kālaniyame’pi brahmādiṣvityukterupapadāntare bhūte’pi pratyayāntaraṃ
bhavatyeva, -- pitṛvyaṃ hatavān pitṛvyaghātī| iha ‘armaṇi hanaḥ’ iti
bhūte ṇiniḥ| kālaniyamaphalaṃtu brahmāṇaṃ hatavān brahmaghātīti
prayogā’bhāvaḥ| sopapadaśca pratyayo niyamena vyāvartyate, niṣṭhā
tu bhavatyeva vṛtraṃ hatavāniti| bhāṣyakārastu
prakṛtikālaniyamāvevā’śiśriyat| tasyāyamāśayaḥ-- dhātukālau hi
neha sūtre śrutau, kiṃ tu prakaraṇalakṣaṇajaghanyapramāṇenopasthitau|
atastayorevoparodho nyāyyo na tūpapadapratyayoḥ,
śrutyupasthāpitatvāt| evaṃ nyāyopaṣṭabdhena bhāṣyeṇa saha
virodhādvṛtimatamupekṣyameveti kaiyaṭe sthitam| yatviha
haradatenoktaṃ-- dhātūpapadaviṣayaṃ niyamadvayaṃ bhāṣye
pradarśitamiti,tatra dhātukālaviṣayamiti vaktavye upapadagrahamaṃ
prāmādikamityavadheyam|

(669) some suñaḥ |3|2|90|
some suñaḥ| ihāpi caturvidho niyama iti vṛtiḥ|
evamutarasūtre’pi| tatra bhūtakālasya kvipi niyatatvātsomaṃ
sutavān somasāvaḥ, agniṃ citavān agnicāya ityaṇna bhavati|
sunoteḥ soma eva upapade niyatatvāccinotestvagnāvevopapade
niyatvāt surāṃ sutavān surāsut,
iṣṭakāśritavāniṣṭakāciditi na bhavati, kiṃ tu surāsāvaḥ iṣṭakācāya
ityaṇeva bhavati| somasya sunotāveva dhātorniyatatvāt, agnestu
cinotāveva niyatatvāt--somaṃ krītavān somakīḥ, agniṃ
bhṛtavān agnibhṛditi kvabni bhavati, kiṃ tusomakrāyaḥ agnibhāra
ityaṇeva bhavati| bhūta eva kvipo niyatatvātsomaṃ sunoti soṣyati
vetyarthe kvibna bhavati| tathā agniṃ cinoti ceṣyati vetyarthe
kvibabhāvaḥ, kiṃtvaṇeva| karmaṇīni| kutsitagrahaṇamiti| etacca vārtikaṃ
punaḥ karmagrahaṇasāmarthyāllabhyate, yatkarma kriyayā saṃbadhyamānaṃ
kartṛkutsāmāvahati tatretyarthaḥ| somādayaśca vikrīyamāṇāḥ śāstre
pratiṣedhātkutsāvahāḥ| kutsitagrahaṇānneha, -dhānyavikrāyaḥ|

(675) anyeṣvapi dṛśyate |3|2|101|

ityāha --ajaḥ| dvija iti| na jāyata ityajaḥ| dvirjāto dvijaḥ|ṭhjanmanā

saṃhitāyāstulyatve’pi prakriyāyāṃ doṣāditi prāñcaḥ| tathā cāhuḥ--
‘ānte dīrghatvākhyo doṣo, dānte doṣo niṣṭhānatvam| dhānte
doṣo dhatvākhyaḥ syānnirdoṣatvātthānto grāhyaḥ’ iti|
tadanusāreṇāha-- dathsyāditi| dāta iti| dāp lavane| ṭhadā’biti
niṣedhānna ghutvam| iha sarve pṣāḥ sūpapādā ityāha--- tānto
vetyādinā| dīrghāpatiriti| vidatamityādāvupasargasyetyarthaḥ|
‘astīṭatyatra dvau pakṣau-- ityasya ya ādeśaḥ sa takārāntaḥ’
‘akārādirve’ti ?| tatrādye pakṣe’yaṃ doṣo nāntye
ityāśayenoktadoṣaṃ pariharati-- takārādāviti| niṣṭānatvamiti|
‘adābhyāṭamityanena| sannipāteti| tādi nimitīkṛtya vihato yo
dāntādyādeśaḥ sa takāravighātakanatvādividhernimitaṃ na bhavatīti
bhāvaḥ| 

(727) aca upasargātaḥ |7|4|47|
aca upasaṅkhyārgātaḥ| takārādakāra uccāraṇārthaḥ| ṭhaca’ ityāvartate|
tatraikaṃ pañcamyantamupasargaṃ viśinaṣṭi| aparaṃ ṣaṣṭhaḷntaṃ
sthānalābhāyeti vyācaṣṭe-- ajantādityādinā| yadvā ṭhaca ityanāvṛtaṃ
pañcamyantamevāstu kiṃ tu
dvitakārako’yamādeśastenānekāltvātsarvasya ghorbhavaviṣyati|
ekatakāro hi ṭhalo’ntyasye’ti bādhitvā ṭhādeḥ parasye’ tyādereva
syāda ca iti pañcamīnirdeaśāt| yadyevam ṭhapo bhī’ tyutarasūtre’pi
dvitakāra eveti sarvādeśaḥ syāditi cet| atrāhuḥ--
pañcamyāntasyā’ca ityanuvṛteracaḥ parasya pakārasyaiva bhaviṣyata
tatrāntyasya saṃyogāntalope pūrvasya jaśtvena siddhamiṣṭamiti|
avadatamityādi| ādikarmaṇītyetatpradatamityasyaiva viśeṣaṇaṃ,
netareṣām , asaṃbhavāt| dātuṃ prakrāntamārabdhamiti
pradatamityasyā’rthaḥ| iṣyate iti| tādeśabādhanārthaṃ nipātanamiṣyata
ityarthaḥ| anye tu avādīnāmapusargapratirūpakatvāśrayaṇe hyavadataṃ
vidatamityādi sidhyati, upasargatvāśrayaṇe tu pūrvoktamavataṃ
vītamityādīti nā’pūrvamidaṃ vacanamityāhuḥ|

neti bhāvaḥ| etacca dṛśigrahamā’nuvṛtyā labhyate| nanvevaṃ pratibhūśabda
saṃjñeti phalitaṃ, tatra ‘aṃjñāyā’mityeva siddhaṃ kimantaragrahaṇena ?|
atrāhuḥ- yāvaddravyabhāvinyaḥ saṃjñāḥ| pratibhūśabdastu satyeva tasmin
ṛṇapradānena nivartata ityubhayorbheda iti| śaṃ sukhaṃ bhāvayatīti
śambhurityarthābhyupagamenāha-- antarbhāviteti| śaṃ bhavatiu
sukhasvarūpo bhavatīti śambhurityanye| saṃ bhavatyasmāditi
vyutpatistu apādāne ḍupratyayā’bhāvāccintyeti mādhavaḥ|

 (1037) śeṣe |4|2|92|
śeṣe| lakṣaṇaṃ ceti| grahaṇakṣuṇṇādiṣvartheṣūtarasūtrānupāteṣu aṇo
vidhāyakamityarthaḥ| nanu lakṣaṇaṃ tāvavdyartham, ‘asyeda’mityanena
cākṣuṣādīnāṃ, ‘aṃskṛtaṃ bhakṣāḥ’ityanena dārṣadādīnāṃ siddheḥ| tathā
adhikāro’pi vyarthaḥ|
tathāhi---adhikārasyāpatyādicaturarthīparyanteṣvartheṣu dhādīnāṃ
ṭaḷuṭaḷulantānāṃ nivṛtiḥ, jātādyacarthasākalyaṃ vā prayojanam| tatra
nivṛtistāvanna prayojanam| ārdrakaśālādīnāmutkarādipāṭhena itaḥ
prācīnerṣṭheṣu ghādayo na pravartante’iti jñāpanāt| anyathā
ṭhvṛddhāccchaḥ’ityeva siddhe tatpāṭhasya vaiyarthyaprasaṅgāt|
nāpyarthasākalyaṃ prayojanaṃ, jātādhikārātprākpāṭhasāmarthyādeba
tallābhāt| yadi saṃnihite jātārtha eva ghādayaḥ syuḥ, tadutareṣu
bhavādyartheṣu ‘rāgdīvyataḥ’iti viśiṣṭāvadhivariccchannertheṣu
vidhīyamānā aṇādaya eva syustadā jātādhikārānantarameva
‘rāvṛṣaṣṭha’bityādibhiḥ saha ṭhrāṣṭrāvārapārā’dityadayo’pi
paṭhaḷeran| tasmāvdyarthamidaṃ sūtramiti cet|
atrocyate--ṭhśaiṣikātsarūpaḥ śaiṣiko ne’ti vakṣyamāṇārthasya
viṣayalābhāya śeṣādhikāra āvaśyakaḥ| śaiṣika prayuktakāryaviśeṣaṃ
dhvanayituṃ kriyamāṇaḥ śeṣādhikāra eva
‘aiṣikānmatubarthīyā’dityādirślokaṃ jñāpayati| eṣa ca rślokaḥ
sanvidhau matubvidhau ca bhāṣye paṭhitaḥ| iha tu sannante paṭhita iti
tatraiva vyākhyāsyate| apatyādiṣvartheṣu ghādīnāṃ
nivṛtyarthamapyadhikāra āvaśyakaḥ| na coktajñāpakenaiva tatsiddhiriti
vācyaṃ, jñāpakasya viśeṣāpekṣatve doṣatādavasthyāt| ṭhārdrakādibhyo
yadi cchaḥ syātarhi caturarthyāmeve’ti niyamasyāpi saṃbhavācca evaṃ
sthite cākṣuṣamityādiṣu gṛhyamāṇatvādiprakārakabodhanāya
vidhāyakatvamapi tasya suvacamiti dik| vigrahītādapītyādi|
vacanamevedaṃ, sūtre yathāsaṅkhyapravṛtyarthaṃ viśiṣṭoccāraṇāt|

(810) śvasīvasīyaśśreyasaḥ |5|4|80|

(1) natvā viśveśvaraṃ sāmbaṃ kṛtvā ca guruvandanam |
siddhāntakaumidīvyākhyā kriyate tatvabodhinī || 1 ||

pratijānīte-munitrayamityādinā | trayo’vayavā yasyeti trayam |
‘aṃkhyāyā avayave tayap’ | ‘vitribhyāṃ tayasya-’ ityayac | mantāre
vedaśāstrārthatatvāvagantāro munayaḥ | ‘anerucca’
ityauṇādikasūtreṇa manerata ukāro maneḥ para in pratyayaśca |

namaskṛtya’ ityatrevātrāpi ‘amaḥsvasti-’ ityādinā caturthī syāt |
maivam | ṭhupapadavibhakteḥ kārakavibhaktirbalīyasī’ iti vakṣyamāṇatvāt
‘amaskaroti devān’ itivaddvitīyāyā eva yuktatvāt | kiṃca
‘ahatsvārthā vṛtiḥ’ iti pakṣe namaḥśabdasyātra nirarthakatvātadyoge
caturthī na bhavati, arthavahrahaṇaparibhāṣāyāḥ pravṛteḥ | ‘vayaṃbhuve
namaskṛtya’ ityatra tu svayaṃbhuvamanukūlayitumityarthavivakṣāyāṃ
‘riyārthopapadasya-’ ityādinā caturthīti mūla eva sphuṭībhaviṣyati |
nacaivaṃ ‘amaḥsvasti-’ iti sūtre namaḥpadaṃ vyarthamiti śaṅkyam,
haraye nama ityatra harimanukūlayitumityarthe’vivakṣite
saṃbandhasāmānye ṣaṣṭhaḷaṃ prāptāyāṃ tadapavādatayā tasyāvaśyakatvāt |
taduktīriti | teṣāṃpāṇinyādīnāmuktīḥ |
sūtravārtikabhāṣyāṇītyarthaḥ | tasya munitrayasyoktīriti vyākhyāne’pi
samudāyena sūtraṃ vārtikaṃ bhāṣyaṃ vā noktamiti samudāyināṃ
munīnāmevoktīriti paryavasyati |
paribhāvyeti | paryālocyetyarthaḥ | naca paripūrvasya
bhavatestiraskārārthatvātkathamatra jñānārthateti śaṅkyam, parītyasya
bhāvīti curādiṇijantena yogāt | kecidatra bhavatinā
yogamabhyupetyāhuḥ-ṭhpurau bhuvo’vajñāne’ iti sūtre parau bhuva
ityasyāvajñāna #iti viśeṣaṇānna tiraskārārthatvaniyamaḥ | ‘anasā
paribhāvya kiṃcit’ ityādi-śrīharṣaprayogācca |
ataevātrā’prayuktatvadoṣaśaṅkāpi nāstīti | anye tu-ṭhanādaraḥ
paribhavaḥ parībhāvastiraskriyā’ iti
kośātparipūrvakādbhavaterghañantādeva

(416) ḍiḍḍhāṇañdvayasajdanghañmātractayapṭhakṭhañkañkkarapaḥ

vacanamidaṃ svarasato na saṅgaccchate| yadi tvanityatvajñāpanameva
vacanasya phalamiti brūṣe, tarhi ‘idgaure’ti sūtra eva ṭhanityaṃ
ṣitaḥ’iti vaktavyaṃ kimanena vakramārgeṇeti dik| daśyate’nayeti
daṃṣṭrā| ‘āmnīśase’tyādinā karaṇe ṣṭran|

jānapadakuṇḍagoṇascchalabhājanāgakālanīlakuśakāmukakabarādvṛtyamatrāvapanākṛtrimāśrāṇāsthaulyavarṇānācchādanāyovikāramaithunecchākeśaveśeṣu |4|1|42|

ghaṭaparyāyaḥ kuṇḍaśabdaḥ sa na pratyudāharaṇam| ‘aṭhiraḥ sthālyukhā
kuṇḍa’miti tasya napuṃsakatvāt| agnyālayādiparyāyo’pi
kuṇḍaśabdo napuṃsakaliṅge niyataḥ| ‘uṇḍamagnyālaye mānabhede
devalāśaye’iti medinīkośāt| āvapanaṃ cediti|

‘aiṣā sthalī yatra vicinvatā tvā’miti sthalā’nyeti|

(444) śoṇātprācām |4|1|43|
śoṇāt| ‘oṇaḥ kokanadaccchavi’riti kośācchāeṇaśabdasya
varṇavācitvāt ṭhvarṇānāṃ taṇe’tyādyaudātatayā ṭhanyato ṅī’ṣiti

(445) voto guṇavacanāt |4|1|44|
guṇavacanāt| guṇo nāma nehaadeṅrūpaḥ, ṭhutaḥ’iti
viśeṣaṇādvacanagrahaṇācca, nāpi viśeṣaṇamātramidam,
ākhurdravyamityādāvatiprasaṅgāditi cet|
atrāhuḥ--ṭhsaṃjñājātikriyāśabdān hitvā’nye guṇavācinaḥ’|
‘atuṣṭayīśabdānāṃ pravṛtirityākaragranthaniṣkarṣādeva nirṇayaḥ’ iti|
bhāṣye tu ‘atve niviśate’paiti pṛthagjātiṣu dṛśyate|
ādheyaścā’kriyājaśca so’satvaprakṛtirguṇaḥ|’iti sthitam| satvaṃ
dravyam| satva eva niviśato iti sāvadhāraṇaṃ vyākhyeyam| etenasatā
vyāvartyate| sā hi na kevalaṃ dravye vartate kintu
dravyaguṇakarmasu| nanu dravya eva dratryatvaṃ vartata iti
tatrā’tivyāptirata āha---apaitīti| apagaccchatītyarthaḥ| arthātsatvādeva|
yathā pītatāyāṃ jātāyāṃ phalādernīlatā’paiti, naivaṃ dravyatvaṃ
dravyādapaiti| evamapi gotvaṃ goṣu vartate aśvādeścāpaiti
tatrātivyāptirata āha--pṛthagjātiṣudṛśyata iti| gotvaṃ hi
dravyatvā’vāntaranānājātiṣu na dṛśyate| guṇastu dṛśyate| yathā amre
dṛṣṭā nīlatā tṛṇādiṣvapi dṛśyate| etena pūrvārdhena
sakalajātervyavacchedaḥ| evaṃ tarhi karma dravye vartate tato’paiti
pṛthagjātiṣu dṛśyate ceti tatrātivyāptirata
āha--ādheyaścākriyājaśceti| utpādyo’nutpādya ityarthaḥ| utpādyo--yathā
ghaṭādeḥ pākajo rūpādiḥ| akriyājo’nutpādyaḥ| sa yathā
ākāśādermahatvādiḥ| kriyā tu sarvāpyutpādyaiva na nityeti tasyā
dvevidhyā’bhāvādguṇatvā’bhāvāḥ| evamapila dravyasya guṇatvaṃ
prāpnoti, avayavidravyaṃ hyastapādādiṣu dṛśyate, dvividhaṃ ca bhavati
nityā’nityabhedena,
niravayavasyā’tmaparamāṇvādernityātvādavayavidravyasya tu
ghaṭāderanityatvādata āha--asatvaparkṛtiriti| adravyasvabhāva
ityarthaḥ| pativareti| evaṃ ca
pāṇigrahaṇotkaṇṭhābhidhāyitvādguṇavacano’yamiti bhāvaḥ|
(446) bahvādibhyaśca |4|1|45|
bahvādibhyaśca| bahuśabdasya guṇavācitvāt pūrveṇa siddhe’pyutarārthaṃ
grahaṇam,--ṭhnityaṃ cchandasī’tyutarasūtreṇa bahuśabdādapi cchandasi
nityaṃ yathā syāditi| vastutastu bahuśabdo, ‘ityaṃ cchandasī’ti
sūtraṃ ca vyarthameva, sarvavikalpānāṃ cchandasi vyavasthitatvāt|
guṇasūtrāmāha--kṛdikārāditi| ‘arvato’ktinnārthā’ dityapi
guṇasūtrameva| vyavasthitavibhāṣātvādiha na,--sugandhiḥ|
priyakatirveśyā| ajananiriti| ṭhākrośe nañyaniḥ’iti
janeranipratyayaḥ| ihā’nyānyapi gaṇasūtrāṇi santi---śaktiḥ śastre|
śaktiḥ śaktī| śastre kim?| śaktiḥ sāmarthyam| śaktiḥ śastrīti pāṭhe tu
śabdadvayam| śastrīḥ śastrī| itaḥ prāṇyaṅgāt| dhamaniḥ| dhamanī|
candrabhāgānnadyām| candrabhāgī| candrabhāgā| ahanśabdo’tra paṭhaḷte,
tatsāmarthyātadanto bahuvrīhirudāhāryaḥ, anupasarjanādhikārabādhaśca|
dīrghāhrī prāvṛṭ| pakṣe ṅīmṅīnbiṣedhāḥ| bahu paddhati yaṣṭi vikaṭa
viśāla kalyāṇa purāṇa caṇḍa kṛpāṇa ahan| ityādi|
(447) puṃyogādākhyāyām |4|1|48|
puṃyogādākhyāyām| ihaṭhpu’miti luptaṣaṣṭhīkaṃ pṛthak padaṃ,
taccāvartate| ‘uṃyogā’diti hetau pañcamī| ṭhākhyāyā’miti tu
pañcamyarthe saptamītyāśayenāha----yā pumākhyetyādi|
‘umākhyā’---puṃvācakaḥ śabdaḥ| ‘uṃyogāt striyāṃ vartate’
ityanena gauṇī vṛtiruktā| yadā tu mukhyārthāt ‘asyedam’ityaṇ,
tadā ‘aupī’tyeva bhavati| yogaḥ--saṃbandhaḥ| sa ceha ‘anpatibhāva
eveti nāgrahaḥ, kiṃ tu janyajanakabhāvo’pi gṛhyate, saṅkoce
mānā’bhāvāt| tena ‘ausalyayā’sāvi sukhena rāmaḥ prākkekayīto
bharatastato’bhū’diti bhaṭṭiprayogaḥ saṅgaccchate| kekayasya duhitā
kekayī| ‘anapaśabdātkṣatriyāda’ñityapatyapratyaye tu ‘aikeyīto
bharata’iti syāt| na ceha ṭhataśce’ti tadvājākārasya lukśaṅkyaḥ, ‘a
prācyabhargādī’ti pratiṣedhāt| tathā ca kālidāsaḥ--ṭhkaikeyi| kāmāḥ
phalitāstave’ti| etena ‘evakī’vyākhyātā| puṃyogāt kim?,
devadatā| ayaṃ hi saṃjñāśabdaḥ svabhāvātstriyamāha, na tu
puṃvācakaśabdayogāt| ākhyāyāṃ kim?, prasūtā| ayaṃ hi
jātaparsavāmāha| sa ca parsavo garbhadhāraṇadvārā puṃyoganimitaka
ityastīha puṃyogaḥ, kiṃ tu nāyaṃ puṃso vācaka iti na ṅīṣ| 
sūryāddevatāyāṃ cābvācvaḥ| sūryāddevatāyāmiti| ṅīṣo’pavādaḥ|
sūrīti| ‘ūryatiṣye’ti yalopaḥ|

(450) ktādalpākhyāyām |4|1|51|

(451) bahuvrīheścāntodātāt |4|1|52|
tena bahviti| ayaṃ

ṭhasvāṅgapūrvapadādve’ti vikalpasya vakṣyamāṇatvādiha

pāṇigṛhīti bhāryāyām| pāṇigṛhītīti| yasyāḥ

(452) asvāṅgupūrvapadādvā |4|1|53|
pūrveṇa nityaṃ prāpta iti| etena vikalpo’pyayaṃ jātipūrvādeveti
dhvanitam| kathaṃ tarhi ‘utrahatī’tyatra ṭhasvāṅgapūrvapadā’diti vā

‘utrādinī’tyatra ‘upyajātau----’iti ṇinirna syāt| yadi
tvadanamādaḥ, so’syāstīti ādinī, putrāṇāmādīnīti vigṛhya
kathaṃcitsādhite’pi ‘ātikālasukhādibhyaḥ’ityantodātavidhāyakasūtre
‘āteḥ kiṃ, putrāyātaḥ’iti vakṣyamāṇamūlagrantho virudhyata eveti
ceducyate---ṭhprādurbhāvavināśābhyāṃ satvasya yugapadguṇaiḥ|
asatviliṅgāṃ bahvārthāṃ tā jātiṃ kavayo viduḥ’---iti bhāṣye
lakṣaṇāntaramuktam| ‘atvasya dravyasya prādurbhāvavināśābhyāṃ
prādurbhāvatirobhāvau yā prāpnoti| yāvaddravyabhāvinītyarthaḥ|
guṇairyugapaddravyeṇa sambadhyate| bahvarthāṃ|
sarvavyaktivyāpinīmityarthaḥ| tāṃ jāti’mityādi kaiyaṭena

yāvaddravyabhāvitvenoktalakṣaṇalakṣitatvājjātivācaka eva putraśabda
iti ṭhasvaṅgeti vā ṅī’ṣiti granthastatra na virudhyate| ṭhākṛtigrahaṇā
jāti’rityādimukhyapakṣāśrayaṇe tu putratvāsyā’jātitvājjāteḥ kiṃ,

anudātānto’yam|

(598) dvitīyā śritātītapatitagatātyastaprāptāpannaiḥ |2|1|24|

ñityādāvapyūhyam| na hi khaṭvetyasya dvitīyāntatvaṃ, gargādīnāṃ

śritāśabdasyaiva ṭābantatvāt, tataḥ ‘trībhyo ḍha’giti ḍhaki

cet| maivam| pradhānastrīpratyaye tadādiniyamā’bhāvena
kāṣṭaśriteyasya nirbādhatvāt| na ca kadācit śritāśabdādapi
ḍhakasyāditi vācyam| jahatsvārthāyāṃ vṛtau

ityāpateriti dik| kṛṣṇaṃ śrita iti| ‘a loke’ti ṣaṣṭhīniṣedhaḥ|
kṛṣṇaśrita iti| ‘rathamanirdiṣṭa’miti dvitīyāntas.ya pūrvanipātaḥ|
yadyapīha śritaśabdo’pi prathamānirdiṣṭastathāpi ‘amāsavidhāyake
prathamānirdiṣṭamupasarjana’mityuktamiti nāstyatiprasaṅgaḥ|
nanvevamavyayādīnāmupasarjanasaṃjñārthamavyayaṃ vibhaktītyādinā
samāsavidhānasyāvaśyakatvāt ‘upsupe’ti samāsyā’nityatve
prāgukjñāpakaṃ na saṃbhavatyeva, tathā
cā’vyayībhāvatatpuruṣādisamāsā’bhāvapakṣe ‘upsupe’ti
samāsapravṛtyā ṭhapa viṣṇoḥ’ṭhpari viṣṇoḥ’ ‘ṛṣṇaṃ śritaḥ’ ṭhrājñaḥ
puruṣa’ityādivigrahavākyāni na sidhdyerannici cet| atrāhuḥ--punaḥ
samāsavidhānaṃ na kevalamupasarjanasaṃjñārthaṃ, tasyāḥ prakārāntareṇāpi
siddheḥ| tathā hi--ṭhprākkaḍārātsamāsaḥ’ityanantaraṃ
‘rathamānirdiṣṭamupasarjanam’, ṭhekavibhakti cāpūrvanipāte’iti
paṭhitvā samāsādhikāre prathamānirdiṣṭamiti
vyākhyāyāmupasarjanasaṃjñā sidhdyatyeva, ṭhvibhaktyarthādiṣutaṭ
vidyamānamavyayaṃ subantena cetsamasyate sa samāso’vyayībhāvaḥ syāt,
dvitīyāntaṃ cetsa samāsastatpuruṣa’
ityevaṃ vyākhyānādavyayībhāvatatpuruṣādisaṃjñāpi sidhyatīti punaḥ
samāsavidhānaṃ vyarthaṃ sajjñāpayatīti| nanu ṭhavyayaṃ vibhakti--’

samāsasyā’nityatve ākaragrantha eva pramāṇam, anyathā
‘innityasamāsayoḥ’iti vārtike ‘ityagrahaṇema nārthaḥ, idamapi siddhaṃ

samāsārambheṇa?| maivam| bahuvrīhau śritakṛṣma iti

(618) ktena ca pūjāyām |2|2|12|
ktena pūjāyām| sūtre upalakṣaṇaṃ pūjāgrahaṇaṃ,
vyākhyānādityāha--matibuddhīti| rājñāmiti| ‘tasya ca vartamāne’iti
kartari ṣaṣṭhī| bhūta iti| na ca takrakauṇḍinyāyena matyādibyaḥ ktasya
vartamānakālo bhūtakālatāṃ bādhata iti vācyaṃ, ‘enaikadi’dityataḥ
‘ena’ ityādhikāre ṭhupajñāte’iti nirdeaśena
bhūtakālasyā’bādhajñāpanāt| ṭhupajñāte’ityatra hi bhūte kto, na tu
vartamāne| anyathā ‘tasya ca vartamāne’iti
ṣaṣṭhīvidhānādupajñataśabdasya teneti| tṛtīyāyogo na syāt| na
caivamapi jñānārtheṣveva jñāpakatvamastviti vācyaṃ, ‘ūjitoḥ yaḥ
surāsuraiḥ’iti prayogānurodhena sāmānyaviṣayajñāpakatvasyaiva
nyāyyatvāt| anye tu kārakaṣaṣṭhaḷa eva samāsaniṣedho’yam,
śeṣaṣaṣṭhaḷa tu samāsaḥ syādevetyāhuḥ| etena ‘alahaṃ sa rāmamahitaḥ
kṛtavā’niti sabhaṭṭiprayogo vyākhyātaḥ| ṭhrāmamahitaḥ sa, kalahaṃ
kṛtavā’nityanvayaḥ|
(619) adhikaraṇavācinā ca |2|2|13|
adhikaraṇavācinā ca|ṭhvāci’drahaṇaṃ cantyaprayojanamiti haradatādayaḥ|
idameṣāmiti| ‘to’dhikaraṇe ce’t ktaḥ| ṭhadhikaraṇavācinaśce’ti
kartari ṣaṣṭhī| ṭhadhikaraṇe ce’tyeva siddhe sūtradvaye’pi ṭhvāci’grahaṇaṃ
spaṣṭārthamityāhuḥ| nanu ‘ivṛtaṃ ṭhyadvṛta’mityatra na karmaṇi ktaḥ,
vṛterakarmakatvāt| tathā cādhikaraṇaktāntena kathamiha samāsa
iticet| maivam| nāyamadhikaraṇe ktaḥ, kiṃ tu ‘atyarthākarmake’ti
kartari| kimā vṛtaṃ niṣpannamityarthaḥ|
(620) karmaṇi ca |2|2|14|
karmaṇi ca| kteneti nānuvartate, ‘tena ca pūjāyā’mati
niṣedhavaiyarthyaprasaṅgāt| ṣaṣṭhī tvanuvartate, kiṃtu sāpi yā
kācitkarmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī na gṛhyate| ṭhapāṃ sraṣṭe’tyādāvanenaiva siddhau
‘ṛjakābhyāṃ kartarī’ti niṣedhavaiyarthyāpateḥ| kiṃ ca
ṭhidhmavraścanaḥ’ityādau samāsasiddhaye vacanaṃ kartavyaṃ syāt| na ca
‘ṛdyogalakṣamā ṣaṣṭhī samasyate’iti vārtikamastyeveti vācyaṃ, tasya
siddhānte pratyākhyānāt| tataśca nipātānāmanekārthatvāditītyarthe
caśabdo’yaṃ, tadāha karmaṇīti yā ṣaṣṭhīti| saptamyekavacanāntaṃ
padamuccārya yā ṣaṣṭhī vihitā pariṣeṣitā vetyarthaḥ|
miyamasūtrāṇāṃ vidhirūpeṇa niṣedharūpeṇa veti dvedhā pravṛteḥ
svīkṛtatvāt| gavāṃ doha iti| ṭhagopene’tyupanyāsastviha
ubhayaprāptipradarśanārthaḥ| atha kathaṃ ‘abdānuśāsana’miti?| atra
vyācakhyuḥ--śabdānāmitīyaṃ ṣaṣṭhī ‘artṛkarmaṇo’riti vihitā, na
tu ṭhubhayaprāptau’ityanena, ācāryasya kartuḥ vastutaḥ
satve’pīhānupādānāt| ‘ṛtvorthaprayoge---’ityataḥ ‘rayoge’
ityanuvartanātkartṛkarmaṇorūpādāna evāyaṃ niyama iti svīkārāt|
ṭhāścāryo gavāṃ doho’gopene’tyatra hi āścaryaṃ pratipādyaṃ tacca
yadyaśikṣito dogdhā durdohā gāvaśca dogdhavyāstadaiva nirvahati
na tvanyathā| ataḥ kartṛkarmaṇorviśiṣyopādānādastūbhayaprāptiḥ, iha
tu ‘abdānāmidamanuśāsanaṃ, na tvarthānā’mityarthanivṛtiparaṃ
vākyaṃ, na tu kartṛviśeṣanivṛtiparamato nāstyubhayaprāptiḥ| astu
yathākathaṃcidubhayaprāptiḥ, tathāpi na kṣatiḥ, ṭhubhayaprāptau’iti sūtre
ṭhaviśeṣeṇavibhāṣe’ti pakṣasyāpi vidyamānatayā
niyamā’pravṛtipakṣeṭhācāryasya śabdānusāsanami’ti prayogasambhavāt|
yadi vā śeṣa lakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhīti vyākhyāyate, tadā tu
samāsaniṣedhaśaṅkaivātra nāstīti|
(621) tṛjakābhyāṃ kartari |2|2|15|
tṛjakābhyāmiha ‘artṛṣaṣṭhaḷa tṛjakābhyā’miti
vṛtikāravyākhyānamayuktamiti dhvayannāha--kartraparthatṛjakābhyāmiti|
‘artṛ’grahaṇaṃ tṛjakayoreva viśeṣaṇamiti yuktaṃ, tayoḥ śrutatvāt,
na tu ṣaṣṭhaḷa iti bhāvaḥ| yadyapi ‘artarī’ti tṛco na
viśeṣaṇamavyabhicārāt, tathāpyakasya viśeṣaṇatvena
tadāvaśyakamityāha--ikṣubhakṣiketi| ‘aryāyārhaṇe’ti bhāve ṇvuc|
karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhaḷa samāsaḥ| nanu ṭhvajrasya bharte’ tyudāharaṇayuktam,
bhartṛśabdasya yājakāditvena
samāsā’vaśyambhāvādityāśaṅkyāha--patyarthabhartṛśabdasyeti| yadyapi
yājakādiṣvarthaviśeṣaviśiṣṭatayā bhartṛśabdo na paṭhitaḥ, tathāpi
rūḍhearbalīyastvātpatiparyāyasyaiva tatra grahaṇam, na tu yaugikasyeti
bhāvaḥ| śeṣaṣaṣṭhaḷeti| nyāsakārastu tṛnnantametat ‘a loke’ti
niṣedhastvanityaḥ, ‘rakābhyā’miti vaktavye tṛcaḥ
sānubandhagrahaṇājjñāpakādityāha| kecutu--ṭhjanikartuḥ’,
‘atprayojako hetuśce’ti nirdeaśādanityo’yaṃ
samāsaniṣedhaityāhuḥ| tanmandam|
śeṣaṣaṣṭhīsamāsenoktanirdeaśopapateḥ|
(622) kartari ca |2|2|16|
neha tṛjiti | na cotarārthatvaṃ śaṅkyam|
tṛckrīḍājīvikayornāstīti jayādityenoktatvāditi bhāvaḥ|
vvāmanastu--ṭhake jīvikārthe’ ityatra ṭhatake’ iti kim?|
‘amaṇīyakate’ti pratyudāharañjīvikāyāṃ tṛcamiccchati|
(623) nityaṃ krīḍṬajīvikayoḥ |2|2|17|
nityaṃkrī| bhāve ṇvuliti| bhañjanaṃ bhañjitā| ‘uṣpāṇā’miti karmaṇi
ṣaṣṭhī| ‘hāve’ityupalakṣaṇam, adhikaraṇe ṇvulyapi bādhakābhāvāditi
matvā ‘aṃjñāyā’miti sūtre kṛdante manoramāyāmuktam ṭhuddālakaḥ
śleṣmākatasatsya puṣpāṇi bhajyanate yasyāṃ krīḍāyāṃ sā
uddālakapuṣpabhañjike’ti|
(624) pūrvāparādharotaramekadeśinaikādhikaraṇe |2|2|1|
pūrvāpara| ṭhekadeśa’śabdo’vayave rūḍhaḥ| ataeva tasya
karmadhārāyatve’pi tato matvarthīyaḥ| ‘ṛṣṇasarpavā’nityatreva ‘a
karmadhārayānmatvarthīyaḥ’iti niṣedhasya rūḍheaṣvapravṛteḥ| yadyapīha
ṭhekagopūrvādi’ti ṭhañ prāptaḥ, tathāpyata eva nirdeaśādiniḥ|
tadetadāha--avayavineti| nanvidaṃ sūtraṃ vyarthaṃ,
‘ūrvakāya’ityādiprayogāṇāṃ karmadhārayeṇaiva siddheḥ,
ṭhūrdhvakāya’itivat, ‘amudāye hi vṛtāḥ śabdā avayaveṣvapi
pravartante’iti nyāyādata āha--ṣaṣaaṭhachīsamāsāpavāda iti| tathā ca
‘āyapūrvaṃ’ityādyaniṣṭaprayoganivṛtaye sūtramiti bhāvaḥ| pūrvaṃ
kāyasyeti| yadyapi ṭhanyārā’diti sūtre ‘iśi dṛṣṭaḥ śabdo
dikśabda’iti vyākhyānena saṃpratyadigvṛtināpi yoge pañcamī
svīkṛteti ṣaṣṭhīha durlabhā, tathāpi ‘asya paramāmreḍita’miti
liṅgāt ṭhavayavavācidikśabdayoge pañcamī ne’tyuktatvātṣaṣṭhaḷeva
bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| pūrva nābheriti| nābheryaḥ pūrvo bhāgaḥ sa
kāyasyāvayava ityarthaḥ| ‘āme’riti digyogalakṣaṇā pañcamī| tenā’tra
pūrvasya bhāgasya nābhiravadhiḥ, na tvekadeśinīti nābhyā saha samāso
netyarthaḥ| kāyena tu syādeva ‘ūrvakāyo nābheḥ’iti| pūrvaśabdasya
nityasāpekṣatvātpradhānatvācca| pūrvaśchātrāṇāmiti| nāsau nirdhāraṇe
ṣaṣṭhī, kiṃ tu samudāyasamudāyisaṃbandhe| bahuvacanaṃ
tadbhūtāvayavabhedasamudāyavivakṣayā| tataśchātrāṇāmekadeśitve
satyapyekatvavaiśiṣṭaḷa’bhāvānna samāsaḥ| sarvo’pīti|
pūrvādibhinno’pītyarthaḥ| jñāpakāditi| anyathā ahnasya sāyapūrvatvaṃ
na syāditi bhāvaḥ| madhyāhna iti| ṭhrājāhaḥsakhibhyāḥ’iti ṭac|
ṭhahnohna’ityahnā deśaḥṣa| ayaṃ cādeśo
madhyāhnasāyāhnaśabdayorūrdhvakāyavatkarmadhārayeṇa na nirvahati,
tasyaikadeśisamāsaprayuktatvāt, ato’tra jñāpakāśrayaṇaṃ yuktameveti
bodhyam| ityāhurutu| na caivaṃ ‘inamadhyo’ ṭhrātrimadhya’ityādi na
sidhyediti vācyam| jñāpakasiddhasyā’sārvatrikatvāt|
(625) arddha napuṃsakam |2|2|2|
ardha napuṃsatam| khaṇḍāvācyarddhaśabdo na nityanapuṃsakaḥ, grāmārddho
nagarārddha iti yathā| samāṃśavācī tu nityanapuṃsakaḥ| sa eveha gṛhyate,
‘ūrvasūtre evārddhaśabde paṭhanīye ṭhardha’mitaci yogavibhāgena
nirdeaśānnapuṃsakatve labdhe, punarnapuṃsakagirahaṇādityāśayena
vyācaṣṭe--nityaṃ klībe sa iti| yo nityanapuṃsakaliṅgiḥ sa
ityarthaḥ| prāgvaditi| ekatvaviśiṣṭenāvayavinā samasyata ityarthaḥ| anye
tu vyācakhyuḥ--ṭhardha’miti nirdeaśādeva napuṃsakatve siddhe
napuṃsakagrahaṇaṃ ‘ūtreṣu liṅganirdeaśo na vivakṣitaḥ’iti
jñāpayitum| ‘ena tasyeda’mityādi liṅgatraye’pi bhavatīti|
ṭhardhapippalī’tyatra ṭhekavibhakti cāpūrvanipāte’ityupasarjanasaṃjñāyāṃ
‘ostrīyo’riti hrasvaḥ syādityāśaṅkya
samādhate--aṣaṭhaḷntavacanamiti| tena
pippalīśabdasyā’nupasarjanatvātanna doṣa iti bhāvaḥ| nanvevaṃ
pañcānāṃ khaṭvānāṃ samāhāraḥ pañcakhaṭvīti na sidhdyet,
upasarjanasaṃjñāniṣedhena khaṭvetyākāre hrasvāpravṛteradantatvābhāvena
‘vigoḥ’iti ṅīpo’pravṛterata āha--|
ekavibhaktāvaṣaṣṭhaḷntavacanam| ekadeśisamāsaviṣayako’miti|
‘añcakhaṭhavī’ti bhāṣyodāharaṇameva ṭhaṣaṭhaḷnto’tyasya saṃkoce
liṅgamitioo bhāvaḥ| ardhapippalīti|
paravalliṅgatvātlastrītvam| ardha pippalīnāmiti| sati samāse
ṭhardhapippalī’tyeva syāt, viśeṣyaikyāt| ‘aravalliṅga’miti
liṅgātideśe’pi vacanātideśā’bhāvācceti bhāvaḥ|
ṭhardhapipalyaḥ’iti prayogastu ṭhardhāni pippalīnā’miti vigrahe
asādhuścedapi khaṇḍasamuccaye sādhureva, ardhaṃ pippalyā ardhapippalī,
ardhapippalī ca ardhapippalī cetyādivigrahāt| ekadeśinā kim?|
ardhaṃ paśordeavadatasya| atra devadataḥ svāmī, na tvavayavīti na tena
samāsaḥ| idaṃ sūtraṃ ‘aravalliṅga’mityatra bhāṣye pratyākhyātam|
tadyathā--ardhaṃpippalīti hi karmadhārayeṇa siddham| ‘amudāye dṛṣṭāḥ
śabdā avayaveṣvapi vartante’iti nyāyāt| samapravibhāgādanyatra
tavāpyeṣaiva gatiḥ, ṭhardhāhāraḥ’ardhoktam’ ṭhardhavilokitam’
ityādiprayogadarśamāt| na ca samapravibhāge ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaṃ
bādhitumidaṃ sūtramiti vācyam, ṣaṣṭhīsamāsasyāpūṣṭatvāt| ataeva
kālidāsaḥ prāyuṅkta--ṭhpremṇā śarīrārdhaharāṃ harasye’ti|
(626) dvitīyatṛtīyacaturthaturyāṇyanyatarasyām |2|2|3|
dvitīyatṛtīyā| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsā pavādo’yaṃ yoga iti
vṛtikṛtoktamayuktamati dhvanayannāha--niṣedhaṃ bādhitveti| 
(627) prāptāpanne ca dvitīyayā |2|2|4|
prāptajīvika iti| ‘ostriyo’rityupasarjanahrasvaḥ|
‘viguprāptāpanne’ti vakṣyamāṇena paravalliṅganiṣedhaḥ| na cedaṃ
bahuvrīhiṇā gatārthamiti śaṅkyam, svare viśeṣāt|
‘rāptasukhaṃ’ityādau niṣṭāntasya ‘ātikālasukhādibhya-’iti
paranipātāpateśca| ‘rāptāpanne ce’ti cakāreṇa
vidheyasamuccayārthenākārapraśleṣānumānāt, prāptāpanne samasyete,
a ca, atvaṃ ca tayoḥ syāditi bhāṣye sthitam| tatra
cakārātpūrvamevā’kāraṃ cchitvā sautratvātprakṛtibhāvo neti prāñcaḥ|
imaṃ kleśaṃ pariharannāha--dvitīyayā a iti| prāptā strīti| ekādeśya
pūrvāntatvena grahaṇālliṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāśaṣayā vā ṭābantayorapi
prāptāpannayoḥ samāsaḥ|
(628) kālāḥ parimāṇinā |2|2|5|
kālāḥ parimāṇinā| parimīyate pariccchidyate yena
tatparimāṇaṃuparicchedakaṃ, tadvānparimāṇī,
tadāha--paricchedyavācineti| kālā iti| kālaviśeṣavācakā ityarthaḥ|
sūtre bahuvacananirdeaśātkālasāmānyasyā’paricchedakatvācca| māso
jātasyeti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāse prāpte vacanam| nanu jātaḥ puruṣastasya tu
hastavatastyādikaṃ paricchedakaṃ, na tu kālaḥ, tasya
kriyāmātrapariccchadakatvāditi cet| atrāhuḥ--sākṣātkriyāṃ
pariccchindannapi kālastaddvārā devadataṃ pariccchinati| yasya hi
jananādūrdhvaṃ māso gataḥ sa ‘āsajāta’ iti vyavahrayate| tatra
vyavahārakālajananakṣaṇayorantalabhāvī māso jananadvārā jātamapi
pariccchinatyeveti| iha vigrahe ṣaṣṭhīnirdiṣṭasyāpi vṛtau prādhānyaṃ
dyotayituṃ ṭhyasya [saḥ’ṭityuktam| alaukike tu prakriyāvākye nāsya
praveśaḥ| evaṃ bahuvrīhāvapīti bodhyam| nanu ‘ātasya māsaḥ’ iti
vigrahe vṛtau māsaśabdasya
pūrvapātārthametatsūtrārambhasyāvaśyakatve’pi māsaviśeṣyakabodha
evatrocita iti kimanena ‘ātasya yasya saḥ’iti kathaneneti cet|
atrāhuḥ--ṭhmāsajāto mṛtaḥ’ityādiprayogānurodhena vigrahe ṭhyasya
saḥ’ iti svīkriyata iti. māsajāta iti| yadyapi māso jāto yasyeti
baha#uvrīhiṇāpīdaṃ sidhyati, ‘ātikālasukhādibhyaḥ parā niṣṭhā
vācye’ti vacanāt| na ca svare viśeṣaḥ| ṭh vā
jāte’ityantodātatvasyāpi siddheḥ, tathāpi
ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāpavādārthamidamārambhaṇīyameva| kiṃ ca māso jātavato
yasya sāmāsajātavānityetadarthamapīdamavaśyārambhaṇīyamiti|
utarapadena parimāṇinā dvigoḥ siddhaye bahūnāṃ
tatpuruṣasyopasaṅkhyānam| utarapadeneti|
parimāṇyutarapadahetukadvigusiddhaye tripadatatpuruṣo vaktavya
ityarthaḥ| ‘upsupe’tyekatvasya vivakṣitatvādaprāpte vacanam|
asmādeva vārtikārambhāt ‘upsupe’ tyekatvaṃ vivakṣitamiti
jñāyate| ahnādeśa iti| trapadatatpuruṣe satyutarapade parataḥ
‘addhitārtha’ityavāntaradvigau satīti bhāvaḥ| pūrvatreti| vdyahajāta
ityatretyarthaḥ|
(629) saptamī śauṇḍṬaḥ |2|1|40|
saptamī śauṇḍṬaḥ| bahuvacananirdeaśādgaṇapāṭhasāmarthyācca
ādyarthāvagatirityabhipretyāha--śauṇḍādibhiriti| akṣaśauṇḍa iti|
śauṇḍaḥupravīṇaḥ| iha āsakti rūpā kriyā vṛtāvantarbhavatīti,
taddvārakaṃ ca sāmarthyam| yathā dadhyodanaguḍadhānādau
upasecanamiśrīkaraṇādidvārā sāmarthyam| tena ‘ārakāṇāṃ kriyayaiva
saṃbandha’ iti niyamasya na vyabhicāraḥ| ādhiśabda iti|
ṭhādheyapradhāna’iti śeṣaḥ| adhikaraṇapradhānasya tvavyayībhāva eva|
adhiharīti yathā| kha iti| ‘itya’miti śeṣaḥ| ṭhvibhāṣāñceḥ’ iti
vibhāṣāgrahaṇasāmarthyāditi vakṣyamāṇatvāt| antaḥ śabdo’tra paṭhaḷte,
sa cādhikaraṇapradhānaḥ| madhye ityarthāt| tadyoge’vayavina
ādhāratvavivakṣāyāṃ saptamī, yathā ṭh vṛkṣe śākhe’ti| vane
antarvanāntarvasati| yastvadhikaraṇakatvamātravṛtirantaḥ śabdastasya tu
ṭhvibhaktyarthe’iti nityamavyayībhāvaḥ| ‘ranirantaḥ śare’ ithi ṇatvam|
vane iti antarvaṇam| yatu tatpuruṣasya vaikalpikatvātpakṣe
avayayībhāva iti haradatenoktam| taccintyam| tatpuruṣasya
vaikalpikatve’pyavyayībhāvasya nityatvādvane antariti
taduktasvapadavigrahasyā’yogāt| kiṃ ca
vibhaktyarthamātravṛteravyayībhāvaḥ, vacanagrahaṇasāmarthyāt| anyathā
vṛkṣasyoparītyādāvatiprasaṅgaḥ syāt| tataśca madhyavācinaḥ
prasaṅgaḥ eva nāstīti dik| śauṇḍa| dhūrta| kitava| vyāḍa| pravīṇa|
saṃvīta| antar| adhi| paṭua| paṇḍita| kuśala| capala| nipuṇa| vṛt|
(630) kṛtyairṛṇe |2|1|43|
kṛtyaiḥ| yartptyayāntenaiva samāsa iṣyate| ṭhalpaśaḥ’ ityanuvṛteḥ|
bahuvacanaṃ tu prakṛtibhedābhiprāyam|
tathaivodāharati--māsedeyamiti| tatpuruṣe kṛtī’tyaluk|
ne--māse dātavyam| niyogopalakṣaṇārthamiti|
niyogo--nirdhāraṇam| āvaśyakopalakṣamārthamityarthaḥ|

(635) taddhitārthotarapadasamāhāre ca |2|1|51|

‘vigorluganapatye’iti lukpravṛteriti bhāvaḥ|

vyutpāditakatamaśabdasāhacaryātādṛśāsyaiva kataraśabdasyāpi grahaṇe
siddhe jātiparipraśnagrahaṇaṃ jñāpayati ‘atamaśa
do’rthāntare’pisādhuḥ’iti| tathā ca pratyudāhṛtaṃ prācīnavṛtiṣu
‘ataro bhavatordeavadataḥ, katamo bhavatāṃ devadataḥ’iti|

(650) puṃvatkarmadhārayajātīyadeśīveṣu |6|3|42|
bhāṣutapuṃskādityādi| etacca ‘triyāḥ puṃva’diti sūtre
sphuṭīkariṣyate| nanu tenaiva karmadhāraye’pi siddhaṃ
jātīyadeśīyayostu ‘asilādiṣvi’ti siddhaṃ, tatkimanena
sūtreṇetyata āha--pūraṇīpriyādiṣviti| tatheti ca| mahānavamīti|
navānāṃ pūraṇī| ‘asya pūraṇe ḍaṭ’ṭhnāntādasaṅkhyādermaṭa’|
ṭitvānṅīp| mahatī cāsau navamī cet vigrahaḥ| puṃvadbhāve
kṛte vakṣyamāṇena mahata ākāraḥ| kopadhāderiti| ‘a kopadhāyāḥ’
‘aṃjñāpūraṇyośca’ ṭhvṛddhinimitasya ca taddhitasyā’raktavikāre’
‘vāhgāccetaḥ’ṭhjāteśce’ti pañcasūtryā pritaṣiddha ityarthaḥ|
krameṇodāharati--pācakastrīti| jātīyadeśayayorapi
pratiprasavamudāharati--evamiti| pācikāprakāravatī pācakajātīyā| ṭh
prakāravacane jātīyar’| pācakadeśīyeti| ṭhīṣadasamāptau’iti
deśīyar| ubhayatra ‘asilādiṣu’iti puṃvadbhāvasya ‘a kopadhāyāḥ’
iti niṣedhaḥ prāptaḥ, paṭuajātīyā paṭuadeśīyetyādau tasya
caritārthatvāt| ityādīti| ādipadāddatajātīyā, pañcamajātīyā,
sraugdhnajātīyā, sukeśajātīyai, brāhmaṇajātīyā| evaṃ
datadeśīyetyādyaudāhāryam| strīpuṃsalakṣaṇeti| stanaśmaśrvādiyuktā
strītyarthaḥ| udaśviditi| ‘akraṃ hyudaśvinmathitaṃ pa#adāmbvārdhā’mbu
nirjala’mityamaraḥ| kaṭhadhūrta iti| nātra kaṭhatvaṃ kutsyate, ataḥ
‘itsitāni kutsanaiḥ’ iti gatārthatā śaṅkyā,
pravṛtinimitakutsāyāmeva tasya pravṛteḥ| ‘anayati kumudabhrānti
dhūrtabako bālamatsyānā’mityatra ‘hūrtabaka’ityasādhureva|

(654) varṇo varṇena |2|1|69|
varṇo| samānādhikaraṇena varṇavācinā varṇavāci samasyata ityarthaḥ|
ṭhviśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇe’tyanenaiva siddhe pṛthagvidhānaṃ ṭhvarṇo
varṇeṣvanete’iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaro vidhīyamānaḥ
pratipadoktatvādetatsamāsapūrvapadasyaiva bhavatu
nānyasyetyetadartham| kṛṣṇasāraṅga iti| sāraṅgaścitraparyāyaḥ| sa
ca guṇopasarjanadravyaparaḥ| kṛṣṇaśabdo’pi kṛṣṇāvayavake bhāktaḥ| evaṃ
ca gauṇe sāmānādikaraṇye ṭhviśeṣaṇaṃ viseṣyeṇe’tyapravutau
samāsārthamapīdamārabdhavyamityāhuḥ| nanu ‘ṛtīye’tyanenaivāyaṃ
samāsaḥ sidhyati, sāraṅgatvasya kṛṣṇādikṛtatvāt| nāpi svare
bhedaḥ| ‘atpuruṣe tulyārtha tṛtīye’tyanenaiva
pūrvapadaprakṛtisvarasiddheriti cedatrāhuḥ--ṭhkṛṣṇaśuklo haritaśukla
ityādyarthaṃ samāso’nenā’vaśyaṃ vidheyaḥ| nahīha tatkṛtatvamasti|
yadyapīha ṭhviśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇe’tyanena samāsaḥ sidhyati, tathāpīṣṭaḥ
svaro na sidhyati| na capratipadoktasamāso’kiñcitkaraḥ,
vyāvartyā’lābāditi vācyaṃ, kṛṣṇaśuklau ityādervyāvartyasya
saṃbhavā’diti|

(658) mayūravyaṃsakādayaśca |2|1|72| 
mayūra| cakāro’trāvadhāraṇārthaḥ| tena ‘aramayūravyaṃsakaḥ’ityādi
samāsāntaraṃ na bhavati| dhūrta iti| evaṃ ca guṇavacanatvātpūrva
nipāte prāpte idaṃ vacanamārabdhamiti bhāvaḥ| anye tu ‘ayūra iva
vyaṃsako mayūravyasaka’ityādau ṭhupamanāni sāmānyavacanai’riti
samāsasyāpavādo’yam| tena ‘amāsasye tyantodātatvamiha
sidhyiti, ‘atpuruṣe
tulyārthe’tyupamānapūrvapadaprakṛtisvarasyopamānasaṃśabdanena
vihite pratipadoktasamāse caritārthatvādityāhuḥ| aśrītapivateti|
iha kriyā rūpasyānyapadārthasya prādhānyātstrītvāṭṭāp| evamagre’pi|
rājantarāmiti| antaraśabdo’tra bhinnavācī| cinmātramiti| ‘ātraṃ
kārtsnye’vadhāraṇe’ityamaraḥ| antara--mātraśabdābhyāṃ saha nityasamāsa
ityubhayatrā’svapadavigrahodarśitaḥ| nityasamāsatvaṃ
tvavadhāraṇārtakacakāreṇa labdhamityāhuḥ| uddhara koṣṭhādityādi| uddhara
utsṛjetyetāvāneva vigrahaḥ| utsṛjetyasya vivaraṇaṃ--dehīti|
koṣṭhāditi tūddharetyasyākāṅkṣāpūraṇārthamuktam| samāsena
cetkarteti| ‘ahi joḍa’mityābhīkṣṇyena ya āha sa jahijoḍaḥ| evaṃ
jahi stambamiti ya āha sa jahistambaḥ|
(659) nañ |2|2|6|
nañ| iha ‘alopo nañaḥ’ityatra viśeṣaṇārtho ñakāraḥ| tatphalaṃ ca
naikadetyatrā’lopaḥ| ṭhavyaye
nañkunipātānā’mityavyayapūrvapadaprakṛti svarārthaṃ
ñakatāroccāraṇamityanye| supā saha samasyata iti|
utarapadārthapradhāno’yaṃ samāsaḥ| tathāhi āropitatvaṃ nañā dyotyate|
tathā ca abrāhmaṇaśabdādāropito brāhmaṇa iti bodhe arthāddbrahmaṇabhinna
iti paryavasyati| ataevā’nusarjanatvādatasminnasa ityādau
sarvanāmakāryaṃ sidhyati|
tatpuruṣasyautsargikamutarapadārthaprādhānyamapyevaṃ sati nirbādham|
ṭhetatado’riti sūtre’nañsamāsagrahaṇaṃ ceha liṅgamityādi
manoramāyānusandheyam|
(660) nalopo nañaḥ |6|3|73|
nalopo nañaḥ| ‘año’śi’ti vaktavye nalopavacanaṃ sākackārthaṃ,
tena naño’kaci ṭhakabrāhmaṇaḥ’ṭhakanaśca’ityādi siddhamityāhuḥ| utarapade
iti| ṭhalugutarapade’ityadhikārāditi bhāvaḥ| utarapade kim?| ghaṭo
nāsti| paṭo nāsti| nanvevamapi ‘traiṇā’rthaḥ’ ityatra nalopaḥ
syāditi cedatrāhuḥ--utarapadākṣiptapūrvapadena nañaṃ viśeṣya
‘ūrvapadabhūtasya nañaḥ’iti vyākhyānānna bhavati| ‘trīpuṃsābhyā’miti
vihitasya nañpratyayasyā’pūrvapadatvāt| ataeva cā’tra
‘ratyayā’pratyayoḥ pratyayasyaiva grahaṇa’miti parubhāṣā nopatiṣṭhate| na
ca pratyayagrahaṇe tadantagrahaṇānnañapratyayāntasya pūrvapadatvaṃ
saṃbhavatyeveti ‘ratyayāpratyayayo’rityetadupatiṣṭhata eveti vācyaṃ,
ṭhhṛdayasya hṛlleke’ti sūtre’ṇgrahaṇātpṛthaglekhagrahaṇena ṭhutarapadā
dhikāre pratyayagrahaṇe tadantagrahaṇaṃ nāstī’ti jñāpanāt| yadvā
ṭhamūrdhamastakāt’ṭhvibhaktāvaprathamāyā’mityādijñāpakāt ‘alopo
nañaḥ’ ityatrā’vyayameva nañ gṛhyate, na tu pratyaya iti|
(661) tasmānnuḍaci |6|3|74|

(665) anukaraṇaṃ ca’nitiparam |1|4|62|
anukaraṇaṃ cā| ‘e prāgdhātoḥ’ityasya saṃjñāniyamapakṣe’nitīti
vyarthamiti matvā pṛtaccchati anitiparaṃ kimiti| itarastu
prayoganiyamapakṣe khāḍityanukaraṇasyetiśabde pare
gatisaṃjñānivāraṇāyā’nitiparamityāvaśyakamiti pratyudāharati
khāḍiti kṛtveti| satyāṃ saṃjñāyāmeṣa prayogo naiva syātkiṃtu ṭhiti
khāṭakṛtye’tyeva syāditi bhāvaḥ| na ca ṭhiti khāṭakṛtye’ti na bhavati,
iteḥ parasyānukaraṇasya gatisaṃjñāniṣedhāditi vācyam,
ṭhanitipara’mityatra itiḥ paroyasmātaditiparaṃ, na
itiparamanitiparamiti bahuvrīhighaṭitanañtatparuṣāśrayaṇāt|
syādetat--anukaraṇasyetiśabdaparatve kriyāyogā’bhāvādgatisaṃjñā
nāstacīti khāḍiti kṛtveti rūpaṃ nirbādhaṃ,
kimanenā’nikiparagrahaṇeneti cet, atrāhuḥ-- itikṛtveti
samupadāye evaṃkṛtvetyarthe vartate| tathā ca itiśabdaḥ kriyāviśeṣaka
iti taddhaṭitasamudāyasya kriyāvāca katvādastyeva kriyāyoga iti|

(674) sākṣātprabhṛtīni ca |1|4|74|

(678) jīvikopaniṣadāvaupamye |1|4|79|
supuruṣa iti| kriyāyogā’bhāvādgatitvā’bhāvaḥ| avyavasthayā

ubhayatra prakāre| tena durācāraḥ puruṣo duṣpuruṣa ityādi siddham|
pragata ācārya iti| anena gatārthe vṛtimasvapadavigraheṇa
nityasamāsatāṃ ca darśayati| evaṃ pragataḥ pitāmahaḥ prapitāmahaḥ|
pramātāmaha ityādi| 
atyādayaḥ krāntādyarthe dvitīyayā| atyādaya iti| ādipadādabhigatā
mukhamabhimukhaḥ| udgato velāmudvelaḥ| pratigato’kṣaṃ pratyakṣa ityādi
siddham| atimāla iti| ‘ostriyo’riti hrasvaḥ|
avādayaḥ kruṣṭādyarthe tṛtīyayā| avādaya iti| ādipadātpariṇaddho
vīrudhā pari vīrut| saṃnaddho varmaṇā saṃvarmeti| 
paryādayo glānādyarthe caturthyā| paryādaya iti| ādipadādudyauktaḥ
saṅgrāmāya--utsaṅgrāmaḥ| adhyayanāyeti| tādarthye caturthī|
gurukulavāsādinā pariglāno’dhyayanārthamityarthaḥ|
nirādayaḥ krāntadyarthe pañcamyā| nirādaya iti| ādipadādutkrāntaḥ
kulādutkulaḥ| nirgatamaṅgulibhyo niraṅgulam| pratiṣedha iti|
‘ugatiprādayaḥ’iti prasaktasamāsasya vaktavyaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ, sa ca ‘urājā,
atisakhe’ti bhāṣyādiprayāgātsvatibhinnanāmeva
karmapravacanīyānāmityarthaḥ|
karmupravacanīyānāṃ pratiṣedhaḥ| vṛkṣaṃ pritīti| ‘akṣaṇettha bhūte’ti
karmapravacanīyatvavidhisāmarthyādiha samāso neti cet, tarhi api
stutatamityudāhāryam| ṭhapi stuyādviṣṇu’mityādau ṭhapiḥ
padārthasaṃbhāvane tyasya sābakāśatvātsvare viśeṣasatvāccatyāhuḥ|
(679) tatropapadaṃ saptamīstham |3|1|92|
tatropapadam| ‘aptamīstha’mityetavdyācaṣṭe--saptamyanta ityādinā|

pṛthagadhikārabalāt ‘aṃnihite dhātvadhikāre’iti labhyate| tena
‘li luṅī’tyasya luṅnte’bhūdityādāvupapade dhātościlarityartho
na bhavati ‘atra grahaṇaṃ vyācaṣṭe---tasmin satyeveti| upapade
satyevetyarthaḥ| tatragrahaṇā’bhāve tu ‘haḥ karmaṇi ṣṭra’nnityādāviva
‘armaṇya’ṇityādāvapi karmaṇyabhidheye’ṇityādyarthaḥ syāt| kiṃca
saptamyantanirdeaśasyopapadasaṃjñārthatayā caritārthatvātkevalādapi
dhātoḥ kartaryaṇpratyayaḥ saṃbhābyeta| kṛte tu ‘atra’grahaṇe
kumbādyaupapadasya pratyayotpatau nimitatva pratītyā
kevalādaṇpratyayaśaṅkaiva nāsti| evaṃ sthiteḥ ‘haḥ karmaṇī’tyādau
kvacidarthagrahaṇaṃ vyākhyānādityāhuḥ| anye tu ‘atropapada’mityasya
‘armaṇya’ ṇityādeścaikavākyatayā pravṛtāvupapadasaṃjñāyā
niparviṣayatvāpatestatragrahaṇaṃ vināpaṣṭiṃ siddyatyevetyāhuḥ|
(680) upapadamatiṅ |2|2|19|
samartheneti| tena ‘ahāntaṃ kumbhaṃ karotī tyādī nātiprasaṅgaḥ|
atiṅntaśceti| subiti tu anuvartata eveti atiṅntamiti
noktamiti bhāvaḥ| kumbha asiti| amiti tu noktaṃ, kṛdyoge
ṣaṣṭhīvidhānāt| atiṅ kimiti| supetyadhikārātkimaneneti
praśnaḥ|itaro vakṣyamāṇaṃ jñāpakaṃ manasi nidhāya pratyudāharati---mā
bhavāniti| samāsā’bhāvasūcanāya ‘havā’niti madhye prayuktam|
pūrvasūtra iti| ‘uprādayaḥ’ ‘atiḥ’iti yogaṃ vibhajya ‘uprādayaṛ
subantāḥ subantena samasyante, gatistu subanto’tiṅntena
samasyate’iti vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tathāceti| yadyapyuktarītyā
gatyupapadayoreva lābhaḥ, tathāpi tritayaviṣayiṇī prācāṃ paribhāṣā
ekadeśānumatidvārā ihāpi jñāpyata iti bhāvaḥ| kārakāṃśe tu
‘artṛkaraṇe kṛte’ti sūtrasthabahulagrahaṇamuktārthe sādhakamityapi
manorathāyāṃ sthitam| prāgiti| kṛdantāccaramapadātsubutpateḥ
pūrvaṃ samāsa ityarthaḥ| prathamāntasubgrahaṇaṃ tvihānuvartata eva, tena
‘ājadarśī’ tyādau pūrvapade nalopādi kārya siddyati|
paribhāṣāphalaṃ darśayan gatimudāharati--vyāghrīti| vyājighratīti
vyāghrī| ṭhātaścopasarge’iti iti kaḥ| ‘āghrādhmādhe’ḍiti śastu
saṃjñāyāṃ na bhavati, vyāghrādibhiriti nirdeaśāditi vakṣyate| vyāṅe
‘hra’śabdena gatisamāsaḥ| sa yadi ghraśabdasya subantatāmāpekṣeta, tarhi
subutpataye saṅkhyādyapekṣyaṃ, tataḥ prāgeva liṅgayoga iti
liṅganimitapratyayena ṭāpā bhāvyaṃ na tu RūĀṣā| ghra śabdamātrasya
jātivācitvā’bhāvāt, tato ghrāśabdena samāsa
ityadantatvā’bhābājjātilakṣaṇo ṅīṣ na syāditi bhāvaḥ|
yadyapyupapadatvenāpyetatsiddhaṃ tathāpi gatigrahaṇamāṅe ghraśabdena
samāse paścādāghraśabdena viśabdasya samāsārthamāvaśyakameva|
āṅpūrvāddhātoḥ kapratyayavidhānādāṅyupapadasaṃjñābhyupagame’pi
viśabde tadanabhyupagamāditi bodhyam|
kārakamudāharati--aśvakrītīti| aśvena krīti| ‘artṛkaraṇe kṛte’ti
samāsaḥ| ‘rītātkaraṇapūrvā’diti ṅīṣ| subantena samāse tu ṭāpā
bhāvyamityadantatvā’bhāvāt ‘rītātkaraṇa---’ ityaye ṅīṣ na syāditi
jñeyam| upapadamudāharati--kaccchapīti| kacchena pibatīti kaccchamī|
‘upi’iti yogavibhāgātkaḥ| ihāpi samāsasya subantatāpekṣāyāṃ
ṭābeva syānna ṅīṣityādi vyāghrātyatreva bodhyam|
prācātuṭhupapadamatiṅntaṃ samasyate’ityuktaṃ, tadasat, tathā sati
prathamāntasubgrahaṇanivṛtyāpatyā ṭhrājadarśī’ṭhcarmakāra’ityādau
nalopo na syāt, padāntatvāt| prāṭitetyādau ṭhato guṇe’ iti
pararūpaṃ ca syāt| syādetat--kacchena sādhanena
pibatītiyarthābhyupagame kaccchasya kārakatvena kaccchapīti rūpasiddhau
nedamupapadasyā’sādhāraṇodāharaṇamiti cet, evaṃ tarhi
‘hāṣavāpiṇī’tyudāhartavyam| ‘upyajātau’iti ṇinau kṛte
māṣopapadasya kṛdantena samāse
‘rātipadikānte’tyādināpūrvapadasthānnimitātparasyā
samāsapratipadikāntanakārasya ṇatvaṃ siddyati| subantena samāse
tvantaraṅgatvānnāntalakṣaṇe ṅīpi paścādvāpinīśabdena samāse
gargabhaginītyatreva ṇatvaṃ na syādityeke| anye tu kacchena hetunā
pibatītyarthavivakṣāyāṃ
kaccchasyā’kārakatvātkaccchapūtyupapadasyodāharaṇaṃ samyagevetyāhuḥ| 
(681) amaivāvyayena |2|2|20|
amaivāvyayena| pūrveṇa siddhe niyamārthamidam| tulyavidhanamiti|

‘vādumi ṇamul’| avyayeneti kim?| kumbhakāraḥ| asati

tathā sati ‘vāduṅkāraḥ’ityatraiva samāsaḥ syānna tu ‘umbhakāra’ityatra
atha pūrvasūtravaiyarthyabhītyā’byayaviṣayakaniyama eva iti cetarhi
amntaviṣayaka eva kiṃ na syāt ṭhamantena yaḥ samāsaḥ so’maiva

(684) tatpuruṣasyāṅguleḥ saṅkhyāvyayādeḥ |5|4|86|

ahargrahaṇaṃ dvandvartham| dvandvārthamiti| ṭhahno rātri’riti

gauṇagrahaṇā’yogāt| ṭhhemantaśiśirāvahorātre ce’tyatra dvandve

(687) ahno’dantāt |8|4|7|

ataṣṭābebātra yuktaḥ| tathaivodāharati--

‘aramamahatparimāṇa’mityatra tu paramamahato dravyasya parimāṇamiti

tadbhāṣyakaiyaṭaviruddham| tathāhi--ṭhyena vidhi’riti sūtre
padādhikāre prayojanamiṣṭakacitaṃ pakveṣṭakacitamiti bhāṣye
udāhṛtaṃ, kaiyaṭena ca padaśabdena utarapadaṃ gṛhyata iti vyākhyātam|
etadevā’rthataḥ kāśikāyāmupanibaddaṃ na tu ṭh iṣṭakeṣīke’tyatra
kātyāyanoktamupasaṅkhyānamasti| nanu pratipadoktasamāse
yadutarapadaṃ tasminneva pare ātvaṃ syānnanyatreti kimanena
samānādhaikaraṇagrahaṇenetyata āha--mahābāhuriti | bahuvrīhirayam,
sa ca sāmānyaśāstranirvṛtatvāllākṣaṇika iti bhāvaḥ| aṣṭanaḥ kapāla
iti| kapāle utarapade haviṣi vācye aṣṭana ātvaṃ vaktavyamityarthaḥ|
aṣṭākapāla iti| ‘aṃskṛtaṃ bhakṣāḥ’ ityaṇaḥ ‘vigorluganapatye’iti
luk| ṭhadhyardhapūrve’tyaṇo lugiti keṣāṃcidvyākhyānaṃ tu
prāmādikaṃ, ‘aṃskṛta’mityaṇo’nāhīyatvāt|
