(704) tatpuruṣayoḥ |2|4|26|
paravalliṅgam| itaretarayoge dvandvo’tra gṛhyate na samāhāre
dvandvaḥ, ‘a napuṃsaka’mityapavādasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt| sūtre
‘vandvatatpūruṣayo’riti na saptamīdvivacanam, tathātve dvandve
tatpuruṣe ca yatparapadaṃ tadvalliṅgaṃ pūrvapadasyātidiśyeta,
parapadasya saṃbandhiśabdatvena pūrvaṃpadākṣepakatvāt, tataśca mayūrī
kukkuṭāvityatra pūrvapade īkāranivṛtiprasaṅgaḥ| kukkuṭamayūryau,
arddhapippalītyādau tu pūrvapade strīpratyaya utpadyeta| kiṃ tu
ṣaṣṭhīdvivacanamityāśayenāha--etayoriti|
dvandvatatpuruṣārthayorityarthaḥ| evaṃ cānuprayoge’pi tadeva liṅgaṃ
siddham| upameye ṣaṣṭhaḷbhyupagamādvatirapi
ṣaṣṭhaḷntādevetyāśayenāha--parapadasyeveti| bhāṣye tu
‘iṅgamaśiṣyaṃ, lokāśrayatvālliṅgasye’ti pratyākhyātamidaṃ
sūtram| asmiṃśca pratyākhyāne tulyanyāyatvālliṅganuśāsanaṃ
sarvameva pratyākhyātaṃ, tathāpi tatprauḍhivādamātram| anyathā
vyākaraṇasyaiva vaiyarthyāprasaṅgāt|
dviguprāptāpannālaṃpūrvagatisamāseṣu pratiṣedho vācyaḥ|
gatisamāseṣviti| gatigrahaṇaṃ prādīnāmupalakṣaṇaṃ prādīnāmulakṣaṇaṃ,
mukhyasya gaterasaṃbhavādityāśayenodāharati---niṣkauśāmbiriti|
atantramiti| atra ca liṅgaṃ ‘ūrvava’dgrahaṇam| anyathā nipātanādeva
siddhe kiṃ teneti bhāvaḥ| iha samāsārthasya vā
pūrvavalliṅgātideśaḥ, utarapadārthasya vā, ubhayathāpyaśvavaḍavau
śobhanāvityanuprayoge’pi puṃstvaṃ sidhyati| nanu samāsārthasya
puṃstve’pi svāśrayastrītvasyā’nivartanāṭṭāpaḥ śravaṇaprasaṅgaḥ| na
cātideśavaiyarthyaṃ, śasi natvapravṛtyā, anuprayoge
puṃliṅgatvalābhena ca tatsārthakyāditi cedatrāhuḥ--ihaiva
nipātanāt, ṭhaśvavaḍavapūrvāparādharotarāṇā’mityatra nipātanādvā
ṭāpo nivṛtiriti|
(705) rātrāhnāhāḥ puṃsi |2|4|29|

puṃstvaṃ vidhīyate| tadantasya tu ‘aravalliṅga’mityeva sidhyati|
ataeva bhinnaviṣayatvāt ṭhvipratiṣedhe paraṃ kārya’miti na pravartate|
evaṃ ca ṭhrātrāhnāhāḥ’iti puṃstvā’pravṛtyā samāhāre ‘a
napuṃsaka’mityeva bhavati, paravalliṅgāpavādatvāditi| tanna |
uktarītyā vdyahatryahādāvapi napuṃsakatvaprasaṅgāt| na ceṣṭapatiḥ|

virodhāpateḥ| ‘e tu triṃśadahorātraḥ’ityādikośavirodācca|

napuṃsakau’ ‘aṅkhyāpūrvā rātriḥ’iti liṅgānuśāsanasūtraṃ

(711) sa napuṃsakam |2|4|17|
sa napuṃsakam| ṭhanantarasye’ti nyāyo’tra nāśrīyate, tathātve
dvihusaṅgraho na syādityāśayenāha---dvigurdvandvaśceti|atra
vyācakṣate--prakaraṇādevānuvādyalābhe ‘a’
grahaṇametatprakaraṇānupātasyāpi samāhāradvandvasya saṅgrahārtham, tena
‘añjñāparibhāṣa’mityādi siddhamiti| pañcagavamiti|
‘addhitārtha’ityādinā samāhāre dviguḥ| dantoṣṭhamiti| ‘vandvaśca
prāṇī’tyādinā samāhāre dvandvaḥ| 
ābanto vā| pañcakhaṭvamiti napuṃsakahrasvaḥ| pañcakhaṭvīti|
upasarjanahrasvasvatve satyadantatvāt ‘vigo’riti strītvapakṣe ṅīp|
ano nalopaśca vā dviguḥ striyām| ano nalopaśceti| ṭhutarapadatve
cāpadādividhau’iti pratyayalakṣaṇapratiṣedhādaprāpte nalopa iti bhāvaḥ|
iha vāśabdaḥ striyāmityanena saṃbadhyate, natu pūrveṇa| tena nityo
nalopa ityāha--pañcatakṣamityādi|
pātrādyantasya na | pātrādyantasyeti| ‘trītva’miti śeṣaḥ|
ākṛtigaṇo’yam|
puṇyasudinābhyāmahnaḥ klībateṣṭā| sudināhamiti| praśastaparyāyaḥ
sudiśabdaḥ, ‘udināsu samāsu kāryametatpravicinvīta viśeṣataḥ
svayaṃ ca’ityādiprayogāt|
pathaḥ saṅkhyāvyayādeḥ| pathaḥ saṅkhyāvyayeti| saṃkhyāvyayarūpo ya
ādistasmādityarthaḥ| trapathaṃ vipathamiti,---ṭhṛkpūrabdhūḥ’ityapratyayaḥ|
supanthāḥ atipanthā iti| ‘a pūjanā’diti samāsantaniṣedhaḥ| kathaṃ
tarhi ṭhvyadhvo duradhvā vipathaḥ tadadhvā kāpathaḥ samāḥ’ityamara iti
cet, pramāda evāyamiti bahavaḥ| manoramāyāṃ tu ‘athe
gatau’ityasmātpacādyaci pathati vyāpnotīti vyutpāditaḥ
pathaśabdo’sti| tathā ca trikāṇḍaśeṣaḥ---ṭhvāṭaḥ pathaśca mārgaḥ
syā’diti| tena pathaśabdena samāse puṃstvamupapannam| na caivaṃ
vipathasiddhāvapi kāpatho na syātkādeśasya durlabhatvāditi vācyam,
ṭhīṣadarthe ce’ti tatsambhavāt, kutsāyāmarthataḥ paryavasānāditi
sthitam| kecitu---ṭhpathaḥ saṃkhye’ti vārtike kṛtasamāsāntasyaiva
grahaṇaṃ na tu pacādyajantasyetyatra bījā’bhāvādvipathaḥ kāpatha iti
prayogo durupapāda evetyāhuḥ| atra
mādhavaḥ--ṭhparavalliṅgāpavādatvātatpuruṣa evedaṃ pravartate nānyatra|
vipathā nagarī| bahuvrīhirayam| pantānamatikrāntā atipathā| ihāpi
na, ‘viguprāpte’tyādinā paravalliṅgatāyāḥ pratiṣedhāditi| 
sāmānye napuṃsakam| sāmānye napuṃsakamiti|
aniyataliṅgaviṣayakamidam| tenādiṃ pacati, prātarādiriti
puṃstvameva| mṛdu pacatīti| kriyāviśeṣaṇatvāddvitīyāntam|
dhātupātabhāvanāṃ prati hi phalāṃśaḥ karmībhūtaḥ | tathā ca
phalasāmānādhikaraṇyedvitīyā| ataeva sakṛllvāvityādau
kārakapūrvakatvādyaṇ| yatra tu bhāvanāṃ prati karaṇatayā
dhātvarthaviśeṣo’nveti tatra tadviśeṣaṇānāṃ tṛtīyāntataiva,
‘yotiṣṭomena yajete’tyatra yathā| etacca ‘araṇe yajaḥ’ iti sūtre
vṛtipadamañjaryoḥ spaṣṭam|

rājamanuṣyapūrvatve śālāvācinaḥ klībatvamuktam, anena tu

(717) vibhāṣā senāsurācchāyāśālāniśānām |2|4|25|
vibhāṣā senā| prāthamārthe ṣaṣṭhīti senādibhistatpuruṣo viśeṣyate|
viśeṣaṇena tadantavidhistadāha--etadanta iti| śvaniśamiti|
kṛṣṇacaturdaśī| tasyāṃ kila kecicchavāna upavasanti| etacca
śāvarabhāṣye tiryagadhikaraṇe spaṣṭam|
‘atpuruṣa’ityādyadhikārasūtrasyātraiva prayojanaṃ, na tu ‘aṃjñāyāṃ
kanthośīnareṣu’ityādipañcasūtryām| atatpuruṣasyaca nañsamāsasyā
karmadhārayasya ca tatrā’sambhavādityākare sthitam| tathaiva
pratyudāharati----dṛḍhasena ityādi| nanu bahuvrīhau
viśeṣyaninghatā nyāyyaiveti kimanena tatpuruṣagrahaṇena?| maivam|
nyāyāpekṣayā vacanasya balīyastvāt| kiṃ cā’sati tadgrahaṇe dvandve
napuṃsakatā syātparavalliṅgāpavādatvādasya prakaraṇavādatvādasya
prakaraṇasyeti dik| iti tatpuruṣaḥ||


 (1187) prāgvahateṣṭhak |4|4|1|

pratyayavidhiḥ, śabdo mākārīti yo niśedhati sa
‘āśabdika’ityucyate| tathā nityaḥ śabda iti ya āha sa
‘aityaśabdikaḥ’| ‘āryaśabdikaḥ’| iha vākyāddvitīyā na sambhavati,

(1200) trermamnityam |4|4|20|
trermamnityam| nityagrahaṇaṃ svātantryeṇa prayogaṃ vārayitum|
ataeva laulike vigrahavākye ‘tinnadīnāṃ prayogo , na tu treḥ,
tadāha---kṛtyā nirvṛtamiti| evamagre’pi pākena nirvṛtamiti
vigraho bodhyaḥ| saṅkhyāvācī triśabdo neha gṛhyate,
pratyayā’pratyayayoḥ pratyayasyaiva grahaṇāt, ṭhṇijāṃ trayāṇā’miti
liṅgācca| nanu nityagrahaṇena nirvṛtārthavivakṣāyāṃ mapaṃ vinā
tripratyayāntasya prayoganivāraṇe’pi tadavivakṣāyāṃ tasya
svātantryeṇa prayogo durvāra iti cet| na| ‘itya’miti yogaṃ
vibhajya tatsāmarthyādartha viśeṣānādareṇaiva svātantryavāraṇāt|
imabiti| evaṃ ca map kartavyaḥ|
bhāvapratyayāntādimabvaktavyaḥ| tathā hi---ṭhbhāvapratyayāntādimap|
tataḥ ‘reḥ’| pūrveṇa siddhe niyamārthamidaṃ,---tripratyayānta imabviṣaya
eveti| tena tripatyayāntasya prayogo nivartate| tato ‘ityam’|
anena nirvṛtārthā’vivakṣāyāmapi tryantasya svātantraṃ vāryate| evaṃ ca
saṅkhyāvācitriśabdasya grahaṇaśaṅkaiva nāsti,
‘hāvapratyayāntā’dityanuvṛteḥ| svare’pi viśeṣo nāsti,
udātanivṛtisvareṇa imapa ikārasyodātatvāt|

(318) bhrasjo ropadhayo ramanyatarasyām |6|4|47|
bhrasjo ropadhayoḥ| ramyakāra uccāraṇārthaḥ| ṭhra’mityasyā’ntyādacaḥ
paratve ṭhropadhayo’riti ṣaṣṭhīnirdeaśasya vaiyarthyamāśaṅkyāha--
nivṛtiriti| ayaṃ bhāvaḥ-- sthāniviśeṣalābhāya mitvasya karaṇānna
ropadhayoḥ sthāne ram bhavati| yatra hyanirdhāritaḥ sthānaṣaṣṭhaḷa
nirdiśya vidhīyate sa tatsthāne bhavati| yathā ṭhiko yaṇacī’tyādau
yaṇādiḥ| prakṛte tu ramo nirdiṣṭastānikatvādopadhayoḥ sthāne na
bhavati| eṃ cāsya ādeśāgamatve bhavati, yathā śnamaḥ pratyayāgamatve’
iti| anye tvetādṛg vyākhyānamayuktamiti matvā ‘anaḥ kticī’tyato
lopamanuvartya bhrasjo ropadhayorlopaḥ,ram tu āgama evetyāhuḥ|
pare tu-- ‘hrasjo rasaranyatarasyā’mityeva sūtramastu| ṭhrasaḥ--
ṛ’iti cchedaḥ| ṭhrasa’ iti rephā’kārasakārāṇāṃ yaḥ saṅghātastasya ṭhṛ’
ityādeśaḥ syādityarthaḥ| tataśca akṅiti bharjako bharjanaṃ
babharjetyādi sidhyati| ṛkārā’bhāvapakṣe tu bhrajjako bhrajjanaṃ
babhrajjetyādi| kṅiti tu ṛkārapakṣe bhṛṣṭiḥ bhṛjyādityādi|
tadabhāve saṃprasāraṇe sati tadeva rūpam| evaṃca barībhṛjyata ityādau
rīko rephasya nivṛtiṃ vārayitum ṭhanudātopadeśe’ tyata
upadeśagrahaṇamanuvartyam, idānīṃ tu nānuvartyaṃ, ‘ṅiti
ramāgamaṃ bādhitvā saṃprasāraṇa’mati pūrvavipratiṣedhaśca na kartavya
iti mahadeva lāghavamityāhuḥ| idaṃ ca ṭhrasorvacanātsiddha’miti
vārtikāśayavarṇanameva na tvapūrvam| rṭhvacanā’dityas vā
ṛvacanāditi chedaḥ| bhāṣyakāraistu ‘ūtraṃ bhidyate yatānyāsamevāstu’
iti vadadbhirasyāṃ kalpanāyāṃ duṣṭatvaṃ sūcitaṃ| tacca manorayāmāṃ
spaṣṭameva| tathā hi rephā’kārasakārasamudāyasya ṛbhāve pañca
doṣāḥ| apilliṭi babharjutaḥ babharjurityādīṣyate, babhṛjatuḥ
babhṛjurityādi syāt| na cā’tra guṇena nirvāhaḥ, ṛbhāve sati
ṭhasaṃyogālliṭ ki’diti kitvapravṛtyā tanniṣedhāt| ‘anīvante’ti
iḍvikalpādvibharkṣatītyādi iṣyate, bibhṛkṣatītyādi syāt| ṛbhāve
ṭhhalantācce’ti sanaḥ kitvapravṛteḥ| liṅsicostaṅbhirkṣīṣṭa
abharṣṭetyādīṣyate, bhṛkṣīṣṭa abhṛṣṭetyādi syāt| ‘iṅ
sicāvātmanepadeṣu’ iti kitvāt| ṇijantāccaṅ ibabharjaditīṣyate|
abībhṛjadityapi syāt| irarārāmapavādatvena ṭhurṛditi
ṛtvapravṛtau ‘anvallaghunī’ti sanvadbhāvāt ‘anyataḥ itītve
‘īrgho lagho’riti pravṛteḥ| yadyapi ṭhurṛ’dityasya
vaikalpikatvādababharjaditi sidhyatyeva tathāpi pakṣe
abībhṛjadityaniṣṭaṃ sya#aditi bodhyam| ṭhṛjibhṛjī bharjane’ iti
bhvādestādṛśaṃ rūpamiṣṭamiti cet| maivam| bharjanārthe hi

prācīnāścatvāro doṣāstu dṛḍhā eva| hi te’pi dhātvantareṇa
supariharāḥ| apilliṭi bhṛjerapi dhātorguṇā’bhāvādanudātatvena

phiḍaphiḍḍapratyayau kutrāpi na vihitau arteruhyaete ṛphiḍaḥ ṛphiḍḍa
iti, tayoḥ kitavaṃ ca kalpyate| tathā ṣaṇḍha ityatra
satvā’bhāvaścetyādi| saṃjñāsviti| anādisaṃjñāsveva, na tu
sarvāsvityāhuḥ| ṭhhṛṣerula’jiti pratyayaṃ dṛṣṭvā śaṅkiḥ
prakṛtiruhyate| tena śaṅkuleti siddham| ṛ gatāvityādibhyaḥ
phiḍāphiḍḍādipratyayā gṛhyante| kāryādvidyāditi| ṭhṛphiḍa’ ityādau
guṇapratiṣedhādikāryānurodhādanubandhaṃ kakārādikaṃ vidyāt|
anūbandhamityatra ṭhupasargasya ghañī’ti dīrghaḥ| etaduṇādiṣu śāstraṃ u
śāsitavyamityarthaḥ|

(1569) ākrośe nañyaniḥ |3|3|112|
ākrośe| ākrośaḥṛ-śāpaḥ| napuṃsake bhāve ktaḥ| nanu ‘ayoreva
kṛtyaktakhalarthāḥ’ iti liṅgatrayasādhāraṇyena bhāvakarmaṇoḥ
kṛtyādividhānātenaiva napuṃsake bhāve ktaḥ sidhyati, kimanena
punarvidhāneneti cet| atrāhuḥ-- ‘hūte’ ityadhikṛtya ‘iṣṭhā’ iti
sūtreṇa vihitasya ktasya bhāvo’rthaḥ ‘ayoreve’ti sūtreṇa vihitaḥ,
anena tu kālasāmānye napuṃsake bhāve kto vidhīyate| evaṃ ca
svaviṣaye paratvāddhañajapāṃ bādhaka iti pariśeṣādevaiṣāṃ
puṃviṣayatvaṃ sidhyati| kiṃca iha ‘hāve cā’karmakebhya’
ityasyā’sannidhānātsakarmakebhyo’pyayaṃ bhavati, ghañādivat| ‘ataṃ
tiriścīnamanūrusāratheḥ’ ityādidarśanāt| tathā ca nāstyatra
śaṅketi| nanvevaṃ kṛdyoge karmaṇi dvitīyā syāt,
kṛdyogalakṣaṇaṣaṣṭhaḷa ‘a loke’ti niṣedhāt| evaṃ ca ‘haṭṃa kṛtaṃ’
vṛkṣaṃ bhinna’mityādi prasajyeta| ṭhanūrusārathe’rityatra tu kartari

(1607) ābhīkṣṇye ṇamul ca |3|4|22|

tu ‘a yadyanākāṅkṣe’ ityatra ktvāpratyayavallaḍādirapi na siddhyet|
tathā ca ṭhyadayaṃ bhuṅkte tataḥ paṭhatī’tyudāharaṇaṃ na syāt|
siddhānte tu ṭhābhīkṣṇye ṇamulce’ti viśeṣavihitayoḥ
ktvāṇamuloreva niṣedhātsāmānyavihitalaḍādirbhavatyeveti
nāstyevā’nupapatiriti dik|pūrvaviṣaya iti| ‘amānakartṛkayoḥ

(1622) upadaṃśastṛtīyāyām |3|4|47|

upadasya | kimupadaśya ?| arthānmūlakamiti saṃbadhyate| etāvataiveti|

upapūrvakāddaśerṇamuliti vyākhyāyatāṃ, kimanayā kusṛṣṭaḷeti| na

khamuñ’ ‘armaṇa# dṛiśivido’ rityārabhya vā vikalpa iti sandehasya
ṭhvyākhyānato viśeṣapratipatiḥ’ riti paribhāṣayā vārayituṃ
śakyatvāt| tasmāt ṭhupadaṃśaḥ karaṇe’ ityeva brūyā’diti manoramā
cintyetyāhuḥ| vastutastu ‘armaṇiprabhṛtīnyanyatarasyā’mityukte
ṭhupamāne karmaṇi ce’tyataḥ karmaṇītyanuvartya ṭhupadaṃśa’ ityeva
sūtramiti svīkārapakṣe kaṣādiṣu yathāvidhyanuprayogo’pi vikalpena
syāt| maṇḍūakaplutyāśrayaṇaṃ tvagatikagatiḥ| ṭhupadaṃśaḥ karmaṇī’ti
sūtrasvīkārapakṣe’pi ‘ūlakopadaṃśa’miti| ‘araṇe prabhṛtīnī’ti
manaramoktau tu samāsā’bhāvapakṣe ‘ūlakenopadaṃśa’miti

(122) so’padādau |8|3|38|

tvāhuḥ-punarmaṇḍūakapluti vināpyanuvartituṃ śakyaḥ, ṭhvā śarī’tyatra
śarā kharaṃ viśeṣya ‘arrūpe kharī’ti vyākhyāne, ‘upvo’riti
sūtre ‘upvoḥ kharī’ti vyākhyāne ca kṣatyabhāvāditi |

sthānivadbhāva iti grahervihitasya ya iṭ tasya ‘ra’hiti
yathāśrutarūpāśrayaṇe ‘ṛhīta’ ityādāviṭo dīrgho na syāditi
vācyam, aṅgasaṃjñāpravṛtivelāyāṃ yathāśrutarūpasyaiva satvāt|
‘rāhita’mityādau tu naivam| ṭhekāca’ iti samādhānaṃ tu
ṇijbhinnaviṣayakameva, ‘iṣṭhāyāṃ seṭī’ti ṇilope
grāhitamityādāvekāctvānapāyāt| taditthaṃ--
ṭhyaṅlugantāṇṇijantācca yaṅntācca graheriṭaḥ| dvidhā tridhā caturdhā
ca dīrghaprāptiḥ samāhitā’| asyārthaḥ--- yaṅlugantārddīrghe prāpte
samādhānadvayam| graheraṅgāditi vyākhyānamekāca
ityanuvṛttiśceti| ṇijantātu grahisvarūpā’bhāvaḥ,
vihitaviśeṣaṇaṃ, sthānivadbhāvaśceti samādhānatrayam|
yaṅntātsamādhānacatuṣṭayam, ṭhekācaḥ’ityanuvṛtiḥ,
pūrvoktasamādhānatrayaṃ ceti| ajarghā iti| gṛdhu abhikāṅkṣāyām| iha
apadāntasyāpi rephasya ṭhro rī’ti lopo bhavatyeva, tatra
maṇḍūakaplutyā padasyetyanuvartanāt| pāpraṣṭīti| pracccha jñīpsāyām|
ṭhvraśce’ti ṣaḥ| pāpraccchitā| pāpraccchiṣyati| prāpaṣṭua| pāpraṣṭāt|
pāpraṣṭām| pāpraccchatu| pāpraḍḍhi| pāpracchāni| apāpracchīt| apāpraṭ|
apāpraṣṭām| apāpracchuḥ| apāpracchīḥ| apāpraṭ| apāpraṣṭām| apāpraṣṭa|
apāpracccham| apāpracchava| apāpraśma| bhāṣye dhvanitamiti| ‘chāeḥ
śū’ḍiti sūtre bhāṣye kṅdgrihaṇe ‘cchaḥ ṣatvaṃ vaktavya’miti|
ananuvartamāne tvanena cchaḥ śatve kṛte śāntatvādeva ṣo
bhaviṣyatīti praṣṭā praṣṭuamityādisiddhaye vraścādisūtre cchagrahaṇaṃ na
kartavyamiti bhāvaḥ| evaṃ hi vadatā bhāṣyakṛtā ūṭha bhāvibhyo
yaṅluṅnāstītyuktaprāyam| anyathā diveryaṅluki īḍabhāvapakṣe
dedeti dedeṣi ityādau bhāvā’bhāvābhyāṃ mahān viśeṣaḥ syāt|
tatra kṅdgrihaṇānanuvṛtāvūṭhaḥ pravṛtyā dedyoti
dedyoṣītyādirūpaviśeṣalābhāt| tataścaitāvānevetyavakāro
virudhyeta| srivimavyostviti| srivu gatiśoṣaṇayoḥ| mava bandhane|
jāhāmīti| īṭpakṣe jāhayīmi| loṭi jāhayītu| jāhuta|
jāhatāt| jāhatām| jāhayatu| jāhahi| jāhatāt| jāhayāni|
jāhayāva| jāhayāma| laṅ-- ijāhayīt| ajāhat| ajāhatām|
ajāhayuḥ| ajāhayīḥ| ajāhaḥ| ajāhatam| ajāhata|ajāhayam| ajāhāva|
ajāhāma| jāhayyāt| ṭhhmyantakṣaṇe’ti vṛddhiniṣedhaḥ| ajāhayīt|
ajāhayiṣṭām| ajāhayiṣyat| jvaratvara| 
(412) jvaratvarasrivyavimavāmupadhāyāśca |6|4|20|
jvara roge| ñitvarā saṃbhrame| atra vṛtau ‘halādau kṅtī’tyuktiṃ
tatra kṅtītyetidrabhayasakṛtamevetyāha-- kṅtīiti nānuvartata
iti| avatestunīti| ‘varatvare’tyupadhāvakārayorūṭhi guṇe ca kṛte
manpratyayasya ṭilope comiti sidhyatītyarthaḥ| jvarāderudāharaṇaṃ
kvipi jūḥ| jurau| juraḥ| jhalādau tu-- jūrtiḥ| jūrṇaḥ| jūrṇavān|
tvara-- tūḥ| turau| turaḥ| tūrtiḥ| tūrṇaḥ| tūrṇavān| srivi- srūḥ|
sruvau | sruvaḥ| srūtiḥ| avi-- ūḥ| uvau| uvaḥ|ūtiḥ| mava-- mūḥ|
muvau| mūtaḥ| mūtiḥ| māmoṣītyādi| īṭpakṣe māmavīṣi|
māmavīmi| māmavītu| amāmavīt | amāmavīriti bodhyam|
rāllopaḥ| ‘chavoḥ śū’ḍitaścchavorityanuvartate|
kvāvudāharaṇaṃ--tūḥ| turau turaḥ| dhurvī-- dhūḥ| dhurau| dhuraḥ|
murcchā--mūḥ| murau| muraḥ|

(413) na dhātulopa ārddhadhātuke |1|1|4|
na dhātulopaḥ| ārddhadhātuke dhātulopo nāstīti lakṣaṇayā
vyācaṣṭe-- dhātvaṃśeti| yadyapi ‘uriṇo lopaśce’tyauṇādike
rakpratyaye, dhātulopaḥ prasiddhastathāpi prayojanavānaprasiddhaḥ, iṇo
luptatvādeva guṇā’prasaṅgāt| pratyayasanniyogena dhātuvatvaṃ
nāsti| iha dhātorlopo yasminniti bahuvrīhiḥ| viśeṣyaṃ
cārddhadhātukamityāśayenāha-- lopanimite iti| guṇavṛddhī na sta
iti| yadyapi ‘ṅiti ce’ti sūtre ‘aigavāyana’ ityatra guṇaniṣedho
mābhūditi ṭhiglakṣaṇe guṇavṛddhī na sta’ iti vyākhyātaṃ, tathāpi iha
prayojanā’bhāvādaglakṣaṇe iti noktam| dhātviti kim ?| lūñ --
lavitā| pūñ-- pavitā| nanvatrānubandhalopanimitamārddhadhātukaṃ na
bhavatīti dvyaṅgavikalamidamiti cedatrāhuḥ-- dhātugrahaṇe sati
dhātorlopo yasmin iti bahuvrīhilābhālopanimita ityartho
labhyate, tadabhāve tu lope satyārddhadhāṃtuka ityarthāllavitetyādau
doṣaḥ syādeveti| yadā tu lopayatīti lopaḥ, tasmiṃllopanimite
ārddhadhātuke iko guṇavṛddhī na sta iti vyākhyayate tadā dhātugrahaṇaṃ
spaṣṭapratipatyartham| utsṛṣṭānubandhasya dhātutvamiti kaiyaṭādimate
tu dhātulopa ityatra bahuvrīhyāśrayaṇaṃ vināpa# dhātvivayavalope
satyārddhaśabde’ ityasmāt ‘hātorekāca’ iti yaṅ tisya luk|
yaṅntasya dhātutve yaṅe dhātvavayavatvālluptatvāccātrāpi niṣedhaḥ
syātanmābhūditi| nanvatra yaṅluko’naimitikatvādiko
lopanimitaparatvaṃ nāstīti dvyaṅgavikalamiti cet| atrāhuḥ---
ārddhadhātukagrahaṇe sati anyapadārthalābhādbahuvrīhirlabhyate,
tadabhāve tvavayavalope sati guṇavṛddhī na sta ityarthādroravītītyatra
doṣaḥ syādeveti| kecitu dhātuṃ lopayatīti dhātulopaḥ|
‘hralope’ ityatreva ‘armaṇya’ṇityabhyupetya vyadhikaraṇabahuvrīhyāśrayaṇaṃ
vinaiva dhātvayavalopanimite guṇavṛddhī na sta iti vyācakṣate| ika
iti kim ?| rāgaḥ| abhāji| kaṭhghañi ca bhāvakaraṇayo’riti
rañjarnalope kṛte vṛddhiḥ| ṭhabhājī’ ityatra tu ‘hañjeśca ciṇī’ti
nalope vṛddhiḥ| iti neha niṣedha iti| sūtrasyodāharaṇaṃ
tu--loluvaḥ, popuvaḥ, marīmṛja ityādi bodhyam| tatra
lolūyapopūyaśabdābhyāṃ pacādyaci ṭhyaṅe’ci ca’ iti yaṅluki kṛte
acpratyayamāśritya prāpto guṇo niṣidhyate| ‘arīmṛja’ ityatra tu
vṛddhiḥ| nanu lolūyādibhyo’cpratyaye ṭhato lopaḥ’ ityallope
yakārasya ṭhyaṅe’ci ce’ti lukyallopasya
sthānivatvādacpratyayanimitaḥ ‘ārvadhātukārddhadhātukayo’riti
guṇo, ‘ṛjervaddhi’ riti vṛddhiśca na bhavediti kimanena
niṣedhasūtreṇa ?| na caivamapi ‘oluva’ ityādāvuvaiṅ kṛte
laghūpadhaguṇaḥ syātadvāraṇāya niṣedho’yamāvaśyakaḥ| uvaṅ ādiṣṭādacaḥ
pūrvatvena laghūpadhaguṇe kartavye sthānivatvā’bhāvāditi vācyaṃ,
sthānidvārā’nādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvena uvaṅe dṛṣṭatvāt| sthānidvārā
dṛṣṭatve’pi sthānivadbhavatītyetat ‘a padānte’ti sūtre
savarṇagrahaṇena jñāpitam| na hi śiṇḍhaītyatra sthānibhūtādacaḥ
pūrvatvenā’nusvāro dṛṣṭaḥ kiṃ tu sthānidvārā| tathāca anusvārasya
parasavarṇe kartavye śnamo llopasya sthānivatvaniṣedhāya tatra
savarṇagrahaṇaṃ kṛtamitīha sthānivadbhāvaḥ siddhaḥ| nonāvetyatra tu
liḍutpateḥ prāgeva bahulagrahaṇādakāraviśiṣṭasya yaṅe luki
sthānavadbhāvā’prasaktyā na vṛddhyabhāvaśaṅketi ‘a dhātulope’ ti
sūtrasya na kiṃcitprayojanamiti cet| satyam| ata eva bhāṣye
pratyākhyātamidamiti saṃkṣepaḥ| totortīti| yadyapyatra ‘opo
vyo’rityanena valopaḥ sidhyati, tathāpi ‘otūrta’ ityādau
valopārtaṃ ṭhrāllopaḥ’ ityupanyastam| anyathā tatra ‘opo
vyo’riti lopaṃ bādhitvā vasya ‘chavoḥ śū’ḍiti ūṭha syāt|
tothortītyādi| thurvī durvī dhurvī hiṃsāyāmā| murcchā|
mohasamucchrāyayoḥ| momūrcchīṣi| momorṣi| momūrthaḥ|
momūrtha| momūrcchīmi| momormi| momūrcchavaḥ| momūrmaḥ|
momūrcchṃacakāra| momūrccchitā| momūrcchītu| momortu|
momūrtāt| momūrhi| amomūrcchīt| amomoḥ| amomūrcchava |
momūrcchayāt| amomūrccchiṣṭām| amamomūrccchiṣyat|
iti tatvabodhinyām yaṅlugantaprakriyā|
